title: Business Development Associate
description:
Job Title: Business Development Associate

**Company:**
NoBroker

**Department:**
Sales

**Industry:**
Real Estate / PropTech

**Work Location:**
Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR & Chennai

About NoBroker

NoBroker is India's first PropTech unicorn and one of the world's largest brokerage-free real estate platforms. We provide end-to-end real estate solutions, connecting property owners, buyers, and tenants directly without intermediaries. With a strong presence across major Indian cities, we are transforming the real estate industry through technology-driven solutions and customer-centric services.

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented Area Sales Manager to drive sales, manage customer relationships, and maximize revenue within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing qualified leads, guiding prospective homebuyers throughout their property-buying journey, negotiating deals, and ensuring successful closures.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle qualified customer leads through calls, virtual meetings, and face-to-face interactions.
* Understand customer requirements, budget, and preferences to recommend suitable residential properties.
* Conduct property presentations and arrange site visits to drive customer conversions.
* Drive end-to-end sales activities, from lead engagement and follow-ups to negotiation and deal closure.
* Negotiate with prospective buyers and ensure successful deal conversions.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships to generate repeat business and referrals.
* Identify opportunities to cross-sell NoBroker's additional products and services.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and consistently achieve daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
* Monitor local real estate trends, property pricing, competitor activities, and market demand.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth and seamless customer experience.

Eligibility & Requirements

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in Field Sales / Direct Sales / B2C Sales.
* Experience in Real Estate, Banking, Insurance, Automobile, or other sales-driven industries will be preferred.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Proven ability to handle customer objections and close sales.
* Good understanding of the local market and customer preferences.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment.
* Must own a two-wheeler or four-wheeler (preferred).
* Fluency in English, Hindi, and the respective regional language.
* Willingness to work 6 days a week, including weekends.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Field Sales & Business Development
* Real Estate Sales & Market Knowledge
* Customer Relationship Management
* Lead Management & Conversion
* Negotiation & Deal Closure
* Communication & Persuasion Skills
* Customer Handling & Objection Management
* Networking & Relationship Building
* Target Achievement & Revenue Generation
* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with India's first PropTech unicorn.
* Performance-driven work environment.
* Attractive incentives linked to performance.
* Career growth and advancement opportunities.
* Exposure to the fast-growing real estate and PropTech industry.

title: Business Development Executive – Land Acquisition
description:
**We’re Hiring: Business Development Executive – Land Acquisition | IDG**

**📍 Location: Mumbai | 💼 Experience: (3–5) years | 🏢 Industry: Real Estate**

**IDG is a growing real estate developer, and we’re looking for a Business Development professional to find, evaluate and close land deals that will shape our next projects.**

**What you’ll do**

* **Source land deals:**
  Find land parcels and development opportunities through landowners, brokers, channel partners and your own market network.
* **Evaluate deals:**
  Do the feasibility calculations for each deal: land cost, FSI/FAR and buildable area, construction cost, revenue, cash flows, margins and IRR.
* **Structure deals:**
  Assess and negotiate outright purchase, Joint Development (JDA), Joint Venture and revenue or area-sharing models.
* **Make deal presentations:**
  Prepare clear presentations and investment notes covering location, market comparable, financials, risks and a recommendation, then share them with management and the internal team.
* **Do due diligence:**
  Work with the legal, liaison and technical teams on title checks, zoning, approvals and site assessments.
* **Negotiate and close:**
  Lead negotiations with landowners and take deals through to term sheet and agreement.
* **Track the market:**
  Keep up with land prices, upcoming infrastructure, regulatory changes and competitor activity.
* **Keep a deal pipeline:**
  Maintain an up-to-date record of every opportunity and report progress to management regularly.

**What we’re looking for**

* 3–5 years in real estate business development or land acquisition with a developer, land aggregator or real estate advisory firm
* A proven record of sourcing and closing land deals
* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills (feasibility, cash flow, IRR)
* Good PowerPoint and presentation skills
* Working knowledge of land laws, title documents, development control rules and the approval process
* An established network of landowners, brokers and local stakeholders in Mumbai
* Strong negotiation and communication skills, and the ability to work independently
* Education: MBA, B.E./B.Tech (Civil), B.Arch or a related degree preferred

**Why IDG**

* You’ll have direct ownership and visibility, working closely with leadership
* You’ll help build a high-growth project pipeline
* Competitive pay plus performance incentives tied to deal closures

**Salary:**
As per market standard

title: Senior Sales Manager - D2C/Consumer brand
description:
Seeking a Sr. Sales Manager for a D2C brand in Mumbai!

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Business opportunity identification and strategy

· Assess the market, customer needs, competitive landscape and product strengths to identify new business opportunities.

· Recommend and prioritize attractive customer segments, routes to market and partnership models based on revenue potential, scalability and profitability.

· Develop a business plan with market priorities, target customers, commercial assumptions, investment requirements and revenue milestones.

· Build a pipeline of prospective customers and strategic partners, with a structured approach to converting opportunities.

· Continuously evaluate market feedback and refine the business strategy.

2. New business development and partnerships

· Personally identify, approach and build relationships with prospective customers, partners and key decision-makers.

· Lead presentations, proposals, pitches and commercial negotiations through to closure.

· Develop anchor accounts and strategic partnerships that can generate meaningful and recurring business.

· Create tailored commercial propositions based on customer requirements and the brand's capabilities.

· Build a strong network of relevant industry contacts and use it to open new business opportunities.

3. Build the business from the ground up

· Translate the business strategy into an executable go-to-market plan, with clear priorities, milestones and ownership.

· Create the sales playbook, including pitch materials, pricing principles, commercial frameworks, customer onboarding and order processes.

· Establish effective working processes with Operations, Merchandising, Finance and Marketing for order management, stock availability, billing, dispatch, returns and collections.

· Set up a robust pipeline, CRM, reporting and forecasting discipline.

· Identify the resources, systems and capabilities required to support growth, and recommend investments where needed.

4. Commercial and financial ownership

· Own agreed revenue, gross margin and contribution targets for the business vertical.

· Evaluate the commercial viability and profitability of prospective customers and opportunities before committing resources.

· Negotiate pricing, discounts, margins, payment terms and other commercial conditions within approved parameters.

· Monitor invoicing, collections, receivables, returns and credit exposure.

· Ensure that growth is sustainable, profitable and aligned with brand’s commercial objectives.

5. Team building and leadership

· Recommend an appropriate team structure and phased hiring plan based on business strategy and growth requirements.

· Recruit, train, manage and develop a high-performing business development and sales team as the vertical scales.

· Set individual and team targets, account ownership, review mechanisms and performance expectations.

· Coach team members on prospecting, presentations, negotiations, account management and commercial discipline.

· Build a culture of ownership, accountability, customer focus and execution.

6. Account management and business growth

· Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and strategic partners.

· Coordinate with internal teams to deliver a reliable customer experience.

· Resolve commercial and operational issues promptly and protect long-term relationships.

· Drive repeat business, account expansion, referrals and new opportunities within existing relationships.

· Track customer satisfaction and use feedback to improve the proposition and service model.

**Job Qualifications**

· 6
–12 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, key accounts, partnerships, retail or distribution, preferably in a consumer-facing business.

· Demonstrated ability to identify and develop new business opportunities, rather than only manage an inherited customer portfolio.

· Experience building a new business line, channel, territory, customer segment or partnership network from an early stage.

· Evidence of personally winning meaningful new accounts and delivering measurable revenue growth.

· Experience managing commercial negotiations and understanding pricing, margins, payment terms, collections and profitability.

· Experience hiring or leading a team, or the demonstrated ability to build one as the business grows.

· Exposure to apparel, kids wear, lifestyle, fashion, sportswear, FMCG, toys, stationery or other consumer categories will be an advantage.

· Strong market understanding, entrepreneurial thinking, commercial judgement and problem-solving ability.

· Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.

· Comfortable working with Excel, CRM tools, business reports and sales forecasts.

· Self-driven, organized and willing to travel as required.

title: Head of Business Development
description:
**Company Description**

BXI (Barter Exchange of India) is a digital marketplace that modernizes the traditional concept of bartering for contemporary Indian enterprises. The platform enables organizations to use their goods and services as a growth engine by converting inventory into a medium of exchange. BXI connects businesses with 10+ categories of products and services from over 100 trusted brands, facilitating cashless trade. Participating organizations pay with their products for what they need, creating a vibrant business community where reputed companies exchange value efficiently. The model supports smarter resource utilization, cost optimization, and access to new partnerships and markets.

**Head of Sales – Media & Barter Deals**

**Location: Mumbai (Head Office)**

**Budget: 18 LPA + Variable**

**Role Description**

The Head of Business Development is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for driving growth, partnerships, and revenue for BXI. This role involves developing and executing the business development strategy, identifying new market opportunities, and expanding the network of member organizations and brands on the platform. The Head of Business Development will lead sales initiatives, build and manage key accounts, and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure retention and growth.
We are seeking an experienced Head of Sales to lead the Sales & Barter Deals team at BXI – Barter Exchange of India. The role involves managing Pan-India sales operations, driving annual revenue goals, and ensuring strong business governance through P&L, MIS, and reporting.

**Key Responsibilities:**

\* Lead and mentor the Pan-India sales team to achieve revenue targets.

\* Manage P&L, MIS, and business reporting for performance tracking.

\* Build CXO-level relationships and close high-value barter deals across categories: Media, Hotels, Gift Vouchers & Electronics.

\* Represent BXI at national industry forums and networking events.

\* Ensure operational efficiency and day-to-day team performance.

\* Travel across India to support team activities and client engagements.

**Requirements:**

\* Education: MBA preferred.

\* Experience: 8–12 years in Sales / Business Development, including 5+ years in leadership.

\* Proven track record of managing P&L and delivering revenue growth.

\* Strong leadership, client management, and negotiation skills.

\* Strategic thinker with execution focus; open to extensive travel.

**Interested Candidates reach HR at sganiga@bxiworld.com OR Whatsapp 8850732823**

title: Sr. Manager, Strategy and Business Development, APMEA
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY**
:
  
  
This role is responsible for supporting regional strategy formulation and structured deployment of strategic priorities across the six Asia Pacific and Middle East & Africa (APMEA) geographies/countries (Geos). The six Geos include: Japan, Korea & Taiwan, India & South Asia, Southeast Asia, Australia & New Zealand, and Middle East & Africa.
  
  
The role serves as a key contributor of mid to long-range growth strategy, portfolio prioritization, and cross-divisional strategic programs and initiatives. It supports the translation of enterprise priorities into clear investment choices, transformation roadmaps, and execution blueprints. Working closely with the teams based in Geos including commercial, marketing, finance, operations, and global business leaders, the role drives alignment, clarity, and disciplined deployment across geo markets. This individual will partner closely with the Senior Director, Strategy and Business Development, to support APMEA strategic direction and ensure disciplined execution of regional priorities.
  
  
This role requires strong strategic judgment, business development, enterprise thinking, financial acumen, and the ability to influence global and regional stakeholders in a highly matrixed environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Strategic & Annual Planning:**

* Support the end-to-end APMEA strategic planning cycle (STRAP, long-range planning, enterprise portfolio prioritization, AOP) in partnership with the Senior Director, Strategy and Business Development and regional leadership
* Contribute to the development of multi-year APMEA growth strategy and transformation initiatives that reflect unique market opportunities and challenges across the six Geos.

title: AGM- Sales
description:
**Company Description**
The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.
  
  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.
  
  
**Job Description**
Nemetschek India is looking for a high-calibre Senior Account Sales Manager to drive strategic enterprise sales across the Mumbai region, with a sharp focus on positioning the Nemetschek portfolio with CXO and business decision-makers in the top 50 AEC accounts.
  
  
The role is designed for a consultative enterprise seller who can open senior relationships, shape digital transformation conversations, and convert those engagements into pipeline and revenue across large developers, EPCs, architects, consultants, contractors, ESPs and owner organizations. This person will operate as a named-account hunter-farmer for Mumbai’s most strategic accounts, building account plans, orchestrating technical and partner resources, and driving multi-brand opportunities across the Nemetschek ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines strong CXO access, disciplined enterprise sales execution, and enough AEC workflow depth to credibly connect BIM, OpenBIM, collaboration, coordination, constructability, and digital delivery outcomes to business value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic account coverage**

* Own and drive a named list of top 50 strategic AEC accounts in Mumbai and surrounding region, with clear account prioritization, whitespace mapping, and coverage plans.
* Build relationships with CXOs, business heads, design heads, digital transformation leaders, project directors, and procurement stakeholders across target accounts.
* Develop deep account plans that identify business priorities, ongoing projects, organization structure, competitive footprint, partner ecosystem, and multi-brand entry points.

**Enterprise selling and business development**

* Position Nemetschek as a strategic digital transformation partner rather than only a software vendor, articulating business value, ROI, workflow efficiency, collaboration improvement, and lifecycle benefits.
* Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from prospecting and discovery through solution shaping, stakeholder alignment, proposal development, commercial negotiation, and closure.
* Create pipeline across new logos, competitive displacement, cross-sell, upsell, and enterprise standardization opportunities.
* Work closely with pre-sales and channel organization to demonstrate software adoption strategy for multiple teams in large organizations.

**AEC domain engagement**

* OpenBIM, Digital Twin, model-based coordination, and connected project delivery concepts for CXOs and design leaders, while also being able to engage credibly with BIM managers, digital delivery teams, and project users on workflows and file formats.
* Understand how developers, architects, interior designers, landscape designers, engineers, BIM consultants, contractors, and training institutes work together across the building lifecycle.
* Identify lighthouse opportunities in major private and public sector projects, especially where design collaboration, model coordination, compliance, field collaboration, document workflows, or handover use cases are strategic.

**Forecasting and operating discipline**

* Maintain high-quality pipeline hygiene, opportunity qualification, next-step rigor, and forecast accuracy in Salesforce or equivalent CRM.
* Run disciplined weekly reviews on deal progress, decision criteria, stakeholder map, competition, commercial strategy, and close plans.
* Use value-based selling and structured enterprise sales methods such as MEDDPICC / TAS to improve deal quality and predictability.

**Ecosystem and cross-functional collaboration**

* Partner closely with technical pre-sales, marketing, customer success, channel partners, renewals, and leadership to progress strategic opportunities.
* Collaborate with marketing, BD and education teams on executive roundtables, industry events, account-based engagement, and thought-leadership programs.
* Represent Nemetschek externally with credibility at industry forums, associations, and customer events where relevant.

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 10-15 years of experience in technical sales, pre-sales, solution consulting, or solution engineering roles.
* Strong exposure to AEC, BIM, infrastructure, engineering, or construction technology environments and software like Allplan,SDS/2, Archicad, Vector works etc
* Experience in customer-facing solution presentations, workshops, and consultative technical selling.

**Skills And Capabilities**

* Strong understanding of AEC workflows, BIM-led collaboration, and digital transformation challenges across the project lifecycle.
* Ability to connect customer business goals with technical solution value and adoption outcomes.
* Strong presentation, demonstration, and workshop facilitation skills.
* Comfort engaging both executive stakeholders and detailed technical users.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration capability.
* Familiarity with platforms and technologies such as BIM, digital twins, project controls, cloud SaaS, interoperability, and workflow integration.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience with enterprise software vendors serving AEC, infrastructure, engineering, or construction customers.
* Exposure to consultative selling in complex multi-stakeholder environments.
* Experience working with strategic accounts, ecosystem partners, and enterprise bid cycles.

title: Business Development Executive – Higher Education Partnerships
description:
Prosperion Consulting is a Mumbai-based advisory firm working with businesses and higher education institutions on growth, strategy and performance improvement.

We have entered a strategic collaboration with UniQuest, UK, part of the Keystone Education Group, to introduce its student engagement, admissions management and enrolment conversion services to higher education institutions in India.

UniQuest works with universities internationally to improve the student journey, from initial enquiry and admissions processing to enrolment conversion and student retention. Its services combine experienced higher education professionals, technology, data analytics and AI-enabled student engagement.

We are looking for a Business Development Executive to help establish and grow this business in India.

**About the Role**

The role involves identifying prospective university and college partners, building relationships with senior institutional decision-makers and developing qualified business opportunities for UniQuest's services.

The person will work closely with Prosperion's leadership team and coordinate with UniQuest's UK team to develop the Indian market.

The initial geographical focus will be 
**Mumbai and Pune**
, followed by other parts of 
**Maharashtra, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh**
, with opportunities for expansion into other Indian markets.

This is a relationship-driven, consultative business development role requiring an understanding of how higher education institutions operate, particularly their admissions, student recruitment and enrolment challenges.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Development and Institutional Relationships**

* Identify and approach private universities, deemed universities, autonomous colleges and other higher education institutions.
* Establish relationships with university promoters, Vice-Chancellors, Registrars, Directors of Admissions, Marketing Heads and other senior decision-makers.
* Arrange and conduct introductory meetings to understand institutional requirements and present relevant UniQuest services.
* Identify opportunities where institutions could benefit from improved enquiry management, admissions processing, student engagement, enrolment conversion and retention.
* Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective institutional partners.

**Market Development**

* Research and map the higher education market across designated territories, identifying institutions with strong potential for engagement.
* Monitor developments in university admissions, student recruitment practices, institutional competition and changing enrolment patterns.
* Support market awareness and promotional activities for UniQuest's services in India.
* Participate in relevant conferences, institutional meetings and networking events.

**Opportunity Development and Coordination**

* Assess prospective clients' requirements and qualify business opportunities.
* Coordinate meetings, presentations and discussions between institutional stakeholders and UniQuest's commercial team.
* Support follow-up discussions and facilitate the progression of opportunities towards formal engagement.
* Maintain accurate records of institutional contacts, discussions, opportunities and follow-up actions.
* Work with Prosperion's leadership and UniQuest's team to review business development progress and priorities.

**Relationship Management**

* Maintain relationships with prospective and existing institutional partners.
* Serve as a local point of contact and facilitate communication between Indian institutions and UniQuest.
* Identify opportunities for expanding relationships and introducing additional services.

**Candidate Profile**

**Essential Requirements**

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in business development, institutional sales, key account management or partnerships.
* Experience selling services or solutions to higher education institutions in India.
* Good understanding of the Indian higher education sector and its institutional decision-making processes.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior university and college leadership.
* Strong communication, presentation, relationship-building and follow-up skills.
* Self-motivated, organised and comfortable working in a business development role with defined targets.
* Based in Mumbai or willing to relocate.
* Willingness to travel regularly within the assigned territories.

**Preferred Experience**

* Existing relationships with universities and colleges in Maharashtra, Gujarat or Madhya Pradesh.
* Experience with education services companies, EdTech businesses, education marketing platforms, student recruitment companies or higher education consulting firms.
* Previous experience working with organisations such as Shiksha, Collegedunia, Careers360 or similar institutional service providers.
* Familiarity with university admissions, student acquisition, lead management, CRM systems and enrolment conversion.
* Experience working with international education companies or service providers.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to build a growing higher education services business in India.
* Exposure to international practices in student engagement, admissions and enrolment management.
* Direct interaction with Prosperion's leadership and UniQuest's international team.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunities for professional growth as the business expands.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates may apply through email by sending their CV to 
**info@prosperionconsulting.com**
 with the subject line:

**Application – Business Development Manager, Higher Education Partnerships**

Candidates are encouraged to briefly highlight their experience in institutional business development and their existing relationships within the higher education sector.

title: Terriotry Sales Manager_MBA fresher - 4 Yrs
description:
**Company Description**
NoBrokerHood is a technologically advanced visitor, community, and finance & asset management platform designed to make life secure and convenient for gated societies. Launched in 2018 as a subsidiary of NoBroker—India’s first prop-tech unicorn—it has rapidly grown to manage over 25,000 societies and serve more than 4.8 million families across the country. The platform provides tailored interfaces for society administrators, management committees, security staff, and residents, along with services such as home maintenance and property rental or sale. NoBrokerHood also enables revenue-generating opportunities for societies and partner businesses through its Monetisation and Marketplace features. Backed by a recent $5 million investment from Google, it is the only community management app with Level 1 PCI-DSS, GDPR, PDPB 2019, and ISO 27001 certifications, ensuring high standards of data security and privacy.
  
**Role Description**
The Territory Sales Manager (MBA fresher – up to 4 years of experience) will be responsible for driving business growth for NoBrokerHood within assigned areas in Navi Mumbai. This full-time, on-site role involves identifying and engaging potential housing societies, conducting meetings and product demonstrations with management committees, and managing the end-to-end sales cycle from lead generation to closure. The role includes building and maintaining strong client relationships, coordinating with internal teams for smooth onboarding, and ensuring customer satisfaction post-implementation. The Territory Sales Manager will also analyze market trends, track sales performance, prepare regular reports, and contribute to local sales strategies while representing NoBrokerHood professionally in the field.
  
**Qualifications**

* Educational background: MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 0–4 years of experience in sales, business development, or client-facing roles, preferably in SaaS, prop-tech, or community management solutions.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence decision-makers in residential societies.
* Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships, manage multiple stakeholders, and handle on-site meetings independently.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to understand customer needs and propose suitable solutions.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint), and digital communication platforms for reporting and client engagement.
* Self-motivated, target-driven, and able to work in a fast-paced, field-oriented environment in Navi Mumbai.
* Proficiency in English and local languages; familiarity with the Navi Mumbai real estate or society ecosystem is an advantage.

The company is known for combining heritage craftsmanship with contemporary design and serves premium residential, hospitality, and commercial spaces through customized carpet and rug solutions. Position Summary

The Business Development Manager – Hospitality & Commercial will drive business growth for Obeetee’s hospitality and commercial segment in Chennai and South India. **Inside Sales Specialist – Education Programs**

Preference will be given to candidates living within approximately 3 km of the office. Candidates who can reliably manage the daily commute are also welcome.

**About DVA Baking Academy**

Dipti Vartak Academy helps aspiring and existing home bakers develop their baking skills and build their baking businesses through online programs, practical learning and a supportive community.

**About the Role**

You will primarily follow up with people who have attended DVA’s webinars but have not yet purchased.

* Typically make 50+ outbound calls daily, aiming to connect with 20–25 prospects. Understand their goals, needs and readiness to join.

* Manage your sales pipeline and work towards agreed conversion and revenue targets, alongside calling and follow-up expectations.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, conversation notes, lead statuses and callback dates so that no assigned follow-up is missed.
* Coordinate with support and operations for a smooth handover after enrolment, and share recurring objections and lead feedback to improve the sales process.

**What we are looking for**

* Relevant experience in inside sales, telesales, admissions counselling or other customer-facing sales roles, with evidence of converting enquiries into sales.
* Clear spoken and written communication, strong listening skills and the ability to handle objections confidently and respectfully.
* Comfort with regular outbound calling, sales targets, rejection and persistent professional follow-up.
* Good organisation and familiarity with CRM systems or sales-tracking tools.
* Ownership of results, openness to feedback and willingness to learn DVA’s programs and processes.

Experience selling education, coaching or training programs, and communicating with aspiring entrepreneurs or home-business owners, will be an advantage.

We value honest communication, realistic expectations and helping prospects make informed decisions.

To Apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. Include a brief summary of what you have sold, the customers you served and the sales results you personally achieved.

* Negotiation and influencing skills
* Commercial acumen
* Key account management
* Market analysis
* Relationship building
* Cross-cultural communication
* Leadership and team development

* Contribution margin improvement
* New business wins

title: Founder's Office, Growth
description:
**Founder’s Office, Growth | Nagarkot Forwarders | Mumbai (Chembur)**

**Most Founder’s Office roles give you a seat near decisions. This one gives you a function to build.**

**Nagarkot Forwarders has cleared cargo at Mumbai’s ports and airport since 1988. We handle 15,000+ containers a year for companies like BMW, Skoda, Lamborghini, Abbott and B. Braun, with a team of 150+, and we run our operations on technology we’ve built in-house.**

**We’re now expanding our Growth team, and we’re looking for someone to help shape how it works and scale it.**

**What you’ll work on**

* Build and run structured outreach to importers and overseas partners, covering target lists, sequences, channels, follow-ups and tracking.
* Run outreach and attend client meetings yourself. The best sales systems are designed by people who have used them.
* Test what converts by comparing messages, sectors, channels and offers, and act on the results.
* Work with our in-house tech team to build BD workflows, reporting and tools.
* Take on cross-functional projects as they come up, whether in operations, pricing, a new service line or a new sector.
* Help hire and onboard new BD team members

**Who thrives here**

Someone who would rather build something rough that works than polish a deck. Some of our most important functions are led by people who learned the job by doing it. We hire for judgement and ownership, not for the right degree.

**You’ll fit well if you have:**

* 2 to 5 years of work experience, with real exposure to BD, sales, growth or a Founder’s Office role.
* A track record you can put numbers on: pipeline built, deals closed, processes you set up that others still use.
* Daily use of AI tools for research, writing and analysis.
* Clear writing, and comfort talking to a plant head one hour and a junior ops executive the next.
* No logistics background needed. You’ll learn customs and freight on the job, alongside our operations teams.

**What you get**

* Ownership of a function at a 38-year-old company, without startup runway risk.
* Exposure to how a logistics business actually runs, from port examinations to pricing to client escalations.
* A role that grows with the team you build.

**Location:**
 work from office, every working day, at Chembur, Mumbai.

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
The Key Account Manager – Immunology is a target-carrying account owner responsible for launching and scaling the Tremfya franchise (PSO, PsA / psoriatic disease and the emerging IBD opportunity) across government / institutional reimbursed accounts. The role follows a focused launch-and-scale model: establish IL-23 leadership in high-readiness accounts, convert accessible patient pools into treated and continued patients.
  
  
Central access creation (Rate Contracts, registrations, listings, GTE and tenders) is owned by the Central Account Team; the incumbent facilitates that access at account level and converts it into procurement and reimbursed sales. Launch priority accounts are Army, CGHS and Railways,expanding to ESI, States, Autonomous institutes and PSU as the business scales. The unifying discipline is: Map deeply → Facilitate access → Shape protocol & biologic sequencing → Identify opportunity pool.
  
  
**Major Duties & Responsibilities**
In order of importance, briefly describe, in sentence form, the major responsibilities of this position as it exists today. Describe the job, not the person in the job. Each item should be a major responsibility, not a day-to-day activity. Typically no more than seven or eight major responsibilities ranked in order of highest percentage time to least.
  
  
**Approximate**
**Major Duties / Responsibilities**
Reimbursed Business Delivery & Tremfya Commercial Ownership
  
  

* Accountable for achieving Tremfya reimbursed sales targets (PSO, PsA and IBD SKUs) in assigned accounts, in line with the RB incentive plan
* Own the account outcome: grow account budget share and drive quarter-on-quarter reimbursed growth.
* Ensure accurate demand forecasting, order fulfilment coordination and timely account receivables in partnership with the Value and Supply teams.
* Map each account end-to-end — PsD / IBD patient pool, treating specialists, formulary and access status — and build a prioritized 360° launch account plan.
* Apply account-archetype logic: Army (early adoption / biologic leadership), CGHS (referral roadmap + formulary), Railways (scalable platform), ESI (future pathway), Autonomous / State (setting pathway and discussions for Franchise (Product promotion) & Medical Team for advocacy & protocol inclusion)

Facilitate Access & Navigate Reimbursement Pathways
  
  

* Facilitate the Value Team’s central access (Army RC, CGHS listing, Railway AMI/registration, GTE inclusion) at account level via account intelligence, documentation and ground follow-up — the KAM facilitates and utilises access .
* Navigate account-specific approval and procurement processes (e.g., Army MMF / PVMS, CGHS STC / non-STC, local-purchase routes) to minimise access-to-treatment timelines.

Value, Influence, Stakeholder Orchestration & Compliance
  
  

* Deliver the differential IL-23 value proposition vs IL-17 / anti-TNF competition, engage KOLs and government decision networks, and build advocacy for formulary and protocol inclusion .
* Act as cross-functional ‘quarterback’ across Medical, Franchise and Value; ensure ethical, compliant engagement and adherence to SOPs on tender interactions and HCC.

**Quality, Regulatory & Compliance (QRC) Responsibilities**

Our mission is to make travel more experiential, accessible, and memorable. We value creativity, flexibility, ownership, and a passion for exploration.

This is a full-time remote role with a primary focus on travel operations, itinerary planning, destination research, vendor coordination, and CRM management. The role will also involve handling customer inquiries, managing WhatsApp communications, making follow-up calls, and assisting with sales conversions.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing multiple responsibilities, communicating with customers and vendors, taking ownership of tasks, and ensuring that travel-related information and operations run smoothly.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Travel Operations & Itinerary Planning (Primary Responsibility)

\* Research domestic and international destinations, attractions, experiences, accommodation, and transportation options.

\* Create detailed and customised travel itineraries based on customer requirements and company trip offerings.

\* Research hotels and properties, compare rates, amenities, room categories, availability, and booking policies.

\* Coordinate with hotels through phone calls, WhatsApp, and emails to collect quotations and relevant information.

\* Communicate with local vendors, activity providers, transport operators, and other travel partners.

\* Collect and compare quotations for accommodation, activities, transportation, and other travel services.

\* Assist in preparing trip costing and customer quotations.

\* Coordinate with the internal team to ensure smooth planning and execution of trips.

\* Identify operational gaps and proactively raise questions or concerns before they become problems.

2. Sales & Customer Communication (Secondary Responsibility)

\* Respond promptly to incoming customer inquiries through WhatsApp and phone calls.

\* Handle customer conversations professionally and understand their travel preferences, requirements, and budgets.

\* Make outbound calls and regularly follow up with prospective customers.

\* Share itineraries, quotations, trip details, and relevant information with customers.

\* Follow up with interested leads and assist in converting inquiries into confirmed bookings.

\* Keep customers updated regarding bookings, payments, and travel arrangements.

\* Escalate customer queries or operational concerns to the relevant team members whenever required.

\* Maintain updated customer communication and follow-up records in the CRM.

3. Coordination & Administration

\* Coordinate between customers, hotels, vendors, and the internal team.

\* Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and follow-ups.

\* Take ownership of pending tasks and proactively communicate delays or dependencies.

\* Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.

\* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

\* Confident in making phone calls and communicating with customers, hotels, and vendors.

\* Strong research skills and the ability to create practical travel itineraries.

\* Good follow-up habits and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

\* Comfortable managing multiple WhatsApp conversations and responding promptly during working hours.

\* Proficiency in Google Sheets, Google Docs, Excel, and online research tools.

\* Familiarity with CRM platforms is an advantage.

\* Ability to work independently and take ownership in a remote environment.

\* Interest in travel, tourism, backpacking, adventure travel, and offbeat destinations.

\* Prior experience in travel operations, hospitality, customer service, or sales will be preferred.

Candidates from Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, Business Management, and related backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

\* Position: Travel Operations & Sales Executive

\* Employment Type: Full-time

\* Work Mode: Remote / Work From Home

\* Working Hours: 10 hours per day

\* Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and suitability.

\* Joining: Immediate

title: Brand Deals Executive.
description:
Brand Deals Executive
  
  
The Perfume Vault | Independent Fragrance Content Creator
  
  
About the role
  
  
I am an independent content creator who creates content around perfumes and the fragrance industry.
  
  
I currently have around 32,000 followers on Instagram and 6,000 subscribers on YouTube. I have also recently started a fragrance focused podcast.
  
  
I am looking for someone who can work directly with me and help bring paid brand collaborations and business opportunities for my social media platforms and podcast.
  
  
This is an individual working role. You will be working directly with me, not joining a marketing agency or a large company.
  
  
What will you be responsible for?
  
  
1. Bringing Brand Collaborations
  
  
- Find Indian and international perfume and fragrance brands that are interested in working with content creators.
  
- Approach brands and bring paid collaboration opportunities.
  
- Focus mainly on long-term partnerships and monthly deals rather than just one-time reel collaborations.
  
- Build good relationships with brands for future collaborations.
  
  
2. Contacting Brands and Closing Deals
  
  
- Find the right people to contact, such as marketing managers, brand managers, founders and other decision-makers.
  
- Reach out to them through email, LinkedIn, Instagram or other suitable channels.
  
- Introduce my content and explain why brands should work with me.
  
- Handle conversations, follow-ups and price negotiations.
  
- Take responsibility for finalising deals and bringing paid work.
  
  
3. Finding Guests for the Podcast
  
  
- Find interesting people from the fragrance industry for podcast appearances.
  
- Connect with perfume brand founders, perfumers, fragrance experts and other relevant personalities.
  
- Contact them, explain the podcast and coordinate their appearance on the show.
  
  
4. Bringing Podcast Sponsors
  
  
- Find perfume and fragrance-related brands that could sponsor the podcast.
  
- Approach potential sponsors and discuss paid sponsorship opportunities.
  
- Negotiate and finalise sponsorship deals.
  
- Look for long-term podcast sponsorships.
  
  
Who am I looking for?
  
  
- Someone with experience in influencer marketing, brand collaborations or bringing brand deals to individual content creators.
  
- Someone who understands how to approach brands and reach the right decision-makers.
  
- Someone who has experience communicating with brands, negotiating prices and closing paid deals.
  
- Someone with good contacts in perfume, grooming, lifestyle or related industries.
  
- Someone who can independently handle the work instead of waiting for instructions every day.
  
- Good communication and negotiation skills are important.
  
  
Important: I am particularly interested in someone who has worked with individual content creators and helped them get paid brand collaborations. Experience working only in an agency or handling large influencer campaigns is not enough by itself.
  
  
Work Details
  
  
- Work Type: Full-time
  
- Work Setup: Remote
  
- Working Directly With: Independent Content Creator
  
- Salary: ₹30,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience.
  
- Additional Incentives: Can be discussed based on performance.
  
- Experience: Prior relevant experience preferred.
  
  
One important thing
  
  
I am not looking for someone whose only job is to send emails or messages to brands.
  
  
I am looking for someone who can take responsibility for finding opportunities, contacting the right people, negotiating, closing paid deals and helping grow The Perfume Vault and its podcast.
  
  
If you have the experience and confidence to bring actual business, I would love to hear from you.
  
  
To apply: Please share your experience in influencer marketing or brand collaborations, examples of deals you have personally helped close.

title: Co-Founder Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Job Description: Co-Founder & Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) – India

Role Type: Executive Co-Founder / Founding Commercial Leader

Engagement Model: Founding Commercial Partnership (Expense Reimbursement + Success Commission + Equity Grant)

Core 90-Day Mission: Sales Closer — Secure 2 to 3 Paying Client Logos

Location: India (Remote / Field-based with local & intercity travel)

Reporting To: Board of Directors / Co-Founders

Executive Overview

Nonashield is seeking an execution-driven Co-Founder & Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) – India to join our founding team as our primary Sales Closer. In this high-impact co-founding role, your singular focus over the first 90 days will be to validate our commercial offering by originating, managing, and closing 2 to 3 enterprise client logos.

This position is structured as a Founding Commercial Partnership. Designed for a hands-on commercial leader with proven enterprise deal-closing ability, this role offers high commercial upside and co-founder equity ownership tied directly to customer acquisition and revenue collection.

 Primary 90-Day Mandate & Target

 Core Goal: Convert enterprise prospects into 2 to 3 signed, paying client logos within the 90-day validation period.

 Execution Focus: Drive rapid discovery, proof-of-value (PoV) trials, proposal delivery, and commercial negotiations to finalize paid contracts.

 Founder Alignment: Leverage dedicated technical, product, and proposal support from the founding team to accelerate deal cycles and overcome client objections.

 Core Responsibilities

 1. Enterprise Sales Closing & Pipeline Origination

 Originate, qualify, and lead high-priority enterprise opportunities across target sectors in India.

 Drive complete deal lifecycles from initial contact through executive presentations, commercial negotiations, and contract sign-off.

 Position Nonashield’s value proposition directly to $CXOs$, Heads of Procurement, and key technical decision-makers to secure fast commercial commitment.

 2. Deal Execution & Proof-of-Value Management

 Structure and manage targeted proof-of-value (PoV) or pilot programs designed to convert into multi-year production accounts.

 Partner with technical co-founders to align technical solutions with client business objectives.

 Ensure clear commercial terms, payment schedules, and onboarding pathways for all new client logos.

 3. Account Governance & Commercial Pipeline Tracking

 Maintain rigorous CRM tracking across all active account stages, deal values, and closing timelines.

 Operate within pre-approved customer acquisition budgets and account development logistics.

 Feed real-time client feedback back to the product and executive teams to optimize pricing and proposal win rates.

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

 30-Day Milestone: Identify and qualify top 10 target accounts; establish active discovery and demonstration meetings with at least 5 decision-makers.

 60-Day Milestone: Advance 3 to 5 qualified opportunities into active PoV/pilot trials or final commercial proposal negotiations.

 90-Day Milestone: Successfully close and secure initial revenue collection from 2 to 3 enterprise client logos.

 Candidate Qualifications & Profile

 Proven Deal Closer: 8–15+ years of enterprise commercial experience with a track record of personally closing complex B2B SaaS, deep-tech, or enterprise solution deals in India.

 Execution-Minded: Highly outcome-oriented with the grit to navigate short, intense closing cycles in an early-stage startup environment.

 Enterprise Network: Strong existing network of corporate decision-makers, buyers, and channel partners across India.

 Negotiation & Deal Structuring: Strong skills in navigating enterprise procurement, legal reviews, and contract finalization.

 Communication: Exceptional storytelling, presentation, and executive relationship management skills.

 Commercial Structure & Compensation Framework

This position is structured as a Founding Commercial Partnership with Expense Reimbursement, Success-Based Commission, and Co-Founder Equity Participation. At this stage, Nonashield prioritizes market validation and client acquisition.

 1. Initial 90-Day Validation Period

 Fixed Retainer/Salary: None during the initial 90-day validation period, unless separately agreed in writing.

 Co-Founder Support: Dedicated technical, product, proposal, demonstration, and executive co-founder meeting support for qualified enterprise opportunities.

 Milestone Reviews: Formal reviews at Day 30, 60, and 90 evaluating pipeline velocity and deal progress toward the 2–3 logo objective.

 2. Expense Reimbursement

Reimbursement covers reasonable, necessary, and pre-approved expenses directly linked to documented customer acquisition and business development activities.

 3. Revenue Commission Structure

 Commission is payable exclusively on net customer revenue actually received by Nonashield, directly originating from and materially managed by the CRO.

 Commission Schedule: Commission rates, payment timelines, renewal terms, channel partner splits, founder-assisted attribution, tax withholdings, and refund/cancellation policies will be established in a separate Commission Schedule.

 Commission calculations account for deal margins, contract sizing, customer acquisition costs, sales-cycle length, and whether accounts are self-generated or co-founder-assisted.

 4. Co-Founder Equity & Vesting

 Grant Eligibility: Unlocked upon successful completion of the initial 90-day period and delivery of the 2 to 3 paying client logos mandate.

 Vesting Schedule: Co-founder equity grant subject to a 3-year vesting schedule linked to continued service and defined commercial performance milestones.

 Scope: Equity allocations reflect true co-founder status—building a repeatable revenue engine and securing early production accounts unlocks meaningful founding-tier equity ownership.

title: Senior Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
**Your Impact**
As a Sr Solution Consultant, you will partner with AspenTech sales teams during the sales cycle to lead in the consultative discovery process with customers; craft a vision and roadmap of a solution that addresses customer requirements; identify differentiated value capture potential; and design an implementation/sustainment program for that solution. This involves maintaining a keen understanding of AspenTech’s product strategy; our value enablers; the execution capabilities of our professional services team and those of our partners; and of the sales pipeline to drive opportunities where AspenTech solutions can bring significant business value to our customers and to AspenTech.
  
  
The Sr Solution Consultant is responsible for delivering high quality solutions and business outcomes based on existing AspenTech products. Demonstrating deep knowledge of the solutions and offerings, capable of contributing to the design of a complete solution across the entire lifecycle of a project - from pre-sales through design and delivery of the solution - the Solution Consultant drives transformational results and realizes business strategy for AspenTech customers.
  
  
This is a customer-facing role that requires self-motivated individuals with excellent business, industry and technical knowledge, along with strong consultative and communication skills to position AspenTech solutions and services with our customers.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, with a proven track record in software / technology sales / consulting. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to this role.
  
  
**Role Details**

* Develop industry- and application-specific solutions for the customer. This is a very customer-facing position that will have you leading value discovery customer sessions, assessing customer needs, and developing solutions.
* Determine and understand prospective customers’ critical business issues in order to present and demonstrate AspenTech’s software capabilities as the best possible solution to win the business.
* Build customer-specific solutions on the AspenTech platform using all the available tool options.
* Develop robust recommendations, proposals and scope of work documents for AspenTech Consulting engagements, while also identifying critical dependencies & gaps.
* Consult with customers and advise on relevant AspenTech solutions and services and establish a credible value proposition.
* Develop & execute sales campaigns and plans together with the Sales teams.
* Work with the Sales team to identify and qualify business opportunities; identify key customer technical challenges; and develop solutions to meet business needs.
* Proactively support pipeline development (e.g. marketing, account planning, awareness sessions, etc.) and sales execution (e.g. strategy for accounts and opportunities, including commercial model conversion, deal models, and Business Requirement Plans) in assigned accounts and opportunities.

What You'll Need
  
  

* Proven experience within consulting, pre-sales, professional services consulting or process industry verticals such as Energy, Petro chemicals, bulk or specialty chemicals.
* Candidates will have a strong understanding of manufacturing economics, with an ability to interact with potential customers and talk knowledgeably about their plants, work processes, and manufacturing economics.
* Technology specialization in one or more of the areas of focus for Aspentech such as:
* Process Engineering
* Manufacturing Supply Chain – Planning and Scheduling
* Advanced process control and optimization
* Predictive Maintenance
* IT/OT real-time Digital infrastructure modernization
* Strong drive to solve customer problems and rapidly convert pipeline opportunities into closed deals.
* Balance of business and technology acumen, including ability to articulate high-level technical solutions to business problems and the differentiated value those solutions can provide.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills, including ability to create clear observations, analyses and conclusions based on customer interviews and data.
* Ability to travel approximately 40%, including domestic and international travel to support customer engagements.

Candidates with similar skills or experiences may be considered and training may be offered where needed. Applicants will be reviewed for this position as well as similar roles with varying skill requirements and/or years of experience.

title: Sales & Channel Partnerships Manager
description:
**Sales & Channel Partnerships Manager**

Mumbai (hybrid, frequent travel) · Full-time · Reccy Adventures Pvt Ltd

**About Reccy**

Reccy is on a mission to "Inspire Every Indian to GET OUT." We design high-performance outdoor apparel and gear for Indian conditions, built on more than 30 years of mountaineering experience.

**The role**

Reccy sells mainly through our own website, and we already have an early offline and marketplace business: a handful of retail partners, institutional orders and our first marketplace listings. It works, but it's small. We're hiring someone to scale it into a meaningful, profitable part of the business across offline retail, institutional buyers and new marketplaces in India and abroad.

**This is not an inbound-sales role.**
You'll be expected to find, pitch and close new partners, then make them work: sell-through, reorders and payments. You'll report directly to the CEO.

**What success looks like in 12 months**

•    A growing network of retail partners across key cities who reorder regularly without being chased

•    At least one new marketplace or international channel, starting with the UAE, live and contributing real revenue

•    A base of institutional and bulk accounts (trekking companies, outdoor clubs, corporates, schools) that place repeat orders

•    Offline and new channels grown into a significant share of Reccy's revenue, at a healthy contribution margin

**What you'll do**

***Build new channels***

•    Find, pitch and sign outdoor and sports retailers, multi-brand stores and franchise partners across India

•    Win bulk and institutional customers: trekking agencies, outdoor clubs, corporates and educational institutions

•    Launch Reccy on new marketplaces and in new countries, starting with the UAE. You'll own each launch from first conversation to listing, pricing, logistics and ongoing performance.

***Make partners successful***

•    Plan each partner's assortment and stock levels, train their staff and support visual merchandising

•    Track sell-through and drive reorders, and step in early when a partner is slowing down

•    Negotiate commercial terms (margins, consignment versus outright purchase, credit, returns) that work for both sides

***Own the numbers***

•    Run the channel pipeline and report on revenue, margin, receivables and partner health

•    Work with the operations, e-commerce and brand teams on supply, fulfilment and marketing support for partners

•    Represent Reccy at selected outdoor events and trade shows where they lead to partnerships

**Must-haves**

•    5+ years in B2B, channel or distribution sales, ideally in apparel, footwear, sporting goods, consumer goods or D2C brands

•    A track record of building a retail or distribution network from scratch, with real revenue numbers you can talk through

•    Experience negotiating trade terms and managing receivables and returns with retailers or distributors

•    Comfortable with numbers: you think in margins, sell-through and payback, not just order value

•    Willing to travel extensively

**Strong advantages**

•    Experience with marketplaces or distributors in the UAE or the wider Gulf (GCC)

•    An existing network in outdoor, sports or adventure retail

•    You spend your own time trekking, climbing, running or cycling

**What we offer**

•    Competitive fixed compensation

•    Performance-linked incentives tied to channel revenue and margin

•    Performance-linked ESOPs

•    Direct access to the founders, real ownership, and the chance to take Reccy's offline and marketplace business to the next level

**How to apply**

**Applications without the video won't be reviewed.**
Send a video of up to 3 minutes, filmed on your phone (no editing needed), covering:

1.  
**A channel you built from zero.**
Which channel was it, how did you land the first partner, and what were the numbers 12 months later? What didn't work?

2.  
**Where you would start.**
Which channel or partner would you go after first for Reccy, and why?

Email the link to jobs@reccy.co with "Channel Partnerships Manager – [Your Name]" in the subject line, or add it to your LinkedIn application.

Application deadline: November 30, 2026.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Shortlisted candidates will be given a short field assignment.

*Ready to help India GET OUT? We'd love to hear from you.*

title: Sales Manager, Pharma Asia Pacific
description:
**About Ingredion:**

Join Ingredion, where innovation impacts lives worldwide! Without even realizing it, you’ve experienced our work in your favorite chocolate, your pet’s food, the paper you write on, and your everyday snacks. As a global powerhouse across more than 60 industries, we harness the potential of natural ingredients to transform lives. Whether you’re just starting your career or bringing years of experience, there’s a place for you here to make a real difference. Be part of our team that values a wide range of perspectives and is committed to shaping a better world with every product we create.

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid (regular travel across India and Asia Pacific)

Lead the growth of Ingredion’s Pharma and Nutraceutical Excipients business across Asia Pacific. Help pharma formulators across the region bring better products to market with the right ingredient solutions.

As a
**Sales Manager, Pharma Asia Pacific**
, you will set and deliver Ingredion’s Pharma growth strategy across the region. You will work closely with the commercial, regulatory, technical, marketing, product management and supply chain teams to grow strategic customers, win new business and deliver profitable growth. This role reports to the General Manager India, Bangladesh & Sri Lanka and Texture Solutions Lead, Pharma APAC, with a dotted line to the Senior Director, Commercial Pharma, Beauty & Home. You will lead a team of three Key Account Managers covering India, Bangladesh & Sri Lanka, North Asia, and ASEAN & ANZ.

**What you will do:**

* Define and deliver the regional growth strategy, building a pipeline of new projects with existing customers and winning new accounts
* Lead country-by-country planning with the Global team, taking into account market dynamics, competitors and the regulatory framework
* Manage strategic accounts for profitable growth through new opportunities, margin growth and price management. Build relationships across customers’ R&D, Production, Quality and Regulatory teams
* Work with portfolio management, marketing, regulatory and applications teams to bring customer-focused solutions to pharma formulators. Share market trends and opportunities that strengthen Ingredion’s specialty position
* Build a Pharma and Nutra distributor network across the region, set goals and drive growth in penetration, sales and margin
* Oversee pricing and contracts so they deliver value to customers and competitive margins for Ingredion
* Lead and develop the Pharma Sales team across Asia Pacific, and build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders

**What you will bring:**

* Technical degree in Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutics or a related field
* 12–15 years of experience in B2B technical sales, business development and commercial leadership in Pharma API, Excipients or Biopharma
* Proven team management experience. Regional (APAC) experience and an understanding of industrial pharma processes and formulations are a plus
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Fluent English, written and spoken, and the ability to travel regularly within India and across Asia Pacific

**Who you are:**

* Growth-oriented and passionate about business development, with a track record of opening up accounts through cross-functional teams
* Focused on performance and on delivering your commitments
* An analytical decision-maker who uses data and customer and market intelligence to make smart judgements
* Culturally aware and comfortable working across functions, geographies and backgrounds
* Transparent and collaborative, and willing to challenge norms and raise issues that block progress

**Why Join Ingredion?**

Discover why Ingredion is the ideal place to advance your career with our exceptional rewards and benefits package designed to help you thrive. Create the future with us and enjoy:

* Total Rewards Package – Competitive salary and performance-based pay recognizing your contributions to our success
* Comprehensive Benefits & Wellness Support – Health, long-term savings, and resources for your physical, mental, and emotional well-being
* Flexible Work Arrangements – We value flexibility to support you both professionally and personally
* Career Growth – Learning, training, and development opportunities
* Employee Recognition Program – A culture of real-time appreciation, with personalized recognition rewards globally
* Employee Referral Program – Refer top talent and earn a bonus if they’re hired
* Relocation Support – Available for candidates relocating within India
