title: Senior VP Business Development NRI
description:
****Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.****
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
We’re currently seeking an experienced professional to join
**IWPB – International Corridors**
.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, focused on positioning HSBC as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story and bringing the full scale of its global capabilities to India.
  
  
The Senior VP Business Development NRI will be responsible for managing the Business Development desk and implementing key business initiatives that contribute towards delivering the O/I AOP. The role will focus on growing the Overseas Indian customer base by developing external partnerships, strengthening internal collaboration and delivering cross-border propositions across priority markets.
  
  
The role holder will work closely with Group International, HBAP INM, local IWPB teams and key priority markets, including the UK, Canada, MENAT, Singapore, Hong Kong, the USA and Australia. The role will also support the delivery of international education and wealth solutions within the applicable regulatory and cross-border framework.
  
  
****Principal Responsibilities****
The primary responsibilities of the Senior VP Business Development NRI will include, but are not limited to, the following. The role holder should:
  
  

* Manage the Business Development desk and implement key initiatives to deliver the O/I AOP.
* Identify, establish and develop external partnerships with educational institutions, VFS, EBS and other relevant organisations.
* Own and resolve issues or challenges arising within external partnerships in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with Customer Value Management, Branch Banking, GBM, CMB, Mobile Sales Force, Contact Centres, HIDL and other internal stakeholders to develop strategies for growing the O/I customer base.
* Build strong working relationships with colleagues across key priority markets, including the UK, Canada, MENAT, Singapore, Hong Kong, the USA and Australia.
* Work with the Group International and Cross Border community to deliver the global international strategy for the local market.
* Act as the in-market subject matter expert for relevant cross-border matters, including the Cross Border Manual and applicable product offerings.
* Own O/I channel activities and support delivery of the Bank’s Target Operating and Business Model.
* Work closely with branches and Direct Sales Teams to deliver agreed targets for New to Bank acquisitions, inward and outward remittances and other relevant measures.
* Build sales capability, streamline processes and increase productivity across sales channels in line with Group direction.
* Initiate and lead events for customers moving overseas, residing overseas or visiting India, working closely with Distribution, Customer Value Management and Marketing teams.
* Lead community marketing campaigns to increase awareness of HSBC’s global footprint among the Overseas Indian community.
* Develop relationships with external speakers and partners to provide relevant insights to Overseas Indians who are resident, or intending to become resident, overseas.
* Develop and manage internal partnerships with CMB, GPB and GBM, as well as external partnerships with NBFC and education consultants.
* Maintain current market intelligence on the O/I competitor landscape and use data analytics to enhance the O/I proposition.
* Provide timely briefings on regulatory and policy changes in India and the relevant priority markets, particularly where these affect cross-border activity.
* Keep frontline colleagues informed about the Overseas Indian proposition, products and services offered by HSBC India and priority markets, including any restrictions on proactive solicitation.
* Ensure the local strategy remains consistent with Group strategy and leverages Global and Regional synergies.
* Deliver fair customer outcomes and maintain the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets.
* Coordinate local resources, including branches and Relationship Managers, to support cross-border referrals.
* Identify gaps, support frontline colleagues and help close referrals made by Relationship Managers.
* Develop initiatives to improve the cross-border referral process, customer experience and internal resource sharing.
* Act as the communication link between India and the relevant priority markets within IWPB.
* Coordinate performance management and investigate and remediate issues affecting business performance.
* Analyse customer insight, macroeconomic conditions and market data to support proposition enhancement campaigns.
* Prepare presentations and insights to support strategic and tactical growth decisions.
* Collate customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve operations, administration, processes and product competitiveness.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards and implement internal and external audit actions within agreed timelines.

**Management of Risk**
**The Role Holder Should:**

* Place fair treatment of customers at the heart of all activities.
* Demonstrate HSBC Values and behaviours and comply with applicable risk policies and procedures.
* Identify, notify and escalate concerns appropriately.
* Manage and mitigate operational risks arising from day-to-day activities.
* Understand and operate in line with the Three Lines of Defence model.
* Comply with Global AML, Sanctions and ABC Policies, supporting guidance and Line of Business procedures.
* Reassess operational risks in light of changing economic, market, legal, regulatory, procedural and technological conditions.
* Ensure audit and regulatory actions are implemented accurately and promptly.
* Ensure operational risks are managed in accordance with the Group Standards Manual, Risk FIM and relevant guidelines and standards, where applicable to the role.

**Observation of Internal Controls**
**The Role Holder Should:**

* Adhere to and demonstrate compliance with all relevant internal controls, policies, processes and procedures.
* Maintain appropriate records and implement internal and external audit actions within agreed timelines.
* Liaise with Compliance at the earliest opportunity when developing or implementing business initiatives.
* Support a strong compliance culture through appropriate resources, training and engagement with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure all activities comply with applicable financial services laws, rules, codes and cross-border requirements.

****Local Job Requirements****
**Role Dimensions**
The role holder will have
**one direct report**
under the approved structure and will be responsible for:
  
  

* Day-to-day management.
* Personal Development Plans.
* Career progression.
* End-of-year performance review.

The role holder will also be expected to exert significant influence across local IWPB branches, Premier teams and IBC to drive Premier O/I recruitment and demonstrate a strong understanding of the O/I proposition.
  
  
**Role Context**
**The Role Holder Will:**

* Drive the O/I business in India and support delivery of the O/I AOP.
* Obtain buy-in from senior stakeholders in the local market.
* Drive projects in response to market changes and opportunities.
* Deliver the O/I strategy in line with HSBC Group strategy.
* Manage the regulatory complexity associated with cross-border activity.
* Build a sustainable collaboration framework across relevant stakeholders.

**Major Challenges**
**The Role Involves:**

* Operating within a complex regulatory environment involving several regulatory entities in India.
* Creating awareness of the HSBC O/I proposition in India.
* Encouraging cooperation between HSBC India and key priority markets while adhering to cross-border guidelines.
* Supporting growth in customer numbers, balances and revenue within the International Indian customer segment.
* Maintaining awareness of competitor propositions and market developments.
* Operationalising and optimising the role profile and collaboration framework.

****Education Qualifications****
**Education Qualifications, Certifications and Requirements**

* Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance or an equivalent discipline.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in financial services and team management, including prior Business Development experience.

****Other Requirements****
The applicant should have:
  
  

* Strong leadership, managerial and strategic planning skills.
* Excellent organisational, decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong communication, analytical, interpersonal and motivational skills.
* Effective negotiation, project management, sales and team-building skills.
* Strong sales management, financial planning and stakeholder management experience.
* A strong business acumen and the ability to make trade-off decisions and build consensus.
* A proven record of delivering business targets, meeting customer needs and improving customer satisfaction.
* The ability to work independently with limited supervision and guidance.
* A strong understanding of financial markets, global economics and financial services.
* A good understanding of credit, risk and cross-border compliance policies and procedures.
* Strong knowledge of the Overseas Indian proposition, including international account opening and referral processes.
* The ability to use numerical data to develop tactical plans within a broader strategic context and adjust plans based on results.
* A sound understanding of customer segments, products and the competitive market.
* A strong stakeholder management capability and resilience when managing ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Strong sales planning and negotiation skills.
* A “hunter” sales approach focused on acquiring new propositions and business opportunities.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and deliver compelling presentations.
* Strong planning, organising, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Inspirational leadership and innovation capabilities.

**Typical Targets and Measures**
**Performance May Be Assessed Through:**

* Number of events and campaigns coordinated.
* Customer feedback received directly or through HSBC colleagues.
* Number of training sessions coordinated and delivered.
* Number of new corporate and business associate relationships acquired.
* Product and process enhancements delivered.
* Achievement of AOP and agreed accelerated targets.
* Referrals generated and supported, including cross-border and in-country referrals.
* Voice of the Customer outcomes.
* Customer complaint levels and resolution.
* Marketing offers and plans delivered.
* Feedback from Group International, INM IWPB and other internal stakeholders.
* Team management and development outcomes.
* Adherence to audit recommendations, compliance requirements, HSBC policies and local banking regulations.

****Additional Notes :****

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable .
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Regional Sales Manager - India
description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
We are seeking a technical, entrepreneurial Regional Sales Manager to own new and expansion opportunities across commercial and mid-market accounts. You will manage the full sales cycle, from account prioritization and pipeline creation through discovery, technical validation, quantified value, pricing, negotiation, close, and expansion.
  
  
This is a full-cycle technical selling role, not a high-volume transactional one. You will keep the discipline in discovery, validation, and value that technical buyers expect.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Prospect, qualify, and close new business across commercial and mid-market accounts.

* Lead opportunities from first meeting through technical validation, security and procurement, pricing, negotiation, and close.

* Expand and retain assigned customers by identifying new workloads, capacity, use cases, and business units, and hand off cleanly to post-sale teams.
* Use MEDDPICC or a comparable method, and keep accurate pipeline, forecasts, activity, and next steps in Salesforce.
* Collaborate with Field Architects, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and partners to deliver a strong customer experience.
* Share what you learn in the field to help sharpen MinIO's commercial playbook as we evolve toward a hybrid product-led and sales-driven motion.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Three or more years of direct B2B SaaS or infrastructure sales experience with consistent quota achievement.
* Evidence of sourcing and closing new customers and managing commercial or mid-market sales velocity.
* Experience leading technical deals in the $50K–$300K+ range.
* Familiarity with cloud-native technology, data infrastructure, object storage, AI/ML, lakehouse, analytics, HPC, or adjacent platforms.
* Credibility with VPs of Infrastructure, Engineering leaders, Enterprise Architects, and related technical buyers.
* A metrics-based approach to pipeline creation, qualification, value selling, forecasting, and negotiation.
* Experience expanding accounts through cross-sell, upsell, and measurable customer value.
* Comfort in an early-stage or growth-stage environment and strong cross-functional collaboration.
* Object-storage, S3, or cloud-native experience.
* Experience in a hybrid product-led and sales-driven motion.
* Familiarity with Salesloft, Outreach, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* MEDDPICC, Force Management, or Challenger training.
* Partner co-sell experience.

MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: District Manager, Pune
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Recon) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.
  
  
The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within the operating theatre environment and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of this environment and of the role as both a representative of Zimmer and a part of the operating theatre team. The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Recon range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.
  
  
The DM (Recon) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.
  
  
As a conduit of information to and from the field, DM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.
  
  
Principal Duties & Responsibilities
  
  
**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts & seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.
* Responsibility of primary and secondary sales in the designated territory and Key accounts.

**Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers currently using competitor products, within targeted geographical & product areas.
* Present proposal to decision makers and convert customers to usage of Zimmer products.
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.

**Management Reporting(5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by NBM/GSM/SM (or others), including monthly reports & expenses.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports on an as-required basis.
* To liaise with Distributors for effective customer service, order procurement for primary sales and realization of receivables from Distributors/Hospitals of the territory in co-ordination with the Area/Regional Sales Manager and Finance Department.

**Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and OT , where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles & data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers & staff.

Expected Behaviour
  
  
The incumbent will be required to demonstrate behavior in accordance with Zimmer Biomet’s Guiding Principles, as listed below;
  
  
We respect you for your individual contributions and your diverse perspectives. We support your professional growth and provide you with opportunities to share in the company's success.
  
  

* Commit to the highest standards of patient safety, quality and integrity.

We commit to the highest standards of patient safety and quality in our products and services and to be recognized for world-class integrity and ethical business practices.
  
  

* Focus our resources in areas where we will make a difference.

We focus our resources in areas where we will make the greatest impact for our customers and patients through our collective knowledge of the disease state or market, established infrastructure, relevant engineering expertise and skillsets.
  
  

* Ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.

We innovate to provide value through effective and efficient solutions for customers and improved outcomes for patients to ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.
  
  

* Give back to our communities and people in need.

We partner with communities where we live and work and support causes and programs that forward our mission for people in need.
  
  
Your Background
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Must Possess The Following**

* Qualifications in B.Pharma, Business, Marketing or Paramedical discipline is preferred.

**The candidate must have the following level of experience in, or knowledge of:**

title: Key Account Manager - VIP Accounts
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today**
At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.
  
  
In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.
  
  
While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!
  
  
**About The Role**
This isn’t a typical Sales role.
  
  
You will work on initiatives that genuinely transform how finance works in India, a type of work few roles offer.
  
  
Build and nurture relationships with VIP customers actively trading options on CoinDCX. Engage users through calls and personalised communications, sharing updates on new listings, product launches, market developments and trading features to drive engagement, retention and satisfaction.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Drive VIP Trader Engagement: Build and own relationships with high-value Options Traders through personalised engagement, delivering timely updates on options products, listings and market opportunities.
* Drive Product Penetration: Identify trader needs and lead cross-sell and adoption of relevant CoinDCX options and derivatives products.
* Own Trading Growth & Retention: Monitor trading activity and volumes, design targeted interventions to reactivate traders and deliver sustained trading engagement.
* Deliver Market & Product Insights: Build trader trust by sharing actionable insights on options strategies, volatility, market trends, margin and product developments.
* Drive Trader VoC: Own the feedback loop with active traders and collaborate with Product, Research and Operations to design and deliver a superior options trading experience.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You**

* Think like a trader: Stay curious about markets, options, volatility and trading behaviour.
* Learn fast, execute faster: Absorb new concepts quickly and turn learning into action.
* Think analytically: Use data to identify patterns, opportunities and trader behaviour.
* Own the outcome: Take end-to-end ownership of tasks and follow through with minimal hand-holding.
* Have a bias for action: Move quickly, experiment, and iterate based on results.
* Communicate with clarity: Present insights and ideas in a simple, structured and actionable way.
* Stay customer-obsessed: Understand the needs of options traders and continuously look for ways to improve their experience.

**You’ll Know You’re Winning When**

* Improved user retention: Contributed to initiatives that improve retention and reactivation of active Options Traders.
* Increased trading volumes: Delivered measurable growth in options trading activity and user volumes within the assigned cohort.
* Improved trader engagement: Built and executed targeted initiatives to increase engagement among high-value Options Traders.
* Delivered actionable insights: Generated data-backed insights on trader behaviour, churn, and product adoption to support growth initiatives.

**Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You**

* Build from the ground up : Be part of the first major experiment focused on VIP Options as a product.
* Own & lead : Get meaningful ownership to shape initiatives, experiment with new ideas and drive outcomes.
* High-impact exposure : Work closely with Options Traders, Product, Research and business teams to understand and build for a fast-evolving market.
* Make your mark : Your work can directly influence how VIP Team builds and scales its Options business.

**Hiring Process**
Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
  
  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best

**Where We Work**
We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
  
  
With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
  
  
**Perks That Empower You**
We believe great people deserve great experiences.
  
  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
  
  
Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Associate - Sales
description:
Associate – Sales (Rentals & Luxe) 

Locations: Mumbai

About Cityflo:

Cityflo is a daily commute company that provides a comfortable, stress-free travel experience for corporate professionals, as an alternative to driving. With premium buses, a simple app and caring customer service, our passengers get the luxury of time in their busy schedules — where they can read their book, watch Netflix, nap or simply soak in the view of the city. We’re bringing joy back to commuting, and turning around urban traffic woes in a big way. 

Today, Cityflo operates a fleet of nearly 1,200 buses across six cities — Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Pune and Chennai — running large-scale, reliable transportation programs every single day. Cityflo is well-funded by prominent VCs — India Quotient and Lightbox Ventures. 

● Website: https://www.cityflo.com/ 

● App: https://bnc.lt/cityflo/ 

● Blog: https://blog.cityflo.com/ 

● Our journey through Covid:
https://bit.ly/3wBiSZx

**About the Role**

At Cityflo, we're transforming corporate mobility with reliable, premium transportation solutions. As an Associate – Business Development (Rentals), you'll play a pivotal role in growing our Rentals business by acquiring new corporate clients, building long-term relationships, and delivering tailored mobility solutions.

From generating new business to nurturing client partnerships, you'll own the complete sales lifecycle while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience. If you're passionate about sales, enjoy meeting people, and thrive in a target-driven environment, this role is for you.

**What You'll Do**

Drive Sales & Revenue Growth

* Own the complete sales lifecycle—from lead qualification to booking conversion.
* Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline to consistently achieve weekly, monthly, and quarterly revenue targets.
* Drive conversions while maintaining business margins and profitability.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, upselling, and cross-selling.

Client Relationship Management

* Build strong relationships with corporate clients, SMEs, travel agencies, and other business partners.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend tailored mobility solutions.
* Deliver an exceptional customer experience throughout the sales journey.

Sales Operations

* Manage and track leads, opportunities, and conversions using CRM and sales tools.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and ensure complete sales pipeline visibility.
* Monitor sales performance, conversion rates, and business metrics to identify improvement opportunities.

Commercial Negotiation & Coordination

* Negotiate commercial terms while protecting business profitability.
* Coordinate with Operations, Fulfilment, Finance, and Customer Support teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Support billing, payment collections, and customer follow-ups to ensure smooth order completion.

Business Development

* Represent the Cityflo brand to corporates, SMEs, travel agents, and ad-hoc groups to generate new rental opportunities.
* Identify new business opportunities through networking, referrals, and market research.
* Contribute to the growth of the Rentals business through proactive sales initiatives.

**What We're Looking For**

* 1–3 years of experience in Sales, Business Development, Account Management, or Corporate Sales.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Strong customer relationship management abilities.
* Comfortable using CRM platforms and sales tools.
* Target-driven, self-motivated, and passionate about achieving results.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-first mindset.
* Experience in the travel, transportation, hospitality, mobility, or service industry will be an added advantage.

**Why Join Cityflo?**

* Be part of one of India's fastest-growing mobility startups.
* Own a high-impact business vertical with significant growth opportunities.
* Work directly with corporate clients and industry leaders.
* Gain exposure to end-to-end business development, account management, and strategic sales.
* Learn from a collaborative team that values ownership, innovation, and execution.
* Accelerate your career in a dynamic, high-growth environment where your ideas and contributions matter.

**Work Schedule**

* 6 days working with one weekly off on either Saturday or Sunday (rotational).
* Rotational shifts:
* 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
* 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM
* Candidates should be comfortable working in rotational shifts based on business requirements.

**Ready to Drive the Future of Corporate Mobility?**

If you're excited about building relationships, closing deals, and creating meaningful business impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Share your resume at ashwini.mahadik@cityflo.com or refer someone who'd be a great fit for this opportunity.

title: Sales Manager
description:
**We’re Hiring | Sales & Business Development Executive

Yumi Kids | Mumbai

Do you love kids, enjoy interacting with people and have a knack for turning ideas into sales? We might just be looking for you!

Yumi Kids is a growing kids’ lifestyle brand specialising in personalised accessories, creative gifting and thoughtfully curated products. We’re looking for an enthusiastic, creative and driven individual to take ownership of our sales and business development function.

What You’ll Do

\* Handle incoming enquiries and leads for personalised gifts, return gifts and customised hampers.

\* Connect with mamas, understand their requirements, preferences and budgets, and suggest products that make their little ones’ occasions extra special.

\* Showcase our wide product range and come up with creative combinations, personalisation ideas and customised gifting solutions.

\* Coordinate with the design team to create unique concepts that go beyond standard gifting options.

\* Drive website enquiries, customer conversions and overall sales.

\* Build relationships with play zones, event planners, preschools and other potential business partners through occasional meetings and visits.

\* Manage the complete sales journey, from the first enquiry to order confirmation, while building lasting customer relationships.

What We’re Looking For

\* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

\* A natural ability to connect with customers and understand their needs.

\* Someone creative, confident, persuasive and enthusiastic about sales.

\* Good follow-up, negotiation and coordination skills.

\* A self-driven individual who enjoys taking ownership and working towards targets.

\* Prior experience in sales, customer relations or business development is preferred.

Why Yumi Kids?

We’re at an exciting stage of building and growing our brand. This is an opportunity to join us early, take ownership of an important business function, bring your ideas to the table and grow alongside the company.

We’re not just looking for someone to sell products. We’re looking for someone who understands that every mama has a little story behind what she wants to create for her child.

If you love kids, love people and love the idea of making gifting more personal, we’d love to have you join the Yumi Kids journey!

title: Buiness Development executive
description:
**Company Description**
KP Sanghvi and Sons, founded in 1965, has grown from a single-cut diamond sourcing business into a globally respected diamond manufacturing leader. Built on ethics, foresight, and hard work, the group has expanded into jewelry (KP Jewels) and real estate (KP Infra), with landmark projects such as KP Epitome. The company operates across India, USA, UAE, Belgium, China, Hong Kong, and Botswana, supported by a team of over 7,000 professionals and partnerships with global brands like Simply Vera Wang and Serena Williams Jewelry. Recognized as a De Beers Sightholder, Rio Tinto Diamantaire, and RJC-certified, KP Sanghvi ensures quality and traceability through cutting-edge technology and a patented ERP system. The organization is deeply committed to social impact, investing in healthcare, education, animal welfare, COVID relief, and pioneering initiatives such as the industry’s first all-women diamond factory aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Business Development Executive role based in Mumbai. The Business Development Executive will identify new business opportunities, build and maintain strong client relationships, and support the expansion of KP Sanghvi and Sons in domestic and international markets. Daily responsibilities include prospecting and qualifying leads, preparing and delivering presentations, coordinating with internal teams on pricing and proposals, and tracking sales pipelines and conversion metrics. The role involves conducting market research, analyzing competitive trends, and recommending strategies to increase revenue and brand visibility. The Business Development Executive will collaborate closely with sales, marketing, and operations teams to ensure seamless execution of business initiatives and maintain KP Sanghvi’s standards of integrity and service.

**Qualifications**

* Strong business development and sales skills, including lead generation, client relationship management, and negotiation.
* Ability to conduct market research, analyze data, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with proficiency in creating proposals and client-facing materials.
* Solid organizational and time-management abilities, with attention to detail and follow-through.
* Comfort working with CRM tools, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), and basic sales reporting systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, International Trade, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in business development, sales, or account management, ideally in luxury goods, gems and jewelry, or related industries.
* Customer-centric mindset, integrity in dealings, and willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and interact with diverse stakeholders across cultures.

title: Account Manager - Sales
description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
  
  
With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts.
  
  
Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a results-oriented Account Manager - Sales to manage and grow customer accounts, drive revenue, and build long-term business relationships within the IT Distribution ecosystem. The role involves managing existing customers, identifying new business opportunities, driving solution sales, and collaborating with internal teams, channel partners, and technology vendors to achieve business objectives.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong account management skills, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to drive revenue growth through consultative selling and strategic relationship management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Account Management**

* Manage and develop relationships with assigned customer accounts.
* Build strong engagement with key decision-makers and stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Develop account plans and growth strategies to maximize business opportunities.

**Sales & Business Development**

* Achieve assigned sales, revenue, and gross margin targets.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling within existing accounts.
* Acquire new customers and expand business within target markets.
* Drive the complete sales cycle from opportunity generation to order closure.

**Customer Engagement**

* Conduct regular customer meetings and business reviews.
* Understand customer business needs and recommend appropriate technology solutions.
* Build strong customer relationships to ensure retention and long-term growth.
* Address customer concerns and coordinate internal resources for timely resolution.

**Solution Selling**

* Promote and position the company's IT products, solutions, and services.
* Work closely with Product Managers and Pre-Sales teams to develop customer-centric solutions.
* Deliver presentations, product demonstrations, and business proposals.
* Support customers through technical and commercial discussions.

**Channel & Vendor Collaboration**

* Work closely with channel partners, system integrators, and resellers to drive business growth.
* Collaborate with OEMs and technology vendors to identify business opportunities and leverage vendor programs.
* Participate in joint customer engagements and business planning initiatives.

**Pipeline & Forecast Management**

* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and consistently generate new opportunities.
* Track and manage opportunities through CRM systems.
* Prepare accurate sales forecasts and periodic business reports.
* Monitor account performance and implement corrective actions where required.

**Market Intelligence**

* Stay updated on technology trends, competitor activities, and market developments.
* Gather customer feedback and market insights to support business growth strategies.
* Identify emerging opportunities within the assigned territory or customer base.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Pre-Sales, Operations, Marketing, and Finance teams.
* Ensure smooth order processing, delivery coordination, and post-sales support.
* Drive customer satisfaction through effective internal and external stakeholder management.

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Strong Account Management and B2B Sales skills.
* Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Consultative and solution-selling approach.
* Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial acumen.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities effectively.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of the IT Distribution and Channel Sales ecosystem.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, CRM, and sales reporting tools.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* MBA preferred.

title: Sales Executive
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION – INSIDE SALES ENGINEER

\*\*Company:\*\* Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd.

\*\*Location:\*\* Taloja, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

\*\*Department:\*\* Sales & Business Development

\*\*Position:\*\* Inside Sales Engineer

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Work Mode:\*\* Hybrid – Taloja Office + Work from Home as per company policy

\*\*Reporting To:\*\* Sales Manager / Head – Business Development

## 1. Job Purpose

The Inside Sales Engineer will be responsible for \*\*generating and qualifying sales enquiries, customer follow-up, preparing and coordinating quotations, maintaining the sales pipeline, and converting enquiries into orders\*\*.

The candidate will work closely with the \*\*Sales, Estimation, Engineering, Purchase, Stores and Project teams\*\* to ensure timely response to customers and effective closure of business opportunities.

The role is particularly focused on Synergie's \*\*Industrial Automation, Siemens products, PLC/HMI/SCADA, Drives, Control Panels, MCC/PCC Panels, automation projects and services\*\*.

## 2. Key Responsibilities

### A. Lead Generation & Customer Development

- Generate new leads through:

- Cold calling

- Email campaigns

- LinkedIn

- Existing customer references

- Online enquiries

- Industrial databases

- Customer mapping

- Identify potential customers in:

- Steel and metals

- Manufacturing industries

- OEMs

- EPC contractors

- System integrators

- Panel builders

- Pharma

- Food & Beverage

- Packaging

- Water treatment

- Cement, glass, rubber, sugar and other industries

- Develop and maintain a database of prospective customers.

- Identify decision-makers such as Purchase, Electrical, Automation, Maintenance, Projects and Plant Heads.

### B. Enquiry Management

- Receive and understand customer enquiries.

- Review technical requirements, BOQ, BOM, specifications and drawings.

- Clarify missing information with customers.

- Register every enquiry in the CRM/system.

- Categorize enquiries based on product, project value, customer and probability.

- Ensure no enquiry or customer follow-up is missed.

### C. Quotation & Pre-Sales Support

Coordinate with the estimation and engineering teams for preparation of:

- Siemens PLC quotations

- HMI and SCADA solutions

- VFD / AC & DC Drive quotations

- PLC/Automation Panels

- MCC/PCC/LT Panels

- Control Desks

- DCS / PCS7 solutions

- Retrofit and migration projects

- Automation modification and upgradation

- AMC and service requirements

Support preparation of \*\*BOQ/BOM, technical offers and techno-commercial quotations\*\*.

### D. Customer Follow-Up

- Follow up systematically on all submitted quotations.

- Understand the customer's feedback, competition and expected order date.

- Record quotation status in CRM.

- Follow up for:

- Technical approval

- Commercial negotiation

- Purchase order

- Payment

- Dispatch

- Maintain a daily follow-up schedule.

- Escalate high-value or critical opportunities to the Sales Manager.

### E. Sales Conversion

- Work towards converting enquiries into orders.

- Understand why an enquiry is lost and record the reason.

- Track:

- Enquiry value

- Quotation value

- Expected order value

- Probability

- Expected order date

- Competitor

- Gross margin

- Support negotiation with customers within approved company limits.

- Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional products.

### F. CRM & Sales Reporting

Maintain accurate and updated information in \*\*Zoho CRM / company sales systems\*\*.

Daily update should include:

- New enquiries

- Calls made

- Customer discussions

- Quotations submitted

- Follow-ups completed

- Orders received

- Lost enquiries

- Next action and follow-up date

Prepare regular:

- Daily sales activity report

- Weekly enquiry report

- Sales pipeline report

- Quotation follow-up report

- Order conversion report

- Lost enquiry analysis

### G. Customer Relationship Management

- Maintain professional communication with customers.

- Develop long-term relationships with existing customers.

- Regularly contact inactive/old customers.

- Identify new requirements from existing customers.

- Generate opportunities for:

- Retrofit

- PLC migration

- Drive replacement

- Panel modification

- Automation upgradation

- Service

- AMC

- Spares

- New projects

### H. Coordination with Internal Teams

Coordinate closely with:

\*\*Sales → Estimation → Engineering → Purchase → Production → Testing → Projects → Accounts\*\*

Ensure proper communication of customer requirements and commercial commitments.

## 3. Technical Knowledge Required

Candidate should have basic understanding of:

- Siemens PLC – S7-1200 / S7-1500

- HMI

- SCADA / WinCC

- AC Drives / VFD

- DC Drives

- MCC / PCC / LT Panels

- PLC Automation Panels

- Control Panels

- Electrical components

- Motors and basic electrical systems

- Industrial automation

- Basic electrical drawings and BOQ/BOM

Knowledge of \*\*Siemens automation products\*\* will be strongly preferred.

## 4. Qualification

\*\*Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech\*\* in:

- Electrical Engineering

- Electronics Engineering

- Electronics & Telecommunication

- Instrumentation Engineering

- Automation Engineering

MBA/PG Diploma in Sales & Marketing will be an advantage.

## 5. Experience

\*\*Experience:\*\* 1–5 years preferred.

Candidates with experience in:

- Industrial Automation

- Electrical products

- Control Panels

- Siemens products

- Industrial B2B sales

- Technical sales

- Inside sales

- Electrical/automation distribution

will be preferred.

Freshers with strong communication skills and technical knowledge may also be considered for a trainee/entry-level position.

## 6. Required Skills

### Technical Skills

- Basic knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA and Drives

- Understanding of electrical panels and automation products

- Ability to understand BOQ/BOM

- Basic technical proposal understanding

### Sales Skills

- Lead generation

- Cold calling

- Customer follow-up

- Enquiry handling

- Quotation follow-up

- Negotiation

- Order conversion

- Customer relationship management

### Software Skills

- MS Excel

- MS Word

- PowerPoint

- CRM software – preferably Zoho CRM

- Email communication

- Basic knowledge of ERP systems will be an advantage

### Behavioural Skills

- Good spoken and written English

- Good communication skills

- Positive attitude

- Strong follow-up discipline

- Target-oriented approach

- Ability to work independently

- Good coordination skills

- Professional customer handling

- Willingness to learn

## 7. Hybrid Work Model

This position will follow a \*\*hybrid working model\*\*.

The employee may work from home for defined inside-sales activities such as:

- Customer calling

- Email follow-up

- CRM updating

- Lead generation

- Quotation follow-up

- Sales reporting

However, the employee must attend the \*\*Taloja office whenever required\*\* for:

- Sales meetings

- Internal coordination

- Product/technical training

- Quotation discussions

- Customer meetings

- Sales reviews

- Team meetings

- Important project discussions

\*\*Work-from-home is subject to performance, discipline, availability and management approval.\*\*

## 8. Key Performance Indicators – KPIs

The employee will be evaluated on:

| KPI | Measurement |

|---|---|

| New Leads | Number of qualified leads generated |

| Customer Calls | Daily/weekly activity |

| Enquiries | Qualified enquiries generated |

| Quotations | Number and value of quotations |

| Follow-Up | % of quotations followed on time |

| Conversion | Enquiry-to-order conversion % |

| Sales | Monthly / annual order value |

| New Customers | Number of new active customers |

| CRM Discipline | 100% enquiry and follow-up updating |

| Lost Enquiries | Proper reason and analysis |

| Collection Support | Coordination for payment follow-up |

## 9. Sales Target Responsibility

The Inside Sales Engineer will be given \*\*monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets\*\*.

The employee is expected to build a healthy sales pipeline rather than only depend on enquiries received from existing customers.

Performance will be evaluated based on:

\*\*Lead Generation → Qualified Enquiry → Quotation → Follow-Up → Conversion → Order Value → Gross Margin\*\*

## 10. Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a candidate who is:

- Technically inclined

- Comfortable speaking with customers

- Strong in follow-up

- Target-oriented

- Comfortable with telephone-based sales

- Good in Excel and CRM

- Interested in industrial automation

- Willing to learn Siemens products

- Capable of working independently in a hybrid environment

- Focused on converting enquiries into business

## 11. Compensation & Incentives

Salary will be based on \*\*experience, technical knowledge and sales capability\*\*.

Performance-based incentives may be provided based on company sales and incentive policy.

## 12. Career Growth

A successful candidate can grow into:

\*\*Inside Sales Engineer → Senior Inside Sales Engineer → Technical Sales Engineer → Sales Manager → Business Development Manager\*\*

## 13. Important Requirement

\*\*This is not a simple telecalling position.\*\*

The candidate must be capable of understanding the customer's \*\*technical requirement, coordinating with the engineering/estimation team, following up commercially and contributing to actual order conversion.\*\*

title: Sales Officer - Gold Loan
description:
**Company Description**
IDFC FIRST Bank is a fast-growing private bank in India, built on the principles of ethical, digital, and socially responsible banking. The Bank combines modern banking services with advanced, cloud-native and API-led technology to deliver seamless experiences across physical branches and digital channels. Serving over 40 million customers across more than 60,000 cities, towns, and villages, it offers a comprehensive range of products spanning retail, MSME, rural, startup, corporate banking, cards, wealth management, and treasury. With a strong focus on social impact, the Bank has supported millions of individuals, entrepreneurs, and small businesses through inclusive lending and fee waivers on essential services. IDFC FIRST Bank is committed to robust governance, regulatory compliance, and building a resilient, sustainable institution for the future.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales Officer – Gold Loan role based in South Mumbai. The Sales Officer will be responsible for sourcing and onboarding gold loan customers through field visits, branch walk-ins, and local market outreach. Daily tasks include assessing customer requirements, explaining product features and terms, verifying documentation, coordinating with branch operations for loan processing, and ensuring timely disbursal. The role involves managing customer relationships, handling queries and issues, and promoting cross-sell opportunities while adhering to compliance, KYC, and risk guidelines. The Sales Officer will also track sales targets, prepare periodic reports, and collaborate with branch teams to drive gold loan portfolio growth in the assigned territory.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong sales and business development skills, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing skills, ideally within retail or secured lending products such as gold loans.
* Candidates should possess customer service and relationship management skills, with the ability to build trust, explain financial products clearly, and handle queries and concerns professionally.
* Candidates should possess basic financial and analytical skills, including understanding of lending processes, documentation, KYC norms, and risk awareness related to gold valuation and collateral.
* Candidates should possess communication and interpersonal skills, including clear verbal and written communication and the ability to work effectively with customers, branch staff, and internal stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess organizational and field execution skills, such as time management, territory planning, and comfort with extensive on-ground customer interaction in South Mumbai.
* Relevant qualifications such as a graduate degree in any discipline, preferably with experience in banking, NBFCs, or financial services; prior exposure to gold loan operations or retail asset sales is an advantage.
* Proficiency with basic digital tools and banking systems, integrity and adherence to ethical standards, and readiness to work in a target-driven environment are highly beneficial.

title: Territory Manager- Mumbai
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
*At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.*
*We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.*
*Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.*
*We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.*
*If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.*

Enhancing the customer experience by identifying the critical need and delivering optimal pharmaceutical based healthcare solutions to achieve business objectives.
  
  
Analyzing market trends and developing a sales plan; Meeting and engaging designated doctors in the assigned territory, promoting company products to customers; strengthening relationships with stakeholders like doctors, paramedics, retailers and stockists in order to achieve individual and pool sales targets using patient focused selling principles while adhering to Lilly compliance guidelines.

Doctors, paramedical & hospital staff, retailers and stockists.

Graduation in any field (preferably Science) with minimum one year of sales work experience.

Good communication and presentation skills, basic knowledge of therapeutic area and product segment, Emotional Intelligence, Organizational Skills, Learning agility.
  
  
**Area of Responsibility & Key Activities**
**Sales and Territory Planning**
Develop a detailed territory business plan for the portfolio by making strategic decisions about goals, resource investments, and monitor and measure the plan.
  
  

* Based on Retail Call Audit and market analysis, refresh and update MCL from the universal list provided by sales operations.
* Prepare a retail call list for important retailers.
* Prepare a patch plan as per customer availability and schedule.
* Prioritize business opportunities.
* Plan for achieving targets set by the company.
* Track and analyze weekly sales data in order to identify trends and make required modifications to the plan.
* Performance Metrics: Approval of plan by supervisor; Quality of analysis.

**Conducting Customer Calls**

* Meet the required number of customers as per SPP targets and call plan.
* Meet retailers as per SPP target and plan in order to gather information about product trends and competitor data.
* Meet compliance requirements on calls.
* Conduct effective pre-call planning by setting objectives tailored to customer segment, needs, attitudes, motivations, environment and business priorities, then prepare potential solutions.
* Conduct post-call analysis and record next call objective in approved CRM tool.
* Use relevant sales materials to address customer questions, objections, and concerns.
* Promote company products to customers as per the Patient Focused Selling Principles and by using aids provided by Marketing.
* Strengthen relationships with all stakeholders.
* Performance Metrics: SPP target v/s achievement; Adherence to compliance requirements; Sales target v/s achievement.

**Customer, Paramedic Staff and Retailer Engagement**

* Finalize doctors engagement plan for a Quarter.
* Conduct programs as per plan and steer all related logistics and coordination.
* Plan, develop, and implement effective communication (e.g. presentations) in a variety of settings.
* Identify speakers and audience for conducting programs, work with various departments to ensure timely documentation and certification of the speaker.
* Invite doctors for Marketing led programs.
* Conduct Retailer Awareness Programs.
* Conduct Nurses awareness programs to upgrade the knowledge of paramedic staff.
* Conduct programs as per compliance guidelines.
* Performance Metrics: Informal/formal feedback from stakeholders on quality of programs; Adherence to compliance requirements; Program attendance as per target.

**Stockist Management**

* Engage with stockists regularly to strengthen relationship.
* Gather information to analyze sales trends every week.
* Conduct physical stock verification at the Stockist.
* Maintain a balance between first line and second line sales as per the company guidelines.
* Participate in ensuring availability at various retailers like placing and collecting orders.
* Coordinate between Stockist and CFA at the time of closing.

* Timely reporting of all the doctor and retailer calls.
* Report details of programs conducted.
* Report any medical services request received from doctors through on-demand.
* Present sales trends in monthly reviews.
* Performance Metrics: Regular and accurate reporting.

**.**

Ensavior Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a comprehensive solutions provider specializing in HVAC products, plumbing systems, fire fighting equipment, and ventilation and indoor air quality services. Identify potential clients, upcoming projects and commercial opportunities across India’s sports infrastructure sector.

Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, analyse information, automate workflows and improve productivity.

Work directly with the founder on evolving business priorities, stakeholder coordination, problem-solving and execution.

Prepare meeting notes, project updates, reports and professional communication materials.

We’re looking for someone who is curious, ambitious, independent and exceptionally good at getting things done. * Strong analytical, research and problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional resourcefulness and ability to figure things out independently.
* High ownership, initiative and accountability.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly.

* Familiarity with CRM platforms, LinkedIn research and professional outreach.
* Experience preparing business presentations, research reports or commercial proposals.
* Prior experience in a Founder’s Office, startup or entrepreneurial environment.

**We value capability, ownership and problem-solving ability over degrees, backgrounds or years of experience. Candidates from all educational backgrounds and experience levels are encouraged to apply.**

**Prior sports industry experience is not required. What matters is your ability to learn quickly, think independently and execute effectively.**

**Compensation & Work Arrangement**

**Location:**
Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai

Hybrid, with 2 hours of in-person work daily at BKC and the remaining responsibilities managed remotely.

15 November 2026

2 months, with potential extension based on performance and business requirements.

You’ll work directly with the founder of a sports strategy and advisory firm, gaining firsthand exposure to business strategy, commercial decision-making, industry stakeholders and the execution of live projects.

The Zoom sales team is a dynamic force driving the company's success. With a focus on delivering cutting-edge communication solutions for clients across all sectors, the team passionately engages with clients worldwide. Through strategic partnerships and a customer-centric approach, they play a pivotal role in expanding Zoom's global presence and ensuring businesses harness the full potential of virtual collaboration.

As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learn for more information.
  
  
**About Us**
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
  
  
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.
  
  
If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.
  
  
Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.

Identify, develop and maintain long-term business relationships with \*\*USFDA / EU-GMP audited Indian API and formulation manufacturers (export-focused to US & Europe)\*\*. 2. Technical communication support & Vendor audit coordination support:

3. End-to-end sales cycle management: Enquiry handling, quotation, sample submission, trial batch coordination, price negotiation, order follow-up, delivery tracking and payment collection.

5. Existing active contacts with procurement, R&D, QA teams at India’s top regulated export pharma companies is a huge advantage.

6.Basic understanding of organic synthesis and pharma raw material quality requirements.

7.Strong negotiation skill, customer relationship management and cross-team coordination.

8.Self-driven, target-oriented, able to work independently with remote reporting line to China.

- Conveyance and site visit expenses covered

**Title: Worldwide Regional Account Executive**
**Location:**
Mumbai/Gujarat
  
  
**Who We Are**
At FedEx, moving the world doesn't only mean delivering for our customers around the globe. Moving the world is also about creating what's next. We are Team FedEx and we are 500,000+ people strong around the world. The work we all do comes down to one purpose: to provide our customers with outstanding experiences as we connect the world to what's next.
  
  
This isn't a place to get just a job. Here, you get a career for life. It's a place to enjoy constant change, growth, and progress in your career. Our willingness to innovate and transform is what keeps us at the forefront of our industry. With curiosity, inventiveness, and entrepreneurial spirit, we keep finding new and better ways to deliver results for our customers, for our people and for the planet.
  
  
Here, you will have the flexibility and empowerment to reimagine the new, spread your wings and see your impact. By doing so, we are motivated to be better together. And together, we will continue to drive and deliver excellence.
  
  
**Our Values**
We take pride in being a people-first company, where our employees feel safe, valued and respected. Our culture values empower us to deliver great results.
  
  
**With One FedEx Culture, We**
**Take care of each other | Commit to do good | Own outstanding | Drive business results | Create what's next**
**Awards**

* FedEx has consistently ranked among the top 20 in the "World's Most Admired Companies" report, published in FORTUNE magazine, since 2001.
* Ethisphere named FedEx as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies® in 2023.

**What You Will Do**
As a Worldwide Regional Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, developing existing customer relationships, and promoting Ocean Freight, Air Freight, Warehousing, and End-to-End Logistics solutions. You will play a key role in expanding the customer base, increasing revenue, and delivering profitable growth through effective sales strategies and strong market engagement.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**

* Business Development: Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers for Ocean Freight (FCL/LCL) and Air Freight services. Generate leads through cold calling, customer visits, networking, and referrals while developing and maintaining a strong sales pipeline to achieve assigned revenue targets.
* Customer Growth: Manage and strengthen relationships with existing customers, identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling, and increase customer wallet share through relevant logistics solutions.
* Customer Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with exporters, importers, manufacturers, traders, and freight forwarders. Understand their supply chain requirements and recommend suitable logistics solutions to meet their business needs.
* Sales & Quotations: Prepare competitive freight quotations in coordination with pricing and operations teams. Negotiate freight rates, contracts, and commercial terms, and proactively follow up on quotations to convert business opportunities into confirmed revenue.
* Market Intelligence: Monitor market trends, competitor activities, freight rate movements, trade lanes, shipping line activities, and airline developments. Share relevant market insights and business opportunities with management.
* Internal Coordination: Collaborate with pricing, operations, customs clearance, and customer service teams to ensure smooth execution and seamless customer experience. Support new customer onboarding, service delivery, collections, and credit control activities.
* Sales Reporting & Forecasting: Maintain accurate CRM records, sales activity reports, and monthly business forecasts. Track sales performance against targets and monitor key metrics such as revenue generation, customer acquisition, and conversion ratios.
* Performance Management: Drive achievement of assigned monthly and annual sales targets while maintaining focus on profitability, customer retention, and timely collections.

**You Will Be a Great Fit If You**

* Hold a bachelor's degree in commerce, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Have 2–8 years of relevant experience in Ocean Freight and Air Freight sales, preferably within freight forwarding, NVOCC, logistics, or shipping organizations.
* Have hands-on knowledge of Ocean Freight operations, including FCL and LCL, and Air Freight Export and Import services.
* Possess a strong understanding of freight forwarding, end-to-end supply chain solutions, and customs clearance processes.
* Demonstrate proven capabilities in business development, new customer acquisition, and managing existing customer relationships.
* Have strong negotiation, influencing, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective customer relationships.
* Possess commercial awareness and a profitability-oriented mindset, with the ability to negotiate competitive rates and identify business growth opportunities.
* Are proficient in CRM management, sales pipeline development, reporting, and business forecasting.
* Have a strong hunter mindset, are self-motivated and target-driven, and demonstrate resilience in working under pressure and meeting deadlines.
* Are proactive in gathering market intelligence, identifying competitor activities, and translating market insights into business opportunities.
* Have a demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets while maintaining customer satisfaction, retention, and payment compliance.

**What You Can Expect**

* Attractive remuneration package.
* Spread your wings and take ownership of your career with opportunities to network and connect with professionals in your field and involvement in cross-functional projects.
* A supportive and inclusive work environment.
* Mentorship and guidance from industry professionals.
* Exposure to real-world projects and challenges across business functions.
* Valuable skills and experience to enhance your professional growth and career progression.
* Complimentary 24/7 access to our learning platforms to support you in becoming who you want to be.

**Our Commitment to Equal Opportunities**
Our greatest asset at FedEx is our people. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, and offer equal opportunities, fairness and respect to all regardless of who you are. We encourage you to apply even if you feel your experience does not align with all the aspects in the job description as you could be exactly who we need for this or another opportunity.
  
  
We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, age, genetic information, citizenship, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status or any other characteristic protected under national, state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate team members and third parties with physical and mental disabilities.
  
  
**Interested to join Team FedEx?**
Everyone at FedEx has a part to play. It's about coming up with smart solutions, remaining resilient in the face of setbacks, and going above and beyond to get the job done. And whether you're a business leader or delivery driver, you'll be empowered to take responsibility and overcome each challenge in your own way.
  
  
If this role and working environment sound like a place you can thrive in, apply today and let's create what's next together.
  
  
Presentation Skills;Influencing & Persuasion Skills;Negotiation Skills;Written & Verbal Communication Skills;Networking Skills
  
  
FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Sales Associate
description:
About Sinclairs

Sinclairs Hotels & Resorts is one of eastern India's most established hospitality names, operating nine properties across the country's hills, plains and coastline, from Himalayan resorts to a beachfront hotel in the Andamans. We are a listed, debt-free group with a strong cash position, now in an active expansion phase and transforming how we run: our commercial discipline, our people systems and our technology.

The Role

You will sell Sinclairs across channels and across properties. One day you are working OTA visibility and rate parity for the hill properties before peak season; the next you are in a corporate's office pitching an offsite, or working a tour-operator contract for Port Blair. You will own a book of accounts and a set of channels, with targets, and be measured on the revenue you bring in.

We are hiring from hospitality. You should already know how a hotel sells: how OTAs rank and price, how travel agents and operators contract, how a corporate RFP works, how a wedding or MICE enquiry becomes a confirmed block. What we add is scope: nine properties, every channel, and a head office building the systems and marketing to back you.

What You'll Do

* Manage OTA performance for your properties: content, parity, promotions, visibility, market-manager relationships
* - Work the travel trade: tour operators, travel agents, DMCs; contracting, allocations, series and FIT business
* - Build corporate accounts for rooms, offsites and MICE; respond to RFPs and negotiate rate agreements
* - Convert wedding, banquet and group enquiries with the properties: site visits, proposals, follow-up, close
* - Keep the pipeline current in the group CRM; plan activity against occupancy gaps
* - Travel regularly to the properties; know every room category and banquet space well enough to sell from memory

What We're Looking For

* 2+ years in hotel or hospitality sales with experience across more than one channel
* - A sales record you can show: targets, production, accounts won
* - Working knowledge of OTA extranets, channel managers, rate parity and promotions
* - Confident with proposals, rate agreements and negotiation; clear in person, on the phone and in writing
* - Comfortable with a CRM and Excel
* - Ambition to grow into a management role, and the work ethic to earn it

Where This Goes

The group sales team is small today and will not stay that way. Progression to Sales Executive and Sales Manager owning a region or channel.
