title: Sales Executive FOS
description:
**About Fos 2.0**
FOS 2.0 (Feet on Street) is Nitco's field sales intelligence programme covering active construction sites across the
  
  
Mumbai Metropolitan Region. Field Sales Representatives are deployed cluster-wise along the suburban rail network
  
  
(Western, Central, Harbour, and Trans-Harbour lines) to generate live, ground-level lead data that feeds directly into
  
  
Nitco's sales pipeline and CRM.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Field Sales Representative is the primary data-collection point for FOS 2.0 and is also responsible for driving
  
  
assigned leads through to closure. The Field Sales Representative visits construction sites within their home cluster,
  
  
engages site personnel and decision-makers using the standard site-visit script, logs structured visit data, and then
  
  
owns the lead end-to-end — converting it in partnership with the Sales Executive designated for that area.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct daily on-ground visits to construction sites within the assigned home cluster, following the FOS 2.0

site-visit script (pre-visit and post-visit with the sales person). 15 Calls a Day.
  
  

* Identify construction stage, tile decision-maker, and site contact details at each visit; prioritise reaching the

actual decision-maker to improve lead conversion.
  
  

* Capture accurate visit data — site details, contact information, brand and competitor presence, product

requirements, and lead priority — via the FOS 2.0 app / daily submission format.
  
  

* Record and flag competitive brand presence at sites.
* Submit a real-time Daily Site Report (DSR) so visit data reflects on the live cluster dashboard.
* Own end-to-end lead conversion for the assigned cluster — from initial site visit through to closure — working

closely with the designated Sales Executive of that area at every stage.
  
  

* Follow up on logged leads through to conversion, coordinating site visits, quotations, and dealer/decision-maker

meetings jointly with the area Sales Executive.
  
  

* Update lead status (converted/lost/follow-up) accurately and in a timely manner, and escalate stalled leads to the

Sales Executive/Cluster Manager.
  
  

* Maintain visit coverage targets for the assigned cluster and report any data or process issues encountered in the

field.
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a graduate/undergraduate degree (any stream; sales, marketing, or

civil/construction background is a plus).
  
  

* Comfortable with extensive daily field travel within the assigned Mumbai cluster, including active construction

sites.
  
  

* Confident communicator, able to approach site staff, contractors, and decision-makers professionally.
* Basic comfort with smartphone-based data entry (forms/app); attention to detail in data logging.
* Self-motivated and reliable — able to work with minimal daily supervision while meeting visit and reporting

targets.
  
  

* Resides in or near the assigned cluster (Western / Central / Harbour / Trans-Harbour corridor) preferred, for ease

of daily commute.
  
  
**What You'll Gain**

* Direct, hands-on exposure to field sales operations at a listed building-materials company.
* Structured training on the official Nitco site-visit script and lead-qualification approach.
* Visibility of your field data feeding directly into cluster dashboards reviewed by senior leadership.
* A certificate of completion and a strong reference for a sales/operations career track.

HCLSoftware is seeking an experienced enterprise sales professional to grow its business across Public Sector Banks in the Mumbai region.

The role requires a mature, consultative salesperson who can build senior customer relationships, identify business and technology requirements, and manage complex software opportunities through the procurement cycle. The candidate will be responsible for developing existing accounts, acquiring new business, and driving upsell and cross-sell opportunities across the relevant HCLSoftware portfolio.

**1. Business Development and Revenue Ownership**

* Own sales targets for the assigned PSU banking accounts and territory.

* Identify new opportunities across bank headquarters, technology teams, business units and other relevant buying centres.
* Expand existing customer relationships through additional use cases, licence expansion, renewals where assigned, and cross-selling of relevant solutions.
* Maintain a balanced pipeline across near-term opportunities and longer-term strategic initiatives.
* Take ownership of opportunities from initial qualification through negotiation, closure and handover.

**2. Strategic Account Planning and Coverage**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive account plans for priority accounts.
* Complete 360-degree account mapping covering business priorities, technology landscape, existing deployments, procurement processes, competitors and partners.
* Build organisation charts identifying decision-makers, budget owners, technical evaluators, procurement stakeholders and influencers.
* Maintain account heat maps to identify current solution coverage, relationship gaps and growth opportunities.
* Establish a structured engagement plan for each account, including executive meetings, technical workshops and opportunity reviews.
* Build relationships across IT, information security, digital banking, operations, procurement and relevant business functions.

**3. Consultative and Value-Based Selling**

* Understand customer challenges and translate them into relevant software use cases and measurable business outcomes.
* Position solutions around customer priorities such as operational efficiency, security, automation, resilience and customer experience.
* Work with Sales Engineers and product specialists to conduct discovery sessions, presentations, demonstrations and proofs of concept.
* Develop business cases and proposals that clearly communicate solution value and commercial justification.
* Apply MEDDIC or the organisation’s prescribed sales qualification methodology to assess and advance opportunities.
* Build customer champions and secure access to economic buyers and key decision-makers.

* Track relevant procurement opportunities, including RFIs, RFPs and tenders.

* Ensure timely completion of bid documentation, internal approvals and submissions.
* Support clarification meetings, technical evaluations, commercial negotiations and contract finalisation.
* Follow applicable customer procurement requirements and company policies throughout the sales process.

* Develop productive relationships with system integrators, channel partners and other relevant ecosystem participants.
* Map three to five relevant partners for each priority account, based on customer access, capabilities and opportunity fit.
* Define clear responsibilities for customer engagement, solution positioning, bidding and execution.
* Build joint account plans and pursue partner-led and co-sell opportunities.
* Coordinate closely with the Partner Manager to strengthen partner engagement and resolve execution gaps.
* Support order processing and payment follow-up with partners and internal teams, as required.

* Maintain accurate and timely CRM records for accounts, contacts, opportunities and activities.
* Keep opportunity values, stages, expected closure dates, qualification details and next steps current.
* Build sufficient qualified pipeline to support the assigned quota and agreed coverage requirements.
* Provide realistic forecasts supported by customer engagement, procurement milestones and documented close plans.
* Identify deal risks early and develop mitigation actions.

Today, over 59,000 companies use MyBiz to streamline their corporate travel operations.
  
  
The business also houses a fast-growing MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions) vertical that delivers end-to-end solutions for group travel and events. From offsites and reward programs to large-scale conferences and exhibitions, the MICE team drives seamless execution through a strong supplier network, centralized contracting, and cost-effective planning.
  
  
Together, MyBiz and MICE position MakeMyTrip as a comprehensive partner for corporate mobility and engagement—empowering organizations to manage both everyday travel and strategic events with equal excellence.
  
  
About the Role: The incumbent in this role will be responsible for driving business growth by acquiring new corporate clients, nurturing key relationships, and expanding the MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions) portfolio across domestic and international markets within MakeMyTrip’s Corporate Channel business.
  
  
The role involves end-to-end ownership of MICE engagements—from understanding client briefs and managing RFPs to conducting destination research, creating customized proposals, and ensuring seamless coordination for flawless delivery.
  
  
It demands a strategic and consultative mindset, coupled with strong sales acumen and execution excellence, to deliver high-impact travel experiences that strengthen MakeMyTrip’s position as a trusted partner in corporate events and group travel.
  
  
**What Will You Be Doing**

* Identifying and evaluating potential corporate clients through networking, outreach, research, and referrals to drive continuous lead generation.
* Managing MICE queries end-to-end — from client briefing, destination shortlisting, budgeting, and proposal creation to closure and handover to operations.
* Preparing and presenting detailed RFPs for both domestic and international MICE destinations, ensuring commercially viable and creative solutions.
* Building and nurturing long-term partnerships with corporate clients to ensure consistent engagement and repeat business.
* Conducting destination and supplier research to create fresh, competitive, and differentiated proposals.
* Collaborating closely with internal teams (Contracting, Operations, Finance, Revenue) to ensure smooth and timely execution of all client deliverables.
* Tracking, analyzing, and reporting sales data, pipeline movement, and performance metrics to senior management.
* Presenting destination options, associated services, and pricing models tailored to client budgets and expectations.
* Developing and executing account-specific business development plans to expand market reach and client wallet share.
* Working with Marketing and Alliances teams to design co-branded campaigns or experiential programs for key clients.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Graduate with 6–10 years of experience in B2B corporate sales, business development, or MICE.
* Prior exposure to corporate travel, event management, or hospitality will be preferred.

**Key Success Factors For The Role**

* Demonstrating a deep understanding of corporate business development and account management.
* Engaging with leading industry professionals and clients, building strong relationships and networks.
* Gaining exposure to data analysis, insights generation, and strategic decision-making.
* Exploring domestic and international MICE destinations through travel opportunities.

title: Business Development Consultant (English)
description:

By partnering cross-functionally with onboarding, technical, and account management teams, you will ensure new advertisers achieve immediate value, measurable ROI, and enduring market impact.
  
  
Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

title: Business Development Manager - Rooftop Solar (Societies)
description:
**About SKS Cleantech (Arkah Energy)**

**SKS Cleantech Private Limited (Arkah Energy) is a Mumbai-based rooftop solar company offering CAPEX EPC, OPEX/RESCO (PPA) and O&M services to co-operative housing societies and commercial and industrial clients across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and pan-India.**

**About the Role**

**We are hiring a Business Development Manager to own the housing-society market across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region: find societies, get meetings with their managing committees, explain rooftop solar and our techno-commercial differentiators, and take opportunities through to committee approval and contract. This is an individual contributor role with a mix of field work and occasional office days.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Society prospecting and lead generation**

* Build and maintain a target list of housing societies across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane and the wider MMR, prioritised by terrace area, sanctioned load, monthly common-area electricity bill and building height.
* Approach societies through secretary, chairman and treasurer contacts, society managers, federations, referrals from existing customers and cold outreach.
* Run on-ground activity: society visits, notice-board and AGM/SGM-linked outreach, and awareness sessions where permitted.
* Track every lead in the CRM from first contact to handover.

**Meeting setup and committee engagement**

* Book and conduct introductory meetings, site visits and managing committee presentations.
* Identify the real decision makers (chairman, secretary, treasurer, committee members, influential residents) and manage the sequence of conversations needed to reach a committee resolution.
* Support the society through its internal process: draft resolution points, an AGM/SGM agenda note, and answers to resident queries.

**Explaining solar and our techno-commercial USP**

* Explain rooftop solar in plain language to non-technical committee members: net metering, savings on common-area bills, discom billing impact (MSEDCL, Adani, Tata, BEST), terrace usage, safety and maintenance.
* Present our commercial models clearly and compare them honestly: CAPEX (society invests) versus RESCO/PPA (zero investment, pay per unit), including tariff, escalation, tenure and ownership terms.
* Articulate our differentiators, led by our in-house technology stack that enables faster, data-backed and transparent proposals.
* Handle objections on terrace leakage, structural load, waterproofing, society funds, resident approval, vendor lock-in and project risk, with facts and reference projects.

**Proposal and closure support**

* Collect inputs (latest electricity bills, terrace photos, society details) and coordinate with the technical team for the site survey, design and proposal.
* Walk the committee through the proposal and financials; follow up through negotiation, clarifications and the committee/general body approval.
* Support documentation: work order, PPA/EPC agreement, and society NOC and approvals, with the legal and operations teams.
* Hand over closed deals to the project team with a clean brief, and stay the society's single point of contact until commissioning.

**Pipeline, reporting and market intelligence**

* Maintain a weekly pipeline with stage, next action and expected closure date.
* Report weekly on meetings held, proposals sent, committee decisions pending and reasons for losses.
* Track competitor offers, society sentiment, tariff and policy changes, and bring them back to the leadership team.
* Build a referral engine from satisfied societies: reference visits, testimonials and introductions to neighbouring societies.
* Target: convert about 1 MW of rooftop capacity per month.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of sales or business development experience in the rooftop solar industry (EPC, RESCO or channel).
* Direct experience selling to housing society committees, with proposals taken through committee and general body approval.
* Working knowledge of Mumbai/MMR rooftop solar: net metering and the discom process, terrace and structural constraints, typical society objections.
* Understanding of CAPEX and RESCO/PPA economics: tariff, savings, payback.
* Fluent in English and Hindi; Marathi is a plus. Comfortable travelling across MMR.
* Graduate in any discipline; B.E./B.Tech or MBA preferred, not mandatory.
* Existing network among societies, managers, federations or consultants is a strong plus.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed salary plus a performance-linked incentive paid every six months on conversions in the previous six months.
* Fuel allowance against receipts.
* Two weekly offs, which can fall on weekdays because society meetings usually happen on weekends.
* 3-month probation period.
* Growth path to Senior BD Manager / Regional Head for MMR.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
We're Hiring: Business Development Manager – Digital Marketing & Growth Solutions

Company: Stratiq Digital

Location: Mumbai

Role: Full-Time | Business Development & Client Acquisition

Experience: 3–7 Years (Relevant Agency Sales Experience Preferred)

About Stratiq Digital

Stratiq Digital is a results-driven digital marketing agency focused on helping brands grow through strategic marketing, performance-driven campaigns, compelling digital experiences, and creative solutions.

With extensive experience in performance marketing, digital strategy, and brand growth, we work with businesses to deliver measurable results and meaningful commercial impact.

We are looking for an ambitious, highly driven, and commercially sharp Business Development Manager who can take ownership of new client acquisition and play a pivotal role in expanding our business.

The Opportunity

We are not looking for someone who simply generates leads. We are looking for someone who converts opportunities into business.

This is a high-ownership, revenue-focused role for a professional who thrives on networking, building relationships, identifying business opportunities, and closing deals.

You will be responsible for driving new business across three core service verticals:

Performance Marketing: Meta Ads, Google Ads, lead generation, customer acquisition, e-commerce growth, and ROI-driven campaigns.

Website Development: Corporate websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, and conversion-focused digital experiences.

Social Media Marketing: Social media management, content strategy, creative campaigns, and brand communication.

The role combines inbound lead conversion, proactive prospecting, face-to-face networking, and strategic business development to build a consistent pipeline of high-value clients.

Key Responsibilities

Own New Business Acquisition & Revenue Growth

**Take end-to-end ownership of the business development cycle, from identifying prospects to successfully closing deals.**

**Consistently acquire new clients across performance marketing, website development, and social media marketing.**

**Understand prospective clients' business objectives, challenges, marketing budgets, and growth opportunities.**

**Develop compelling pitches that position Stratiq Digital as a strategic growth partner rather than just another marketing agency.**

**Independently manage client meetings, presentations, proposals, commercial negotiations, and closures.**

**Build a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities and consistently achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.**

Convert Inbound Leads into Paying Clients

**Take complete ownership of inbound enquiries generated through digital advertising, website enquiries, referrals, and other marketing channels.**

**Respond promptly, qualify prospects, and identify genuine business opportunities.**

**Conduct discovery calls and consultations to understand client requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.**

**Coordinate with internal strategy and creative teams to develop customised proposals and pitches.**

**Follow up persistently and professionally to maximise lead-to-client conversion.**

**Ensure every qualified lead is systematically tracked and nurtured until closure or disqualification.**

Drive Offline Business Development & Strategic Networking

**A critical part of this role involves actively building business relationships beyond the office.**

**Regularly attend industry conferences, trade fairs, business exhibitions, networking events, entrepreneur meets, and professional gatherings.**

**Proactively identify and engage business owners, founders, CEOs, CMOs, marketing heads, and other key decision-makers.**

**Build meaningful relationships with potential clients and identify opportunities for digital marketing partnerships.**

**Represent Stratiq Digital confidently and professionally at industry events.**

**Convert event interactions into qualified meetings, proposals, and ultimately paying clients.**

**Develop and maintain a strong professional network that creates a continuous source of business opportunities.**

**Identify relevant upcoming industry events and proactively plan participation to maximise business generation.**

**We expect someone who can walk into a room full of business owners, initiate meaningful conversations, identify opportunities, and turn those connections into long-term clients.**

Lead Sales Presentations, Proposals & Negotiations

**Confidently pitch digital marketing solutions to founders, business owners, and senior marketing decision-makers.**

**Communicate the business value of performance marketing, website development, and social media marketing.**

**Translate client challenges into relevant, commercially viable marketing solutions.**

**Work with internal teams to prepare impactful presentations, proposals, and scope-of-work documents.**

**Handle objections, negotiate commercials, and close deals while protecting agency profitability.**

**Identify opportunities for retainers, cross-selling, and long-term client partnerships.**

Build a Predictable & Scalable Sales Pipeline

**Maintain accurate records of prospects, meetings, proposals, follow-ups, and deal stages in the CRM.**

**Develop a disciplined approach to prospecting, follow-ups, and opportunity management.**

**Track conversion rates, sales cycles, pipeline value, and revenue forecasts.**

**Provide weekly updates on business development activities, opportunities, challenges, and closures.**

**Continuously identify new industries, business segments, and acquisition channels.**

**Contribute ideas to improve lead quality, sales effectiveness, and overall business growth.**

**Who We're Looking For**

**We want a natural business developer, persuasive communicator, proactive networker, and strong deal closer.**

**Essential Requirements**

**3–7 years of relevant experience in business development, B2B sales, or client acquisition, preferably within a digital marketing, advertising, or creative agency.**

**Demonstrated experience in successfully closing B2B clients and achieving revenue targets.**

**Strong understanding of performance marketing, website development, and social media marketing services.**

**Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.**

**Confidence in interacting directly with founders, business owners, and senior management.**

**Proven ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle.**

**Strong follow-up discipline, commercial awareness, and result-oriented mindset.**

**Willingness and enthusiasm to regularly attend conferences, exhibitions, trade fairs, and networking events across Mumbai and other relevant markets.**

**Ability to work independently, take initiative, and operate with minimal supervision.**

**What Will Make You Stand Out**

**An established network of business owners, founders, marketing heads, or senior decision-makers.**

**A proven record of acquiring clients for digital marketing agencies.**

**Experience selling recurring monthly marketing retainers and high-value digital projects.**

**Ability to confidently discuss marketing budgets, lead generation, ROAS, ROI, customer acquisition, and conversion strategies.**

**A consultative selling approach that focuses on solving business problems rather than merely selling services.**

**Strong networking instincts and the ability to create business opportunities without depending entirely on company-generated leads.**

**A demonstrable history of meeting or exceeding sales targets.**

**What Success Looks Like**

**Your success will be measured by your ability to:**

**Consistently close new clients and generate profitable revenue.**

**Convert qualified inbound enquiries into signed contracts.**

**Independently generate business through networking, conferences, exhibitions, and proactive outreach.**

**Build a strong, predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities.**

**Acquire recurring retainer clients alongside one-time website and digital projects.**

**Develop long-term relationships that contribute to sustained agency growth.**

**This is a target-driven role with clear accountability for new business revenue, not simply lead generation or meeting coordination.**

**What We Offer**

**The opportunity to play a key role in the growth of an ambitious digital marketing agency.**

**Direct exposure to business owners, founders, and senior marketing decision-makers.**

**The freedom to proactively explore new industries, markets, and business opportunities.**

**A collaborative internal team to support strategy, pitches, and execution.**

**Competitive fixed compensation with performance-linked incentives.**

**Significant growth opportunities based on performance and business impact.**

**How to Apply**

**If you are someone who loves meeting people, understands digital marketing, thrives on winning new business, and has the confidence to turn conversations into contracts, we would love to hear from you.**

**To apply, share your CV along with:**

**Your experience selling digital marketing or related services.**

**Examples of clients or deals you have personally closed.**

**Your average deal size and monthly or quarterly sales achievements.**

**Your experience generating business through networking, events, or independent prospecting.**

* **We're looking for someone who doesn't wait for opportunities — but knows how to create them, pursue them, and close them.**

title: Leads Specialist
description:
Your job in one line: every person who enquires with Urbane Decor gets a real conversation and a clear next step.

**About Us**

Urbane Decor (M H Deco LLP) is a premium architectural surfaces brand for interiors and exteriors, with 2,400+ projects delivered across India. Architects, interior designers, developers, dealers and homeowners come to us for their projects.

**The Role**

You will handle around 5 to 10 new enquiries a day, plus the follow-ups on every open one. We care about depth more than volume: each enquiry is a person with a real project and a deadline. This is a new role, so you will shape how it works.

**Job Details**

* Location: Vile Parle West, Mumbai (office-based)
* Full-Time, Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm, one Saturday off a month
* Reports to: Founder / Director

**Pay and Incentives**

* Fixed salary: ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month, based on your experience
* Incentive on every order: earned on top of your salary for each order that comes from your leads, and paid once the client's payment is received. The more orders your leads bring, the more you earn. We share the incentive structure at interview.

**What You'll Own: Respond**

* Reply to every new enquiry from the website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Meta ads, Google Business Profile, Justdial and phone calls
* Read the full chat history first, so nobody has to repeat themselves
* Handle replies from our outreach to architects, designers and developers on LinkedIn, email and BNI

**What You'll Own: Connect**

* Pick up the phone rather than only texting. Learn who they are, the space, the area in sq ft, the project stage, the city and the timeline
* Give designers, architects, dealers and bulk buyers priority
* Send the right catalogue, arrange samples and book Experience Centre visits
* Hand serious buyers to the sales team with a complete brief, and confirm the handover

**What You'll Own: Follow Through**

* Keep following up until there is a clear yes or no, then close the lead politely
* Keep every promise made to a lead, and check stock, price and delivery with the team before you make one
* Log every lead, call and outcome the same day in our tracker and CRM, and fill in a short daily scorecard
* Use our AI-assisted worklist and draft replies, and apply your own judgment before anything goes out
* Tell us each week which channels bring real buyers and what customers keep asking for

**Your First 90 Days**

* Days 1–30: Learn the full range at our Experience Centre, sit in on calls, and start replying to new enquiries with support.
* Days 31–60: Own all new enquiries yourself, and work through older open enquiries one by one.
* Days 61–90: Hit the targets below every week, and bring us one idea that improves how we handle leads.

**How We'll Measure You**

* First reply within 30 minutes during working hours
* A real conversation with at least 1 in 2 new leads within 2 working days
* Every open lead has a status and a next follow-up date, every day
* Samples, Experience Centre visits and quotations that come from your leads

**What We're Looking For**

* 1+ years in inside sales, telecalling, customer support or lead handling. We will teach you the products, so industry experience is a plus and not a must
* A warm, confident phone voice in English and Hindi (Marathi or Gujarati a plus)
* Clear, polite written replies on WhatsApp and Instagram
* Good with Google Sheets, and organised enough to hold many conversations without dropping one
* Bonus: you have spoken with architects or designers, used a CRM such as Odoo or Zoho, or simply love interiors

**Not For You If**

* You send one message and wait for the customer to come back
* You prefer copy-paste replies to reading what the person actually wrote
* You need someone to remind you who to call next

**Why Join Us**

You will be a core member of a small, fast-moving team, with real ownership of how customers first meet our brand and direct access to the founders. Calls on the work number are recorded, and we review them with you every week so you improve quickly. You also get 12 days of paid leave after your 3-month probation.

**How To Apply**

Email info@urbanedecor.in with the subject "Leads Specialist, Mumbai", and attach these three things:

* Your CV
* A 60-second voice note introducing yourself, in English or Hindi
* Your reply to this: a stranger sends our Instagram page one word, "Price?". What do you write back?

We only review applications that include all three.

Join us as a Senior Multi-Channel Field Sales Representative and make your mark in a role where relationships drive results. You'll partner with channel players to unlock growth opportunities, deliver solutions that matter, and help customers achieve their efficiency and sustainability goals with Schneider Electric's industry-leading portfolio.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Drive business growth by managing and developing a portfolio of channel partners through strategic field engagement
* Uncover new opportunities by understanding customer challenges and presenting tailored solutions from our complete offering
* Collaborate with specialized sales resources to craft winning proposals that address complex customer needs
* Build and maintain strong relationships across the value chain to maximize success and beat the competition

**What are the key skills we are looking for?**

* Account Management — intermediate level; managing partner portfolios to drive revenue growth and long-term value
* Consultative Selling — intermediate level; uncovering customer needs and positioning solutions that solve real business challenges
* Customer Relationship Management — intermediate level; building trust and loyalty across multiple stakeholder levels
* Negotiation — intermediate level; closing deals that balance customer value with business objectives
* Planning and Forecasting — intermediate level; setting priorities and predicting pipeline outcomes with accuracy
* Product Knowledge — intermediate level; articulating how our full portfolio addresses customer efficiency and sustainability goals
* Sales Prospecting — intermediate level; identifying and qualifying new opportunities within your territory
* Channel Development — intermediate level; equipping partners with tools and support to succeed throughout the customer journey

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

* Strategic thinker who thrives working independently and making confident decisions when the path isn't clear
* Strong influencer who inspires partners and customers to see new possibilities
* Team player who knows how to orchestrate resources and guide others toward shared success
* Customer-focused professional with genuine passion for solving meaningful business challenges

**What's in it for me?**

* Meaningful work where you help customers achieve real efficiency and sustainability impact
* Autonomy to manage your territory and build relationships your way
* Access to a comprehensive portfolio backed by industry-leading expertise and support
* Collaborative culture that values your contributions and invests in your professional growth

Bring your sales expertise to a team that's ready to support your success — apply today!
  
  
Rewards designed for you
  
  
Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.
  
  

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**
When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.
  
  
IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.
  
  
We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

title: Sales Engineer – Electrical/Electronics
description:
About Krafthan Systems:

KraftHan Systems delivers advanced Partial Discharge testing and Condition Monitoring solutions for the Power, Energy, Marine and Industrial sectors, helping clients protect critical electrical assets.

The company focuses on enhancing asset reliability, minimizing downtime, and extending the operational life of high-value electrical infrastructure through specialized diagnostic technologies.

The team works closely with clients to ensure safe, efficient, and consistent electrical performance, offering practical expertise that supports long-term operational success.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a motivated and technically proficient Sales Engineer with a strong understanding of electrical systems and a proven track record in technical sales. The Sales Engineer will be responsible for identifying and developing business opportunities in the Indian sub-continent region.

This full-time, on-site role includes engaging with prospective and existing customers, understanding their technical requirements, and proposing suitable solutions that align with their operational needs. Day-to-day activities involve conducting technical presentations and product demonstrations, preparing quotations and proposals, and coordinating with internal engineering teams to address customer specifications and application challenges.

The role also includes providing pre-sales and post-sales technical support, resolving customer queries, and maintaining strong, long-term customer relationships. The Sales Engineer will be expected to visit client sites, gather feedback from field applications, and contribute insights to improve product offerings and service delivery. The role is based out of Mumbai, with frequent travel within India.

Key Responsibilities:

       •      Develop and manage sales for testing & measuring instruments, and condition monitoring solutions in the power utility and industrial sector.

       •      Identify and engage with potential customers including utilities, EPCs, OEMs, and industrial clients.

       •      Demonstrate product capabilities and provide technical support during pre-sales and post-sales stages.

       •      Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and influencers in target organizations.

       •      Prepare proposals, quotations, and tender responses in coordination with the technical team.

       •      Monitor market trends and competitor activities to refine sales strategies.

       •      Achieve assigned sales targets and report on sales metrics, forecasts, and customer feedback.

Required Qualifications & Experience:

       •      Educational Qualification: Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.

       •      Experience: Minimum 3+ years of experience in technical sales if holding a B.E./B.Tech degree. Minimum 5+ years of experience if holding a Diploma in Engineering.

       •      Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of electrical assets in transmission, distribution, and generation.

       •      Familiarity with testing and measuring equipment, condition monitoring tools, and electrical safety systems.

Key Skills & Competencies:

       •      Strong communication and presentation skills.

       •      Ability to understand customer requirements and translate technical features into benefits.

       •      Self-motivated, target-driven, and capable of working independently.

       •      Comfortable with regular travel across India.

To Apply:

Email your resume and a brief cover letter to sales@krafthan.com with the subject line “Application for Sales Engineer”.

title: Engineer - Business Development & Market Intelligence - Battery Cooling
description:
Position: Engineer - Business Development & Market Intelligence (Battery Thermal Management Fluids)
  
  
Department: Marketing - Technical Operations
  
  
Location: Mumbai, with travel across India
  
  
Experience: 4+ years in BESS, EV, battery packs or power electronics
  
  
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electrical & Electronics, or Electronics & Communication
  
  
**About The Role**
Support business development for battery thermal-management fluids used in BESS and electric 2W/3W applications. Applications include water-glycol coolants for cold-plate cooling and dielectric fluids for immersion cooling. This role manages the business development data, prospect follow-ups and sample trials behind that growth.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Data and dashboards: Keep the BD web portals, outreach trackers and Excel master files accurate and up to date every day. Prepare weekly and monthly management reports.
* Customer follow-up: Run regular follow-ups with BESS, battery pack and 2W/3W EV manufacturers. Fix technical meetings and record the outcomes.
* Technical qualification: Confirm each prospect’s cooling method, coolant specification, fill volume and who decides the purchase. Track samples from dispatch to approval with the R&D team.
* Market intelligence: Track new manufacturers, plant capacities, competing coolant suppliers and cooling technology trends in India.
* Exhibitions: Support lead capture and follow-up at industry events.

**Requirements**

* Working knowledge of lithium-ion cells, battery packs, BMS and BESS systems.
* Understanding of battery cooling methods: air, cold-plate liquid and immersion.
* Strong MS Excel skills, and comfort with web dashboards and AI tools.
* Good communication in English. Hindi is an advantage.
* Disciplined with follow-ups and record-keeping, and willing to travel.

Skills: battery management systems,communication,english,business development,excel

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Business Development Manager

**Company:**
IDEX Events Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office (5 days a week)

**Department:**
Sales & Business Development

**About IDEX Events**

IDEX Events is a leading B2B events and exhibitions company behind established industry platforms such as
**Professional Beauty India, Aesthetic Medicine India and GamingCon Bharat**
.

Operating across diverse industries, IDEX creates platforms that bring together businesses, brands, professionals and key industry stakeholders through exhibitions, conferences and networking opportunities. With an expanding portfolio and plans to enter newer markets and industry verticals, IDEX offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing events business.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a driven and result-oriented
**Business Development Manager (BDM)**
to spearhead revenue generation for IDEX Events' portfolio of conferences and exhibitions.

The individual will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, acquiring clients and sponsors, developing strategic partnerships and driving sales across existing and upcoming event properties.

The role requires a strong understanding of B2B markets, excellent business development skills and the ability to work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and client satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Revenue Generation**

* Drive revenue growth through the sale of exhibition space, sponsorships, conference partnerships and other commercial opportunities.
* Identify, prospect and acquire new clients, exhibitors, sponsors and strategic partners across relevant industry verticals.
* Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline to consistently achieve and exceed assigned revenue targets.
* Explore new business opportunities across existing event properties as well as emerging markets and industry segments.
* Prepare commercial proposals, negotiate deals and successfully close business opportunities.
* Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers and industry stakeholders.

**2. Client Servicing & Relationship Management**

* Act as a primary point of contact for clients, ensuring effective communication and relationship management.
* Understand client objectives and recommend relevant participation and partnership opportunities.
* Ensure timely follow-ups, resolution of client queries and overall client satisfaction.
* Build long-term relationships to encourage repeat business and strengthen client retention.

**3. Internal Coordination & Event Execution**

* Work closely with marketing, operations and conference teams to ensure effective delivery of client commitments.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth onboarding and servicing of exhibitors, sponsors and partners.
* Maintain accurate sales reports, pipeline updates and client records through the company's CRM.
* Participate in pre-event planning, on-ground event execution and post-event client engagement.

**Candidate Profile & Requirements**

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales.
* Proven track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of B2B markets, sales cycles and consultative selling.
* Experience in exhibitions, conferences, media, events or sponsorship sales will be an added advantage.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Ability to independently identify opportunities, develop prospects and close business.
* Comfortable engaging with senior decision-makers, business owners and corporate stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM platforms.
* Willingness to work from the office five days a week.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to work across diverse industries including beauty, aesthetics, gaming and emerging business sectors.
* Exposure to established industry platforms and the opportunity to contribute to new event launches.
* A dynamic, growth-oriented environment with significant opportunities for professional development.
* The opportunity to build relationships with leading brands, industry professionals and business leaders.

**Job Summary**
The Senior Director Sales & Distribution leads the sales and distribution agenda for a portfolio of hotels within the designated area. Reporting to the VP, Sales & Distribution, South Asia and the Market Vice-President, West India, the role sets commercial direction, aligns property and multi-property sales teams with Marriott Commercial strategies and enterprise priorities, and strengthens customer and stakeholder relationships to deliver sustainable, profitable growth.
  
  
Accountable for revenue growth, market-share performance, business mix, channel profitability, and cost of sales, the Senior Director converts market intelligence into focused hotel-level strategies and execution plans. The role maintains regular communication with Market Vice President, West India and VP, Sales & Distribution, South Asia, ensuring timely visibility of performance, risks, opportunities, and key decisions, and remains closely aligned with both reporting leaders on priorities and execution. Working with Revenue Management, Finance, National Sales, General Managers, and owners, the role optimizes direct and intermediate channels, builds commercial capability, and positions hotels to capture priority demand across market segments.
  
  
BUSINESS CONTEXT
  
  

* Travel is required approximately 50% of the time.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  

* Graduate qualification required; a university degree is necessary.
* Eight to ten years of progressive hotel-industry experience, with a strong focus on sales, marketing, and distribution.
* Demonstrated experience leading commercial strategy across multiple properties or markets is preferred.

Skills and Competencies Commercial and Distribution Expertise
  
  

* Deep knowledge of hotel sales, digital commerce, distribution channels, strategic pricing, yield management, and account profitability.
* Proven ability to develop and implement successful sales and distribution strategies aligned with brand priorities and market conditions.
* Strong understanding of revenue management, sales contracts and commercial planning.

Leadership and Influence
  
  

* Demonstrated leadership, coaching, and talent-development capability.
* Ability to influence outcomes and align stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Strong customer-development and relationship-management skills.

Business and Communication Acumen
  
  

* Ability to interpret market, financial, operational, and competitive data and convert insights into action.
* Working knowledge of operating and capital budgets.
* Excellent written, verbal, listening, negotiation, and presentation skills.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Area Commercial Leadership
  
  

* Partner with the VP, Sales & Distribution, South Asia, the Market Vice-President, West India, and General Managers to set area sales priorities, accelerate revenue growth, and gain market share.
* Keep the Market Vice-President, West India and VP, Sales & Distribution, South Asia informed through regular, fact-based updates on business performance, market dynamics, risks, opportunities, and decisions requiring leadership alignment.
* Translate Marriott Commercial strategies and enterprise and regional priorities into clear area and hotel-level goals, deployment plans, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
* Provide strategic direction to hotel and above-property sales leaders, ensuring consistent focus and execution across the portfolio.
* Communicate initiatives clearly and recalibrate strategy in alignment with both reporting leaders as customer, competitive, and market conditions evolve.

Revenue, Market Share, and Business Planning
  
  

* Responsible for total revenue in hotels across rooms, catering and banquets, food and beverage, and other relevant revenue streams.
* Use market share, month-end, cost-of-sales, competitive, and business outlook data to identify growth opportunities and close performance gaps.
* Review and shape annual business plans and translate them into specific, measurable strategies by hotels and segment.
* Lead annual pricing, RFP, and RFI processes, with oversight of group contracts and business-evaluation recommendations.
* Conduct regular property and performance reviews, recognize strong delivery, and establish corrective action plans where results fall short.

Sales Strategy and Deployment
  
  

* Develop and execute area sales strategies that optimize hotels business mix and deploy resources against priority segments and accounts.
* Direct sales leaders across corporate, groups, catering, business travel, extended stay, reservations, and destination sales, as applicable.
* Lead field account management to accelerate strategic-account growth, acquisition, retention, and conversion.
* Monitor account deployment, lead flow, conversion, performance, and leakage across the GSO, National Sales Organization, properties, clusters, and EBCs.
* Embed disciplined account planning and pipeline management to expand existing accounts and capture new opportunities.

Revenue Management and Distribution
  
  

* Partner with Area Revenue Management to set and continuously refine pricing, channel, segment, and sales strategies in line with demand patterns and business outlook.
* Optimize distribution channels and loyalty programs to balance revenue growth, profitability, customer value, and cost of sales.
* Maintain a current view of competitor pricing, positioning, sales strategies, strengths, and vulnerabilities across priority segments.

Customer and Stakeholder Relationships
  
  

* Build trusted, commercially focused relationships with owners, General Managers, hotel leaders, customers, and internal discipline partners.
* Act as the voice of the customer and participate in strategic sales calls, negotiations, site inspections, customer events, and trade shows.
* Mobilize the GSO, NSO, cluster sales teams, EBCs, Revenue Management, and other functions to convert opportunities and deliver integrated customer solutions.
* Strengthening industry, community, and alliance relationships through relevant local, regional, national, and international forums.

Talent and Organizational Capability
  
  

* Build a strong sales leadership pipeline through disciplined selection, deployment, development, engagement, succession planning, and career progression.
* Coach and mentor sales leaders and associates to strengthen commercial capability, accountability, and performance.
* Review organization design, staffing levels, KPIs, and goals regularly, realigning resources and priorities where required.

Hotel Openings, Conversions, and Development
  
  

* Lead commercial planning and sales execution for hotel openings and conversions, including strategy, pricing, staffing, and pro forma input.
* Support development assessments, new-project planning, cluster design, and owner engagement.

Perform other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
  
  
GLOBAL DISTRIBUTION STRATEGY
  
  

* Set hotel-level goals and incentives that grow profitable room nights through direct channels and strengthen demand acquisition.
* Assess intermediate channels on net revenue and cost of sales and redirect hotel activity to improve channel profitability.
* Partner with the Director, Distribution Strategy, South Asia to implement priority distribution initiatives across the area.

MANAGEMENT COMPETENCIES Leadership
  
  

* Communication: Conveys information and ideas clearly, credibly, and persuasively through a range of methods.
* Leading Through Vision and Values: Keeps Marriott’s vision and values central to decisions and actions.
* Managing Change: Leads change, remove barriers, sustains momentum, and models composure under pressure.
* Problem Solving and Decision Making: Assesses issues and opportunities, compares evidence, evaluates alternatives, and selects an effective course of action.
* Professional Demeanor: Demonstrates confidence, earns respect, and represents the company in line with its values.
* Strategy Development: Identifies high-potential opportunities and develops practical business plans supported by disciplined evaluation.

Managing Execution
  
  

* Building a Successful Team: Builds cohesive, engaged teams focused on a shared mission.

* Driving for Results: Sets high standards, establishes accountability, monitors progress, and acts proactively to achieve objectives.

Building Relationships
  
  

* Customer Relationships: Builds and sustains relationships grounded in customer and stakeholder needs and Marriott service standards.
* Global Mindset: Values diverse perspectives and uses them to strengthen innovation, engagement, and business results.
* Strategic Partnerships: Builds collaborative internal and external partnerships and connects disciplines, markets, and resources to achieve shared objectives.

Talent and Organizational Capability

Professional Expertise

* Opportunity Analysis: Uses customer, economic, financial, industry, and organizational data to identify opportunities and inform action.

Business Results

The Scale Ecosystem Sales Manager (ESM), India is a senior, market-facing role responsible for building and scaling GitLab's partner business in India across the full breadth of the ecosystem. This role focuses on new logo acquisition and aligns closely with our new business team in India. This will involve working with hyperscalers, India-centric system integrators (SIs), and born-in-the-cloud / AI-native partners. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who has already built a career scaling partner-sourced and influenced revenue in India — someone who knows the hyperscaler ecosystem (AWS & GCP), has deep, credible relationships with India's major SIs, and understands how to engage newer-generation cloud-native and AI partners as they become an increasingly important part of the go-to-market.

* Direct experience managing hyperscaler relationships (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) including Marketplace motion.

* Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align internal sales, marketing, and partner-side stakeholders around joint goals.
* Native or business-fluent Hindi and strong business English (for regional collaboration with APJ leadership).

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience at or with a hyperscaler (AWS, GCP) in a partner or alliances capacity.
* Familiarity with GitLab, DevSecOps, or adjacent developer-tooling ecosystems.
* Experience helping design or reset a partner coverage model, comfortable building process rather than only inheriting one.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
We're building Suman, an app (Android, iOS and web) that helps Indians with burnout, family pressure, log kya kahenge and everything in between. So we're not going to pretend this job is about "pushing product."

Here's the truth: we're a team of people who give a damn. Suman is a personal wellness companion that actually speaks Hindi, Hinglish and English, and gets your stress without judgment. Therapists can also use it to stay connected with their clients between sessions. We need one more person, this time out in the field.

Mumbai · In the field · Full-time

Fair pay, travel allowance and incentives. Own your territory.

What you'll work on:

→ Meeting psychologists, psychiatrists and counsellors across Mumbai and Thane.

→ Showing them how Suman supports their clients between sessions, and exactly what they see and what stays private.

→ Sitting with them as they connect their first client, then coming back to fix whatever gets in the way.

→ Helping run small evening workshops for clinicians in your area.

→ Bringing back what clinicians tell you, so we build what they actually need.

A client sees their therapist for one hour a week. You'll help Suman be there for the other 167.

Few points:

→ Best suited for 2-6 years in pharma field sales (Medical Representative or Business Executive), ideally in a CNS or psychiatry division. Psychology graduates who love meeting people, apply too.

→ You know Mumbai and Thane, and the locals don't scare you. English and Hindi; Marathi is a bonus.

→ We don't work on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.

→ Done with your visits early? The rest of the day is yours. We count the therapists you help get started, not hours or kilometres.

→ A short call report each evening and one weekly review. No micromanaging.

→ Salary on the last working day of every month.

We'd love someone who fits that culture and can start within 2 months. Once you're in, our notice period is a humane 15 days, because life's too short for long goodbyes.

[Applications are only accepted through LinkedIn.]

title: Key Accounts Executive - HLA
description:
**Company Description**
Akshayakalpa Organic is India’s first certified organic dairy enterprise, combining scientific practices with the country’s traditional dairy farming heritage. The organization follows a farmer-first and planet-friendly approach, striving to deliver nutritious products that are free from antibiotics, chemicals, and preservatives. Akshayakalpa’s model empowers farming communities through ethical, humane, and profitable entrepreneurship initiatives. The company prioritizes sustainable farming, natural fodder, and stress-free, free-roaming cows to ensure high-quality, great-tasting milk. Its farm-fresh and A2 milk form the basis of a range of organic dairy products, including curd, ghee, butter, paneer, and artisan cheese.
  
**Role Description**
The Key Accounts Executive – HLA role is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. This role is responsible for managing and growing relationships with key modern trade, HORECA, and large retail accounts, ensuring consistent availability and visibility of Akshayakalpa products. Day-to-day activities include coordinating with account stakeholders for orders, promotions, and merchandising, as well as monitoring sales performance and implementing initiatives to meet revenue and distribution targets. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams such as sales, marketing, supply chain, and finance to execute account plans, resolve operational issues, and maintain high service levels. The Key Accounts Executive will track market trends, gather customer feedback, and recommend improvements to strengthen Akshayakalpa’s brand presence and partnerships in the region.
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience in key account management, preferably in FMCG, dairy, or food and beverage, with a focus on modern trade or large retail accounts.
* Strong sales, negotiation, and relationship-building skills to manage multiple stakeholders and drive account growth.
* Ability to analyze sales data, track performance metrics, and prepare accurate reports and forecasts.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally and represent the brand professionally.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities to handle field visits, account reviews, and promotional activities.
* Working knowledge of MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and basic CRM or sales management tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in the Mumbai market and familiarity with sustainable or organic product segments is beneficial.

* Ensure successful deployments that can scale from proof-of-concept to enterprise-wide implementation
* Partner with global product teams to prioritize features critical for Indian financial institutions, such as multi-language support, data residency, auditability, and integration with local systems
* Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to navigate India's evolving AI and data protection regulations
* Provide market intelligence on competitive dynamics, pricing expectations, and emerging BFSI use cases unique to India
* Build internal alignment between Anthropic's global strategy and India's market requirements

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 15+ years of enterprise sales experience in the Indian market, with a proven track record of closing large, complex deals, ideally across BFSI sector
* Deep understanding of how Indian financial institutions operate, including decision-making processes, budget cycles, and stakeholder dynamics
* Experience selling transformational technology (Cloud, AI/ML, Digital Transformation platforms) to Indian enterprises
* Established relationships with senior executives across banks, NBFCs, insurers, or fintechs
* Understanding of the Indian regulatory landscape, including RBI, NSE, IRDAI, and SEBI requirements, data protection laws, and sector-specific compliance
* Consultative selling expertise, with the ability to position AI as a strategic business driver rather than just a technology solution
* Complex deal structuring experience, including multi-year contracts, phased deployments, and outcome-based pricing
* Technical acumen to engage credibly with CTOs, architects, and data science teams
* Cross-cultural communication skills to work effectively with both Indian stakeholders and global teams
* Entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to build a market from scratch with limited local resources initially
* Patient yet persistent approach to long enterprise sales cycles, while maintaining momentum

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience selling directly into large Indian banks, insurers, or financial conglomerates
* Relationships with Indian system integrators such as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and HCL, particularly their BFSI practices
* Familiarity with Indian business groups and conglomerates, and how decisions flow within these complex organizations
* Track record of first-in-market roles or launching new products in India
* Domain expertise in areas critical to Indian financial services, such as UPI payments, core banking systems, KYC/AML compliance, Aadhaar integration, or insurance underwriting
* Knowledge of government initiatives such as Digital India and their impact on financial sector technology adoption
* Experience navigating public sector bank and PSU sales processes is a plus

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Interconnection Sales Specialist
description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Interconnection Sales Specialist (ICS) is an architecture-led seller who grows interconnection revenue across Equinix's full portfolio, physical and virtual, in new and existing accounts.
  
  
An ICS sells architectures, not transactions. They work with customers to design how their networks, clouds, partners and AI workloads connect, then land that design on Platform Equinix as a repeatable pattern. Each landed architecture is a design win: a durable position in the account that further connections and workloads route through.
  
  
The ICS partners with Account Executives (across all teams), Solution Architects, Sales Engineers, and Technical Account Managers to create pull-through for the whole team, not to compete with it for credit.
  
  
What you'll sell
  
  
The ICS sells every Equinix interconnection service, combined into the architecture the customer needs rather than one product at a time. Typical architectures the ICS designs and lands include:
  
  

* WAN core and network modernization on Fabric and Network Edge
* Hybrid multicloud connectivity using Fabric Cloud Router and cloud on-ramps
* Distributed AI hubs and high-capacity GPU and data-movement interconnect
* AI inference and application delivery at the edge
* Private connectivity to SaaS, AI platforms and ecosystem partners
* Digital supply chain and partner ecosystems built on cross connects, peering and Metro Connect

**Responsibilities**
Architecture-led selling and design wins
  
  

* Lead design conversations with customer network, cloud and infrastructure architects to understand business drivers, technical requirements and pain points
* Map customer needs to proven interconnection architectures, combining physical and virtual services into a single design
* Partner with Solution Architects on presales feasibility and solution design, and produce blueprints another team can run
* Register the architecture scope early, and drive it from customer commitment to the first production circuit and a published blueprint
* Build value cases and value metrics that show the business impact of the architecture to technical and executive buyers

Account and territory planning
  
  

* Run joint account planning with Account Executives and Sales Engineers for assigned accounts, segments or verticals
* Analyze the installed base and interconnection footprint to find accounts ready for a new architecture, and prioritize them for short- and long-term pursuit
* Drive interconnection growth in existing accounts and help open new logos, including magnet customers that pull through partners and ecosystems
* Contribute to quarterly business reviews to find and develop new interconnection opportunities

Partnership with the account team
  
  

* Act as the interconnection expert for the account team, from pursuit strategy through close
* Bring in the right resources for each deal: Solution Architects, Technical Account Managers, product, customer success, alliances and channel partners
* Co-sell with cloud, technology and channel partners where partner-led plays create the strongest path to a design win
* Hand off landed architectures cleanly so that follow-on connections are booked by whoever is best placed, whether AE, partner or portal

Expertise and enablement
  
  

* Be the field expert on the full interconnection portfolio, industry trends and competitive landscape
* Help AEs identify interconnection fit, use cases, buyer personas, common objections and competitors
* Contribute to playbooks, reference architectures and customer case studies so winning patterns repeat across the region
* Keep current on networking, multi-cloud, AI infrastructure and digital transformation trends

Pipeline, forecasting and cadence
  
  

* Build and manage a pipeline of architecture opportunities against monthly, quarterly and annual objectives
* Provide timely, accurate forecasts and opportunity status through the team's operating cadence
* Follow the Equinix selling methodology and keep CRM records current, including registered design scopes
* Work with marketing, partner and business development on campaigns that generate interconnection pipeline

Commercials and negotiation
  
  

* Support the AE on quoting, pricing, negotiation and closing of interconnection deals
* Shape commercial structures that support the full build-out of the architecture over time
* Work with deal desk and legal on interconnection terms as needed

**Qualifications**
Knowledge and experience
  
  
**Required**

* 5+ years selling network, cloud, data center or infrastructure-as-a-service solutions to enterprise or service provider customers, in a technical sales, or specialist role
* Architecture depth in enterprise networking, interconnection and hybrid multicloud: WAN, routing, peering, cloud connectivity and network virtualization
* Ability to design a solution with customer architects and write it up as a blueprint others can deliver
* Executive presence and credibility with both technical buyers and business decision makers
* Track record of working with account teams and partners, and meeting or exceeding sales objectives
* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI and GPU-cluster networking, data movement or large-scale cloud architecture (especially for Strategic and hyperscale accounts)
* Hands-on background as a network or solutions architect, or with a cloud provider, carrier or network service provider
* Industry certifications such as CCNP, JNCIP or cloud networking specialty certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud
* Experience in one of Equinix's vertical segments: Financial Services, Enterprise, Strategic, Telco & Media or Public Sector
* MBA or advanced degree

Our Culture

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Come build something meaningful with us.**

Autopulze is an early-stage, growth-oriented platform that we are building to make connections across the automotive aftermarket more useful and accessible. We are starting by helping suppliers and buyers improve inventory visibility and connect through qualified enquiries. As a Field Sales Executive, you will be one of the people who bring this platform to life—meeting businesses, listening to their needs, and turning first conversations into lasting relationships.

**Our Vision**

To build a trusted, connected, and increasingly intelligent automotive
**B2B ecosystem where businesses can discover opportunities, access the right supply, and grow with greater confidence**
.

**Our Mission**

To make business connections across the automotive aftermarket simpler and more productive—starting with better inventory visibility and enquiry connections and growing towards a marketplace that creates value for suppliers, distributors, garages and other industry participants.

***A note from the founding vision:***
Autopulze is being built on one relationship, one useful insight, and one dependable action at a time. We want people who join us to feel that they are helping shape the

company—not simply filling a position.

**Your journey at Autopulze**

You will help shape Autopulze’s earliest market relationships. Your conversations will influence how the platform is understood, which business needs are prioritized, and how the onboarding experience evolves. This is a
**role for someone who enjoys being out in the market, learning directly from customers, and seeing the impact of consistent relationship-building.**

**What you will help make happen**

* Meet and engage garages, workshops, retailers, and other potential buyers, as well as suppliers, dealers, and distributors.
* Explain the Autopulze proposition clearly and demonstrate how the platform can support discovery, visibility, and business inquiries.
* Build a qualified pipeline, follow up consistently, and convert relevant prospects into active platform participants.
* Support onboarding, capture accurate business information, and ensure required consent is recorded before adding individuals to WhatsApp groups or marketing communications.
* Share market feedback, customer pain points, and competitor observations with the founder and team.
* Represent Autopulze professionally in the field and help build trust in the brand through reliable follow-through.

**You may be a great fit if you bring**

* Hands-on
  **B2B e-commerce sales experience is mandatory.**
* Confidence in field sales, relationship-building, prospecting, negotiation, and follow-up.
* Ability to communicate with business owners and decision-makers in a practical, respectful way.
* Deep understanding of Mumbai city and suburban areas is a must, and comfort with extensive local travel across the city and nearby business clusters; travel expenses are reimbursed as per company policy.
* Self-motivation, resilience, learning agility, and the ability to work in an evolving startup environment.

**What you can experience here**

* A chance to contribute early and see how your work connects to real business outcomes.
* Direct collaboration with the founder and a close-knit team where initiative, reliability, and ideas matter.
* Room to learn, take ownership, and grow as the business develops—alongside the company, not just within a fixed job description.
* Earn attractive incentives with a progressive structure in place to ensure every effort and contribution is recognised.

**A word to the person considering this role**

**Job Location: CST, Mumbai (on-site)**

**Days per week: 6 Full days**

**Timings: 9:30am - 6:30pm (with flexibility as per terms of employment)**

If you enjoy opening doors, understanding how businesses really work, and building trust beyond a sales pitch, this position could be your opportunity to help create a new way for automotive businesses to connect. Bring your curiosity, energy, and ownership mindset—we’ll build the playbook together.

**If you want to help build the journey—not just join the journey—we’d like to hear from you.**
