title: Tour Sales Consultant
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – TOUR SALES CONSULTANT**

Nature Explorers India (NEI)

Position: Tour Sales Consultant

Department: Sales

Reporting To: Sales Head & Reporting Director

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Mulund West, Mumbai

Compensation: As per experience and skills

**1. Role Overview**

The Tour Sales Consultant will be responsible for converting qualified leads into confirmed tour bookings for Nature Explorers India (NEI), specialising in wildlife and nature-based travel experiences.

This is a sales conversion and closing role, not a telecalling or cold-calling profile. The Client Relationship & Experience Manager will manage the pre-sales process, including initial customer interaction, understanding travel requirements, and qualifying leads. The Tour Sales Consultant will take over qualified leads and drive them towards booking confirmation through effective sales conversations, customised proposals, negotiation, objection handling, and timely follow-ups.

The role requires strong sales acumen, customer understanding, ownership of conversion targets, and the ability to maximise revenue and Gross Profit (GP).

**2. Key Responsibilities**

A. Sales Conversion & Gross Profit Achievement

• Take ownership of qualified leads received from the Client Relationship & Experience Manager and convert them into confirmed bookings.

• Understand the customer's travel requirements, preferences, budget, and decision-making factors from the pre-sales handover.

• Recommend suitable wildlife tours, safaris, and customised nature travel experiences.

• Present tour proposals, itineraries, inclusions, and pricing effectively to help customers make informed decisions.

• Handle sales discussions, negotiations, objections, and customer concerns to close bookings.

• Achieve assigned monthly sales and Gross Profit targets.

• Identify opportunities for upgrades, add-on experiences, and higher-value bookings while maintaining profitability.

**B. Lead Conversion & Follow-up Management**

• Work exclusively on qualified leads rather than cold calling or generating enquiries through telecalling.

• Follow up with assigned prospects consistently until the booking is confirmed or the lead is appropriately closed.

• Understand customer hesitation and identify the reasons preventing conversion.

• Build customer confidence by explaining the value, uniqueness, and benefits of NEI's tour experiences.

• Ensure no qualified sales opportunity is lost due to delayed follow-ups, ineffective communication, or lack of ownership.

• Maintain accurate updates on lead status, next steps, and expected closure dates.

**C. Customer Engagement & Relationship Building**

• Build trust with prospective customers through personalised sales conversations and professional communication.

• Address questions related to tour itineraries, pricing, inclusions, wildlife experiences, and booking terms.

• Provide relevant information to support the customer's booking decision without making inaccurate commitments.

• Coordinate with the Client Relationship & Experience Manager whenever additional customer background or pre-sales information is required.

• Maintain a positive customer experience throughout the sales and booking confirmation process.

• Encourage repeat bookings and referrals through effective relationship management.

**D. Coordination with Operations**

• Coordinate with the Operations Team to verify tour availability, itinerary feasibility, inclusions, and other operational details before confirming commitments.

• Ensure customer requirements and special requests are accurately communicated.

• Complete a proper handover of confirmed bookings, including customer details, agreed pricing, payment status, and special requirements.

• Coordinate with the concerned teams to resolve booking-related queries or issues.

• Ensure a smooth transition from sales closure to tour execution.

**E. Sales Reporting & Performance Tracking**

• Maintain updated records of assigned qualified leads, follow-ups, quotations, negotiations, and booking status in the designated CRM.

• Track lead-to-booking conversion ratios, sales closures, revenue, and Gross Profit.

• Submit regular sales performance updates to the Sales Head.

• Analyse lost leads and identify reasons for non-conversion.

• Share feedback on lead quality, customer objections, pricing concerns, and market trends with the Client Relationship & Experience Manager and Sales Head.

• Identify opportunities to improve sales closure rates and profitability.

**F. Continuous Learning & Improvement**

• Develop in-depth knowledge of NEI's wildlife destinations, tour packages, itineraries, and customer segments.

• Continuously improve negotiation, objection-handling, presentation, and closing skills.

• Participate in sales reviews, training sessions, and performance improvement discussions.

• Understand customer buying behaviour and apply appropriate sales strategies.

• Take ownership of individual performance and proactively work towards achieving assigned targets.

**3. Key Expectations**

• Strong ownership of assigned qualified leads and booking conversions.

• Excellent sales, negotiation, persuasion, and closing skills.

• Consistent follow-ups and a result-oriented approach.

• Ability to maintain profitability while achieving sales targets.

• Clear communication and effective coordination with internal teams.

• Proactive problem-solving and accountability for sales outcomes.

• Commitment to customer satisfaction and accurate communication.

**4. Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

• Monthly sales and Gross Profit achievement.

• Qualified lead-to-booking conversion ratio.

• Number and value of confirmed bookings.

• Follow-up effectiveness and closure turnaround time.

• Profitability and GP per booking.

• Lost-lead analysis and improvement in conversion rates.

• Customer satisfaction and booking experience.

• Accuracy of CRM updates and sales reporting.

• Timely handover of confirmed bookings to Operations.

**5. Skills & Qualifications**

• Graduate in any discipline; Travel and Tourism or Hospitality qualifications will be an advantage.

• Prior experience in sales, tour sales, travel consulting, or closing qualified leads is preferred.

• Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and objection-handling skills.

• Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable travel experiences.

• Good knowledge of CRM systems, spreadsheets, and sales tracking tools.

• Strong target orientation, accountability, and customer-centricity.

• Passion for wildlife, nature, and travel will be an advantage.

**6. Preferred Traits**

• A confident closer who can convert opportunities into business.

• Proactive, persistent, and focused on results.

• Strong commercial understanding and profitability mind-set.

• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

• Organised, accountable, and committed to continuous improvement.

**IMPORTANT:**

• Minimum of 1 to 3 years’ experience in tourism Sales & Operations.

• Full time job

• Job location: Nirmal Corporate Centre, Mulund West

• Probation for 3 months

• Monday to Saturday 10 am to 7 pm. Sunday off. Monthly All Saturday’s Half Days – 10am to 3:30pm.

• Salary - As per currently drawn and industry standards. Our preferred bracket is 25k - 40k per month

Join Nature Explorers India and turn qualified travel enquiries into unforgettable wildlife and nature experiences.

**Job Description**

**Product Sales Specialist – Airtel IQ CPaaS Communication Portfolio**

**Role Purpose**

The Product Sales Specialist will act as a regional growth driver for the Airtel IQ Communication portfolio, covering Cloud Telephony, UCaaS, CCaaS, Omnichannel Messaging, WhatsApp Business, RCS and Spam based AI solutions.

This role is designed for a proactive sales enabler who can go beyond regular account management and actively create demand, build a strong opportunity funnel, engage customers consultatively, and convert communication-led business requirements into revenue opportunities.

The incumbent will work closely with enterprise sales teams, product teams, technical teams and customer stakeholders to position Airtel IQ solutions effectively and drive adoption across existing and new accounts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales Growth and Funnel Development**

* Build and execute regional sales plans for the Airtel IQ CPaaS and communication solutions portfolio.
* Identify new business opportunities across existing accounts, prospective customers and Sales team-led opportunities.
* Drive active funnel creation by initiating customer conversations, qualifying opportunities and progressing them through the sales lifecycle.
* Focus on portfolio penetration across Cloud Telephony, UCaaS, CCaaS, WhatsApp Business, IVR, RCS and SPAM AI based solutions.
* Work with sales teams to identify whitespace within accounts and convert those gaps into revenue-generating opportunities.
* Own opportunity movement from lead stage to demonstration, proposal, commercial closure and customer onboarding.

**2. Customer Engagement and Solution Positioning**

* Engage with CXOs, IT heads, business users and decision-makers to understand customer communication challenges and business goals.
* Translate technical capabilities into business outcomes such as improved customer engagement, better reachability, automation, compliance, productivity and customer experience.
* Conduct customer presentations, product walkthroughs, technical discussions and solution demonstrations.
* Position Airtel IQ as a converged communication platform that can support voice, messaging, collaboration and customer interaction use cases.
* Customize solution narratives based on customer segment, industry vertical and business requirement.

**3. Pre-Sales and Proposal Support**

* Collaborate with product, solution, technical, Customer Experience and commercial teams to design suitable customer solutions.
* Support the creation of value propositions, solution documents, proposals, RFP/RFI responses and bid submissions.
* Ensure proposals clearly highlight Airtel’s solution strengths, service capabilities, differentiation and customer value.
* Assist sales teams in handling technical queries, commercial discussions and customer objections.
* Provide inputs for use-case based solutioning across IVR, Cloud Telephony, UCaaS, CCaaS, WhatsApp, RCS and CPaaS APIs, Business name display and network API.

**4. Ecosystem Enablement**

* Work closely with internal sales teams to drive joint sales motions.
* Enable sales teams with product messaging, pitch decks, use cases, objection handling and technical understanding.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure all stakeholders are aligned on solution positioning and customer requirements.
* Build Sales team confidence through regular engagement, training, opportunity reviews and deal support.
* Drive accountability across sales teams to ensure timely opportunity progression.

**5. Market Intelligence and Business Planning**

* Track market trends, customer buying behavior, competitor offerings and emerging technologies in the CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS and OTT communication space.
* Identify growth opportunities based on industry trends, customer demand and regional market potential.
* Share market insights, customer feedback and competitive observations with product and business teams.
* Support business planning through regular funnel reviews, sales forecasts, opportunity tracking and performance reporting.
* Recommend initiatives to improve customer adoption, solution relevance and revenue growth.

**6. Customer Success and Revenue Expansion**

* Ensure smooth transition from sales closure to delivery and customer adoption by coordinating with relevant internal teams.
* Support account teams in increasing wallet share across assigned accounts and domains.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer usage, business expansion and communication needs.
* Maintain strong customer relationships to support long-term account growth and retention.
* Contribute to sustained adoption of Airtel IQ services across targeted customer segments.

**Key Deliverables**

**Funnel Creation and Conversion**

* Build a healthy and qualified regional sales funnel for Airtel IQ communication solutions.
* Drive movement of opportunities from prospecting to closure.
* Improve conversion rate through proactive follow-ups, demonstrations and solution-led engagement.

**Portfolio Penetration**

* Increase adoption of Cloud Telephony, UCaaS, CCaaS, WhatsApp, RCS, CPaaS, SPAM solutions across existing and new accounts.
* Identify whitespace in existing customer accounts and convert it into revenue opportunities.

**Sales Enablement**

* Equip sales teams with the right product knowledge, sales narrative and technical support.
* Conduct regular enablement sessions, customer workshops and product demonstrations.

**Proposal and Deal Support**

* Support high-quality proposal creation for RFPs, RFIs and strategic customer opportunities.
* Ensure timely submission of solution inputs, technical responses and customer-facing presentations.

**Business Outcome Ownership**

* Drive measurable improvement in opportunity pipeline, customer demonstrations, proposal submissions, deal closures and product adoption.
* Contribute directly to regional revenue targets for the Airtel IQ communication portfolio.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have a strong blend of sales acumen, technical understanding and consultative customer engagement skills. The role requires someone who can understand communication technologies, simplify them for customers and drive commercial outcomes through structured sales execution.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Good understanding of VoIP, Cloud Telephony, IVR, UCaaS, CCaaS and CPaaS platforms.
* Working knowledge of WhatsApp Business, RCS, SMS, APIs and omnichannel communication use cases.
* Current knowledge on what kind of SPAMs are unfolded in market and what are the solutions to counter the same
* Ability to understand enterprise voice, messaging and collaboration requirements.
* Comfort in working with technical teams to design customer-specific solutions.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in simple business language for decision-makers.

**Sales and Business Skills**

* Proven experience in B2B solution sales, enterprise sales, product sales or pre-sales.
* Ability to independently create, manage and progress a sales funnel.
* Strong experience in customer presentations, solution pitching, proposal support and deal closure.
* Strong commercial orientation with the ability to identify revenue opportunities within existing accounts.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ability to work with sales, product, solution, technical, CSD, and leadership teams.
* Strong influencing skills to drive alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior customer stakeholders, including business heads, IT teams and CXO-level decision-makers.

**Key Behavioral Attributes**

**Sales Drive**

The candidate should have a strong hunger to create opportunities, hunt within existing accounts and drive new revenue streams. This is not an administrative role. It requires a business driver who can actively influence pipeline and closures.

**Consultative Mindset**

The candidate should be able to understand customer pain points and recommend practical communication solutions that solve business problems.

**Technical Evangelism**

The candidate should be able to present converged communication solutions in a compelling manner, making them relevant for both business and technical stakeholders.

**Ownership and Execution**

The role requires strong follow-through, discipline and execution speed. The candidate should be able to move customer conversations from interest to demonstration, proposal and closure.

**Collaboration**

The candidate should be comfortable working across multiple teams , ensuring everyone is aligned toward customer success and revenue growth.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in telecom, cloud communications, CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, SaaS, enterprise voice, collaboration or digital customer engagement solutions.
* Prior exposure to enterprise customers, SMB or mid-market accounts.
* Experience in handling customer demos, technical discussions, solution proposals and RFP/RFI responses.
* Familiarity with communication platforms, APIs, SIP, IVR, WhatsApp Business, RCS and cloud-based voice solutions.

title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
**Role:**
Senior Sales Manager

**Location:**
Mumbai (field + office)

**Experience:**
5+ years in B2B sales

**Reports to:**
CMO

**Role description:**

This is a pure, quota-carrying sales role for someone who loves winning new customers. You will be the company's dedicated sales hire, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signing contract for SMEs and start-ups.

You will not inherit a team or a playbook. You will build the pipeline, close the first wave of logos, and help shape how the company sells as we grow. The growth potential is as much as you can chase your dream!

**What you will do:**

1. **Hunt new logos.**
   Build and work a target list of SME’s and start-ups in Manufacturing, Services and Retail your own network.
2. **Own the full sales cycle.**
   Run discovery with promoters, CEOs, CFOs and finance heads; deliver demos; build the business case; handle objections; negotiate and close.
3. **Hit your number.**
   Own and deliver an annual new-business target.
4. **Keep the pipeline honest.**
   Maintain every lead, opportunity and forecast in HubSpot CRM and share a weekly pipeline review with the Leadership.
5. **Work with marketing.**
   Follow up fast on inbound leads and feedback what prospects say so we can sharpen messaging, content and pricing.
6. **Shape the playbook.**
   Document what works (ICP, pitch, objection handling, pricing approach) so the next sales hires ramp faster and of course you will lead it!

**What you must bring:**

This role is open only to candidates with a hands-on, quota-carrying sales background. Applications from pre-sales, marketing, customer success or account-management-only profiles will not be considered.

* **7+ years in B2B sales**
  , with at least 4-5 years selling software, SaaS or tech services to SMEs or mid-market companies. Selling software’s like SAP / Oracle will be a big plus.
* **A closing track record:**
  you have personally negotiated and closed deals and can share your quota and attainment for the last 2–3 years.
* **Self-sourced pipeline:**
  a meaningful share of your closed deals came from your own prospecting and not inbound leads.
* **Comfort with business owners and finance leaders:**
  you can hold a conversation about cost, cashflow, margins and reporting with a promoter or CFO.
* You sell outcomes and not features.
* **Hunter mindset:**
  high activity, resilience with rejection and urgency in follow-up.
* **CRM discipline:**
  experience keeping a clean pipeline and forecast in a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho.
* **Strong communication**
  in English and Hindi; Marathi is a plus.
* Comfort splitting time between client meetings across Mumbai and the office.

**Good to have:**

* Experience selling ERP, finance software (SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, MS Business central etc).
* An existing network among SME promoters, CFOs, CA firms or industry associations in Manufacturing, Services or Retail.
* Experience as an early sales hire at a start-up or opening a new region or vertical.
* Any Degree does not matter, what matter is your sales record!

**This role is not for you if:**

* You have mainly set meetings or generated leads, and others closed the deals.
* You prefer managing a team over selling yourself.
* You need a large inbound engine or an established brand to hit your numbers.

title: Process Manager – Sales Operations & Lead Conversion
description:
**Company Description**
ORN Journeys is reshaping travel by designing every journey around the traveler rather than individual bookings. The company integrates mobility, stays, journeys, local operations, technology, and customer support into a single, organized system. In Europe, ORN’s model is expressed through fixed departures, integrated operations, direct procurement, and local teams. This approach creates simpler, more accessible, and more reliable travel experiences with one accountable standard for quality and service. ORN Journeys offers opportunities to work at the intersection of travel, technology, and operations in a growth-focused environment.

**Role objective**

Own the entire customer lead-management process, from the moment a customer enters the ORN system until the lead is closed, converted, or returned according to the defined process. Ensure that advisors work the right leads at the right time and that no customer is lost due to poor follow-up, delayed contact or weak process discipline.

The Process Manager owns serving the lead: ensuring that the process is followed for every customer.

**Key roles and responsibilities**

* Lead allocation: Ensure new leads are assigned correctly based on advisor capacity, language, city, product and specialization.
* Customer connectivity: Monitor first-call SLA, call attempts, connect ratio and timely follow-ups.
* Call discipline: Track calls and meaningful conversations, including the target of 3–4 minutes of talk time per lead where appropriate.
* Lead lifecycle management: Monitor every stage from first call to engaged, follow-up, will-book and booking closure.
* EBD management: Ensure every qualified customer has a realistic Estimated Booking Date (EBD), likely booking date and next action recorded.
* Appointment management: Ensure qualified customers receive appointments and that customer meetings are tracked, attended and followed up.
* CRM discipline: Maintain accurate statuses, call notes, callback dates, lead aging and disposition reasons.
* Pipeline recovery: Identify untouched, overdue, unconnected and stalled leads; drive corrective actions with advisors and the SME.
* Performance reporting: Publish daily funnel reports and identify process bottlenecks by advisor, source, city and product.
* Cross-functional coordination: Work with the SME-cum-Team Manager to improve sales conversion without taking over the SME's product coaching responsibilities.

**Experience and qualification**

* 5–10 years in BPO operations, contact center management, inside sales or lead management.
* Experience handling a team of agents, advisors or team leaders.
* Graduate required; management qualification preferred.
* Strong understanding of CRM systems, MIS, Excel, funnel analytics, workforce productivity and quality monitoring.
* Travel-industry experience is an advantage but is not mandatory if the candidate has strong sales-process experience.

**Ready to Build Your Career with ORN?**

If you're an experienced travel sales professional who loves Europe, enjoys connecting with customers and wants your earning potential to reflect your performance, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and become part of ORN Europe Journeys.

title: Business Development Manager, Monetization
description:

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development with a focus on monetization, advertising, or platform revenue
* Experience structuring and closing complex, multi-party commercial agreements including revenue-sharing, licensing, or platform monetization deals
* Track record of defining and executing partnership strategies that have generated measurable, large-scale revenue impact
* Experience engaging and influencing C-suite and senior executive stakeholders at partner organizations
* Experience operating independently in ambiguous, high-stakes deal environments with accountability for company-level outcomes

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience building and scaling business development functions or establishing new partnership categories from the ground up
* Background in commerce, payments, or emerging platform monetization surfaces such as messaging, AI-driven experiences, or wearables
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in digital advertising ecosystem partnerships, including programmatic, performance marketing, or ad tech monetization models

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

Sales & Client Relationships

**About Aarthik Solutions LLP**

Aarthik Solutions LLP is a multi-product financial services and asset distribution company focused on providing individuals and businesses with comprehensive financial solutions.

Our offerings include Mutual Funds, Equity & Commodities, Life, Health & General Insurance, Loans, PMS & AIF, Corporate Financial Solutions, Government Subsidy Consulting, and other financial and wealth management solutions.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a
**dynamic, target-oriented, and customer-focused Relationship Manager**
to join our sales team.

The Relationship Manager will be responsible for acquiring new clients, understanding their financial requirements, building long-term relationships, generating business, and recommending appropriate financial solutions based on customer needs.

The role involves both
**client acquisition and relationship management**
, with a strong focus on achieving monthly and quarterly business targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Generate new business through leads, references, networking, field activities, and other business-development initiatives.
* Understand clients' financial requirements and recommend suitable financial solutions.
* Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients.
* Follow up with prospects and convert qualified leads into business.
* Conduct online and offline client meetings and presentations.
* Cross-sell relevant financial products based on client requirements.
* Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Maintain accurate client and lead information in the company's CRM.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Operations, Compliance, and Product teams for smooth client onboarding.
* Provide proactive after-sales support and maintain high customer satisfaction.
* Stay updated with financial products, industry developments, market trends, and applicable regulations.
* Follow all company policies, compliance requirements, and ethical sales practices.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong sales and business-development orientation.
* Good convincing and negotiation abilities.
* Customer-focused approach.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, email, and CRM systems.
* Willingness to learn financial products and industry practices.
* Self-motivated, disciplined, and target-oriented.
* Ability to work independently as well as within a team.
* Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills.

**Eligibility**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Finance, Commerce, or Management background will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.
* Previous experience or internship in sales or financial services will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of the local language is preferred.

**Compensation**

**Annual CTC:**
₹1,80,000 – ₹2,40,000

In addition to fixed compensation, the role offers
**performance-linked incentives and rewards**
based on achievement of assigned business targets.

**Career Growth**

Successful candidates will receive training and mentorship in:

* Financial products and solutions
* Sales and client acquisition
* Relationship management
* Compliance and regulatory practices
* Business development



Career progression opportunities may include:

**Associate Realtionship Manager → Relationship Manager → Senior Relationship Manager → Team Lead**

**Why Join Aarthik Solutions LLP?**

* Opportunity to build a career in the financial services industry.
* Exposure to multiple financial products and business verticals.
* Structured training and professional mentorship.
* Performance-based incentives and recognition.
* Opportunity for career growth based on performance.
* Customer-first and professional work environment.

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.**

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Siddhi Education is a long-established learning organization with over 30 years of experience in the education sector. The institution offers regular, distance, and online learning options, providing flexible pathways for diverse learners. Siddhi Education covers a wide range of course types, enabling individuals to pursue education tailored to their interests and career goals. The organization is committed to helping learners explore knowledge and develop skills that support personal and professional growth. Its learner-focused approach emphasizes accessibility, quality, and continuous improvement in educational offerings.
  
**Role Description**
The Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building strategic partnerships, and expanding Siddhi Education’s presence in the Mumbai market. This full-time, on-site role involves meeting with potential institutional and corporate partners, presenting educational programs, and negotiating agreements that drive enrollment growth. The role includes analyzing market trends, developing and executing business development plans, and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders. The Business Development Manager will collaborate with marketing and academic teams to align offerings with market needs, track performance metrics, and prepare regular reports and forecasts. The position is based in Mumbai and requires active field engagement, client interactions, and participation in events and initiatives to promote Siddhi Education’s courses.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Demonstrated skills in business development, sales, and client relationship management, preferably in the education or training sector.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills to engage effectively with partners, institutions, and learners.
* Ability to conduct market research, analyze data, and develop strategic plans to grow enrollment and partnerships.
* Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple opportunities, follow up consistently, and meet targets.
* Proficiency with CRM tools, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), and basic digital platforms for outreach and reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Experience working in on-site, client-facing roles in Mumbai or similar metropolitan markets is beneficial.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and maintain a learner-centric, ethical approach to business growth.

title: RSM - Sales  – Vending Solution
description:
**Company Description**
Roastea is one of India’s fastest-growing omnichannel beverage companies, offering chai and coffee experiences through outlets, vending solutions, and an e-store. Founded by twin brothers Anurag and Chaitanya Bhamidipaty, Roastea is driven by a commitment to elevate everyday beverages from ordinary to exceptional. The brand has reimagined office vending with advanced brewing technology that delivers home-style chai, fresh coffee, and artisanal green teas. Roastea outlets provide a wide range of beverages, from bold traditional chais to specialty coffees and cold brews, catering to diverse preferences. Online, Roastea has introduced India’s first functional instant coffee, Super Power Coffee, designed to enhance focus, support workouts, and boost immunity.

**Role Description**
The RSM – Sales – Vending Solution (Mumbai) role at Roastea is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai, focused on driving sales and business growth for the vending solutions vertical in the assigned region. The role involves managing and expanding a portfolio of corporate and institutional clients, identifying new business opportunities, and achieving revenue and profitability targets. The individual will lead regional sales activities, including pipeline development, client meetings, negotiations, and closure of contracts, while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with operations and technical teams for smooth vending machine installations, monitoring performance and utilization, and implementing local marketing and promotional initiatives. The role also requires regular reporting on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities, as well as mentoring and supporting any assigned sales team members.

**Qualifications**

* Strong regional sales management experience in Corporate sales, Institutional sales, B2B or vending solutions, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
* Proficiency in client relationship management, account management, and negotiation, with the ability to handle complex corporate deals.
* Ability to analyze sales data, market trends, and customer feedback to inform strategy and improve performance.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Hands-on experience working on-site with customers and operations teams, ensuring smooth service delivery and issue resolution.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Experience in the vending machine industry is highly beneficial.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, productivity software, and basic reporting dashboards.
* Ability to work independently, manage regional responsibilities, and travel within the territory as required.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (FSI) - Mumbai
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
Elastic is searching for an Enterprise Account Executive (FSI) to expand our Enterprise and Strategic customer accounts. Our Enterprise Account Executives are individual contributors, passionate about building new business and growing the Elastic footprint within accounts of more than 4,000 employees and ensuring our customers are successfully leveraging Elastic cloud solutions across their organization. Are you ready to help users address their hardest problems through the power of search? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

* Building awareness and driving demand for Elastic solutions within new Enterprise accounts, by helping users and customers derive value from their data sets
* Serving as an evangelist for our Open Source offerings while communicating and demonstrating the capabilities of our commercial features
* Uncovering new and diverse use cases to enable our users to work smarter, not harder
* Collaborating across Elastic business functions to ensure a seamless customer experience
* Working thoughtfully with customers to identify new business opportunities, leading through the sales cycle and closing complex transactions
* Building a robust business plan through community, customer and partner ecosystems to achieve significant Elastic growth within your accounts

**What You Bring:**

* A track record of success in selling SaaS subscriptions into net new complex accounts, demonstrated by overachievement of quota and strong customer references
* A deep understanding and preferably experience selling into the ecosystem we live in, including Enterprise Search, Logging, Security, APM and Cloud
* The ability to build relationships and credibility with both Developers and Executives
* Predictability and accurate forecasting capabilities using SFDC

* Previous experience selling in to the FSI sector in India

* Previous experience selling in an Open Source model or SaaS

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
**(Internally titled Key Account Executive)**

  

Responsible for managing and growing an assigned portfolio of customers with less than US$250K in committed revenue, while developing new business opportunities. The role combines account management, renewals, client relationship development and proactive sales to maximise revenue, increase share of wallet and achieve sales targets.

  
Key Responsibilities

  

  
1. Account Management & Revenue Growth
  
2. New Business Development
  
3. Client & Internal Stakeholder Management
  

**Your Next Challenge:**
  

Own the day-to-day relationship for assigned accounts, developing a strong understanding of clients’ businesses, industries, content needs and workflows to identify growth opportunities.

  

  
* Grow existing accounts by increasing content consumption, expanding user adoption, identifying content gaps and maximising share of wallet
  
* Drive consumption and retention of committed deals through effective onboarding, regular client engagement and expansion into new teams, users and use cases
  
* Manage the end-to-end renewal process, including account performance reviews, commercial negotiations and closure
  
* Lead project-level discovery, proposals, quotations and negotiations for ALC and new committed deals, involving Customer Support Associates (CSAs) where appropriate
  
* Identify opportunities to improve deal value and stickiness through workflow integration, including APIs, DAMs, plugins and other relevant solutions
  
* Introduce clients to new products and services, including Custom Solutions, and guide them through the associated processes
  
* Encourage appropriate self-service adoption while ensuring a high standard of customer experience and support
  
* Proactively identify, develop and close new business opportunities through networking, field sales, referrals and targeted prospecting
  
* Identify key decision-makers, influencers and buying opportunities within target organisations to build a strong pipeline and expand client penetration
  
* Develop new customer relationships and uncover end-client opportunities within agency networks to enable targeted pitches and referrals
  
* Leverage Getty Images’ full portfolio of products and services to develop new customer segments and create incremental revenue opportunities
  
* Conduct client meetings and presentations, including at senior decision-making levels, to communicate Getty Images’ value proposition and secure new business
  
* Meet or exceed assigned sales targets across existing accounts and new business
  
* Build and maintain long-term client relationships, handling complex commercial conversations and negotiations professionally
  
* Coordinate with internal teams across sales, customer support, service and management to resolve client challenges, identify suitable solutions and deliver on customer expectations
  
* Collaborate with colleagues to ensure consistent account planning, customer service standards and achievement of revenue goals
  
* Maintain accurate and timely customer, opportunity and activity records in Salesforce and other relevant systems, ensuring effective pipeline management and forecasting
  
* Develop and maintain strong industry and market knowledge to inform account strategies and identify emerging opportunities
  
  

  
**What You'll Need:**
  

  
* Proven experience in sales, account management and new business development within a fast-paced organisation
  
* Demonstrated success in growing existing accounts, acquiring new customers and closing revenue opportunities
  
* Strong relationship-building, networking and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage senior decision-makers
  
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and proposal development skills
  
* Strong pipeline management, forecasting and commercial negotiation capabilities
  
* Ability to manage multiple accounts, projects and priorities effectively, with sound judgement and time management
  
* Ability to work independently while building effective cross-functional relationships
  
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems, preferably Salesforce
  
* Industry knowledge and experience in media, digital content or related sectors preferred
  
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, evolving environment within an international organisation

  

**Sales (AMER, APAC, EMEA)**

 

  

*The Sales team works to grow our customer base across all regions by understanding how visual content plays a part for our customers' businesses—and how our products and services can help them overcome challenges, elevate their message, and achieve their goals.*

**There’s a story in every picture, a narrative in every frame.**

 

  

We believe in the power of visuals. As a leading visual content creator, our three brands–Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash–offer a full range of content solutions to meet the needs of any customer, whatever their size, location, or budget. Whether the goal is commercial or philanthropic, revenue-generating or society-changing, market-disrupting or headline-driving, our visuals help any brand, business, or organization communicate more effectively with their target audience and urge them to action. In other words, we know how powerful an image or video can be—and that it can move the world. 

  

 

  

**Working at Getty Images**

 

  

Our goal is to be one of the best places to work globally, which means we’re dedicated to providing experiences and resources that allow you to do your best work. Foundational to our culture are our Leadership Principles, which are the shared values that guide how we come together to do our work. We raise the bar and collectively bring solutions while exercising trust, transparency, and care. We actively reject biased behavior and are inclusive of different voices, perspectives, and experiences. We focus on our customers and deliver on our commitments and commercial goals. 

  

 

  

We foster a collaborative and supportive environment that prioritizes delivering results efficiently and using time wisely, so that all employees can achieve balance between commitments to the company and health and well-being in our lives. We value the importance of rest and recovery ranging from company-paid holidays to time away from work. 

  

 

  

Our employees’ growth, development, belonging, and engagement are important investments. title: Assistant Manager - Onboarding
description:
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
  
  
From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Objective**
The objective of this team is to identify, onboard, and grow premium, high-CFT and trending
  
  
outlets on Dineout, with a strong focus on being the first mover in acquiring high-potential
  
  
restaurants before competitors such as District.
  
  
The team will initially focus on premium outlet acquisition and onboarding, with a long-term
  
  
mandate to also own account management, GOV growth, market share, and exclusive
  
  
campaigns/events for these strategic accounts.
  
  
**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs)**

* Identify Premium & High-Potential Outlets
* Identify premium restaurants and high-CFT outlets across priority markets.
* Track trending, upcoming, and high-demand restaurants that have strong customer pull.
* Build a pipeline of strategically important outlets based on brand value, CFT potential, customer demand, and market relevance.
* Proactively identify new restaurant launches and emerging premium brands.
* Close Comp-Gaps for Premium Outlets
* Identify premium outlets that are already live on Z but are missing from Dineout.
* Prioritize and close these Comp-Gaps to ensure strong outlet coverage.
* Develop a systematic approach to track, prioritize, and convert high-value Z-Gap opportunities.
* First-Mover Advantage
* Ensure Dineout is the first mover in onboarding high-value premium outlets, wherever possible.
* Track upcoming launches, competitor movements, and market trends to identify opportunities before other competitors.
* Build strong relationships with restaurant owners, management teams, and key decision-makers to secure early partnerships.
* Create a culture of proactive acquisition rather than reactive competitor-led onboarding.

**Long-Term Scope of the Team**
The role is expected to evolve beyond acquisition into end-to-end ownership of strategic
  
  
premium accounts.
  
  

* Account Management
* Build account management capabilities within the team for outlets onboarded by them.
* Maintain strong relationships with premium restaurant partners.
* Drive partner engagement, retention, and business growth after onboarding.
* Identify opportunities to deepen the relationship and increase business contribution.
* Drive GOV Growth & Market Share
* Own and drive GOV growth from the premium outlet portfolio.
* Increase Dineout's market share within premium restaurant segments.
* Identify opportunities to improve outlet performance, customer transactions, and overall business contribution.
* Exclusive Campaigns & Events
* Identify premium partners suitable for exclusive campaigns, partnerships, and events.
* Work closely with internal teams to conceptualize and execute differentiated campaigns.
* Leverage Scenes to create visibility and demand for premium restaurant partners.
* Build exclusive restaurant-led experiences and campaigns that strengthen Dineout's proposition for both consumers and restaurant partners.

**Key Success Metrics**
The performance of the team can be evaluated through:
  
  

* Number and quality of premium/high-CFT outlets identified.
* Premium outlet onboarding rate.
* Reduction in Z-Gaps.
* First-mover onboarding rate versus competitors.
* GOV generated from newly onboarded premium outlets.
* GOV growth from managed accounts.
* Dineout market share within the premium outlet segment.
* Number and quality of exclusive campaigns/events launched.

**Qualifications**

* Strong business development and sales orientation.
* Ability to identify and pursue high-value opportunities proactively.
* Strong understanding of the premium restaurant/F&B ecosystem.
* Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work with data and identify business opportunities.
* Ability to transition from pure acquisition into strategic account management

**Additional Information**

title: Regional Sales Manager _ West
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai                                        
**Department:**
Retail Sales\_EBO

**Experience:**
8–12 Years’                                
**Salary:**
₹10–12 LPA

**About Sweet Dreams:**
**https://www.sweetdreams.in/**

**SWEET DREAMS (S D Retail Limited)**
is India’s premier sleepwear brand, listed on NSE under the ticker
**SDREAMS**
. With over three decades of market presence, Sweet Dreams offers comfortable, stylish, and functional sleepwear designed for modern lifestyles. The brand has a legacy of
**35+ years**
and a growing network of Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs).

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for an experienced Regional Sales Manager – West**
to drive sales, profitability, and operational performance across the assigned EBO network. The role will primarily focus on
**regional sales management, store performance, team productivity, target achievement, and operational excellence**
, with limited involvement in new business development and store expansion.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regional Sales & Target Achievement**

* Drive regional sales and revenue targets across all assigned EBOs.
* Develop monthly, quarterly, and annual sales plans for the region.
* Track store-wise performance against targets and take corrective actions.
* Identify sales gaps and implement strategies to improve revenue and profitability.
* Drive like-to-like sales growth and overall regional business performance.

**2. Store Performance Management**

* Monitor individual EBO performance through key sales and operational metrics.
* Conduct regular store visits to evaluate sales, customer experience, VM, stock, and team performance.
* Identify underperforming stores and prepare actionable improvement plans.
* Ensure effective implementation of company sales strategies and promotional campaigns.
* Monitor store productivity, conversion, ATV, UPT, and other relevant retail KPIs.

**3. Team Management & Development**

* Lead, motivate, and develop Store Managers and retail sales teams.
* Set clear performance expectations and review team performance regularly.
* Coach teams on selling skills, customer service, product knowledge, and achieving targets.
* Identify training requirements and coordinate with the HR/Training team.
* Support manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, and retention of store teams.

**4. Retail Operations Excellence**

* Ensure adherence to company SOPs, retail standards, and operational guidelines.
* Ensure proper implementation of VM, promotional, pricing, and customer service standards.
* Monitor stock availability, replenishment, ageing inventory, and sell-through.
* Coordinate with VM, Supply Chain, Commercial, Marketing, and HR teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure stores are audit-ready and compliant with company processes.

**5. Business Analysis & Reporting**

* Analyse daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports to identify business trends.
* Prepare regional performance reviews and action plans.
* Track key KPIs including:
* Sales & Achievement %
* Like-to-Like Growth
* Conversion %
* Average Transaction Value (ATV)
* Units Per Transaction (UPT)
* Store Productivity
* Stock Availability & Sell-through
* Inventory Ageing
* Present regional business updates and recommendations to the NSM / Retail Head.

**6. Customer & Market Management**

* Monitor customer trends, local competition, pricing, and promotional activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition and retention.
* Ensure a consistent premium customer experience across all EBOs.
* Share market insights with the leadership team for business planning.

**7. Limited Expansion & Business Development**

* Support the Retail Head/management team in evaluating potential locations for new EBOs.
* Provide market and sales inputs for new store feasibility.
* Support pre-opening sales planning and store launch activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams during new store openings as required.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Retail Management, or a related field.
* **8–12 years of experience in retail sales management**
  , preferably in Fashion, Apparel, Lifestyle, or Premium Retail.
* Strong experience managing
  **multiple EBOs / retail stores and sales teams**
  .
* Proven track record of achieving regional sales targets.
* Strong understanding of retail KPIs, sales analytics, inventory, and store operations.
* Excellent people management, coaching, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across the assigned region.

**Key Competencies**

* Regional Sales Leadership
* Target & Revenue Management
* Retail Operations
* Team Leadership & Development
* Business Analytics
* Customer Experience
* Commercial Acumen
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Execution & Accountability

**Ideal Candidate**

* **The ideal candidate will be a strong retail sales leader**
  with hands-on experience managing multiple stores, Store Managers, and large retail teams. The candidate should be highly target-oriented, commercially strong, comfortable with extensive travel, and capable of improving store productivity and regional profitability.

title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Company Name:**
Thriwe Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

**Experience:**
3-5 Yrs

**Work Location:**
Mumbai

**Position:**
Senior Manager-Sales

**About the role**

Thriwe builds and runs benefits and loyalty programmes for banks, card issuers and large enterprises, covering golf, airport services, lifestyle privileges and rewards, along with the platforms underneath them. Our clients are some of the largest banks in India, the card networks, banks in the Middle East and Southeast Asia, and corporates across industries. This role sells to all of them. Banks are the biggest part of the book, so you need to understand how that sector works, but the job is not limited to it. You will find the right teams inside a client, get in the room, build the case, close, and stay involved until the programme is live. It is an on-ground sales job with targets.

**Roles and responsibilities**

* Build and run a pipeline of new clients across banking, financial services and enterprise accounts.
* Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, first meetings, proposals, commercial negotiation, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Grow revenue from existing clients by finding and selling additional programmes and services.
* Meet clear and ambitious quarterly and annual targets on revenue and gross margin. You will be measured on both.
* Build proposals, decks and commercial structures, present them to senior stakeholders, and rework them in the room when the conversation changes direction.
* Face senior banking and enterprise leadership in meetings and hold the room.
* Manage client stakeholders across levels, from working teams to decision makers, and keep them all moving.
* Work with product and engineering to scope what a client has asked for against what we can deliver.
* Handle difficult client conversations: pricing pressure, escalations, delays, scope changes.
* Track usage and margin data on your accounts and bring it into client discussions.

**Requirements**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in B2B sales or business development.
* A bachelor’s degree in any discipline. A master’s degree is a plus. We care more about how you communicate and think than what you studied.
* A strong sales instinct. Someone who likes selling, is comfortable asking for the deal, and does not need to be pushed to make the next call.
* A working understanding of the BFSI sector: how banks run cards, loyalty and customer engagement, and who decides what.
* Excellent communication, spoken and written. You should be able to explain a commercial structure to a senior stakeholder in two minutes and present a deck without reading from it.
* Good at building commercials and proposal decks. Clear numbers, clean slides, tight story.
* Comfortable using AI tools in daily work and a working understanding of what AI can and cannot do. We use it heavily and expect you to as well.
* Quick on your feet. Client meetings rarely go to script, and you need to think, respond and adjust in the moment rather than take it back to the office.
* Comfortable working without a brief. Many client asks arrive half-formed and you will shape them yourself.
* Analytical. You know the numbers on your accounts before the client asks.

title: Expert Business Development Manager
description:

**Reports to: Managing Director, Head of Markets, Asia Pacific**
**Introduction**
Are you a seasoned commercial leader with deep expertise in corporate services, fund administration, and entity management and a strong track record of shaping complex client solutions? Join CSC’s Markets team within the Global Financial Solutions (GFS) team in India as a Market Director where you will lead high-impact pursuits, influence strategic client engagements, and drive growth across our multinational client base.
  
  
In this senior role, you’ll collaborate with sales executives, service delivery leaders, and fellow subject matter experts to design innovative solutions, strengthen client relationships, and position CSC as a trusted advisor in the corporate and fund administration services space, and be a key driver of revenue growth, client satisfaction, and market expansion.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Hudle is India’s largest sports community platform, enabling more than 2 million players across 110+ cities to play regularly, join communities, and make sport part of everyday life. The platform has grown from simplifying sports venue discovery and booking into a full ecosystem that powers how India plays, connects, and experiences sport. Hudle connects 4,000+ venues and 40+ sports with community-led play, events and tournaments, coaching, and curated player experiences. The company also focuses on content, highlights, and stories that extend beyond the game, reflecting sport as a social ritual and lifestyle. Hudle is a Series A-funded startup backed by leading investors including Sky Impact Capital, Physis Capital, Inflection Point Ventures, and Survam Partners.

**Experience: 3 -6 Years**

**About Hudle:**

At Hudle, work is literally Play! We are a sports tech company on a mission to enable 100 million Indians to play active sports as a way of life through a combination of cutting-edge technology and on-ground expertise.

We are a fast-growing platform with Indian cricket legend Ajinkya Rahane as a brand ambassador.

**About the Role:**

You will own Hudle's business development outcomes for Mumbai. That means hitting the city's partner acquisition and revenue targets, making sure every new venue is onboarded well and starts generating bookings, and building long-term relationships with the city's most important partners. You'll run the full sales cycle yourself on key deals while coaching a small team to do the same.

**What You'll Own:-**

**Mumbai targets and pipeline**

- Deliver monthly and quarterly targets for partner acquisition and venue activation for the region

- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through market mapping, outbound outreach, referrals and on-ground prospecting

- Personally lead high-value and strategic deals, including multi-venue operators, premium clubs, institutions and real estate developers

**Onboarding and activation**

- Drive end-to-end onboarding of new partners: commercials, agreements, listing setup, pricing and inventory, and handover to Partner Growth

- Make sure onboarded venues go live quickly and start receiving bookings, and fix whatever stands in the way

- Coordinate with internal teams (Partner Growth, Product, Ops, Hudle Vision) for smooth launches

**Key relationships**

- Own relationships with Mumbai's top partners and decision-makers, serving as their senior point of contact

- Find opportunities to deepen partnerships: additional courts or sports, exclusive listings, premium products such as Hudle Vision, and co-marketing

- Stay close to the local market: new venues, competitor activity, pricing trends and emerging sports

**Team leadership**

- Coach and manage 1–2 BD Executives, including setting targets, doing joint field visits and running regular pipeline reviews

- Build repeatable playbooks for prospecting, pitching and closing in the Mumbai market

**Process and reporting**

- Keep Zoho CRM accurate and current for yourself and your team

- Share weekly and monthly progress reports with leadership, covering pipeline health, closures, activation and forecasts

- Suggest improvements to sales processes, pitch materials and commercial structures

**How Success Is Measured**

title: QNB3737 - Senior Manager, Global Transaction Banking Sales (Cash and Trade)
description:
**About QNB**
Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
  
  
QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
  
  
QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
  
  
Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
  
  
QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The roles and its primary focus will be business development and marketing of the banks existing product base. The incumbent is responsible for identifying Cash Management opportunities and Trade Finance opportunities through understanding the client’s business model, including operational and financial processes and working capital and treasury management needs. Cash Management includes all payments, collections, liquidity management solutions. Trade Service businesses include traditional and Open Account trade products. The incumbent will provide customer centric banking solutions and services to meet customer needs and improve the client experience. The role has annual revenue targets and other quantitative and qualitative KPIs, contributes to the GTB department objectives in terms of growing the customer base, increase revenue and transaction volumes in compliance with established QNB Group policies, regulatory requirements, and best market practice. The role reports to corporate banking management domestically and to the global GTB business.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  
**Shareholder & Financial**

* Responsible for QNB in-country timely and quality planning of sales plan of transaction solutions to contribute to department’s revenue, profitability for Cash Management and Trade Finance. Works towards delivering set targets in line with Global Corporate and Institutional Banking strategic directions and applicable policy guidelines.
* Works with country corporate management team in achieving unit’s budget and implementing of group approved business plans for the unit and overall objectives of the QNB group with direct P/L ownership, including growth of transaction fees, as well as growth of Trade assets and CASA balances.

**Customer (Internal & External)**

* Is responsible for collection of market information on competitor actions, customer preferences as well as market/business development.
* Formulates and proactively implements the sales and marketing strategy that enables QNB to achieve its plans in relation to Cash Management and Trade Finance business.
* Is responsible for client and market data analysis as well as preparation of meaningful and actionable results aimed for enhancement of GTB offerings as well as preserving and increasing the market share.
* Works closely with in-country RMs in identifying cash management and trade finance opportunities from corporate clients and regular follow-ups to close the product sales.
* Regularly interacts with customers and other relevant market participants to gather feedback on the GTB products and services as well as provides this information to the parties concerned.
* Demonstrate thought leadership in developing new solutions, in relation to GTB to complement Global Corporate and Institutional banking business growth
* Increase adoption of digital channels and increase straight through processing and improve the efficiency in order to maximize the shareholder benefits

**Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory)**

* Based on market research data as well as customer feedback provides valuable inputs to Group cash management and trade services product development team based in H.O for product development requirements.
* Is responsible for preparation of country sales/marketing plan, road shows/customer workshops to promote awareness of cash management and trade finance products and services.
* Responds to Request for Proposals (RFPs), assessing customer needs and recommending effective approach as well as pricing structure. Ensure RFPs as and when received from customers in country are well coordinated with GTB Sales, Product and Services and Implementation team to ensure best offers made to win deals.
* Supports Relationship Managers in their selling efforts by providing expertise and structuring know-how.
* Performs verification of information on assigned customers' activities to ensure correctness of data.
* Is responsible for preparation and delivery of periodic as well as ad hoc MIS reports on personal and unit performance. Reports on a regular basis with group reporting.

**Legal, Regulatory, And Risk Framework Responsibilities**

* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML & CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.

**Education/Experience Requirements**
Education and Experience Requirements
  
  

* University graduate with a Major in Banking, Finance, Accounting or related field of study. Masters Preferred
* At least 8 years of relevant banking experience, preferably with at least 2 years at banking within a highly rated international bank.
* Sound Cash Management experience, typically acquired through 2-3 years of experience in Cash Management and /or related filed.
* Fluency in English.
* Solid technical knowledge of the bank’s operations, transaction cycles, payments/ collection processing, bank account information, SWIFT transmissions related to corporate and retail bank accounts.
* Understanding of relevant laws, regulations and practices pertaining to corporate banking products and services in particular and Banking Industry, geography in general
* Good understanding of in-country GTB customer base, it's needs and expectations
* Strong analytical skills with ability to communicate both verbally and in writing
* Problem solving abilities as part of relationship and technical knowledge of outstanding issues.

* Resume/CV
* Copy of ID
* Copy of Education Certificate

At Wilson Composites India LLP, we are manufacturers of custom Architectural Fiberglass (FRP) and (GFRC) products for the commercial construction industry. We specialize in design, engineering, and fabrication.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a commercially driven Business Development Manager to build our India business. Architectural projects remain in scope but will be pursued selectively. The role is supply-only to begin with and may extend installation work later.

hours to overlap with our U.S. team

title: Manager, Sales
description:
**Job Description**
The role involves identifying new business opportunities, managing the end-to-end sales cycle, developing account strategies and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver tailored telecom solutions. The candidate should possess deep knowledge of telecom networks, strong negotiation and presentation skills, and experience handling complex enterprise sales engagements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Identify new business opportunities and drive revenue growth for telecom equipment solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers and influencers within Tier-1 operator organizations.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to contract closure and post-sales support.
* Collaborate with internal teams (engineering, product, support) to deliver customized solutions to clients.
* Prepare and present proposals, quotations, and product demonstrations to clients.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify potential areas for growth.
* Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets and KPIs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA preferred.
* 10–15 years of experience in sales and business development of telecom equipment, with a focus on Tier-1 operator accounts.
* Deep understanding of telecom networks, products, and solutions.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and large customer accounts.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel as required.

**About Us**
Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R&D. We design and manufacture high-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading-edge telecom products for building end-to-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 900,000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99.999%. Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS-PON), carrier-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct-to-Mobile and Satellite-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution. As an R&D-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.
  
  
**Diversity And Inclusion Statement**

* Tejas Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating all inclusive environment for all employees.
* We welcome applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or veteran status.
* Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to ensure every employee feels valued and respected.

**About The Team**
At Tejas Networks, product development is driven by a comprehensive lifecycle approach that begins with understanding customer and network requirements, followed by competitive analysis, architectural design, and implementation. This process emphasizes performance, scalability, cost-efficiency, and environmental considerations, culminating in deployment and operational support. The technology portfolio spans diverse networking domains, including optical transport (DWDM, OTN), broadband access (GPON, XGSPON, CPON), service provider routing (IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, MPLS-TP), and enterprise switching (L2/L3). Products range from compact systems to complex, multi-terabit, chassis-based platforms designed for high availability, modularity, and scalability. Development involves specialized skills across hardware, firmware, FPGA, software, and synchronization, enabling teams to address multidisciplinary challenges effectively. Supporting these engineering efforts there is a centralized operational framework that provides strategic direction, governance, and essential services across the organization. This includes financial management, talent development, compliance, branding, innovation, risk management, and CSR. Together, these functions ensure seamless execution, alignment with business goals, and a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.
