description:
**BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE**

**ABOUT SHESHI**

Sheshi is a Financial Operating System - the governed infrastructure layer that converts raw financial data into results that organisations can completely trust. Governed, auditable, period-locked, and traceable to the source.

**Every organisation between seed stage and large enterprise has the same structural problem -financial data exists, but the process that converts it into trusted results is fragmented, manual, and dependent on individuals. Sheshi solves that problem with infrastructure-grade software built for the long term.**

We are headquartered in Bengaluru, India, building an enterprise-grade product for the global market.

As a Sales Executive, you own the full sales cycle for your accounts - from first outreach to signed deals across the segments and geographies. You will be coached and supported by the Sales Lead, and you will work with a strong sales stack that gives you the tools to prospect, engage, and close with intelligence and discipline.

**WHY SHESHI**

* **A product that solves a real problem.**
  Every organisation you prospect has this problem. The conversation starts from a place of genuine relevance.
* **Global scope.**
  You will work accounts across India and international markets from day one — building skills and relationships that most sales roles at this stage do not offer.
* **Full-cycle ownership.**
  You own your accounts end to end — no handoffs, no shared credit.
* **Strong coaching environment.**
  You will be developed by a Sales Lead who has carried significant numbers and closed complex deals personally.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Prospecting and Pipeline Building**

* Identify and target enterprise finance teams and funded startups across India and international markets through research, outreach, referrals, and signal-based prospecting.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline across all stages - volume and quality both matters.
* Use CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, outreach tools, and signal data to prospect with intelligence and consistency.

**Discovery and Qualification**

* Run structured discovery conversations with CFOs, Finance Controllers, founders, and finance managers to understand their current workflows, pain points, and scale.
* Qualify accounts with rigour - the right fit at the right time, pursued with the right level of effort.

**Demo and Solution Presentation**

* Deliver product demonstrations tailored to the buyer's specific context - enterprise finance teams and startup founders have different priorities and different conversations.
* Connect Sheshi's capabilities directly to what the buyer is trying to solve or scale.

**Negotiation and Closure**

* Own the commercial conversation - pricing, terms, and objection handling through to a signed agreement.
* Manage enterprise deal complexity - multiple stakeholders, procurement processes, and longer timelines - with discipline and patience.
* Run startup deals with speed - founders move fast and expect the same in return.

**Relationship Management**

* Maintain relationships with prospects through the full sales cycle - enterprise buyers and startup founders both buy from people they trust.
* Keep CRM updated with accurate deal status, next steps, and communication history at all times.

**Digital and Tool-Led Outreach**

* Use the sales stack - CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, outreach automation, and signal tools - as a core part of your daily workflow.
* Build and run outreach cadences that generate consistent pipeline across India and international markets.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Experience**

* 3–6 years in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology sales, with a full-cycle track record prospecting through closure.
* Experience selling to finance decision-makers - CFOs, Finance Controllers, or founders managing their financial function.
* Demonstrable history of meeting or exceeding sales targets consistently.
* Some exposure to international sales or cross-border accounts is a plus.
* Experience selling financial software, ERP, accounting tools, or enterprise governance products.
* Familiarity with how enterprise finance teams operate - close cycles, reporting, consolidation, audit.
* Exposure to the startup ecosystem - understanding how funded companies think about financial governance and investor reporting.
* International sales experience or comfort working across time zones and cultures

**Sales Capabilities**

* Comfortable owning the full sales cycle independently across different deal sizes and complexities.
* Strong discovery skills - you ask the right questions and listen before you pitch.
* Confident, credible demo presenter - you adapt the conversation to the buyer, not the other way around.
* Disciplined CRM user - your pipeline is always current, accurate, and actionable.
* Proficient with modern sales tools - LinkedIn Sales Navigator, outreach automation, and signal-based prospecting.

**Character and Approach**

* High persistence without being pushy - you follow up with professionalism and intent.
* Honest pipeline management - you call deals accurately, not optimistically.
* Comfortable selling to senior finance professionals and founders - the conversation requires credibility and preparation.
* You take ownership of your number - if it is not coming in, you know why and you have a plan.

title: Executive - Sponsorship & Brand Partnership
description:
**Location: Mumbai / Delhi**

**About Us:**

SVF Entertainment is Eastern India's largest entertainment conglomerate, founded in 1995, with a commanding presence across film production and distribution (135+ Bengali films, 900+ releases), television content (5,000+ hours), digital cinema, music (800+ songs, #1 Bengali YouTube), hoichoi OTT platform, new media, multiplex cinemas, and equipment rental. Backed by 8 National Awards and visionary leadership, SVF delivers blockbuster storytelling through powerhouse brand storytelling and with hoichoi, SVF Music, MNI
and SVF Cinemas.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sponsorship Marketing & Partnerships professional who can identify potential brand partners, develop strategic sponsorship opportunities, and successfully close sponsorship deals for events and entertainment properties.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of
**target audiences, brand positioning, and marketing objectives**
. They should be able to identify brands that align with an event’s audience and objectives, develop compelling
**sponsorship strategies, and pitch partnership opportunities that deliver mutual value for both the brand and the event.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Brand Identification & Research: Identify and approach relevant brands based on the target audience, nature, and positioning of events or entertainment properties.
* Audience Understanding: Analyze target audiences, brand preferences, and consumer behaviour to identify potential sponsorship opportunities.
* Sponsorship Strategy: Develop customized sponsorship strategies that align the event’s objectives with the sponsor’s marketing goals and target audience.
* Pitch Development: Create compelling sponsorship proposals, presentations, and pitch decks highlighting the value proposition, brand visibility, audience reach, and partnership benefits.
* Business Development: Proactively reach out to brand decision-makers, marketing heads, media agencies, and relevant stakeholders to generate sponsorship leads.
* Deal Closure: Lead sponsorship discussions, negotiate partnership terms, address objections, and convert potential sponsors into confirmed partners.
* Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with brands and agencies to establish long-term partnerships and explore repeat business opportunities.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with internal teams to understand event requirements and develop sponsorship opportunities that meet both commercial and creative objectives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of marketing, brand positioning, target audiences, and consumer behaviour.
* Knowledge of brands across relevant categories and the ability to identify suitable sponsors for different events.
* Experience in sponsorship sales, brand partnerships, event marketing, media sales, or business development is preferred.
* Excellent pitching, presentation, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to engage senior brand stakeholders and decision-makers.
* Ability to develop strategic, customized pitches rather than relying on generic sponsorship proposals.
* A proactive, target-oriented approach with a strong focus on converting leads and closing deals.
* Ability to think creatively and establish a clear connection between a brand’s marketing objectives and an event’s audience.

**What We Are Looking For:**

We are looking for someone who can go beyond identifying potential sponsors and demonstrate the ability to build a strong brand-event connection, present a compelling business case, and confidently close sponsorship deals.

The ideal candidate is persuasive, commercially minded, strategic, and confident in representing the organization while engaging with brands and partners.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:

You will leverage Redington’s comprehensive technology portfolio to develop strategic customer relationships, drive solution-led sales, and maximize business opportunities across enterprise accounts.**

This opportunity is ideal for fresh MBA graduates seeking to build a career in luxury retail sales, premium customer engagement, business development and relationship management.

title: Business Development Manager- Quick Commerce
description:
This is a remote position.

About the role

367 Agency drives growth for consumer brands across D2C, marketplace, and quick commerce. Your role is to onboard new clients: mid-to-large brands looking to scale on Blinkit, Instamart, Zepto - opening doors, closing retainers, and handing them over to delivery team to execute.

What you will do

* Target High-Value Brands: Build and execute a target list of mid-size and large consumer brands selling on Quick Commerce platforms.
* Run Discovery Calls: Connect directly with founders, category heads, and marketing leads to understand their growth opportunities on quick commerce.
* Pitch & Close: Lead pitches, define scope and pricing, and close monthly retainers.
* Manage Smooth Handovers: Provide a thorough brief to the delivery team upon signing and stay close for the first 30 days to ensure a smooth transition.
* Build Platform Relationships: Build and maintain working relationships with the teams at Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart.
* Keep a Regular Cadence: Meet the Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart teams on a fixed schedule.
* Be Present at Events: Participate in quick commerce and industry events to meet platform teams and brand decision-makers in person.
* Track the Pipeline: Maintain weekly CRM updates and share conversion metrics, deal statuses, and insights directly with agency partners.
* Share Market Intelligence: Feed platform trends, brand feedback, and competitive insights back into our agency strategy.

What you will not do

* Day-to-day client management
* Campaign setup, optimisation or media buying
* Performance reporting and dashboards

The delivery team owns all of this. Your work ends at a signed client and a clean handover.

  
  
Requirements
  
  

* Experience: 6 to 8 years in sales or business development, with at least 2 years selling services or solutions to FMCG, D2C, or consumer brands.
* Quick Commerce Expertise: Practical understanding of operational and growth bottlenecks on Blinkit, Instamart, or Zepto- gained either inside a quick commerce company (marketing/ops) or from brand/agency side partnerships.
* Existing Network: Active relationships with brand founders, category heads, or marketing leads.
* Track Record: Proven history of closing retainer-based deals, backed by shareable numbers.
* Discipline & Conviction: Comfort with cold outreach and multi-touch pipelines, plus the strategic confidence to hold your ground and defend your POV in pitches.

How success is measured

* Qualified discovery conversations started each month
* Pitches delivered and retainers signed
* Average retainer size and 6-month retention rate

  
  
Benefits
  
  

* We don’t run on rigid policies, ownership matters more than rulebooks
* No micromanagement. If you take responsibility for your work, you get full trust and autonomy
* No unnecessary salary cuts or restrictive leave calendars
* Remote team offering flexibility to work from wherever you are
* Freedom comes with responsibility, be available, responsive, and deliver quality work
* Opportunity to sit in on real founder-level conversations and business discussions

title: Strategy & Business Development Director
description:
**Job Description**
The Strategy & Business Development Director will shape and accelerate Honeywell Technologies’ growth across APAC & India through two connected mandates.
  
  
**Software & Software ARR Growth:**
The Director will drive software-led growth with a dedicated focus on Software revenue and Software ARR, defining portfolio and market strategies, identifying and developing high-value growth opportunities, and building the commercial mechanisms required to expand predictable, profitable Software ARR.
  
  
**Acquisitions Growth & Revenue Synergies:**
For a focused set of acquisitions, the Director will act as the regional commercial lead in APAC & India, owning the translation of growth strategy into commercial outcomes. This includes accelerating the total revenue contribution of these businesses, unlocking cross-business growth across Honeywell, and ensuring agreed revenue synergy targets are met.
  
  
Working across business units and functions, the Director will connect customer needs, market dynamics, technology roadmaps and go-to-market execution to create scalable growth platforms and maximize shareholder value.
  
  
**Acquisitions Growth & Revenue Synergies**

* Acquisition growth strategy: set the APAC & India growth strategy that drives acquisitions contribution to Honeywell's growth, covering market opportunity, share of demand, priority segments, target accounts and routes to market, and translate it into clear execution plans with accountable owners.
* Offering fit and regional readiness: Assess the fit and readiness of acquired offerings for APAC & India markets, including customer needs, localization, pricing, channel and delivery or support capabilities, informed by a clear understanding of each offering’s NPI roadmap. Prioritize where each offering can win, and work with offering owners to close the gaps that limit growth and align roadmap priorities with regional demand.
* Cross-sell and cross-business growth: As the main lever for acquisition growth, drive cross-selling and pull-through between acquired businesses and Honeywell business units through integrated customer offerings, joint account pursuit plans and opportunities identified with strategic account leaders. Convert these into qualified pipelines, commercial wins and realized revenue.
* Revenue synergy delivery and barrier resolution: Serve as the APAC & India point person tracking and ensuring agreed revenue synergy targets are met. Track performance against targets, identify gaps early, and resolve the commercial, operational or offering barriers that prevent growth.

**Operating rhythm:**
Establish governance, metrics and reviews that move strategic initiatives from concept to measurable commercial outcomes.
  
  
**Measures of Success**

* Growth of Revenue and Software ARR across the APAC & India software portfolio.
* Realization of acquisition revenue synergies against agreed base and aspirational targets, by acquisition and operating region.
* Quality, value and conversion of the strategic opportunity pipeline.
* Adoption and performance of new commercial models, partnerships and routes to market.
* Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, ARR and strategic plan execution.
* Delivery of the on-premise-to-SaaS migration roadmap, including customer conversion, retained revenue and ARR uplift.
* Coverage, quality and commercial use of APAC & India customer references and associated communications.
* Closure of priority portfolio-readiness gaps for target APAC & India markets.

**Responsibilities**
**Software & Software ARR Growth**

* Market intelligence: Assess market size, customer economics, competitor positioning, regulatory developments and technology trends to identify attractive growth spaces.
* Portfolio readiness and market fit: Assess the software portfolio’s readiness and fit for APAC & India markets, including customer needs, localization, deployment model, cybersecurity, data residency, regulatory requirements, pricing, support and channel capabilities; maintain a strong understanding of the NPI roadmap to anticipate which gaps upcoming releases will close, and translate remaining gaps into prioritized actions and investment recommendations.
* Regional customer references: Build and maintain a catalogue of APAC & India customer references with quantified outcomes and reusable proof points. Work with Communications Team to build amplification plan in the media.
* Subscription and SaaS acceleration: Create and orchestrate a phased plan to migrate on-premise applications and customers to SaaS, addressing portfolio sequencing, commercial conversion, customer value, technical dependencies, channel enablement, retention risks and ARR impact.
* Installed Base Mining Go-to-Market: Partner with sales, marketing, product and customer success teams to define segmentation, routes to market, channel strategies, demand generation and account expansion plays.
* Decoupled software growth: Identify customer entry points that allow software to be sold and scaled independently of hardware or major capital projects, and develop repeatable acquisition and expansion plays around them.
* Identify & Scale Strategic Partnerships: Identify and prioritize the partners most critical to software growth in APAC & India, define joint value propositions and business plans, and execute agreed go-to-market, co-sell, integration and customer-development strategies with them.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, computer science, economics or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
* Significant experience in strategy, business development, corporate development, mergers and acquisitions, product strategy or commercial leadership within industrial technology, enterprise software, SaaS or a related sector.
* Demonstrated success building software growth strategies and translating them into commercial outcomes.
* Strong command of software recurring-revenue economics and metrics, including Software ARR, annual contract value, net revenue retention, churn, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value and gross margin.
* Experience developing subscription pricing, packaging, channel and go-to-market models.
* Track record of shaping complex partnerships and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience working across multiple APAC & India markets in a matrixed, multinational environment.
* Fluent English; additional regional languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively across APAC & India and, when required, internationally.

title: Manager - Business Development - Global Ratings
description:
Our client is a full-service Credit Rating Agency (CRA) with a mission of Empowering Global Capital Market Participants Through Unrivalled Insights and Expertise. Our Client has emerged as the leading agency for covering many rating segments including manufacturing, infrastructure, financial sector including banks, non-financial services, among others. The company has an established track record of rating companies over almost three decades and has had a pivotal role to play in developing bank debt and capital market instruments including CPs, corporate bonds and debentures, and structured credit.

**Position:**
Business Development - Global Ratings

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Role Overview:**
This role leads origination and relationship coverage out of Mumbai - India's banking, treasury and capital-markets hub - bringing global-scale rating mandates from financial institutions, corporates and intermediaries, while supporting the firm's sovereign, multilateral and ecosystem initiatives. It is a hands-on, high-visibility role in a lean team, working closely with the Business Head and senior management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Origination & Pipeline:**

- Originate global-scale and international rating mandates from Mumbai-based banks, NBFCs, infrastructure financiers, PSUs, large corporate groups and their offshore entities.

- Build and convert a pipeline of issuers raising cross-border and foreign-currency debt - ECBs, USD and Masala bonds, IFSC listings and loans booked through IFSC Banking Units.

- Position Client for regulatory and investor use cases, including bank capital treatment under RBI ECAI accreditation, investor mandates and IFSC requirements.

- Identify unrated issuers and help them move into the rated universe, articulating how a global-scale rating supports pricing, investor access and fund-raising.

**Client & Intermediary Relationships:**

- Build and deepen senior relationships across CFO, treasury, risk and credit functions, and with DCM desks, arrangers, merchant bankers, law firms, investors and IFSC Banking Units.

- Manage the client journey from pitch to mandate, information gathering and rating completion, coordinating with the analytical team within the regulatory separation between business development and rating analysis.

- Drive renewals, surveillance continuity and client satisfaction; work with client's coverage teams to source referrals and cross-group opportunities.

**Ecosystem, Events & Strategic Initiatives:**

- Plan and execute knowledge-sharing sessions and roundtables in Mumbai.

- Support sovereign, multilateral and government-relations initiatives - pitch materials, country briefs, meeting preparation and follow-through.

- Represent Client at industry forums and engage with the GIFT IFSC ecosystem, including regulators, exchanges and market bodies.

**Targets, MIS & Governance:**

- Deliver quarterly and annual targets on mandates, revenue and pipeline conversion; contribute to the annual business plan, product mix and pricing.

- Maintain the BD action tracker, CRM and sales MIS with disciplined weekly pipeline reporting to the Business Head.

- Track competitive intelligence on global and regional rating agencies, market trends and issuance activity.

- Adhere to IFSCA regulations for credit rating agencies and to internal policies on conflict of interest, confidentiality and code of conduct.

**Skills & Competencies:**

- Sound understanding of credit ratings, the rating process and the distinction between global-scale and national-scale ratings.

- Working knowledge of debt capital markets, foreign-currency borrowing (ECB framework), bank capital regulation and the GIFT IFSC framework.

- An established network across Global & Mumbai's banking, NBFC and corporate treasury community is a strong advantage but not mandatory requirement.

- Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills; able to draft crisp pitch decks and briefs, and comfortable engaging CXOs and senior officials.

- Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with CRM/MIS tools.

- Self-driven, target-oriented and comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving team; willing to travel.

- Prior experience in handling business development relating to rating/ grading products for Equity Capital Markets and/or Debt Capital Markets (NCD / CP / CD / Structured Finance).

- Working Knowledge of basic rating / grading products e.g. Corporate Finance Rating / IPO Grading/ Bank Loan Rating/ Mutual Fund Grading.

**Experience:**

- 2 - 8 years in business development or relationship management with a credit rating agency, investment or corporate bank, DCM desk or treasury advisory.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
**Background**

Praan (Praan, Inc.) is an impact focused deep-tech startup democratizing clean air using breakthrough filterless technology. The company is backed by top tier VCs and CXOs globally and currently operates between the United States and India. Our team puts extreme attention to detail and loves building technology that's aspirational. Praan's team and culture is positioned to empower people to solve large global problems at an accelerated pace.

**Why?**

Everyone worries about the dooms-day in climate change which is expected to occur in the 2050s. However, there's one doom's day which is the reality for millions of people around the world today. Air pollution takes more than 7 Million lives globally every single year. Over 5% of premature children death occur due to air pollution in developing countries. Everyone has relied on governments or experts to solve the problem, but most solutions up until today have either been too expensive or too ineffective. Praan is an attempt at making the future cleaner, healthier, and safer for the generations to come.

**The role**

You'll own the architect, interior designer and developer ecosystem in your city — building the relationships that get Praan specified into projects, and driving those specifications through to closed,
*billed*
revenue. This is a true hunter seat: you open doors, you own the number, and you carry the deal from first design-stage conversation all the way to payment in the bank.

**What you'll do**

* Build and own deep relationships with top architects, interior designers, PMCs and developers in your market
* Drive specification-led sales — getting Praan designed into projects at the earliest stage
* Own the full deal cycle: pitch, technical proposal, commercial negotiation, close
* Lock payment terms and billing
  *before*
  projects mobilise — you own revenue, not just pipeline
* Track and convert your pipeline to collected cash, keeping receivables tight
* Represent Praan credibly in the design and architecture community

**What we're looking for**

* **5–7 years selling to architects, interior designers and developers**
  — specification or project sales, where you got a product designed into projects and closed the deal.
* **An existing network you can activate on day one**
  — real relationships with architects, IDs, PMCs or developers in Mumbai/Delhi, ideally from premium building materials, lighting, sanitaryware, furniture or luxury interiors.
* **A closer, not a pipeline-builder**
  — you can point to specific deals
  *you personally*
  won, with real numbers, not team wins.
* **Commercial ownership**
  — you lock payment terms up front, structure milestone billing, and chase collections. A delivered project sitting unbilled is your problem, not finance's.
* **Credibility with designers**
  — architects treat you as a peer who understands their world, not just a vendor pitching product.
* **Based in Mumbai/Delhi**
  (or ready to relocate), and comfortable owning a number in a fast-moving startup.

**Praan is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, caste, gender, disability or any other criteria. We just care about working with great human beings!**

title: Business Development Lead
description:
**About Accrete**

Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high-stakes, judgement-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.

At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.

From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a
**Business Development Lead**
to establish and grow Accrete’s presence in the
**India market**
. You will open doors at India’s leading technology companies and global system integrators and build the relationships, partnerships, and pipeline that bring Accrete’s Knowledge Engine and agentic products to enterprise clients.

This is a
**hands-on, high-ownership role**
. You will act as Accrete’s on-the-ground voice in India: shaping our go-to-market approach, leveraging your network to secure senior-level access, and taking deals and partnerships from first conversation to close. You will work closely with Accrete’s leadership, product, and engineering teams to turn market conversations into revenue and lasting strategic relationships.

**What You'll Do**

**Market Entry & Strategy**

* Define and execute Accrete’s India go-to-market strategy, including priority accounts, segments, and use cases for the Knowledge Engine and agentic products.
* Map the India enterprise technology landscape - IT services and consulting firms, technology companies, and large enterprises across industries- and identify the sectors and use cases where Accrete can create the most impact.
* Track competitors, pricing, buying patterns, and regulatory considerations (such as data residency and privacy requirements) and feed insights back to leadership.
* Build India-specific sales playbooks, positioning, and collateral in partnership with Accrete’s product and marketing teams.

**Relationships & Strategic Partnerships**

* Leverage your existing network to secure introductions and build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers — CXOs, Heads of AI, Digital, Innovation, Delivery, and Alliances - at leading Indian technology companies.
* Identify, negotiate, and manage strategic partnerships with IT technology/services firms and system integrators, including co-sell, referral, reseller, and co-delivery models.
* Represent Accrete at industry events, forums, and ecosystem engagements to build brand awareness and credibility in India.
* Nurture long-term executive relationships that lead to repeat business and expanded engagements.

**Pipeline & Deal Ownership**

* Generate, qualify, and grow a healthy enterprise pipeline through outbound outreach, partner channels, and referrals.
* Own the full sales cycle for complex, long-cycle enterprise deals, from first meeting through proposal, negotiation, and closure.
* Lead pitches, product demos, and executive briefings that clearly articulate Accrete’s value - context-grounded, governed, expert AI agents for high-stakes work.
* Structure commercial proposals and partnership terms, and work with Accrete’s legal and finance teams to close deals.
* Maintain accurate pipeline tracking, forecasting, and reporting in the CRM.

**Collaboration**

* Partner with product and engineering to share market and customer feedback and shape integration and localization priorities.
* Work with solutions and delivery teams to scope and run proofs of concept and pilots that convert into long-term engagements.
* Coordinate closely with Accrete’s leadership team across time zones to align priorities and share progress.
* Own initiatives from
  **market entry and relationship-building through deal closure and account expansion**
  .

**What We're Looking For**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; an MBA from a reputed institution is preferred.
* **10+ years of experience in B2B technology business development, enterprise sales, or strategic alliances**
  , with a strong track record in the India market.
* Proven experience closing enterprise deals and/or partnerships with large IT services companies, system integrators, or large enterprises in India.
* **An established network of senior decision-makers**
  at leading Indian technology companies and IT services firms.
* Experience selling complex technical products - AI/ML, data platforms, cloud, or enterprise software - to both technical and business stakeholders.

**Skills & Expertise**

* Strong technical fluency in
  **AI, LLMs, agentic systems, data platforms, APIs, and cloud**
  - enough to hold credible conversations with CTOs, CDOs, and architects.
* Consultative and solution-selling skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* Experience navigating partner onboarding, vendor empanelment, and procurement processes at IT services companies and enterprises.
* Strong commercial acumen, including deal structuring, pricing, partnership economics, and contract negotiation.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-presence skills; fluent in English.
* Hands-on experience with CRM tools such as
  **Salesforce or HubSpot**
  .

**Leadership & Working Style**

* Self-starter who thrives in ambiguous, early-stage market environments and can operate independently.
* Strong ownership and accountability for pipeline, revenue, and partnership outcomes.
* Comfortable working across time zones with a globally distributed team.
* High integrity, credibility, and a track record of building trust with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and leadership teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience at an AI, data, or enterprise software company, or in an alliances/partnerships role at a global IT technology/service firm.
* Experience building a market presence in India for a global product or technology company.
* Experience with channel, co-sell, or marketplace go-to-market motions.
* Exposure to regulated industries or selling into environments with strict security, compliance, and data-sovereignty requirements.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, AI agents, or knowledge graph technologies.

**Cultural Fit & Values**

At Accrete, success goes beyond technical expertise. We value:

* **Ownership & Accountability:**
  Drive initiatives to completion with high standards and proactive problem-solving.
* **Transparency & Communication:**
  Share information openly and give and receive constructive feedback.
* **Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving:**
  Analyze challenges critically and develop effective, scalable solutions.
* **Collaboration & Professionalism:**
  Work effectively across teams and contribute to a culture of mutual respect.
* **Passion for AI & Innovation:**
  Stay curious, continuously learn, and push the boundaries of AI.
* **Going Beyond the Job Description:**
  Look for opportunities to create impact beyond your immediate responsibilities.

These principles shape our culture, performance expectations, and growth opportunities.

**Company Benefits**

* **Competitive Compensation:**
  Fixed salary with a performance-linked variable component, aligned with experience and market standards.
* **Mediclaim:**
  ₹10 lakh coverage for you and your family.
* **Flexible PTO & Hybrid Work:**
  Take time off when needed and enjoy remote flexibility in accordance with company guidelines.
* **Growth & Development:**
  Access to professional learning opportunities and career advancement support.
* **Onsite Perks:**
  Catered lunches and snacks.
* **Team Bonding:**
  Company-sponsored social events and team activities.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: National Sales Manager – IVF Products
description:
Location: Mumbai (Head Office)

Reports To Country Manager – Esco Medical & Allwin Medical Devices, India

Team: Leads a team of Regional/Area Sales Managers and Business Development Executives across India

Travel: Extensive domestic travel (approx. 50–60%) across IVF centres, hospitals, and distributor markets

**ABOUT US**

Esco Medical and Allwin Medical Devices are part of the Esco Lifesciences Group, a global life sciences and healthcare technology company. Esco Medical designs and manufactures advanced ART (Assisted Reproductive Technology) capital equipment, including the MIRI time-lapse incubator platform used by leading IVF centres worldwide. Allwin Medical Devices complements this with a comprehensive portfolio of IVF consumables. Together, the two brands support IVF clinics and hospitals across India with a full-spectrum solution — from capital equipment to daily-use consumables — backed by clinical training and after-sales service.

As the India business scales toward its FY26–FY29 growth targets, we are building out a stronger national commercial team to deepen clinical relationships, expand geographic coverage, and convert market share from legacy competitors.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The National Sales Manager – IVF Products will own the national sales strategy, revenue targets, and team leadership for Esco Medical's ART capital equipment and consumables business in India. This is a high-visibility, individual-contributor-plus-team-leadership role reporting directly to the Country Manager, responsible for driving both new capital equipment placements and recurring consumables revenue across IVF centres, hospital ART units, and fertility chains nationally.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

• Own and deliver the national sales plan and revenue targets for IVF incubators IVF consumables portfolio.

• Lead, coach, and performance-manage a team of Regional/Area Sales Managers and Business Development Executives across defined territories.

• Build and manage direct relationships with key IVF centres, fertility chains, hospital ART departments, embryologists, and clinical directors (KOLs) to drive equipment adoption and consumables pull-through.

• Manage and develop the distributor network where applicable, including onboarding, target-setting, and performance reviews, while supporting the transition toward a direct/hybrid go-to-market model.

• Own the capital equipment sales cycle end-to-end — lead generation, clinical demonstrations, tender/quotation management, commercial negotiation, and order closure.

• Ensure consumables reorder cycles are tracked and grown through structured account management and cross-sell of the entire portfolio.

• Provide accurate sales forecasting, pipeline reporting, and market intelligence (competitor activity, pricing, new IVF centre openings) to leadership.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Regulatory, and Service teams on product launches, GeM listings, tenders, and after-sales support to ensure a seamless customer experience.

• Represent the company at key industry conferences, IVF society events, and clinical workshops.

• Ensure adherence to pricing policy, credit control norms, and distributor/dealer agreement terms across the country.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Experience & Education**

• 10–15 years of progressive sales experience in the IVF/ART, fertility, or medical devices industry, with at least 3–5 years in a national or multi-regional sales leadership role.

• Proven track record of selling capital equipment (preferably ART/embryology, diagnostics, or critical-care medical devices) into hospitals and specialty clinics.

• Prior experience managing both a direct sales team and a distributor network is strongly preferred.

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent management qualification is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong clinical and commercial acumen — able to engage credibly with embryologists, clinicians, and hospital administrators.

• Demonstrated people-leadership skills, with experience setting territory targets, running performance reviews, and developing a sales team.

• Sound understanding of tender processes, GeM listings, and institutional/government sales in the medical devices space.

• Strong negotiation and key-account management skills, including pricing and credit-terms discussions.

• Data-driven approach to forecasting, pipeline management, and territory planning.

• Willingness to travel extensively across India.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• An opportunity to lead the national sales function for a fast-growing, high-visibility segment of the Esco Lifesciences portfolio.

• A direct reporting line to the Country Manager with significant influence over India go-to-market strategy.

• Competitive fixed compensation with a performance-linked incentive structure.

• Access to a global product portfolio backed by strong clinical training and marketing support.

title: Manager – Dermatology Sales & Clinic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT US

We are an upcoming premium, science-led skincare brand, manufactured in South Korea and developed for Indian consumers. With launch planned in the next 3–6 months, we are looking for someone to help build our dermatologist and clinic business from the beginning.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will build relationships with dermatologists and skin clinics, introduce our products, and grow sales through clinics stocking and selling our range.

You should have strong existing dermatologist relationships in Mumbai and active doctor contacts in Delhi NCR and Bengaluru.

This is a hands-on role. You will initially manage doctor visits, clinic partnerships and sales independently, working closely with the founders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Meet dermatologists and clinic owners to introduce the brand and develop business opportunities.

• Clearly explain product ingredients, benefits and supporting scientific evidence.

• Before launch, build a pipeline of interested clinics and coordinate sampling and product evaluations as products become available.

• After launch, open clinic accounts, achieve sales targets and generate repeat orders.

• Train clinic teams and follow up regularly to build lasting working relationships.

• Develop relationships with leading dermatologists and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).

• Track doctor visits, business opportunities and sales, and share market feedback with the team.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 3–10 years of relevant sales experience in prescription dermatology, cosmeceuticals, professional skincare or aesthetic medicine.

• Strong dermatologist relationships in Mumbai and active contacts in Delhi NCR and Bengaluru.

• A proven record of acquiring accounts and growing sales.

• Confidence in presenting products and discussing their scientific benefits with doctors.

• Initiative, consistent follow-up and the ability to build a new business channel independently.

Experience selling skincare products that clinics stock and retail will be an advantage. Candidates with prescription dermatology experience are also welcome.

WHY JOIN US?

Work directly with the founders, help shape our dermatology business, and build lasting partnerships with doctors and clinics. As the business grows, there will be scope to take on broader responsibilities and grow with the brand.

LOCATION AND TRAVEL

The role is based in Mumbai. Candidates willing to relocate are welcome, provided they already have strong Mumbai dermatologist relationships.

Frequent local doctor visits and outstation travel will be required. Outstation travel frequency will be decided later. The company will cover travel expenses and applicable allowances based on the travel required.

COMPENSATION AND JOINING

Fixed pay plus performance-linked incentives, discussed during the selection process.

Candidates should be available to join within 60 days.

TO APPLY

Please email your CV to archana@aaskcosmetics.com, along with your current location, notice period, expected annual fixed compensation, and a brief summary of your dermatology sales experience and market coverage. Please include one measurable sales or account-acquisition achievement.

title: Strategic Account Executive - India
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

As a Strategic Account Executive for our Mumbai territory, you'll drive GitLab's growth across large Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) institutions, alongside leading enterprises and conglomerates headquartered in the city. It will be a blended territory of Enterprise and Conglomerates slightly more BFSI heavy. You'll help these organisations adopt, implement, and expand their use of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, guiding them through modernisation and DevSecOps transformations while building a pipeline that translates into measurable Net ARR and long-term expansion.
  
  
You'll bring an understanding of the software development lifecycle, including continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) automation, secure development practices, and infrastructure modernisation. You'll apply it to the realities of regulated industries, where security, compliance, auditability, and data residency shape every technology decision. You'll connect customer stakeholders with GitLab's field organisation so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner across the full sales cycle.
  
  
In your first year, you'll be expected to build a strong BFSI and Enterprise portfolio across your territory, create repeatable sales motions aligned to how regulated financial institutions and large enterprises buy and adopt platforms, and consistently forecast and report on deal progress and account health.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and grow GitLab's largest and most strategic BFSI, Enterprise, and Conglomerate prospects and customers in Mumbai, focusing on organisations that run mission-critical software delivery at scale
* Drive the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline generation through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, including the longer procurement, vendor risk, and security review processes typical of regulated financial institutions
* Provide hands-on account leadership throughout the pre- and post-sales process to ensure a smooth customer experience and strong adoption of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform
* Position GitLab against regulatory and compliance priorities (for example RBI, IRDAI, and SEBI guidelines on IT governance, outsourcing, cyber resilience, and data localisation), working with Solutions Architects and Security specialists on deployment options such as self-managed and GitLab Dedicated
* Partner closely with Sales Development Representatives, Solutions Architects, Customer Success, system integrators, and strategic channel partners to generate qualified opportunities, co-sell, and execute account strategies that drive new business and expansion
* Develop and maintain detailed account plans for priority customers, including opportunity mapping, stakeholder alignment, and multi-threaded engagement across engineering, security, risk and compliance, platform, infrastructure, procurement, and business leaders
* Tailor your approach to each segment: a compliance- and risk-led value story for BFSI, and a modernisation-, productivity-, and consolidation-led story for enterprises and conglomerates with multiple business units
* Coordinate and facilitate the involvement of cross-functional GitLab team members, including sales leadership, marketing, product, legal, and support, to progress opportunities and deliver an excellent customer experience
* Prepare activity and forecast reports, contribute to forecasting and pipeline reviews, and share root cause analysis and lessons learned from wins and losses with account managers, marketing, and technical teams
* Act as the voice of the customer by contributing product ideas to our public issue tracker, and by preparing and delivering customer-facing and internal presentations, quotes, proposals, and formal sales documents that address BFSI and enterprise business challenges and clearly communicate long-term value and outcomes.

**What You'll Bring**

* Deep experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with large enterprise customers, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS and infrastructure solutions that support the software development lifecycle
* A track record selling into BFSI institutions in India, with an understanding of their buying behaviour, long evaluation cycles, vendor risk assessments, and procurement processes (experience across both BFSI and large enterprises or conglomerates is a strong plus)
* Ability to prospect, build pipeline, and close new business while expanding strategic relationships within large accounts across Mumbai
* Strong understanding of modern software delivery, including CI/CD, secure development practices (DevSecOps, supply chain security), and cloud and infrastructure modernisation, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes
* Working familiarity with the regulatory and compliance landscape for Indian financial institutions, including data residency, audit, and security expectations, and comfort discussing on-premises, private cloud, and hybrid deployment models
* Proven ability to navigate and influence complex organisations, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders such as CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, heads of engineering, and technology risk and compliance leaders
* Experience creating and executing account plans for priority accounts, including opportunity mapping, multi-threaded engagement, and disciplined deal and account management
* Experience working with system integrators and channel partners to co-sell and deliver in the Indian market
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including comfort leading customer presentations, negotiations, and executive-level conversations, and coordinating internal resources to move opportunities forward
* Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote environment while staying aligned to shared goals, processes, and forecasting expectations across the broader GitLab team, with the flexibility to meet customers in person across Mumbai
* Familiarity with forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and reporting, including sharing learnings from wins and losses to improve repeatable sales motions

**Some examples of our projects**

* Building and growing a territory plan for Mumbai that balances large BFSI institutions (banks, NBFCs, insurers, asset managers, payments and fintech) with high-potential enterprises and conglomerates, from new logo prospecting through long-term expansion on GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform
* Leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and partnering with Solutions Architects, Sales Development, Customer Success, system integrators, and channel partners to position GitLab as a trusted platform for modern software delivery, security, and compliance in regulated and large-scale environments
* Helping BFSI customers consolidate fragmented toolchains and modernise legacy delivery pipelines while meeting regulatory, audit, and data-residency expectations

**About The Team**
The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the India market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. Kids Age has earned national acclaim and multiple prestigious awards, including the Limca Book of Records, India Book of Records, Asia Book of Records, and India’s Best Education Sector Magazine Award. Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

30K + Travel + upto 1 Lakh plus Incentives

**About the Role**

**reimagining the joy of reading**
for over 1.2 million young learners across India. As a School Partnership & Academic Success Manager, you will be the driving force behind expanding and sustaining our footprint across leading K-12 schools and pre-schools in Mumbai. You will connect directly with institutional decision-makers - Trustees, Principals, and Academic Coordinators - to integrate our curriculum-aligned, screen-free, experiential publication into everyday classroom and home reading routines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Institutional Acquisition & Network Expansion**

* Leverage existing relationships with school management, Trustees, and Principals across Mumbai/MMR to introduce Kids Age.
* Drive institutional adoption and student-level subscription rollouts across primary schools and pre-schools.
* Align with school academic calendars to pitch, pilot, and close contracts during peak planning and procurement cycles (October–April).

**2. School Retention, Penetration & Renewals**

* Manage long-term relationships with existing partner schools to ensure 90%+ renewal rates year-on-year.
* Increase student subscription penetration within existing schools by converting single-grade adoptions into whole-school reading programs.
* Identify cross-opportunity initiatives such as school library subscriptions, activity books, and kindergarten-specific editions.

**3. Academic Engagement & Reading Evangelism**

* Conduct orientation sessions and walkthroughs for educators on utilizing interactive formats (such as 3D, Solar Active, and Spy Decoder activities) for classroom engagement.
* Organize school reading drives, inter-school literacy activities, and reading-hour initiatives to demonstrate tangible value to educators.
* Support schools with communication collateral for parent-teacher forums, helping convey the value of screen-free reading to parents.

**4. Operations, Dispatch & Financial Collections**

* Oversee end-to-end account coordination, from student count finalization and subscription onboarding to timely monthly delivery fulfillment.
* Manage commercial terms, invoicing, and timely payment/fee collections from partner school administrations.
* Act as the single point of contact to resolve logistics or distribution challenges across the MMR region.

**Who Can Be a Buiness Development Executive - School Partnership ?**

* **Proven B2B School Network:**
  1–3 years of direct B2B sales or institutional partnership experience in education publishing, K-8 curriculum solutions, pre-school content, or school-focused EdTech.
* **Active Mumbai Rolodex:**
  Demonstrated direct access and established trust with Principals, Trustees, and Pre-school heads across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Thane.
* **Commercial & Academic Balance:**
  Proven track record in quota attainment, school-fee collection cycles, contract renewals, and managing academic relationships.
* **Understanding of School Cycles:**
  Clear understanding of institutional buying calendars, board-specific curriculum expectations (CBSE, ICSE, State, IB, and early-childhood frameworks), and school administration dynamics.
* **Field Readiness:**
  High energy with a willingness to travel locally across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region for in-person school visits and meetings.

**Strategic Dimensions Included to Strengthen This Role**

* **Parent-School Dynamic:**
  Because children's newspapers are frequently funded via annual student activity fees or parent consent forms, this role actively incorporates parent-facing orientation tools and support for Parent-Teacher Meets (PTMs).
* **School Academic Procurement Timing:**
  The responsibilities explicitly tie KPIs to the academic budgeting cycle (Q3/Q4 institutional alignment for June rollouts).
* **Early Childhood / Pre-School Adaptation:**
  Added dedicated focus on pre-school chains and early childhood centers, where experiential and tactile learning formats have high adoption rates.

**Qualifications**

* Ability to drive New Business Development and Lead Generation, with a focus on building a strong pipeline of school and institutional clients.
* Strong Business and Account Management skills to nurture relationships, retain clients, and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
* Excellent Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication and confident presentation abilities.
* Proven experience in sales or business development, preferably in education, media, publishing, or related sectors.
* Strong negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills, with a customer-centric approach.
* Comfort working in an on-site, field-oriented environment in Mumbai, including regular client visits.
* Basic proficiency in using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and presentation software to manage leads and report performance.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**Role**
: Client Solutions Partner
  
  
**Experience**
: 8-14 years
  
  
**Location**
: Mumbai / Bangalore
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**
As part of the core sales and GTM team of Quantiphi, you will be responsible for execution of end-to-end sales processes in a B2B environment. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Prepare and deliver technical presentations explaining products or services to customers and prospective customers
* Managing customer communication & relationships
* Engage & drive end-to-end pre-sales activities for business development for the company in the Data Science & Applied AI domain
* Ability to identify & prospect full range - Proficient in developing business collaterals based on latest developments in AI to showcase the potential of ML & AI for the enterprise
* Experience in handling or being hands-on for analytical/machine learning projects (Good to have)
* Work in conjunction with the Solution Architects & Data Science teams to gather, analyze and prospect business problems to be solved using large volumes of quantitative and qualitative data and develop of point of view to build a solution for the problems
* Applying the right analysis frameworks to develop creative solutions to complex business problems
* Planning and executing both short-term and long-range projects and manage teamwork, and client expectations
* Challenge and inspire customers and peers to solve difficult problems with ambitious and novel solutions
* Work with the team to identify and qualify business opportunities. Identify key customer technical objections and develop a strategy to resolve technical blockers.
* Work hands-on with customers to demonstrate and prototype Google Cloud product integrations in customer/partner environments and manage the technical relationship with Google’s customers.
* Recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution using best practices on Google Cloud.
* This includes understanding, analyzing and prospecting complex business problems to be solved using Data solutions & AI Applications in a variety of industries including Healthcare, Media, BFSI, CPG, Retail, and many others
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required

**Required Skills**
You would be involved in the development of new business opportunities and value-added services which requires a high level of creativity, learning potential and deep quantitative subject matter expertise and therefore self-driven individuals willing to learn on the go would be preferred.
  
  

* Strong team player
* Degree in Business (BBA/BBM/MBA), Economics or Engineering
* Good communication , abstraction , analytical and presentation skills
* Experience of B2B sales , customer communication and relationship management
* Experience and knowledge of critical phases of the sales process which includes requirement gathering, sales planning, solution scoping, proposal writing and presentation
* Data driven mindset. Your plans and actions are backed by not just gut feeling but also customer/industry/market research
* Knowledge and willingness to learn and apply emerging trends in business research, data science, Machine learning Artificial Intelligence, Cloud
* Excellent aptitude in business analysis and awareness of quantitative analysis techniques
* Excellent communication (both written & verbal) & articulation skills (Mandatory)
* Strong team player and ability to collaborate with a cross functional team
* Experience with sales reporting
* Self-driven and strong aptitude to work in an entrepreneurial , fast-paced environment with minimal supervision and a passion for developing new value-added AI based solutions for clients across a variety of industries.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

title: Business Development Consultant
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an experienced, driven and commercially sharp
**Business Development & Growth Consultant**
who can take ownership of new business acquisition, strategic partnerships and revenue growth at Social Square Media.

This isn't a traditional lead generation role. We're looking for someone who understands the advertising and marketing industry, knows how to identify the right brands, can get conversations started with decision-makers and, most importantly,
**convert those conversations into long-term business relationships**
.

The ideal person should be comfortable working independently, building sales pipelines, negotiating commercials, developing pitches and using AI-powered tools and automations to make business development more efficient and scalable.

We're looking for someone who can eventually become an integral part of the company's growth and leadership, rather than simply working on a list of leads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Client Acquisition**

Take end-to-end ownership of business development, from prospecting and outreach to negotiations and closures.

Identify and acquire clients across
**FMCG, F&B, hospitality, sports, healthcare, wellness, fashion, beauty, lifestyle and consumer brands**
.

Develop relationships with founders, CEOs, CMOs, marketing heads and other key decision-makers.

Identify brands actively seeking marketing agencies, creative partners, social media management and digital marketing services.

Build a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects with genuine business potential.

Handle introductory conversations, discovery calls, client meetings and commercial discussions.

Convert qualified opportunities into retainer-based clients, projects and long-term partnerships.

Explore opportunities for larger agency mandates, integrated campaigns and strategic brand partnerships.

**2. AI-Powered Lead Generation & Automation**

Build and manage intelligent lead generation systems using
**AI tools, CRM platforms, automation workflows and prospecting software**
.

Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, ChatGPT, Make, n8n and other relevant platforms.

Set up automated workflows to identify prospective clients, monitor buying signals and track new business opportunities.

Research brands expanding into new markets, launching products, hiring marketing teams or actively looking for agency partners.

Develop personalised outreach campaigns across email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

Automate lead enrichment, follow-up tracking, CRM updates and reporting wherever appropriate.

Continuously optimise lead quality, outreach effectiveness and conversion rates.

**3. International Business Development**

Identify and approach potential international clients, particularly in markets such as the
**UAE, UK, US and other relevant regions**
.

Research international brands looking to outsource social media, creative, content production and digital marketing services.

Build relationships with international founders, marketing teams and agencies.

Explore white-label partnerships and agency-to-agency collaborations.

Manage international prospecting, outreach, discovery calls and proposal discussions.

Identify new markets and sectors where the agency can build a competitive presence.

**4. Pitching, Proposals & Negotiations**

Work closely with the Founder and creative/strategy teams to develop compelling pitches and proposals.

Understand client briefs, business objectives, marketing challenges and budget expectations.

Contribute commercially and strategically to pitch decks, credentials presentations and service proposals.

Lead client presentations and discussions wherever required.

Negotiate retainers, project fees, deliverables and commercial terms.

Maintain a strong understanding of agency pricing, profitability and scope management.

Follow through on proposals, negotiations and approvals to ensure timely closures.

**5. Revenue Growth & Business Strategy**

Develop and execute a structured business development strategy with clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Identify new revenue streams, service offerings, partnerships and market expansion opportunities.

Build a predictable pipeline of recurring retainer revenue.

Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing client relationships.

Monitor conversion rates, sales cycles, pipeline value and revenue generated.

Work closely with the Founder on long-term growth plans and business expansion.

Contribute to building scalable systems that support the agency's next phase of growth.

**6. Ownership & Leadership**

Operate with a high level of independence and accountability.

Take ownership of the business development function rather than waiting for day-to-day instructions.

Build systems, processes and reporting structures that can scale with the agency.

Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from client acquisition to onboarding.

Help shape the agency's commercial direction, positioning and growth strategy.

Demonstrate the ability to eventually lead the business development vertical and take on broader commercial leadership responsibilities.

**What We're Looking For**

**1-3 years of relevant experience**
in business development, agency sales, growth consulting or strategic partnerships.

Previous experience working with a
**digital marketing, advertising, creative, branding or PR agency**
is strongly preferred.

A solid understanding of how marketing agencies operate, pitch, price and acquire clients.

Proven experience in generating leads and converting them into paying clients.

Existing industry relationships and professional networks would be a significant advantage.

Experience working with brands across FMCG, food, hospitality, sports, healthcare and lifestyle sectors.

Strong understanding of AI-powered prospecting, sales automation and CRM systems.

Ability to independently handle discovery calls, client presentations and commercial negotiations.

Experience with international client acquisition or cross-border business development is an advantage.

Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills and understanding of profitability.

Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.

Self-motivated, resourceful, organised and comfortable working with clear revenue targets.

**What Success Looks Like**

We're looking for someone who can deliver measurable business outcomes, including:

A consistent pipeline of relevant, qualified leads.

Regular meetings with founders and senior marketing decision-makers.

Strong pitch-to-conversion rates.

New monthly retainer clients and project opportunities.

Growth in recurring agency revenue.

Expansion into new sectors and international markets.

An efficient, AI-enabled business development process.

A scalable acquisition system that does not depend entirely on the Founder.

**The focus is on conversions and revenue, not simply the number of leads generated or emails sent.**

**Growth & Long-Term Opportunity**

We're looking to build a long-term association with someone who sees the potential in growing an agency and wants to be actively involved in making that happen.

For the right individual, this role could evolve beyond consultancy into a
**senior leadership or business growth partnership position**
.

Based on performance, consistent revenue contribution, long-term alignment and demonstrated ownership, we would also be open to exploring
**profit-sharing, performance-linked incentives or potential equity participation in the company**
at a later stage.

Any such arrangement would be subject to mutual agreement, performance evaluation and separately agreed commercial and legal terms.

**The Person We'd Love to Work With**

Someone who doesn't need to be told which brands to approach, how to find the right people or when to follow up.

Someone who understands that business development is not about sending 100 generic emails a day, but about finding the right opportunities, building genuine relationships and knowing how to close them.

We're looking for someone who can walk into a meeting, understand a brand's business challenges, confidently present solutions, negotiate the commercials and bring the business home.

**More than a consultant, we're looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who wants to build, grow and eventually help lead something bigger.**

description:
We're Hiring: Business Development Executive – Interior Sales

**Company:**
Namaste Design | Namaste Ventures

**Location:**
Goregaon, Mumbai (Office + Field Sales)

**Employment:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Salary:**
₹25,000–₹40,000/month + Performance-Based Incentives

About Namaste Design

Namaste Design is a growing interior design and turnkey execution company delivering premium residential and commercial interiors.

We focus on transparent pricing, quality workmanship, reliable project timelines, and a seamless client experience from design to execution.

We're expanding our sales team and looking for someone who can help us acquire new clients, build strong relationships, and close high-value interior projects.

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, confident, and results-driven
**Business Development Executive**
who enjoys selling, meeting people, negotiating, and closing deals.

This is a sales-heavy position where you will own the complete sales cycle, from identifying potential customers to converting them into paying clients.

You will work closely with our design and execution teams, but your primary responsibility will be
**generating business and driving revenue**
.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Generation & Business Development**

* Independently generate leads through cold calling, referrals, networking, field visits, and digital platforms.
* Identify potential residential and commercial interior projects across Mumbai.
* Build relationships with builders, real estate brokers, architects, developers, corporate decision-makers, and property owners.
* Develop new referral and channel partnerships to generate consistent business.
* Actively identify opportunities beyond company-provided leads.

**2. Client Meetings & Sales Conversion**

* Connect with prospective customers and understand their requirements, budgets, and timelines.
* Schedule and conduct client meetings, site visits, and sales presentations.
* Present Namaste Design's services, portfolio, pricing approach, and value proposition.
* Coordinate with the design team to prepare proposals and quotations.
* Negotiate commercial terms, handle objections, and close deals.
* Convert qualified prospects into confirmed projects with signed agreements and booking payments.

**3. Sales Pipeline Management**

* Manage both company-generated and self-generated leads.
* Ensure timely follow-ups through calls, WhatsApp, emails, and meetings.
* Maintain accurate lead information, meeting notes, deal stages, and follow-up schedules in the CRM.
* Track sales opportunities from initial enquiry through project confirmation.
* Share regular updates on pipeline progress, expected closures, and revenue.

**4. Revenue Growth & Performance**

* Work towards monthly and quarterly sales and project-acquisition targets.
* Improve lead-to-meeting and meeting-to-conversion rates.
* Develop repeat business, referral opportunities, and long-term client relationships.
* Collaborate with management to improve sales processes and customer acquisition strategies.

Who We're Looking For

* 2–5 years of experience in business development, field sales, or client acquisition.
* Experience in interior design, real estate, construction, modular furniture, home improvement, or building materials is preferred.
* Strong cold-calling, negotiation, presentation, and deal-closing skills.
* Confident in interacting with homeowners, business owners, and corporate decision-makers.
* Comfortable travelling across Mumbai for meetings and site visits.
* Strong follow-up discipline and ability to work independently.
* Working knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, WhatsApp Business, and CRM tools.
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi; Marathi is an advantage.
* A proven track record of meeting sales targets is highly desirable.

**An existing network of architects, brokers, builders, or corporate clients will be a strong advantage.**

What We Offer

* Competitive fixed salary with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunity to earn more through successful project closures.
* Exposure to premium residential and commercial interior projects.
* Direct collaboration with the leadership and design teams.
* Opportunity to grow into a Senior Business Development or Sales Manager role.
* A fast-growing environment with ownership and accountability.

Important

**This is not a telecalling-only or sales coordination role.**

We are looking for someone who can independently identify business opportunities, build relationships, meet customers, and convert projects.

If you enjoy sales, love closing deals, and want to grow with an ambitious interior design company, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply

Share your updated resume along with:

* Current and expected salary
* Notice period
* Previous sales experience and industry
* Monthly sales targets and actual achievements
* Examples of projects or deals you have successfully closed
* **Namaste Design | A Namaste Ventures Company**
