description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply
**Here**
PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
  
  
**About The Project**
There have been persistent efforts focused on improving primary healthcare (PHC) and overcoming the hurdles of low coverage and poor quality of health services through several Digital Health interventions. However, majority of these initiatives are designed with very specific clinical or administrative purposes and lack a comprehensive ecosystem approach resulting in multiple applications and digital portals in use for their health system. This cascades into poor accountability and performance, time and resource wastage, lack of continuum of care, and low coverage of health services, resulting in poor health outcomes.
  
  
PATH is supporting the state of Maharashtra with digitization of primary level of care and health service delivery in select districts. The project intends to demonstrate end to end digitization in healthcare and develop a digital saturation model at district level, leveraging fit for purpose digital solutions/interventions through the use case of improving reproductive, maternal and child health service delivery indicators. The district saturation model will include coverage across rural & urban areas and service delivery across public and private sectors. The focus will be on digitizing healthcare facilities, community health initiatives/programs and deploying innovations for accelerating service delivery across continuum of care. The project aims to form a digitally competent health workforce, improve access to health and systems-level data for resource planning and management, enable creation of longitudinal health records for patients, and enable interoperability of digital systems across healthcare facilities. This will result in data-driven decision-making leading to improved access and service coverage, citizen empowerment, quality care, and enhanced healthcare provider accountability. These positive health outcomes, complemented by favorable policies, governance support, local leadership, and partnerships, will accelerate Universal Health Coverage (UHC).

**Role Purpose**

The Growth & Sales Executive will be responsible for generating qualified leads through digital marketing and converting them into paid RoyalPath customers. The role combines marketing execution, lead nurturing, sales calls, CRM management, and partnership support.

Increase monthly paid bookings and collected revenue through marketing campaigns and disciplined sales follow-up.

* Track campaign performance: leads generated, cost per lead, lead quality, and conversion rate.

**B. Sales Conversion & Counselling Sales – 35% of time**

* Contact every new lead within 24 hours through calls and WhatsApp.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand the student’s academic situation, career confusion, and parent expectations.
* Explain RoyalPath’s assessment and counselling packages clearly.
* Handle objections related to price, need, timing, and trust.
* Book paid counselling sessions and follow up until payment is received.
* Maintain CRM/pipeline records with lead status, next action, call notes, and payment updates.
* Convert qualified leads into paid customers through structured follow-up.

**C. CRM, Reporting & Coordination – 15% of time**

* Maintain a clean lead pipeline using tools like Google Sheets, Airtable, or Zoho Bigin.
* Ensure every lead has a current status, owner, last contact date, and next follow-up date.
* Prepare weekly reports on leads, conversions, revenue, and campaign performance.
* Share customer feedback and objections with the founder to improve offers, scripts, and messaging.

**D. Partnerships & Events – 10% of time**

* Support outreach to schools, coaching centres, colleges, and local education partners.
* Coordinate career-awareness sessions, parent meetings, and student workshops.
* Follow up with partners for referrals, session bookings, and repeat collaborations.

**Time Allocation**

Marketing and lead generation - 40%

Sales calls and conversion - 35%

CRM, reporting, and coordination - 15%

Partnerships, events, and founder support - 10%

**Key Performance Indicators**

The candidate will be measured on:

* Number of qualified leads generated per month
* Cost per lead and lead quality
* Percentage of leads contacted within 24 hours
* Number of sales calls, meetings, and counselling sessions booked
* Number of paid bookings per month
* Revenue collected per month
* CRM discipline and follow-up consistency

**Indicative monthly targets for the first 90 days:**

* 60–100 qualified leads
* 40–60 sales calls or meetings
* 15–25 paid bookings
* Revenue target based on package mix and campaign performance

Targets will be reviewed after the first 30–45 days based on actual performance and market response.

**Who Should Apply**

You are a strong fit if you:

* Have 2–5 years of experience in sales, marketing, business development, education sales, edtech, coaching, insurance, financial products, or customer-facing roles.
* Are comfortable doing both
  **digital marketing**

  and

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Business Development Executive**

timepay.ai is hiring a Mumbai-based Business Development Executive to win enterprise accounts in two markets: lenders (banks, NBFCs, ARCs and fintechs) and D2C brands.

**Location:**

Mumbai (candidates must be based in Mumbai)

**Work mode:**

Hybrid

**Reports to:**

Business Head

**Experience:**

1–4 years in B2B sales or business development

**About timepay.ai**

timepay.ai builds AI voice agents that hold natural phone conversations with customers at scale. We work with two kinds of businesses:

* **Lenders:**

  banks, NBFCs, ARCs and fintechs use our bots for collections and loan recovery. Leading lenders already run their collections on them.
* **D2C brands:**

  brands use our bots to recover abandoned carts, guide shoppers through complex products on consultation calls, and handle operational calls such as order confirmations and delivery updates.

Our in-house voice engine, Vox, replies with under 40 ms text-to-speech latency and speaks Hindi, English and 12+ regional languages, switching mid-call and with real emotion in its voice. During a call, the bots can send WhatsApp and SMS messages, such as a payment link or a cart link, and transfer to a human agent. Ask AI lets clients ask plain-language questions about their call data.

**About the role**

You will sell to both lenders and D2C brands, and own each deal from first touch to a live pilot. That means researching the right companies, reaching their decision-makers, running demos, gathering what our team needs to build each prospect's bot, and following up until the deal closes.

You will work directly with the Business Head and founders, and alongside our prompt engineering and tech teams.

**What you'll do**
**Across both markets**

* **Research and prioritise prospects:**

  map lenders (banks, NBFCs, small finance banks, housing finance companies, ARCs, fintechs) and D2C brands (beauty, personal care, health and wellness, fashion, electronics, home). Rank them by size and priority, and find the decision-makers using Apollo and LinkedIn.
* **Run outreach:**

  reach decision-makers through calls, personalised emails and WhatsApp, and follow up consistently until you get a clear answer.
* **Book and run demos:**

  set up demos with both business and tech teams. Share our deck and sample voice recordings. Answer questions on languages, latency, compliance and integrations.
* **Coordinate bot builds:**

  brief our prompt engineers on what each prospect needs, such as a higher-DPD bot that stays calm with abusive customers or a cart-recovery bot that knows a brand's products, and make sure demo bots are ready on time.
* **Manage the pipeline in Zoho CRM:**

  update accounts, contacts, tasks and statuses after every conversation, and share regular pipeline updates with the Business Head.

**Lending**

* **Pitch collections and recovery bots**

  to Heads of Collections, Chief Collections Officers, CIOs and call-centre heads.
* **Discover requirements:**

  understand each lender's buckets (Bucket X, higher DPD, NPA), call volumes, current vendors and pain points.
* **Gather what we need to build:**

  customer data points, scripts, call recordings and the escalation matrix for each lender's bot.
* **Represent us at industry events**

  such as collections summits, and build partnerships with field-collection agencies, BPOs and fintech platforms.

**D2C**

* **Pitch to founders and growth, marketing, CX and operations heads**

  at D2C brands.
* **Sell abandoned-cart recovery:**

  show brands how calling shoppers who left items in their cart brings back lost orders.
* **Sell consultation calls:**

  show how our bots explain complex products and answer shoppers' questions before they buy.
* **Sell operational calls:**

  order confirmations, delivery updates and other routine calls that take up a CX team's time.
* **Discover requirements:**

  understand where each brand's customers drop off, its order volumes, its product range and how it calls customers today.

**What we're looking for**

* 1–4 years in B2B sales, business development or inside sales, ideally selling software or tech services
* Comfortable selling to both lending and D2C stakeholders, and switching between the two
* Confident cold-calling senior people, and following up persistently without being pushy
* Clear spoken and written English and Hindi
* Highly organised: you log every conversation and never let a follow-up slip
* Quick to learn a technical product and able to explain it simply
* A self-starter who takes ownership and moves fast

**Good to have**

* Experience selling to banks, NBFCs or fintechs, or working in collections, a call centre or a BPO
* Experience selling to D2C or e-commerce brands, or working in growth, retention or CX at one
* Familiarity with collections terms such as DPD buckets, NACH bounces, promise to pay and the RBI Fair Practices Code
* Familiarity with D2C metrics such as cart abandonment, conversion rate, RTO and repeat purchase rate
* Hands-on experience with Zoho CRM, Apollo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* A regional language besides Hindi and English

**Why join**

* Sell one product into two large markets, built in-house by our AI team
* Work directly with the founders and Business Head, and see your customer feedback shape the product
* Room to grow your role as the company scales

title: Manager – GTM & Sales Strategy, Meesho AI Services (MAS)
description:
**About The Team**
MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
  
  
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a
**technology company, not an AI BPO**
: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.
  
  
We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role is for a GTM generalist who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about AI-led offerings, and wants to build the full range of enterprise sales skills — with an eye on growing into a closer and sales leader over time, or moving into Business/GTM Operations. Both are real paths from this seat.
  
  
You own the
**middle mile**
of the deal: the stretch between a qualified conversation and a close-ready opportunity. That means deep client discovery, mapping who really decides, understanding how a client's teams actually work today, and making sure the deal never goes cold on your watch — following up, keeping momentum, and setting up the closer to walk into the room fully briefed. Our central team owns top-of-funnel lead-gen, but this isn't a purely inbound or coordination role — you'll still make cold calls and run early client meetings yourself when a deal needs it.
  
  
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for a simple reason: nobody on the deal ever gets deep enough into the account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. That's exactly the gap this role exists to close — the middle mile is where deals live or die.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the middle mile of the sales cycle — from a client's first "yes, let's talk" through to a well-packaged, close-ready opportunity.

* Run structured discovery conversations to understand a client's real pain points, current workflows, and AI-readiness.
* Map client org structures — identify the true economic buyer, decision-makers, influencers, and blockers — and keep stakeholder engagement alive between senior-level touchpoints.
* Help identify and nurture an internal champion for MAS within the account — someone advocating for us when we're not in the room.
* Support structured, MEDDPICC-style account qualification alongside your closer, so every deal has an honest diagnosis of what's actually blocking it.
* Make cold calls and run client meetings yourself where needed, working alongside (not just waiting on) the central lead-gen team.
* Own the follow-up cadence after every client conversation — chasing next steps, addressing objections, and making sure momentum doesn't drop.
* Build a working understanding of MAS's guaranteed-savings and outcome-based pricing models (per-minute, slab-based, pilot, risk-sharing) and contribute early pricing inputs on deals you're driving.
* Brief and prep senior closers ahead of high-stakes conversations — sharp account context, clear stakeholder maps, clear next steps.
* Bonus: build and iterate on client-specific product demos in partnership with Product/Tech.
* Feed client and market insights back into the sales playbook and to Product, Tech, and Ops.
* Bring structured, consultative thinking to every account rather than a transactional, task-based approach.

**What You Will Need**

* 4–7 years of experience in enterprise sales, GTM, business consulting, or client-facing analyst/BD roles, ideally with exposure to Indian mid-market/enterprise clients.

* Strong discovery and analytical skills — able to quickly and accurately unpack a client's business problem and current workflow.
* Comfort making cold calls and running early client meetings — this is not a purely inbound or coordination role.
* A structured communicator — able to produce crisp meeting notes, account maps, and follow-up briefs.
* Basic commercial acumen — able to understand and reason about pricing structures (you won't be expected to own pricing negotiations independently yet).
* Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology — you don't need to code, but you should "get it."
* Exposure to (or curiosity about) structured account-qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC is a plus — we'll teach you the specifics.
* High ownership and follow-through — comfortable chasing a deal over weeks or months without losing momentum.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity, without established playbooks, in a 0–1/1–10 business environment.
* Ambition to grow — either toward a full closing/sales-leadership role, or into Business/GTM Operations — over time.
* Bonus: prior exposure to building or presenting product demos.
* Evidence that you're genuinely top-tier talent — that might show up as academic pedigree (a strong record at a top institute) or as a professional track record (success at a recognizable brand, or a reputation for excellence in high-stakes client work). We care about the evidence of excellence, not which box it comes from.

title: Manager – Business Development & Debt Syndication
description:
**Company:**
Growthally Advisors
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
3–9 Years
  
  
**Department:**
Corporate Finance / Debt Syndication
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Team Leader / Senior Management
  
  
**Role Overview**
Growthally is looking for a highly driven
**Manager – Business Development & Debt Syndication**
to drive client acquisition, deal origination, and revenue generation for its AIF & Credit Fund platform.
  
  
This is a
**front-end, target-driven role with focus on Business Development and Debt Syndication Execution**
. The ideal candidate will be responsible for independently sourcing new clients, building a strong deal pipeline, developing referral networks, and converting funding requirements into successful debt transactions.
  
  
The role requires a strong hunter mindset, established industry relationships, commercial acumen, and the ability to originate and close corporate and SME debt deals, including structured debt, growth capital, and refinancing opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Development & Client Acquisition
* New Client Acquisition: Independently identify, approach, and onboard corporates, SMEs, business owners, and promoters seeking debt funding, structured credit, growth capital, or refinancing solutions.
* Lead Generation & Deal Origination: Build and maintain a strong pipeline of self-sourced business opportunities through direct outreach, networking, referrals, and market intelligence.
* Promoter & CFO Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with promoters, CFOs, founders, business owners, family offices, and corporate decision-makers.
* Channel Partner Development: Establish and strengthen referral networks with Chartered Accountants (CAs), consultants, investment bankers, financial advisors, brokers, and other intermediaries.
* Funding Solutions & Pitching: Understand clients’ financial requirements and pitch suitable AIF, Credit Fund, and structured debt solutions based on their funding needs.
* Revenue Generation: Achieve business development targets through successful client acquisition, deal sourcing, transaction closures, and fee generation.
* Market Mapping: Identify potential sectors, companies, and emerging businesses with debt funding requirements aligned with Growthally’s investment strategy.
* Relationship Management: Build long-term client relationships to generate repeat business, referrals, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Networking & Brand Building: Represent Growthally at industry events, CFO forums, business conferences, and networking platforms to strengthen market presence and generate leads.
* Market Intelligence: Track competitor activity, prevailing interest rates, credit market trends, lender appetite, and structured debt opportunities.
* Debt Syndication & Deal Execution
* Initial Deal Assessment: Gather preliminary financial information and assess the client’s funding requirement, business profile, repayment capacity, and broad transaction feasibility.
* Deal Structuring Support: Coordinate with internal credit and investment teams to evaluate suitable debt structures, funding options, and potential transaction terms.
* Documentation & Due Diligence: Coordinate the collection of financial statements, business information, KYC documents, and other necessary documentation from clients.
* Internal Coordination: Act as the primary point of contact between clients and Growthally’s credit, investment, legal, compliance, and operations teams.
* Transaction Progress Monitoring: Follow up on credit evaluation, due diligence, internal approvals, documentation, and other execution milestones to facilitate timely closure.
* Negotiation & Closure Support: Assist in coordinating commercial discussions, term negotiations, and transaction documentation through disbursement or deal closure.
* Compliance & Deal Quality: Ensure that sourced opportunities meet preliminary fund eligibility criteria and adhere to internal processes and applicable compliance requirements.
* Post-Closure Relationship Support: Maintain client engagement after transaction closure to identify additional funding requirements and future business opportunities.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong business development, sales, and client acquisition capabilities.
* Proven experience in sourcing and converting corporate or SME debt opportunities.
* Good understanding of debt syndication, structured finance, corporate finance, and credit products.
* Strong network among promoters, CFOs, business owners, CAs, consultants, and financial intermediaries.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to independently generate leads, develop a pipeline, and achieve revenue targets.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to identify viable funding opportunities.
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills to support debt transaction execution.
* High ownership, self-motivation, resilience, and a performance-driven mindset.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Mandatory: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Preferred: MBA / PGDM in Finance, Marketing, or Strategy.
* Additional Advantage: CFA or other relevant finance certifications.

**Experience & Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 3–9 years of experience in Business Development, Client Acquisition, Debt Syndication, Corporate Banking, Relationship Management, NBFCs, Investment Banking, or Fintech lending.
* Demonstrated ability to independently source clients and generate a healthy pipeline of corporate and SME funding opportunities.
* Existing relationships with promoters, CFOs, founders, CAs, consultants, and other financial intermediaries will be an advantage.
* Experience in structured debt, private credit, AIFs, credit funds, or corporate lending will be preferred.
* Candidates with a strong sales orientation and a proven track record of revenue generation and deal closures are encouraged to apply.

**Compensation & Incentives**

* Competitive fixed compensation with aggressive performance-linked variable incentives.
* Higher incentives for proprietary deal sourcing, successful transaction closures, AIF / Credit Fund opportunities, and structured debt transactions.
* Quarterly performance reviews based on business generation, pipeline quality, fee generation, and deal closures.
* Opportunities for accelerated career growth based on performance and revenue contribution.

**This role is primarily suited for a business development professional who can independently originate debt transactions and drive revenue, while coordinating with internal teams to facilitate execution and closure.**
**How To Apply**
Interested candidates can share their profile or resume at 07506 236023.
  
  
Skills: investment,funding,pipeline,credit,closure,client acquisition,revenue,business development

description:

With its AI Agent Builder and Bot Studio, enterprises can create and deploy complex AI agents and bots across chat and voice in minutes.**

* Opportunity to work in a culture where you can challenge leadership, share ideas, and contribute to strategic decisions.

* Opportunity to shape enterprise sales strategy and drive growth for an innovative AI-powered conversational platform.

title: Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
10
  
  
**The Role**
The
**Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)**
is a critical technical and operational position within the global Sales Compensation team.
  
  
**The Team**
You will join the global Sales Compensation team — a high-impact, technically sophisticated group at the operational heart of S&P Global's commercial engine. Spanning time zones and geographies, we combine enterprise system precision with financial rigor to ensure 1,500+ salespeople worldwide are paid accurately and on time, every single cycle. We are a team that values methodical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to scalable, auditable, and compliant operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Drive end-to-end commission calculation cycles for 1,500+ global payees across all commercial business units — delivering 100% mathematically precise, on-time payroll files to regional Finance and Payroll teams across the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Administer and configure the enterprise Xactly platform (Incent, Connect & Analytics) — owning crediting rule setup, tiered accelerator matrices, split-crediting algorithms, batch ETL pipeline monitoring, and participant security profiles that directly reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Execute the full payee lifecycle — from configuring new hire profiles and quota ramp models, to implementing mid-period role transitions, LOA credit adjustments, and producing audit-ready departure settlement calculations.
* Build and optimize advanced SQL queries and Python/Alteryx automation scripts to perform high-volume ledger-to-payout reconciliations, pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and root-cause remediation of calculation anomalies before file delivery.
* Lead annual platform readiness activities — authoring UAT test scripts, executing calculation logic change validation, managing plan roll-forwards, and maintaining comprehensive SOPs and runbooks that keep operational cycles repeatable and defensible.
* Serve as the frontline operational liaison to the Central Governance & Compliance team — delivering automated calculation logs, approval artifacts, and clear mathematical payout explanations to global sales leaders, managers, and representatives across multiple time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Xactly System Administration & Configuration Management**

* Serve as the core hands-on administrator for Xactly Incent, Xactly Connect, and Xactly Analytics, overseeing rule configurations, crediting logic, participant hierarchies, and payout rate tables.
* Configure and maintain crediting rules, plan logic, tiered accelerator matrices, and split-crediting algorithms inside Xactly to reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Manage batch ETL integrations and data sync pipelines between upstream CRM/data warehouse platforms and Xactly Connect, proactively monitoring API sync jobs and resolving ingestion failures.
* Lead platform readiness for annual plan roll-forwards, plan parameter cutovers, and system testing; author test scripts and perform User Acceptance Testing for calculation logic changes.
* Administer participant security profiles, statement release workflows, and audit tracking within Xactly to ensure strict data privacy and system integrity.

**End-to-End Commission Calculation & Payroll Execution**

* Own and execute the monthly and quarterly commission calculation process across all global commercial business units, ensuring 100% timeliness and mathematical precision.
* Lead high-pressure calculation cycles against strict monthly payroll cutoffs, coordinating data freezes, calculation runs, manual adjustment validations, and final payroll sign-offs.
* Generate, reconcile, and format gross-to-net payroll transmission files, ensuring seamless handoffs to regional Payroll and Finance teams in the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Perform automated pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and historical variance spot-checks to catch calculation spikes, zero-payout outliers, and crediting bugs before file delivery.
* Execute calculation reruns, retroactive plan corrections, and adjustment batches within established cutover windows.

**Payee Lifecycle Operational Execution**

* New Hires & Onboarding: Configure new payee profiles in Xactly, assign plan rules, set up draw and guarantee schedules, and apply effective-dated quota ramp models based on start dates.
* Mid-Period Role Changes & Promotions: Implement plan transitions, target prorations, and crediting split adjustments for internal transfers and commercial promotions.
* Leaves of Absence (LOA): Adjust quota relief parameters, freeze crediting timelines, and prorate plan targets according to regional statutory and corporate policy guidelines.
* Departures & Offboarding: Calculate final commission settlements, review trailing pipeline revenues, verify recovery and clawback schedules, and deliver audit-ready exit calculations.
* HRIS-to-Engine Roster Reconciliation: Run scheduled automated reconciliations between Workday/HRIS and Xactly to identify roster deltas, missing employee IDs, and effective-date mismatches before payroll lock.

**Advanced Data Reconciliations, Automation & Quality Assurance**

* Build, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, join, and audit high-volume transaction datasets across enterprise databases and calculation engines.
* Develop automated data reconciliation scripts using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or advanced script-based tools to perform automated ledgers-to-payout reconciliations.
* Identify, isolate, and remediate root causes of data anomalies, including duplicate deal bookings, mismatched currency conversions, orphan transactions, and misaligned territory mapping.
* Maintain comprehensive calculation runbooks, process maps, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure repeatable, documented operational cycles.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance Liaison**

* Partner with regional Payroll teams to investigate post-payroll discrepancies, off-cycle payment adjustments, and tax or deduction inquiries.
* Collaborate with the global Modeling and Strategic Programs analysts to transition new incentive rules and SPIFF structures into scalable Xactly calculation logic.
* Act as the frontline operational execution partner to the dedicated Central Governance & Compliance team, providing automated calculation logs, approval artifacts, and audit evidence for internal and external reviews.
* Provide clear, step-by-step mathematical explanations to sales managers and representatives regarding payout mechanics, adjustment deductions, and statement reporting.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 5+ years of technical sales compensation operations, financial systems administration, or payroll calculation experience in a complex, multi-national corporate environment.
* Xactly Platform: Minimum 2 years of hands-on administration and configuration experience with Xactly Incent and Xactly Connect, including crediting rule configuration, plan logic setup, and payout rate table management.
* SQL Proficiency: Demonstrated experience writing complex multi-table JOIN queries, subqueries, indexing, and aggregation scripts to validate high-volume financial transaction datasets.
* Data Automation: Proven experience building automated data validation or reconciliation pipelines using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or VBA/Power Query in a financial operations context.

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Xactly Certification: Xactly Certified Administrator credential; or equivalent platform certification in Varicent, Anaplan, or SAP Commissions.
* HRIS & CRM: Demonstrated experience using Workday for HRIS roster management and Salesforce for CRM data structures and effective-dating logic in a compensation operations context.
* Advanced Excel: Proven use of dynamic arrays, Power Pivot, nested logic formulas, and complex lookup models for financial reconciliation and compensation modeling.
* Global Payroll Operations: Experience generating, reconciling, and formatting gross-to-net payroll transmission files across multiple regional Finance and Payroll teams.
* Power BI Reporting: Experience reviewing and interpreting Power BI dashboards in a compensation analytics or financial operations environment.
* Audit & Compliance Support: Experience producing calculation logs, change control artifacts, and audit evidence packages for internal or external compliance reviews.
* Stakeholder Communication: Demonstrated ability to communicate complex payout mechanics and calculation adjustments clearly in written and spoken English to international stakeholders across multiple time zones.

You will work closely with customers end-to-end throughout their lifecycle - from concept to technical requirements, implementation, adoption, expansion, and paid. This is truly an expansive sales responsibility that spans selling, success, and support. Activities related to this role will, for example, include:
  
  

* Expand outreach to existing rolodex and new opportunities, working with BDRs
* Relentlessly manage customer followup and your own pipeline, against quotas
* Work with our Growth team to increase product awareness
* Nurture and follow up with customers to share relevant use cases, find key decision makers, and gather requirements
* Guide customers through implementation plans to further adoption and drive paid conversion
* Work with our Product and Engineering to share feedback and feature requests
* Create content and refine scripts to support the customer journey and engagement points
* Maintain pipeline data and account information in DevRev's in-house CRM

**Ideal Candidate Qualifications**

* BA/BS, or equivalent educational or professional experience
* Ability to connect with people deeply!
* Outstanding communication (written and spoken), collaboration, and follow-up skills, with professionalism and friendliness
* Named account, customer success, account management, or other related experience
* Understanding of customer journeys and product-development feedback loops
* Some technical knowledge in cloud-based SaaS implementations and integrations
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced, global environment

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

**Company Description**

Endimension Technology is a healthcare Artificial Intelligence startup incubated at IIT Bombay, focused on transforming medical diagnosis through advanced AI solutions. The company develops AI-powered medical imaging solutions across X-ray, CT, and MRI, helping healthcare providers improve diagnostic accuracy, efficiency, and clinical workflows.

Our vision is to enable patients worldwide to receive accurate and early diagnosis, improving clinical outcomes and access to quality care. Endimension is backed by a founding team of computer science graduates from IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, and the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, bringing over a decade of industry experience.

With an established customer base across India and international markets, we are expanding our partnerships with leading hospitals, diagnostic networks, and healthcare organisations.

**Role Description**

We are looking for an experienced
**Enterprise Sales & Business Development Manager – Healthcare AI**
to drive enterprise customer acquisition, strategic relationships, and revenue growth.

This is a full-time, hybrid, individual contributor role, reporting directly to the Founders and CXO teams. The role involves working from our Mumbai office as required, along with frequent travel to hospitals, diagnostic centres, and customer locations across India, particularly South India.

The role involves independently managing end-to-end enterprise sales, from identifying and developing business opportunities to engaging senior hospital stakeholders, conducting product presentations, coordinating clinical evaluations and pilots, negotiating commercial agreements, and closing deals.

The successful candidate will work closely with product and technical teams while taking ownership of customer relationships, sales opportunities, and business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, develop, and convert enterprise business opportunities with leading hospitals, hospital chains, diagnostic networks, and healthcare organisations.
* Build and maintain relationships with radiology heads, medical directors, hospital leadership, IT teams, procurement teams, and other key decision-makers.
* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and solution discussions, clearly communicating the clinical, operational, and commercial value of our AI offerings.
* Independently manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, stakeholder engagement, proposals, pilot evaluations, negotiations, and contract closure.
* Understand customer requirements, address objections, and effectively communicate product differentiation and competitive positioning.
* Coordinate with internal product, technical, and operations teams to support AI pilots, implementations, and successful customer onboarding.
* Develop commercial proposals, business cases, and suitable pricing approaches based on customer requirements.
* Maintain a structured sales pipeline, proactively drive follow-ups, resolve sales bottlenecks, and work towards customer acquisition and revenue targets.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, long-term partnerships, and adoption of additional AI solutions.
* Gather customer insights and market intelligence to strengthen sales positioning and business development strategies.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in B2B enterprise sales, business development, or strategic account management.
* Experience selling to hospitals, diagnostic chains, healthcare institutions, or other enterprise healthcare customers is strongly preferred.
* Background in healthcare technology, medical imaging, PACS/RIS, healthcare software, medical devices, or B2B SaaS is advantageous.
* Demonstrated track record of independently managing complex enterprise sales opportunities, handling multiple stakeholders, negotiating, and closing deals.
* Strong analytical thinking, commercial acumen, problem-solving abilities, and understanding of business and financial considerations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to engage confidently with senior clinical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to understand technical products, explain their value clearly, and respond effectively to customer questions.
* Strong ownership, initiative, organisational skills, and ability to manage multiple opportunities independently.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Healthcare, or a related field preferred. MBA is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Willingness to travel frequently for customer meetings across India and Abroad.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work directly with the Founders & CXO's of a growing healthcare AI company.
* Ownership of enterprise business opportunities with leading hospital groups and diagnostic networks.
* Exposure to advanced AI technology with real-world clinical applications.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Significant responsibility, autonomy, and opportunities for professional growth.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Light Source International (LSI) is a leading provider of exclusive architectural lighting solutions in India, representing four renowned European brands: IGUZINNI, We-Ef, IBL, and LED-Linear. The company focuses on technologically advanced, aesthetically refined lighting products and applications for architecture and design professionals. With offices in Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, and a strong dealer network, LSI serves projects and clients across India. Its experienced team of engineers, technicians, designers, and brand custodians receive regular training from European partners, ensuring deep product and industry knowledge. LSI also operates a state-of-the-art Experience Center in New Delhi, enabling customers to explore real-life lighting applications and make informed decisions.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Business Development Manager role based in Mumbai. The Business Development Manager will identify and pursue new business opportunities, build and maintain relationships with architects, lighting designers, developers, and institutional clients, and drive sales of LSI’s portfolio of European lighting brands. The role involves managing the sales pipeline, preparing proposals and presentations, conducting product demonstrations in coordination with technical teams, and negotiating contracts in line with company guidelines. The Business Development Manager will collaborate closely with engineering, design, and brand custodian teams to ensure solutions meet client requirements and project specifications. Day-to-day responsibilities include market research, visiting project sites, participating in industry events, forecasting revenue, and reporting performance to leadership while maintaining a strong customer focus and high service standards.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong business development and sales skills, including lead generation, opportunity qualification, account management, and negotiation.
* Candidates should possess relationship-building and customer management skills, including stakeholder engagement, client presentations, and long-term partnership development.
* Candidates should possess market and product understanding skills, with the ability to learn technical aspects of architectural lighting, interpret specifications, and communicate value propositions clearly.
* Candidates should possess planning and analytical skills, including sales forecasting, pipeline management, and use of CRM or similar tools to track activities and performance.
* Candidates should possess clear written and verbal communication skills, including professional correspondence, report writing, and confident presentation skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, architecture, design, or a related field is preferred; experience in architectural products, lighting, construction, or building materials is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Mumbai, visit client offices and project locations, and travel within the region as required; demonstrated self-motivation and ownership of targets.
* Familiarity with the Indian architecture and design ecosystem, and comfort working with cross-functional technical and design teams, will be an advantage.

Our platform enables D2C and consumer brands to streamline content production, maintain brand consistency and significantly reduce the time and effort involved in creating e-commerce and marketing assets.

We are building the next generation of AI-powered creative solutions for brands across
**Beauty, Personal Care, Food & Beverages, FMCG, Lifestyle and Consumer Electronics**

.

As we scale our enterprise business, we're looking for an ambitious, well-connected
**Enterprise SaaS Business Development Manager**

to drive brand partnerships, enterprise adoption and revenue growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven Business Development professional with
**3–5 years of experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise sales, D2C partnerships, e-commerce technology or MarTech**

.

The ideal candidate should have an established network of D2C brands and strong working relationships with founders, CMOs, Heads of E-commerce, Digital Marketing Heads and other key decision-makers.

You will be responsible for introducing One Click Co. to brands, demonstrating its value, securing paid pilots and converting enterprise opportunities into long-term SaaS contracts.

This is a high-ownership, revenue-focused role with the opportunity to help build our enterprise business from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities****1. Enterprise Sales & Business Development**

* Identify, approach and acquire D2C, FMCG and consumer brands for One Click Co.'s enterprise solutions.
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified enterprise and mid-market opportunities.
* Drive the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to product demonstrations, commercial negotiations and deal closure.
* Pitch annual SaaS subscriptions, enterprise packages, usage-based solutions and pilot programmes.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue and customer acquisition targets.

**2. D2C Brand Relationships & Partnerships**

* Leverage existing relationships with D2C brands to generate qualified meetings and business opportunities.
* Build strong relationships with founders, marketing leaders, e-commerce teams and brand managers.
* Develop strategic partnerships with e-commerce enablers, brand aggregators and relevant ecosystem partners.
* Represent One Click Co. at industry events, networking forums and business meetings.

**3. Product Demonstrations & Enterprise Solutions**

* Understand each brand's creative production challenges, catalogue size, marketplace requirements and operational workflows.
* Conduct compelling product demos showcasing AI product photography, PDP/listing image generation, video creation, SKU intelligence and brand-consistent content production.
* Recommend appropriate enterprise plans based on business needs, content volumes and expected usage.
* Design and coordinate paid proof-of-concept engagements and convert successful pilots into annual contracts.
* Work closely with product and technology teams to communicate enterprise requirements.

**4. Account Growth & Revenue Expansion**

* Build long-term relationships with acquired enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, additional credit consumption and new business-unit adoption.
* Coordinate onboarding, renewals and upselling opportunities.
* Track customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve retention and product adoption.

**5. Sales Strategy & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate sales pipelines, forecasts and activity reports using CRM tools.
* Track lead conversion, sales cycles, pipeline value and closed revenue.
* Monitor competitor offerings, enterprise buying trends and customer requirements.
* Work directly with the founders to refine enterprise pricing, positioning and go-to-market strategies.

**Must-Have Requirements:**

* **3–5 years of relevant experience**

  in B2B SaaS sales, enterprise business development, MarTech, AdTech, e-commerce technology or D2C partnerships.
* **Strong existing relationships with Indian D2C brands are mandatory.**
* Demonstrated access to decision-makers such as brand founders, Heads of E-commerce, CMOs and Marketing Directors.
* Proven track record of acquiring B2B clients and closing revenue-generating partnerships.
* Experience managing consultative sales conversations, product demonstrations and commercial negotiations.
* Strong communication, presentation, relationship management and negotiation skills.
* Self-driven approach with the ability to independently generate business and close deals.

title: Territory Manager - Immunology & Neurology
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
*At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.*
*We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.*
*Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.*
*We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.*
*If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.*
**About Lilly’s India Affiliate**
*Few careers offer the opportunity to work directly for the people your work is ultimately meant to serve.*
*Lilly’s India affiliate is one of them.*
*Whether you are building brand strategies, developing sales capabilities, creating market access, or enabling the teams that do — the work you do here ensures that Lilly’s medicines reach the people who need them.*
**Job Description**
**Broad Objective of the Role:**
Enhancing the customer experience by identifying the critical need and delivering optimal pharmaceutical based healthcare solutions to achieve business objectives.
  
  
Analyzing market trends and developing a sales plan; Meeting and engaging designated doctors in the assigned territory, promoting company products to customers; strengthening relationships with stakeholders like doctors, paramedics, retailers and stockists in order to achieve individual and pool sales targets using patient focused selling principles while adhering to Lilly compliance guidelines.
  
  
**Key Customers:**
Doctors, paramedical & hospital staff, retailers and stockists.
  
  
**Minimum Qualification:**
Graduation in any field (preferably Science) with minimum one year of sales work experience.
  
  
**Key Competencies:**
Good communication and presentation skills, basic knowledge of therapeutic area and product segment, Emotional Intelligence, Organizational Skills, Learning agility.
  
  
**Area of Responsibility & Key Activities**
**Sales and Territory Planning**
Develop a detailed territory business plan for the portfolio by making strategic decisions about goals, resource investments, and monitor and measure the plan.
  
  

* Based on Retail Call Audit and market analysis, refresh and update MCL from the universal list provided by sales operations.
* Prepare a retail call list for important retailers.
* Prepare a patch plan as per customer availability and schedule.
* Prioritize business opportunities.
* Plan for achieving targets set by the company.
* Track and analyze weekly sales data in order to identify trends and make required modifications to the plan.
* Performance Metrics: Approval of plan by supervisor; Quality of analysis.

**Conducting Customer Calls**

* Meet the required number of customers as per SPP targets and call plan.
* Meet retailers as per SPP target and plan in order to gather information about product trends and competitor data.
* Meet compliance requirements on calls.
* Conduct effective pre-call planning by setting objectives tailored to customer segment, needs, attitudes, motivations, environment and business priorities, then prepare potential solutions.
* Conduct post-call analysis and record next call objective in approved CRM tool.
* Use relevant sales materials to address customer questions, objections, and concerns.
* Promote company products to customers as per the Patient Focused Selling Principles and by using aids provided by Marketing.
* Strengthen relationships with all stakeholders.
* Performance Metrics: SPP target v/s achievement; Adherence to compliance requirements; Sales target v/s achievement.

**Customer, Paramedic Staff and Retailer Engagement**

* Finalize doctors engagement plan for a Quarter.
* Conduct programs as per plan and steer all related logistics and coordination.
* Plan, develop, and implement effective communication (e.g. presentations) in a variety of settings.
* Identify speakers and audience for conducting programs, work with various departments to ensure timely documentation and certification of the speaker.
* Invite doctors for Marketing led programs.
* Conduct Retailer Awareness Programs.
* Conduct Nurses awareness programs to upgrade the knowledge of paramedic staff.
* Conduct programs as per compliance guidelines.
* Performance Metrics: Informal/formal feedback from stakeholders on quality of programs; Adherence to compliance requirements; Program attendance as per target.

**Stockist Management**

* Engage with stockists regularly to strengthen relationship.
* Gather information to analyze sales trends every week.
* Conduct physical stock verification at the Stockist.
* Maintain a balance between first line and second line sales as per the company guidelines.
* Participate in ensuring availability at various retailers like placing and collecting orders.
* Coordinate between Stockist and CFA at the time of closing.
* Identify new stockists and propose to ASM.
* Performance Metrics: Inventory plan v/s achievement.

**Sales and SPP Reporting**

* Timely reporting of all the doctor and retailer calls.
* Report details of programs conducted.
* Report any medical services request received from doctors through on-demand.
* Present sales trends in monthly reviews.
* Performance Metrics: Regular and accurate reporting.

*At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients.*
*It is how we work.*
*We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work.*
*This is not just a policy.*
*It is who we are.*

title: Territory Business Manager
description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait**
.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Business Manger” to drive sales of pharmaceutical products in your assigned territory. You will gather market intelligence, conduct prescription audits, and implement sales strategies to achieve sales targets. Additionally, you will manage queries from doctors, maintain customer relationships, and ensure accurate territory data management.
  
  
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
  
• You will be responsible for understanding market trends and competition status by gathering information from stockists and chemists and relaying this data to the Sales Business Manager (SBM) or Regional Sales Manager (RSM).
  
  
• You will be responsible for conducting Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) on doctors in the assigned area to identify potential high-prescribers and providing the final list of doctors likely to prescribe large quantities to the SBM/RSM for sales forecasting purposes.
  
  
• You will be responsible for attending relevant training programs and staying updated on product literature.
  
  
• You will be responsible for obtaining sales targets and promotion budget details from SBM/RSM.
  
  
• You will be responsible for utilizing the allocated budget to plan launch activities for different doctors, camps, or Continuing Medical Education (CME) sessions in the assigned area.
  
  
• You will be responsible for conducting regular sales pitches and presentations with doctors to promote products.
  
  
• You will be responsible for submitting reimbursement bills to SBM/RSM.
  
  
• You will be responsible for implementing marketing plans provided by the Product Manager.
  
  
• You will be responsible for gathering Point of Business (POB) details from chemists and coordinating with stockists to ensure product delivery.
  
  
• You will be responsible for monitoring and tracking sales of new products with chemists to achieve sales targets.
  
  
• You will be responsible for collecting queries from doctors regarding both new and existing products.
  
  
• You will be responsible for entering queries into the system for review by the Infogini team.
  
  
• You will be responsible for utilizing email responses from Infogini to address doctors' queries and increase prescriptions per doctor.
  
  
• You will be responsible for maintaining regular interactions with doctors to understand their prescription trends.
  
  
• You will be responsible for communicating prescription trend data to SBM/RSM.
  
  
• You will be responsible for keeping track of specific customer needs and providing feedback to Area Sales Manager (ASM), SBM/RSM, or Head Office (HO).
  
  
• You will be responsible for preparing lists of doctors for all CME events and submitting them to SBM/RSM to foster strong relationships and loyalty among doctors.
  
  
• You will be responsible for maintaining and updating data on doctor lists, route maps, retailers, and other supply chain contacts in the internal database.
  
  
• You will be responsible for ensuring accurate management of sales activities to optimize sales volume and effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification-**
Graduate with science background.
  
  
**Minimum work experience-**
3-5 years of experience in pharmaceutical sales.
  
  
  
  
**Skills & attributes
  
  
Technical Skills**
  
• Deep understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing.
  
  
• Understanding of key trends in Pharmaceutical Sales.
  
  
• Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.

AdmitKard is a Noida-based ed-tech platform supporting students who seek admission to universities and colleges abroad in countries such as the US, UK, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and Singapore. The platform guides students through their entire journey, including test preparation, profile building, admissions, education loans, and student visas. AdmitKard focuses on simplifying complex processes and providing structured, data-driven guidance for international education. The organization is committed to helping students not only gain admission but also successfully complete their academic programs. Team members collaborate in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that centers on student success and global opportunities.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time remote role for a Business Development Manager – Education Loan. The role involves building and managing partnerships with financial institutions and lending partners to expand education loan offerings for students. The person in this role will identify and pursue new business opportunities, negotiate commercial terms, and develop strategic initiatives to drive loan approvals and disbursements. Daily responsibilities include engaging with internal teams (admissions, counseling, product, and marketing), optimizing loan processes, tracking performance metrics, and ensuring a smooth experience for students applying for loans. The Business Development Manager will also analyze market trends in education finance, contribute to product and process improvements, and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to support AdmitKard’s growth in the education loan segment.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Demonstrated experience in business development, partnership management, or sales within financial services, education loans, or related domains.
* Strong skills in relationship building, stakeholder management, and negotiation to create and maintain productive partnerships.
* Capability to analyze data, understand market trends, and use insights to improve processes and drive growth.
* Solid communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain loan products and processes clearly to diverse audiences.
* Comfort working in a technology-driven, high-growth environment, with the ability to collaborate effectively across remote and cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant certification in finance or business is an advantage.
* Prior exposure to ed-tech, overseas education consulting, banking, NBFCs, or education financing is highly beneficial.
* Proactive, organized, and goal-oriented mindset, with a commitment to ethical, inclusive, and student-centric practices.

title: Field Sales Manager

Full-Time | Field Sales

About Fodxpert
  

Fodxpert is an innovative restaurant-focused digital advertising platform that installs TV screens inside restaurants, enabling brands and restaurants to promote their offerings through engaging digital content.

We are looking for an experienced and result-driven
**Restaurant Onboarding & Sales Manager**

* Acquire restaurant chains, standalone restaurants, premium dining outlets, cafés, and hospitality groups.
* Develop strategic partnerships to expand Fodxpert's restaurant network across Mumbai.

* Maintain a strong sales pipeline and consistently achieve monthly restaurant acquisition targets.

* 3–6 years of experience in restaurant acquisition, F&B partnerships, hospitality sales, or business development.

Compensation

Competitive fixed salary + performance-based incentives linked to successful restaurant onboarding.

**Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with details of their previous restaurant acquisition experience.**

title: Domain Pre Sales AP
description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)**
is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Business Partner in our Domain Risk Pre-Sales unit, you'll identify and cultivate new opportunities related to credit and fraud risk, combining deep business knowledge across both domains with a consultative, solutions-based approach to selling. This role focuses on building new revenue streams through the expansion of FICO Platform capabilities, working closely with the Asia Pacific sales team to translate client business challenges into compelling and credible solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Contribute**

* Partner with clients on discovery and scoping sessions to uncover business challenges and growth opportunities, then develop proposals and business cases that demonstrate value.
* Contribute to client account plans and lead deal structuring and negotiations, working with internal teams to shape and position solutions that protect existing business and win new deals.
* Contribute to go-to-market strategy and market sizing, tracking industry trends and maintaining a strong grasp of our products and the competitive landscape.
* Support innovation workshops, quarterly business reviews, and PoC/PoV engagements, acting as a credit and fraud risk subject matter expert for financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications clients.
* Apply your knowledge of the risk management lifecycle, including originations, customer management, fraud, collections, and digital transformation, to build platform demos with Key Account Managers, Solution Sales Executives, and Platform Presales teams.
* Develop strategic plans, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations, tailoring content for audiences ranging from technical teams to C-level executives.
* Build FICO Platform brand awareness and thought leadership through social media, case studies, blogs, white papers, webinars, and event presentations.
* Up to 50% travel across the region.

**What We’re Seeking**

* Exceptional executive-level communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage C-suite stakeholders, boards, and senior leadership, translating complex business insights and technical detail into business impact, ROI, and actionable strategy across strategic planning documents, proposals, and business cases.
* Experience in credit and/or fraud risk management, with a proven track record of achieving meaningful loss reduction and/or customer experience improvements, complemented by sales experience as a vendor and demonstrated project leadership and results orientation.
* Comprehensive understanding of the risk management lifecycle across the entire customer journey, with senior-level expertise across multiple credit and fraud risk domains including originations, transactional/payment fraud, online/mobile banking fraud, application fraud, first party fraud, customer management, and collections.
* Extensive experience working with payment processors, payment gateways, payment networks, issuers, and acquirers, including authorization flows, real-time decisioning, and processor, gateway, and network-specific operating models.
* End-user knowledge of credit and fraud risk management solutions, authorization systems, authentication solutions, loan origination systems, and other decision management platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, data science, or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.

**Our Offer to You**

* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
  
  
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  
  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
  
  
Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
  
  
FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy

title: R29829 Business Development Manager - Mumbai
description:
**Job Purpose**

The Business Development Manager will drive High revenue growth, market share, and brand visibility within the assigned territory. This role owns the end-to-end B2B commercial cycle—combining primary sales and strict collection management with localized marketing activations to generate secondary demand for channel partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales & Commercial Management (Primary Function)**

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets through structured B2B distribution networks.
* Ensure 100% timely collection of outstanding payments to maintain a healthy credit cycle.
* Manage high-value accounts, clinical chains, and individual retail audiologists.
* Monitor territory commercial health, analyzing sales data to identify growth white spaces.

**2. Channel Partner Management & Expansion**

* Build, nurture, and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing B2B channel partners.
* Onboard new channel partners, audiometry clinics, and ENT hospital setups to expand market footprint.
* Implement structured partner engagement programs to ensure high brand-share-of-wallet.

**3. Marketing & Secondary Demand Generation**

* Design and execute ground-level B2B2C marketing activations to drive footfall for channel partners.
* Plan and organize localized community touchpoints, including residential society screening camps.
* Network with premium social clubs (e.g., Rotary Club, Lions Club) to set up corporate/social awareness programs.
* Track the ROI of field marketing investments and measure camp-to-clinic lead conversion rates.

**4. Territory & Competitive Intelligence**

* Map the complete geographic territory to track competitor pricing, schemes, and product positioning.
* Supply regular market intelligence reports to national marketing and product development teams.
* Utilize CRM systems to track pipelines, manage client interactions, and forecast sales accurately.
* Identify and develop new business opportunity across assigned territories

**Preferred candidate profile**

* Direct experience in the hearing aid industry, or transferable B2B network management experience from high-turnover industries like Paint, Tyres, or Telecom

* Experience: 8-10 Years in B2B channel sales, dealer management

* Location: Navi Mumbai

**About us:**

Headquartered in Denmark, GN Hearing is among the leading manufacturers of hearing aids in the world. The company offers a full range of instruments and accessories under several brands. The company has subsidiaries in more than 25 countries and distributors in 80 more. Driven by technological innovations and commercial excellence, GN Hearing has been the growing faster than the industry for the last many years.

In India, the hearing aid industry at wholesale prices is approximately INR 750 crores annually. Private retail consumption accounts for over 85% of the hearing aid market in revenue terms with the balance coming from government tenders. The market is growing @10~12% p.a. and likely to grow at these rates for the next decade due to very favorable demographics viz.

* 90% of hearing aid users are in the 50+ age group.
* They are living longer due to healthier lifestyles.
* Leading a more active retired life and would like to enjoy life with friends and family.
* Have the money to fund hearing aids.

In the hearing-impaired population, the hearing aid penetration level is only 2%. In developed countries the penetration is in the 20~40% levels.

In India, GN is headquartered in Navi Mumbai. In 2023, GN posted revenues of INR 131 cr (USD 16 mln). GN has been the fastest growing company since 2012 growing revenues @ 18% CAGR. GN is now the 2nd largest company in the lucrative retail market with a 20% market share, up from 5% market share in 2011. GN is the most profitable company in the industry with the highest % EBITA margin. Leadership in technology, a clear India strategy and strong execution have been the drivers of this performance.

Given the strong momentum, GN has an opportunity to drive growth higher than the current already high rate. GN has put in place aggressive plans for the 2023~2025 strategy period. The strategy involves executing on multiple key sales initiatives in parallel with speed and accuracy. GN operates through a direct dealer network of about 700 customers. The larger key customers account for a disproportionate share of the industry potential and consequently GNs business.

Hearing aids are dispensed as a medical device and the dealer (dispenser) makes the brand choice. Among other things, fast, accurate and at times customized service solutions to these larger customers are important to succeed with them. The customized solutions tend to put a strain on operations increasing complexity. The relatively small size of the business is deceptive when compared to the complexity of the challenges involved.

Hello, we’re L’Oréal, We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it). Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**

For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.

description:

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Channel Sales Manager is responsible for driving growth and market share in the Commercial Channel and SMB segments by expanding partner engagement, maximizing AMD sell-out, and strengthening AMD’s presence in key accounts and market verticals. Acting as the primary liaison between AMD and its partner ecosystem, this role ensures alignment on business objectives and execution excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Channel Strategy & Execution: Develop and implement channel sales strategies to maximize revenue, market share, and partner engagement.
* Partner Acquisition & Development: Identify, recruit, onboard, and develop new channel partners to support business growth and strategic objectives.
* Relationship Management: Manage and nurture relationships with existing channel partners through consistent communication, support, and engagement initiatives.
* Pipeline Management: Build a stronger and more predictable sales pipeline by deepening engagement with top channel partners across the region.
* OEM Collaboration: Strengthen relationships with OEMs and develop joint business plans with key partners to accelerate mutual growth.
* Partner Enablement: Enhance partner relationship depth, focusing on sales and presales teams to improve pipeline creation and deal conversion.
