If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing Lakebase opportunities within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.
* Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.
* Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.
* Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.
* Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.
* Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.
* Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.
* Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.
* Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role
  
  
This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:
  
  

* Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.
* Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.
  
  
**Success In This Role Requires Strength In Four Areas**

* Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.
* Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.

AIRIQ 365 LIMITED

Hotel Business

Full-time

Head – Hotel Business

Regular travel for partner meetings and business development

**Role Overview**

The Sales Manager – API Distribution & Relationship Management will drive AIRIQ’s hotel business by acquiring, activating and managing B2B API distribution partners, including OTAs, travel platforms, travel management companies, bed banks and other travel intermediaries.

The role involves expanding the distribution of AIRIQ’s pre-purchased and directly contracted hotel inventory, generating profitable sales and developing long-term partner relationships. The selected candidate will work closely with Technology, Distribution, Procurement, Revenue, Operations and Finance to ensure successful onboarding, consistent booking production and account growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partner Acquisition and Business Development**

* Identify and acquire partners for the distribution of AIRIQ’s hotel inventory through APIs.
* Build and maintain a sales pipeline across relevant domestic and international markets.
* Present AIRIQ’s hotel portfolio, destination coverage, inventory availability and commercial advantages.
* Understand prospective partners’ requirements and propose suitable commercial arrangements.
* Negotiate pricing structures, payment terms and business commitments within approved guidelines.
* Coordinate agreements, documentation and internal approvals.

**2. API Onboarding and Partner Activation**

* Manage the commercial onboarding process from agreement signing through integration, testing and go-live.
* Coordinate with partner and internal technical teams on API access, hotel mapping, inventory availability and booking requirements.
* Track onboarding milestones and resolve business dependencies to support timely activation.
* Ensure relevant hotels and destinations are enabled on partner platforms.
* Drive initial bookings and develop newly integrated partners into consistently productive accounts.

**3. Relationship and Account Management**

* Act as the primary commercial contact for assigned API distribution partners.
* Develop relationships with partner leadership, sourcing, sales, revenue, product and technical teams.
* Understand each partner’s customer segments, destination demand, booking patterns and growth opportunities.
* Prepare account plans covering sales targets, inventory promotion and business expansion.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and agree on actions to improve production.
* Coordinate the resolution of commercial, booking and service escalations.

**4. Sales Growth and Inventory Distribution**

* Achieve agreed targets for room nights, revenue, contribution and productive accounts.
* Promote AIRIQ’s pre-purchased and directly contracted hotel inventory across partner networks.
* Increase sales of priority hotels, destinations and travel periods.
* Work with Revenue on partner-specific pricing, mark-ups, offers and promotional campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to increase wallet share and reactivate low-producing accounts.
* Share partner demand and hotel sourcing requirements with Procurement.

**5. Distribution Performance and Market Intelligence**

* Monitor partner searches, bookings, conversion, cancellations and hotel-level production.
* Coordinate action on rate competitiveness, availability, mapping errors and booking issues affecting sales.
* Review search-to-book performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion.
* Track competitor offerings, partner feedback and emerging market demand.
* Recommend improvements to AIRIQ’s hotel portfolio and distribution proposition.

**6. Credit, Collections and Reporting**

* Coordinate partner credit limits, payment schedules and collections with Finance.
* Monitor outstanding balances and escalate overdue payments or credit concerns.
* Ensure commercial commitments remain within approved policies and authority limits.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales pipelines, account plans and business forecasts.
* Submit regular reports on partner acquisition, activation, production and account performance.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in travel, hospitality or business management is preferred.
* **6–8 years of experience**
  in B2B hotel sales, API distribution, bed-bank sales or travel account management.
* Established relationships with hotel API buyers, OTAs, travel platforms, travel management companies or other relevant distribution partners.
* Proven ability to acquire new accounts and grow existing partner business.
* Working understanding of hotel APIs, hotel mapping, room and rate plans, booking flows and distribution commercials.
* Experience coordinating API partner onboarding with technical teams.
* Understanding of hotel pricing, margins, credit exposure and commercial negotiations.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, CRM systems and sales reporting.
* Candidates should be based in, or willing to relocate to,
  **Mumbai or Bengaluru**
  , depending on the position.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New API distribution partners acquired.
* Partners integrated, activated and generating bookings.
* Time from agreement signing to go-live and first booking.
* Room nights, revenue and contribution from assigned accounts.
* Sales of priority pre-purchased and directly contracted inventory.
* Growth, retention and wallet share of existing partners.
* Improvement in partner conversion and productive hotel coverage.
* Timely collections and adherence to approved credit terms.
* Accuracy of sales forecasts and account reporting.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Business Development Manager – International Wholesale VoiceAbout the Company

AI Mobile Network LLC is a USA-based global telecommunication and CPaaS provider delivering international communication solutions to telecom operators, carriers, wholesale voice providers, and enterprise clients worldwide.

Our mission is to provide high-quality, reliable, and cost-effective communication services with exceptional customer support. As part of our global expansion, we are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Business Development Manager to expand our international wholesale voice business.

Role Summary

We are seeking a
**Business Development Manager – International Wholesale Voice**
to lead business development initiatives, expand our global carrier network, acquire strategic customers, and drive sustainable revenue and profitability in the international wholesale voice market.

The role involves identifying new markets, developing relationships with international telecom operators and voice carriers, negotiating commercial agreements, growing voice traffic, and building long-term business partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

·       Develop and execute business development strategies to expand the international wholesale voice business.

·       Identify new markets, destinations, customers, and strategic opportunities for voice origination and termination services.

·       Acquire and develop relationships with international telecom operators, Tier 1 and Tier 2 carriers, voice aggregators, wholesalers, and VoIP service providers.

·       Build and maintain a strong network of international voice partners to expand coverage, improve routing options, and strengthen commercial competitiveness.

·       Drive customer acquisition, account expansion, revenue growth, and profitability across assigned international markets.

·       Negotiate wholesale voice rates, commercial terms, payment conditions, credit limits, and interconnection agreements within approved business guidelines.

·       Develop competitive pricing strategies in coordination with routing, commercial, and management teams.

·       Work closely with technical, NOC, routing, and operations teams to ensure service quality, route availability, and customer satisfaction.

·       Monitor international voice traffic performance, including ASR, ACD, PDD, call completion rates, and other relevant quality indicators, in coordination with technical teams.

·       Identify opportunities to improve gross margins through competitive sourcing, efficient routing, and effective commercial negotiations.

·       Manage key customer and carrier relationships, resolve commercial escalations, and identify opportunities for long-term account growth.

·       Analyse market trends, destination pricing, competitor activities, traffic demand, and emerging business opportunities.

·       Prepare business proposals, commercial presentations, forecasts, and periodic performance reports for management.

·       Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline, establish business priorities, and track progress against revenue and profitability targets.

·       Coordinate with finance and operations teams on customer onboarding, credit approvals, payment follow-ups, and outstanding receivables.

·       Represent the company at international telecom conferences, industry events, and business meetings as required.

·       Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual business development, revenue, and gross profit targets.

Qualifications & Skills

·       Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Telecommunications, IT, or a related field.

·       
**3–5 years of experience**
in business development, international wholesale voice, telecommunications, VoIP, or carrier sales.

·       Strong understanding of the international wholesale voice market, including voice termination, origination, carrier interconnections, and voice traffic trading.

·       Proven experience in acquiring customers, developing carrier relationships, negotiating commercial agreements, and growing revenue.

·       Good understanding of international voice pricing, destination rates, routing concepts, and profit margin management.

·       Familiarity with voice quality metrics such as ASR (Answer-Seizure Ratio), ACD (Average Call Duration), and PDD (Post-Dial Delay).

·       Knowledge of SIP, VoIP, SIP trunking, and international voice interconnection is preferred.

·       Strong commercial negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship management skills.

·       Ability to identify business opportunities, develop market strategies, and convert prospects into active customers.

·       Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on revenue growth and profitability.

·       Ability to manage multiple customers, commercial discussions, and business opportunities simultaneously.

·       Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with CRM systems.

·       Ability to work with international customers and partners across different time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

·       Established relationships with international telecom operators, Tier 1/Tier 2 carriers, wholesale voice providers, or VoIP aggregators.

·       Experience managing high-volume international voice traffic and commercial carrier accounts.

·       Exposure to Least Cost Routing (LCR), route quality management, rate negotiations, and margin optimization.

·       Experience managing customer credit exposure, payment terms, and commercial risk.

·       Demonstrated ability to open new markets, establish strategic partnerships, and deliver consistent revenue growth.

What We Offer

·       Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

·       Opportunity to build and expand an international wholesale voice business.

·       Exposure to global telecom operators, carriers, and voice service providers.

·       Career growth within the international telecommunications and CPaaS industry.

·       Opportunity to take ownership of business development initiatives and commercial strategy.

·       Dynamic and collaborative work environment.

Key Success Metrics

·       Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.

·       Gross profit and profit margin growth.

·       New customer acquisition and activation of commercial traffic.

·       Growth in active carrier relationships and international voice destinations.

·       International voice traffic volume and account expansion.

·       Customer retention and strategic partnership development.

·       Competitive route sourcing and commercial rate optimization.

·       Sales pipeline growth and conversion rates.

·       Payment collection performance and management of customer credit exposure.

·       Overall contribution to sustainable business growth and profitability.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
**About Glean**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
  
  
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
  
  
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
  
  
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Strategic Account Executive at Glean, you will drive new business and growth within our largest enterprise prospects by developing tailored strategies to break into and expand major accounts. This role demands sophisticated account research, executive-level messaging, and champion-building to deliver on customer pain points and priority business outcomes. You will have the opportunity to build a territory in the India region and play a key role in shaping Glean’s presence among industry-leading organizations and advancing our mission to transform work with AI.
  
  
**You Will**

* Source and close net new logos within a given territory
* Have the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and identify executive sponsors and champions
* Research and understand the business objectives of your customers and have the ability to perform a value drive sales cycle
* Collaborate with internal partners to move deals forward and ensure customer success
* You will consistently deliver ARR revenue targets and drive success through a metric based approach
* Develop and execute sales strategies and tactics to generate pipeline, drive sales opportunities and deliver repeatable and predictable bookings
* Provide timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions
* Create ROI and business justification reports based off of a data driven approach
* Run tight POCs based off of business success criteria

**About You**

* 10+ years of closing experience in Sales with a track record of being a top performer
* Ability to learn, pitch and demonstrate a highly technical product and have the ability to adapt in a fast growing and changing environment
* Have clear examples of closing complex deals and selling into complex organizations
* Effectively use a repeatable method for uncovering greenfield opportunities and building out a new territory
* Previous experience building relationships and selling face to face to C level executives
* Knowledge of best of breed softwares and a technical understanding of integrations, APIs, infrastructure management, security and analytics
* Experience selling technical SaaS and cloud based software solutions
* Basic understanding of search infrastructure is a plus
* You have previous experience working with multiple teammates including SEs, BDRs, PMs, Executives & Engineers
* Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and using MEDDIC and Challenger (or similar) methodologies is a plus

**Location:**

* This role is remote (must be based in Mumbai)

**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
  
  
**AI-First Mindset At Glean**
At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work.
**As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.**
Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.
  
  
**Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants**
Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. title: Senior Cloud Services Sales Specialist
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Title:**
Senior Cloud Services Sales Specialist
  
  
**Locations:**
Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Mumbai
  
  
**About the Role:**
NTT DATA is a strategic technology services and solutions partner of AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, helping enterprises modernize their technology environments and accelerate cloud, data and AI transformation.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Specialist Sales professional to drive cloud-led business development and Sales across NTT DATA’s enterprise client base. The role will operate within NTT DATA India working horizontally across Client Management, Business Units, hyperscaler alliance teams, solutioning/presales and delivery organizations.
  
  
The Cloud Specialist Seller will act as a cloud subject-matter sales leader and opportunity orchestrator, identifying and creating cloud transformation opportunities, shaping customer conversations, developing qualified pipelines and bringing the right NTT DATA and hyperscaler capabilities together to progress opportunities through to closure.
  
  
The role requires someone who can operate effectively across organizational boundaries, influence without direct authority, engage senior customer stakeholders and translate cloud technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Cloud Business Development & Pipeline Creation
* Develop and execute cloud sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities across cloud migration, modernization, application

transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud-native development, managed cloud services and cloud optimization.
  
  

* Proactively create demand rather than relying solely on existing account pipeline.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified cloud opportunities and achieve agreed sales/revenue targets.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing NTT DATA relationships through cloud-led transformation initiatives.
* Develop account-level cloud whitespace maps covering AWS, Azure and GCP

opportunities.
  
  

* Client Engagement & Consultative Selling
* Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business leaders and technology decision-makers to understand transformation priorities.
* Lead executive-level conversations around the business value of cloud, rather than selling individual cloud products.
* Understand customer technology landscapes, transformation roadmaps, business drivers and pain points.
* Position NTT DATA’s capabilities together with hyperscaler technology to develop differentiated customer propositions.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and establish NTT DATA as a strategic cloud transformation partner.
* Matrix / Client Manager Collaboration

As a horizontal specialist organisation, the role will work closely with Client Managers and BU sales teams across NTT DATA.
  
  
**Key responsibilities include:**

* Partner with Client Managers to identify and qualify cloud opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Work across multiple BUs to leverage existing customer relationships and industry expertise.
* Establish joint account plans with Client Managers and BU leadership.
* Support Client Managers with cloud-specific opportunity identification, qualification and strategy.
* Bring specialist cloud expertise into broader account planning and customer

engagements.
  
  

* Maintain clear ownership and engagement models with Client Managers to avoid channel conflict and ensure a coordinated customer experience.
* Influence stakeholders across the matrix without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Hyperscaler Alliance Engagement
* Develop strong working relationships with AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud sales and technical teams.
* Create joint account strategies and opportunity plans with hyperscaler sellers.
* Leverage hyperscaler funding, migration programs, assessments, workshops, incentives and partner programs to accelerate opportunities.
* Coordinate joint customer engagements involving NTT DATA and hyperscaler teams.
* Build differentiated propositions leveraging NTT DATA’s services capabilities and hyperscaler platforms.
* Track hyperscaler ecosystem developments and translate relevant capabilities into customer opportunities.
* Opportunity Shaping & Sales Leadership
* Lead the commercial sales strategy for qualified cloud opportunities.
* Develop opportunity plans covering customer business problem, solution proposition, stakeholders, competition, commercial model and path to closure.
* Coordinate with solution architects, presales, delivery, commercial and legal teams.
* Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified before significant presales investment.
* Lead proposal strategy, customer presentations, workshops and executive engagements.
* Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasting and opportunity reporting.
* Drive opportunities from initial qualification → solution shaping → proposal →negotiation → closure.
* Cloud Solution & Commercial Understanding

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly with customers and technical stakeholders across:
  
  

* Cloud migration and modernization
* IaaS / PaaS / SaaS
* Cloud-native architectures
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Data platforms and analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI workloads
* Cloud security
* Networking and hybrid cloud
* DevOps / DevSecOps
* FinOps and cloud optimization
* Managed cloud services

The role is not expected to be the primary technical architect, but must be able to understand customer requirements, challenge solution assumptions and connect technical capabilities to business outcomes.
  
  

* Internal Orchestration

The specialist seller will act as the single-threaded sales orchestrator for cloud opportunities, bringing together:
  
  
Client Manager → BU → Cloud Specialist → Presales/Solution Architecture → Delivery →Hyperscaler → Commercial/Finance
  
  
**Responsibilities include:**

* Establishing the right internal team for each opportunity.
* Creating clear roles, responsibilities and next steps.
* Driving opportunity cadence and governance.
* Removing internal blockers.
* Ensuring commercial, solution and delivery stakeholders remain aligned.
* Maintaining momentum from opportunity creation through closure.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8–10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably including significant cloud sales experience.
* Proven experience selling AWS, Azure and/or GCP solutions/services.
* Experience in a Systems Integrator, IT Services company, hyperscaler or technology consulting organisation preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working in a matrixed organisation is highly desirable.
* Experience selling through or alongside hyperscaler partner ecosystems preferred.
* Technical & Business Skills

**Strong understanding of:**

* AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
* Cloud transformation and modernization
* Data & AI workloads
* Cloud economics and business cases
* Enterprise architecture concepts
* Managed services
* Cloud security
* Digital transformation
* Sales Competencies
* Consultative / value-based selling
* Enterprise account planning
* Opportunity qualification
* Pipeline generation
* Executive stakeholder management

description:

Full-Time

minimum 3 Years

**Industry:**
Automotive Accessories / PPF / FMCG / Consumer Durables / Distribution

About Scratchgard Technology

Scratchgard Technology is an expanding automotive protection solutions company specialising in Paint Protection Film (PPF), advanced pre-cut technology and automotive surface protection products.

As we expand our aftermarket business across India, we are building a professionally managed national sales and dealer distribution network.

We are looking for a
**highly organised, analytical and process-driven Sales Operations & MIS Coordinator**
to establish and manage the reporting, monitoring and operational control systems supporting our national sales team.

Key Responsibilities

**1. National Sales Monitoring & Reporting**

* Monitor daily, weekly and monthly performance of approximately 20 territory sales managers across India.
* Develop and maintain national sales dashboards, MIS reports and performance scorecards.
* Track sales targets, achievements, dealer onboarding, revenue and territory-wise performance.
* Prepare consolidated management reports for the National Sales Head and Managing Director.
* Highlight performance gaps, overdue activities and areas requiring management attention.

**2. CRM & Sales Process Management**

* Manage and maintain the company's CRM and sales reporting systems.
* Ensure all territory managers update customer visits, dealer enquiries, sales pipelines and follow-up activities.
* Monitor compliance with established sales processes, reporting deadlines and company policies.
* Maintain accurate dealer databases, sales records and territory-wise information.
* Identify reporting discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.

**3. Dealer Network Development Monitoring**

* Track the expansion of our national aftermarket dealer network.
* Monitor dealer onboarding, activation, training and commercial performance.
* Maintain dealer-wise records of sales, orders and business development activities.
* Track dealer engagement, repeat orders and inactive dealerships.
* Coordinate with territory managers to ensure timely completion of dealer activation activities.

**4. Sales Team Coordination & Accountability**

* Coordinate daily with territory sales managers to ensure reporting compliance.
* Track assigned tasks, pending actions and management instructions.
* Organise weekly sales review meetings and maintain action trackers.
* Follow up on commitments made by territory managers and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate delays, non-compliance and unresolved operational issues to management.

**5. Management Dashboards & Performance Analysis**

* Develop structured daily, weekly and monthly MIS formats.
* Analyse sales trends, territory productivity and dealer conversion performance.
* Prepare performance comparisons against targets.
* Identify underperforming territories and highlight opportunities for improvement.
* Provide management with reliable information for business planning and decision-making.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Management or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Coordination, MIS or CRM Management.
* **Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets is essential.**
* Experience working with CRM platforms such as Zoho CRM, Salesforce or similar systems.
* Experience developing dashboards using Power BI, Looker Studio or similar tools will be an advantage.
* Strong analytical, reporting and data management capabilities.
* Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to follow up with multiple sales managers across different geographical locations.
* Experience supporting national sales teams or dealer/distributor networks is preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

✔ Highly systematic, disciplined and detail-oriented.

✔ Confident in following up with senior sales professionals.

✔ Strong in Excel, CRM, reporting and performance analysis.

✔ Proactive in identifying problems rather than simply reporting numbers.

✔ Capable of implementing and enforcing reporting procedures.

✔ Comfortable working directly with senior management.

✔ Focused on accountability, efficiency and continuous improvement.

Why Join Scratchgard?

This is an opportunity to play an important role in developing the operational backbone of a rapidly expanding national automotive aftermarket business.

The successful candidate will work closely with the National Sales Head and senior management, helping establish professional sales systems, reporting structures and performance monitoring processes across India.

**Our objective is to build a technology-enabled, data-driven and professionally managed national sales organisation.**

description:

* Support onboarding, training, and knowledge sharing within the team.

* 3–4 years of experience in business reporting, analytics, and visualization in consumer-packaged goods or a related industry.
* Proficiency in SQL, Tableau, advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and data environments such as GCP.
* Experience using data to influence decision making and deliver business recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Cloud Sales Specialist
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a strategic technology services and solutions partner of AWS, Microsoft Azure and
  
  
Google Cloud, helping enterprises modernize their technology environments and accelerate
  
  
cloud, data and AI transformation.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Specialist Sales professional to drive cloud-led
  
  
business development and Sales across NTT DATA’s enterprise client base. The role will operate
  
  
within NTT DATA India working horizontally across Client Management, Business Units,
  
  
hyperscaler alliance teams, solutioning/presales and delivery organisations.
  
  
The Cloud Specialist Seller will act as a cloud subject-matter sales leader and opportunity
  
  
orchestrator, identifying and creating cloud transformation opportunities, shaping customer
  
  
conversations, developing qualified pipelines and bringing the right NTT DATA and hyperscaler
  
  
capabilities together to progress opportunities through to closure.
  
  
The role requires someone who can operate effectively across organisational boundaries,
  
  
influence without direct authority, engage senior customer stakeholders and translate cloud
  
  
technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cloud Business Development & Pipeline Creation
* Develop and execute cloud sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities across cloud migration, modernization, application transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud-native development, managed cloud services and cloud optimization.
* Proactively create demand rather than relying solely on existing account pipeline.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified cloud opportunities and achieve agreed

sales/revenue targets.
  
  

* Identify opportunities to expand existing NTT DATA relationships through cloud-led transformation initiatives.
* Develop account-level cloud whitespace maps covering AWS, Azure and GCP opportunities.
* Client Engagement & Consultative Selling
* Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business leaders and technology decision-makers to understand transformation priorities.
* Lead executive-level conversations around the business value of cloud, rather than selling individual cloud products.
* Understand customer technology landscapes, transformation roadmaps, business drivers and pain points.
* Position NTT DATA’s capabilities together with hyperscaler technology to develop differentiated customer propositions.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and establish NTT DATA as a strategic cloud transformation partner
* Matrix / Client Manager Collaboration

As a horizontal specialist organisation, the role will work closely with Client Managers and BU sales teams across NTT DATA.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Partner with Client Managers to identify and qualify cloud opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Work across multiple BUs to leverage existing customer relationships and industry expertise.
* Establish joint account plans with Client Managers and BU leadership.
* Support Client Managers with cloud-specific opportunity identification, qualification and

strategy.
  
  

* Bring specialist cloud expertise into broader account planning and customer engagements.
* Maintain clear ownership and engagement models with Client Managers to avoid channel conflict and ensure a coordinated customer experience.
* Influence stakeholders across the matrix without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Hyperscaler Alliance Engagement
* Develop strong working relationships with AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud sales and technical teams.
* Create joint account strategies and opportunity plans with hyperscaler sellers.
* Leverage hyperscaler funding, migration programs, assessments, workshops, incentives

and partner programs to accelerate opportunities.
  
  

* Coordinate joint customer engagements involving NTT DATA and hyperscaler teams.
* Build differentiated propositions leveraging NTT DATA’s services capabilities and

hyperscaler platforms.
  
  

* Track hyperscaler ecosystem developments and translate relevant capabilities into customer opportunities.
* Opportunity Shaping & Sales Leadership
* Lead the commercial sales strategy for qualified cloud opportunities.
* Develop opportunity plans covering customer business problem, solution proposition,

stakeholders, competition, commercial model and path to closure.
  
  

* Coordinate with solution architects, presales, delivery, commercial and legal teams.
* Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified before significant presales investment.
* Lead proposal strategy, customer presentations, workshops and executive engagements.
* Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasting and opportunity reporting.
* Drive opportunities from initial qualification → solution shaping → proposal →

negotiation → closure.
  
  
C. Cloud Solution & Commercial Understanding
  
  
The successful candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly with customers and technical stakeholders across:
  
  

* Cloud migration and modernization
* IaaS / PaaS / SaaS
* Cloud-native architectures
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Data platforms and analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI workloads
* Cloud security
* Networking and hybrid cloud
* DevOps / DevSecOps
* FinOps and cloud optimization
* Managed cloud services

The role is not expected to be the primary technical architect, but must be able to understand customer requirements, challenge solution assumptions and connect technical capabilities to business outcomes.
  
  

* Internal Orchestration

The specialist seller will act as the single-threaded sales orchestrator for cloud opportunities, bringing together:
  
  
Client Manager → BU → Cloud Specialist → Presales/Solution Architecture → Delivery → Hyperscaler → Commercial/Finance
  
  
Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Establishing the right internal team for each opportunity.
* Creating clear roles, responsibilities and next steps.
* Driving opportunity cadence and governance.
* Removing internal blockers.
* Ensuring commercial, solution and delivery stakeholders remain aligned.

Maintaining momentum from opportunity creation through closure.
  
  
Required Qualifications:
  
  

* 8–10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably including significant cloud sales experience.
* Proven experience selling AWS, Azure and/or GCP solutions/services.
* Experience in a Systems Integrator, IT Services company, hyperscaler or technology

consulting organisation preferred.
  
  

* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working in a matrixed organisation is highly desirable.
* Experience selling through or alongside hyperscaler partner ecosystems preferred.

Technical & Business Skills
  
  
Strong understanding of:
  
  

* AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
* Cloud transformation and modernization
* Data & AI workloads
* Cloud economics and business cases
* Enterprise architecture concepts
* Managed services
* Cloud security
* Digital transformation

Sales Competencies
  
  

* Consultative / value-based selling
* Enterprise account planning
* Opportunity qualification
* Pipeline generation
* Executive stakeholder management
* Deal shaping and negotiation
* Partner ecosystem management
* Forecasting
* Cross-functional influence
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**Workplace type:**
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

* Experience managing complex, long-cycle sales opportunities involving multiple stakeholders.

title: Sales Lead, Luxury Villa Project
description:
**Sales Lead, Luxury Villa Project**

**Location:**
Nariman Point, Mumbai, with regular site visits to Khalapur, Raigad

**Experience:**
3–8 years

**About the Company**

Omegarealtech is hiring for Silhara, a luxury villa project of private residences in the Sahyadris, developed by Omega. The company is building a buyer-facing sales process around qualified digital enquiries, responsive communication, informed site visits, and compliant transaction management. The role is based from the company’s Nariman Point office and supports buyer engagement for the Khalapur project. The team works across marketing, sales, legal, and finance to move qualified buyers from initial enquiry through meetings, site visits, token booking, and agreement for sale. Candidates will join a project environment where accurate information, disciplined follow-up, CRM visibility, and buyer trust are central to commercial performance. The company expects sales communication to remain aligned with approved project materials and applicable Maharashtra real estate requirements. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a measurable luxury residential sales funnel while representing a distinctive Sahyadri private-residence project to Mumbai, Pune, Raigad, and wider buyer markets.

**About the Role**

As Sales Lead, you will own the conversion of qualified digital enquiries into office meetings, Khalapur site visits, token bookings, and signed agreements for sale. You will be the primary buyer contact from first response through transaction completion, using WhatsApp, phone, email, meetings, site walkthroughs, CRM discipline, and structured follow-up as your operating levers. Success means responding within two hours during business hours, qualifying buyer intent and fit, building a visible pipeline, and converting serious buyers without compromising accuracy or compliance. You will present approved pricing, unit options, and payment plans, address objections within authorised terms, coordinate site logistics, and partner with marketing, legal, and finance. The role is based at Nariman Point, Mumbai, with Khalapur site visits two to three days each week.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own every inbound enquiry from WhatsApp, social media, and property portals, responding within two business hours and prioritising follow-up by buyer fit, intent, and responsiveness.
* Qualify buyers against budget, timeline, purpose, decision-makers, and purchase readiness, creating clear CRM notes that separate serious opportunities from casual enquiries.
* Convert qualified leads into Nariman Point meetings and Khalapur site visits by coordinating schedules, transport, access, visit plans, and post-visit next steps.
* Present approved pricing, unit options, and payment plans accurately, resolving objections on price, location, timelines, and construction within authorised commercial terms.
* Drive qualified buyers from site visit and token booking through agreement for sale, coordinating dependencies with legal and finance to reduce transaction delays.
* Maintain complete CRM records and submit weekly reporting on leads, qualification, meetings, visits, bookings, and pipeline value for management visibility.
* Feed structured insights to marketing on lead quality, buyer objections, source performance, and conversion patterns so campaigns generate stronger opportunities.
* Protect buyer trust and company compliance by using approved project information, MahaRERA details, and authorised claims while safeguarding personal data under company policy.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Three to eight years of premium or luxury residential sales experience, including a demonstrable record of converting inbound enquiries into meetings, site visits, bookings, and agreements.
* Strong phone, WhatsApp, email, and in-person selling skills, with the judgement to qualify efficiently, negotiate within approved terms, and communicate clearly with high-net-worth buyers.
* Practical CRM capability covering lead activity, qualification notes, follow-up tasks, pipeline stages, weekly reporting, and feedback loops with marketing and management.

**Additional Plus**

* Villa, resort, second-home, or luxury residential sales experience is strongly preferred because the buyer journey involves considered purchases, site visits, and multiple decision-makers.
* Experience working with NRI buyers, home loans, payment-plan structures, and the Mumbai, Pune, Raigad, Khalapur, or Lonavala buyer market is advantageous.
* Hindi or Marathi fluency, a valid MahaRERA agent registration, or a valid driving licence would strengthen effectiveness in this role.

**What You'll Bring**

* A proven record in premium residential sales, with the stamina to work every qualified lead systematically and the commercial judgement to focus time on buyers most likely to progress.
* Strong buyer conversations across phone, WhatsApp, email, and face-to-face meetings, translating needs into relevant unit options and clear next steps without overselling.
* Confidence hosting office meetings and site walkthroughs, coordinating practical details, and following up within 24 hours with accurate summaries, commitments, and decision paths.
* Discipline with CRM systems and reporting, ensuring every active opportunity has current qualification notes, an agreed next action, and a reliable pipeline stage.
* Negotiation ability within approved pricing and payment terms, with sound judgement on when to involve management, legal, or finance rather than making unauthorised commitments.
* Working knowledge of MahaRERA and Maharashtra property transactions, including the importance of approved project information, accurate documentation, and careful handling of buyer data.
* Market familiarity across Mumbai, Pune, Raigad, Khalapur, and the Lonavala belt, plus comfort discussing home loans and structured payment plans.
* English proficiency is required; Hindi or Marathi is strongly preferred. You should be Mumbai-based, willing to visit Khalapur two to three days weekly, and able to obtain MahaRERA registration before joining if needed.

**Why Join Us**

* Own a complete luxury residential sales funnel rather than a narrow activity segment, with direct influence over lead quality, buyer experience, conversion, bookings, and transaction completion.
* Represent a distinctive private-residence project in the Sahyadris while working across marketing, legal, and finance to turn qualified interest into measurable commercial outcomes.
* Work from Nariman Point while engaging directly with buyers and the Khalapur project, combining metropolitan access with an on-site, relationship-led sales cycle.

**What We Offer**

* Full-time Sales Lead opportunity based at Nariman Point, Mumbai, with regular travel to the Khalapur project site.
* Opportunity to own buyer engagement from first digital enquiry through site visit, token booking, and agreement for sale.
* Cross-functional exposure to marketing, legal, and finance within a luxury villa sales environment.

**Inside Sales Executive — Second Homes, Villas and Plots (Vashi office)**

Holistic Group · Vashi, Navi Mumbai · 6 days a week · No site travel

###
**About Us**

At J.C. Fitkneesguy Pvt. Ltd., we specialize in helping individuals overcome chronic knee conditions such as osteoarthritis, ligament injuries, and post-surgical rehabilitation challenges, including ACL and meniscus surgeries.

Our team of experienced sports physiotherapists and strength and conditioning coaches provides personalized online knee rehabilitation programs designed to help clients reduce pain, restore mobility, improve strength, and regain confidence in their daily lives.

We are looking for a motivated and results-driven \*\*Sales Consultant\*\* who can understand clients' concerns, communicate effectively, and successfully sell our online knee rehabilitation programs.

###
**About the Role**

As a Sales Consultant, you will be responsible for interacting with prospective clients seeking solutions for knee pain, sports injuries, and rehabilitation needs.

You will conduct one-on-one sales consultations over Google Meet, understand clients' concerns, explain our knee rehabilitation programs, handle objections, and convert qualified prospects into paying clients.

The role requires strong communication, consultative selling, consistent follow-ups, objection handling, and sales closing skills.

###
**Key Responsibilities**

- Conduct one-on-one sales consultations with prospective clients through Google Meet.

- Understand clients' knee-related concerns, rehabilitation goals, and expectations.

- Present and sell our personalized online knee rehabilitation programs.

- Clearly explain program benefits, structure, and pricing to prospective clients.

- Confidently handle objections related to pricing, trust, program effectiveness, and commitment.

- Convert qualified leads into paying clients through effective sales techniques.

- Be persistent and consistent with follow-ups, ensuring interested prospects are regularly contacted and no potential sales opportunities are missed.

- Follow up with prospects who have not made an immediate purchasing decision and work towards successfully closing them.

- Maintain accurate lead records, sales data, and follow-up details using Google Sheets.

- Manage consultation schedules, appointments, and follow-ups using Google Calendar.

- Learn and adapt to new CRM tools, sales systems, and internal processes.

- Coordinate with the rehabilitation and operations teams to ensure smooth client onboarding.

- Consistently work towards individual and team sales targets.

###

\*\*1. Strong Communication Skills\*\*

- Excellent verbal communication skills in \*\*English and Hindi\*\* are mandatory.

- Ability to communicate confidently, professionally, and empathetically with prospective clients.

- Strong active listening skills to understand client concerns and requirements.

\*\*2. Sales & Objection Handling\*\*

- Strong negotiation, persuasion, and objection-handling skills.

- Ability to manage challenging conversations and address client doubts effectively.

- Confidence in closing sales without being overly aggressive or pushy.

- Persistence in following up with leads, including those who are hesitant, undecided, or require multiple conversations before making a decision.

- Strong ability to build trust, maintain client relationships, and convert follow-ups into successful sales.

- A result-oriented mindset with a strong focus on achieving sales targets.

- Ability to maintain organized lead records, track follow-ups, and manage appointments.

- Comfortable using Google Meet and other digital communication platforms.

- Willingness to quickly learn and adapt to new software, CRM platforms, and company systems.

- Strong work ethic, discipline, accountability, and professionalism.

- Self-motivated, persistent, target-oriented, and committed to achieving results.

- Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and continuously improve.

- Strong team collaboration and time-management skills.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

\*\*5. Industry Knowledge (Preferred)\*\*

- Interest in fitness, rehabilitation, and helping individuals improve their quality of life.

- Candidates with experience in sales, physiotherapy, rehabilitation, fitness consultation, or service-based sales will be preferred.

- \*\*Uncapped Incentives:\*\* No upper limit on commission earnings.

ZoTok.AI is a WhatsApp-native Agentic AI platform that transforms how Brands manage their relationships with Distributors and Retailers — on the channel they already use every day. The General Trade channel moves ₹50 lakh crore of goods every year in India. It runs on relationships, phone calls, and gut feel. ZoTok is the infrastructure layer that brings AI-powered speed, visibility and intelligence to that channel — without asking anyone to change the way they work.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager who has lived the General Trade grind — someone who has walked the market with an ASM or Zonal hat, understands the pain of a missed beat or a stockist claim gone wrong, and can walk into a Supply Chain Head's office and earn credibility in the first five minutes. You will own enterprise pipeline, run consultative sales cycles, and close deals that matter.
  
  
**Why ZoTok is the smartest career move for a seasoned GT Sales Leader**
The AI-for-Sales industry is one of the fastest-growing sectors globally — and ZoTok sits at a rare intersection: cutting-edge AI technology applied to a domain you already know deeply. Your years of managing zones, building distributor relationships and driving secondary sales are not just relevant here — they are your single biggest competitive advantage. You will be selling to people who think like you did, solving problems you have have lived firsthand.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who waits for a brief. We are looking for someone with a go-getter, ownership mindset — someone who can walk into an ambiguous situation, map the client's pain, design a solution on the fly and drive it to closure. If you have ever stood in a market and figured it out with no playbook, you will feel at home here.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end enterprise sales — from prospecting to commercial closure — for brands across FMCG, Consumer Goods, Construction, Auto Components, Agri and adjacent sectors
* Build and manage relationships with CXO, Supply Chain, Sales and IT stakeholders at target accounts

* Design solutions on the fly — not off a script — basis deep understanding of the client's channel reality
* Partner with the founding team on account strategy, proposal design and negotiation
* Represent ZoTok at industry forums, distributor conclaves and brand events

**Who You Are**

* You understand the Distributor-Retailer-Brand triangle from the inside — beat plans, secondary sales, claim cycles, ROI conversations — and can walk into a Supply Chain or Sales Head's office and earn credibility in the first five minutes
* Your GT background is not a detour — it is your unfair advantage. You are selling AI to people who think exactly like you once did, solving problems you have lived firsthand
* You do not wait for a playbook. You walk into ambiguous situations, map the pain, design a solution on the spot and drive it to closure
* Comfortable navigating both business and technology stakeholders — switching fluently between "what's my ROI" and "how does this work"

* Based in Mumbai or Ahmedabad or Hyderabad, with willingness to travel for key accounts

title: Sr Solution Sales - AI Platform
description:
Lexsi Lab is a frontier AI research lab and platform company building the
****AI Engineering Layer for mission-critical AI****

. We help enterprises turn open and closed models into
****governed, auditable, production-grade systems****

without vendor or infrastructure lock-in.

Founded by pioneers in deep learning, with research hubs in Mumbai and Paris, Lexsi operates at the intersection of
****AI safety, interpretability, alignment, and systems engineering****

. Our work is published at top-tier venues (ICML, IJCNN, WWW, ACL), and our patented technologies, such as
****DL-Backtrace****

, enable explainability and auditability at a scale that enterprise AI demands.

Our customers deploy AI in environments where failures are expensive, regulation is real, and evidence matters: banking, financial services, insurance, and other high-risk domains.

The Role

We are looking for a
****Senior AI Solutions Architect****

to lead strategic, high-value customer engagements and support large enterprise transactions. This is a senior, customer-facing pre-sales role for someone who combines
****deep AI understanding, system-level thinking, and executive communication skills****

.

You will work closely with sales leadership, researchers, and engineers to shape deals from first conversation to closure. You will regularly engage with CXOs, Heads of AI, Risk, and Engineering, helping them understand how to build
****sovereign, governed, and defensible AI systems****

using Lexsi’s platform and research-led primitives.

This role is not about running delivery projects. It is about
****owning technical credibility in complex sales cycles****

.

What You’ll Do

You will lead technical discovery, solution design, and executive-level presentations for large, multi-stakeholder customers across Europe, the Middle East, and South Asia. You will frame customer problems around AI sovereignty, risk, governance, cost, and control, and translate them into clear architectures and evidence-backed solutions.

You will own the technical narrative in proposals, RFPs, and regulatory questionnaires, working closely with internal research and engineering teams to ensure accuracy, rigor, and feasibility. You will support advanced demos and proofs-of-concept, and help customers understand how Lexsi enables governed LLM gateways, explainability at scale, alignment and fine-tuning pipelines, and runtime observability.

Internally, you will act as the voice of the customer, feeding structured insights back into product, platform, and go-to-market strategy.

Who You Are

You have significant experience working with AI systems and have spent time in
****pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting roles****

tied to complex enterprise deals. You have built or shipped AI products and understand modern ML systems beyond surface-level tooling.

You are comfortable discussing topics such as explainability, alignment, evaluation, and deployment trade-offs with both researchers and senior enterprise stakeholders. You can walk into a high-stakes meeting and clearly explain why governance, auditability, and model optionality matter, without losing the room in technical detail.

You write clearly, present confidently, and operate well in ambiguity. You enjoy shaping solutions rather than following scripts.

Why This Role at Lexsi

You will work at the frontier of
****trustworthy and mission-critical AI****

, influencing how advanced research is adopted in real enterprises. You will play a visible role in large strategic deals and help define how Lexsi is positioned with regulators, banks, and global institutions.

This is a role for someone who wants to sit where
****research, product, and revenue intersect****

, and who enjoys being trusted with conversations that actually matter.

title: Principal Sales Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Principal Sales Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Director, Sales Engineering in the APJ Field Sales department. A Principal Sales Engineer is an industry expert who advises, encourages and challenges customers and prospects to evolve their cybersecurity architecture from one based on legacy Network and Perimeter architectures to one based on Zero Trust Architecture design principles leveraging the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE).
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Facilitate consultative discovery and design workshops meant to uncover a customer’s business requirements and their current-state architecture
* Design a high-level Zero Trust Architecture including a phased adoption roadmap expressing how the customer can transform to a Zero Trust Architecture future-state over time
* Engage across customer functional teams, as well as Zscaler partner and internal teams, to develop rapport and to ensure success across organizational structures from engineer to executive
* Code-switch seamlessly between CXO and IT Operations audiences to balance a combination of executive presence and deep technical credibility
* Adopt a confident, yet consultative customer-facing persona built on executive presence and humility

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 15+ years of relevant experience, or 10+ years of experience and an advanced degree
* Advanced product expertise and solution development capability, delivering on advanced solution selling across end-to-end Enterprise Architectures and complex Networking and Security environments
* Hands-on experience with technologies including TCP/IP protocol stack, DNS, BGP routing, MPLS, SD-WAN, GRE, IPsec, Layer-7 firewalls, Web Proxies, Load Balancing, and Data Loss Prevention
* Strong familiarity with NIST Zero Trust Architecture along with applicable laws, regulations, standards, and frameworks such as GxP, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and CISA

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience architecting or advising on AI-driven threat detection, automated security analytics, or integrating AI/ML models within modern Zero Trust frameworks
* Coach or mentor mindset that up-levels the collective team, combined with senior thought leadership to influence internal organizational direction and external customer venues

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

title: Microsoft-MS-MS Dynamics and Sales Support-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Consulting - Sales Support executive (Senior Manager):**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Sales Support executive (Senior Manager) is a key contributor to Consulting growth, responsible for supporting sales pursuits, proposal execution, and commercial analysis across priority opportunities. This role works closely with Senior Managers, Partners, Account Leaders, and solution teams to improve pursuit effectiveness, deal quality, and pipeline discipline.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Sales & Pursuit Support

+ Support end to end sales pursuits for consulting opportunities, including qualification, proposal development, pricing support, and approvals.
+ Partner with pursuit leaders to help shape deal strategy, solution positioning, and client value propositions.
+ Maintain strong discipline on pipeline tracking, win probability updates, and pursuit milestones.

* Proposal & RFP Management

+ Manage and coordinate RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and client presentations under guidance of Senior Managers and Partners.
+ Work with cross functional teams (solution architects, finance, legal, risk, delivery) to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely submissions.
+ Consolidate inputs, track dependencies, and ensure alignment between scope, commercials, and delivery approach.

* Commercial & Financial Analysis

+ Support pricing models, effort estimates, margin analysis, and financial summaries for consulting deals.
+ Assist in preparing business cases, deal review materials, and approval documentation.
+ Analyse deal economics and highlight commercial risks, assumptions, and improvement opportunities.

* Sales Operations & Governance

+ Ensure compliance with sales governance, review checkpoints, and approval workflows.
+ Support maintenance of sales support templates, trackers, and standard documentation.
+ Identify process gaps and contribute to continuous improvement of sales support operations.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Act as a primary working level contact for account teams and pursuit stakeholders.
+ Provide clear, structured updates on pursuit status, risks, and next steps.
+ Support leadership in pipeline reviews, forecast updates, and performance reporting.

* Team Collaboration & Capability Building

+ Mentor Senior Consultants and Consultants within the sales support team.
+ Share best practices on proposal writing, commercial structuring, and pursuit management.
+ Contribute to knowledge assets, playbooks, and reusable pursuit collateral.

**Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in consulting sales support, pursuit management, commercial advisory, or related roles.
* Hands on experience supporting medium to large consulting deals across technology, data, digital, or transformation programs.
* Experience working in a global / matrixed consulting environment is preferred.
* Should have strong AI understanding

**Core Competencies**

* Strong understanding of the consulting sales lifecycle and proposal processes.
* Working knowledge of pricing, effort estimation, and commercial constructs.
* Ability to synthesize complex inputs into clear, client ready deliverables.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

**Behavioural & Leadership Skills**

* Detail oriented with strong execution discipline.
* Comfortable operating in fast paced, deadline driven pursuit environments.
* Collaborative team player with emerging leadership capabilities.
* High standards of quality, compliance, and professionalism.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent is an advantage.

**What We Look For**

* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

SCT sellers serve as the strategic bridge between Services Acceleration, Frontier Co, regional sales teams, and priority industry motions. Speacilist sellers within SCT bring high levels of workload or domain expertise into transformational services led opportunities.
  
  
As a Strategic Consulting Executive, in India, you will operate as a senior individual contributor at the heart of industry-led transformation and custom deal-making, engaging C-Suite stakeholders, selling transformation, and applying deep industry and business acumen through a consultative selling approach to drive measurable business outcomes. Industry Strategic Consulting sellers focus on Microsoft’s priority industries, bringing industry-specific expertise, market insight, and transformation patterns to shape high-value customer opportunities.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role serves as a senior strategic services sales leader who drives cloud, AI, consulting, and support revenue growth by building executive relationships, shaping customer transformation strategies, leading complex negotiations, and orchestrating Microsoft teams to deliver business outcomes and long-term customer success.
  
  
**Drive Strategic Cloud, AI, and Services Growth**
Lead complex consulting, cloud, AI, security, and Unified support opportunities from qualification through close, expanding customer investment through renewals, multi-year agreements, upselling, and new business acquisition while accelerating Microsoft market share.
  
  
**Lead Executive Customer Relationships & Business Strategy**
Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, articulate business value and ROI, influence customer transformation strategies, and position Microsoft solutions against competitors to drive long-term business outcomes.

Coordinate cross-functional account, consulting, customer success, pursuit, delivery, and partner teams to develop account strategies, manage forecasting, execute close plans, negotiate contracts, mitigate risks, and ensure successful deal closure and delivery handoff.
