title: Sales and Client Engagement Internship
description:
Reaviva Holistic Health is a premium, science\-led wellness centre in Santacruz West, Mumbai, offering integrated care across aesthetics, fitness, recovery, nutrition and mental well\-being. We are offering a six month, full time internship for management graduates who wish to build a career in sales and client relationship management.
 



  





**The Role** 




 The intern will manage the enquiries the centre receives each day, engaging prospective clients by telephone and WhatsApp, and converting genuine interest into booked consultations. The quality of the first conversation determines whether an enquiry becomes a consultation, so the internship suits candidates who are articulate, assured on the telephone, and comfortable being assessed on measurable outcomes from the outset.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Contact every enquiry generated by the centre's marketing activity by telephone, and complete the agreed follow\-up sequence for those not reached at the first attempt
2. Qualify each enquiry through structured discussion, establish the prospective client's requirement and circumstances, and book a consultation at the centre
3. Respond to inbound telephone calls, WhatsApp messages and direct messages within the agreed response time, through the working day
4. Improve the attendance rate of booked consultations through timely reminders and a clear explanation of what the appointment involves
5. Record every conversation and update the enquiry stage in the customer relationship management system as it occurs, so that no enquiry is lost and no client is contacted twice on the same matter
6. Submit a daily summary of calls placed, connections made and consultations booked, and take part in the weekly review of the enquiry funnel
7. Uphold the confidentiality, discretion and presentation standards expected in a premium health and wellness environment, and make no claim about a treatment or an outcome that has not been approved by the medical team



  





**Candidate Requirements** 



1. A postgraduate degree in management, either completed or in the final stage, from a recognised institution
2. Spoken English of a high standard, together with fluency in Hindi. A clear, courteous and unhurried telephone manner is the principal requirement of the role
3. The ability to listen attentively, to ask considered follow\-up questions rather than rely on a script, and to converse with senior professionals with confidence
4. Comfort with daily measurement of calls made, connections achieved and consultations booked
5. Working knowledge of spreadsheets and of customer relationship management systems
6. Availability to work full time from the centre at Santacruz West for the full six months



 What the Internship Offers
 


1. A monthly stipend, confirmed at the time of offer
2. Structured training in the consultative selling of high value services, provided by the Sales Manager
3. Exposure to the complete client journey, from first enquiry through consultation to treatment
4. A certificate of completion, and consideration for a permanent position at the end of the term, subject to performance



  





**Position Details** 




 Position: Sales and Client Engagement Intern
 



 Reporting to: CMO / Sales Manager
 



 Location: Santacruz West, Mumbai. This is a full time, on site internship and is not remote or hybrid
 



 Duration: Six months
 



 Working days: Monday to Saturday
 



 Working hours: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Please apply through LinkedIn, or send your curriculum vitae and a brief covering note to hardikdesai@reavivaholistichealth.com. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an on\-site discussion.

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Kirti Lasers specializes in the design, development, and prototyping of advanced laser systems for industrial, medical, and defense applications. The company’s work spans laser materials processing, high‑power and pulsed laser systems, and precision optics and optical metrology. Teams at Kirti Lasers use CAD/CAM tools and specialized measurement instruments to build, test, and optimize laser solutions. The organization emphasizes laser safety, robust electronic control systems, and continuous process improvement to deliver high‑quality, reliable products. This environment offers technical professionals the opportunity to work with cutting‑edge laser technologies and contribute to performance\-critical solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Technical Sales Engineer role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Mumbai. The individual in this role will engage with prospective and existing customers to understand their technical requirements, propose appropriate laser solutions, and support the sales process from initial inquiry through order closure. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include preparing technical proposals and presentations, conducting product demonstrations, and collaborating with engineering teams to translate customer needs into feasible configurations. The Technical Sales Engineer will also provide pre\-sales and post\-sales technical support, assist with troubleshooting, and ensure timely resolution of customer issues. Regular activities involve maintaining accurate sales documentation, tracking opportunities in the pipeline, and contributing feedback to improve products and customer experience.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Technical Sales and Sales skills to identify opportunities, manage the sales cycle, and achieve revenue targets.
* Candidates should possess Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills to interpret customer requirements, configure solutions, and assist with implementation and issue resolution.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to explain complex technical concepts clearly, prepare documentation, and collaborate with customers and internal teams.
* Candidates should ideally have experience in laser systems, optics, or industrial equipment, with the ability to quickly learn product specifications and applications.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering (such as Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, or related field) or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
* Ability to work on\-site in Mumbai, travel to customer locations as needed, and maintain a customer\-focused, solution\-oriented mindset.
* Strong problem\-solving, presentation, and negotiation skills, along with proficiency in standard office and CRM software, are beneficial.

title: Sr Fashion Consultant
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mulmul is a family\-owned, homegrown Indian fashion label dedicated to making ethnic wear a joyful part of everyday life. Over the past four years, the brand has focused on creating timeless Indian styles with a distinct signature touch, elevating ethnic wear beyond special occasions. Mulmul places strong emphasis on quality, beginning with carefully chosen fabrics and extending to thoughtful craftsmanship. The company is committed to spreading happiness through its garments, supporting its artisans and team, and bringing delight to customers’ wardrobes. Born and raised in India, Mulmul has grown into a label loved by customers around the world.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Sr Fashion Consultant is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai. This role involves providing personalized styling advice to clients, guiding them on silhouettes, fabrics, and outfits that align with Mulmul’s aesthetic and the customer’s preferences. The Sr Fashion Consultant will demonstrate deep product knowledge, assist with fittings, coordinate looks for various occasions, and ensure an elevated in\-store experience. Daily responsibilities include engaging with customers, building long\-term relationships, driving sales, managing client appointments, and maintaining visual merchandising standards. The role also involves mentoring junior consultants, sharing trend insights, and collaborating with the store team to achieve performance targets and deliver exceptional customer service.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Product Knowledge and understanding of Indian ethnic wear, fabrics, fits, and current fashion trends.
* Proven expertise in Fashion Consulting and personal styling, with the ability to curate looks for diverse customer needs.
* Excellent Communication skills, including active listening and clear, inclusive client interactions.
* Customer Service skills focused on creating positive, memorable in\-store experiences and building repeat clientele.
* Sales skills, including upselling, cross\-selling, and achieving individual and store\-level targets.

* Ability to work on\-site in Mumbai, including weekends and peak festive seasons, with strong time management and teamwork.
* Relevant education in Fashion, Retail Management, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

 The core responsibilities of Key Account Manager for Strategic Account at Perfios can be broken down into key areas: Account Management, Sales Strategy Development, Adoption \& Account Ecosystem, Customer Relationship Management, Problem Management and Revenue Growth.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Account Development**



 Manage One Large Account for Perfios with Strong business development, pipeline build \& management, Relationship building \& development, Escalation Management, Internal collaboration \& Stakeholder management skills.
 


* **Sales Strategy Development**



 The Key Account Manager is responsible for developing a comprehensive sales strategy that aligns with the company's overall goals and objectives for a large account. This involves building a strong account plan for the Strategic Account, defining sales pipeline build plan, Planning to achieve sales targets, Collections and developing pricing propositions that are competitive and sustainable.
 



 Additionally, the Account Manager must track account trends, competition, and customer needs to adjust the sales strategy as needed to maximize revenue growth, come up with innovative contracting models for large clients. Plan engagements without RFPs and work on nomination basis with the client by showcasing Perfios value proposition.

 The Strategic Key Account Manager is responsible for building a strong account system through a team of Sales, Solutioning, Customer Success, Product professionals or a strategic account to achieve sales targets, stronger adoption of Perfios Tech and drive revenue growth. This involves deep collaboration skills across teams, clear roles \& responsibilities, managing extended teams and building a strong ecosystem of professionals managing the client for higher revenue performance, best account management \& good P\&L through collections.

 Yral Foods is dedicated to bringing rich, diverse, and authentic Indian flavors to homes and businesses worldwide. The company specializes in dry snacks, spices, dry fruits, ready\-to\-cook meals, long shelf\-life sweets, breakfast items, and traditional Indian tea and coffee, all produced to meet global quality standards. The role will involve coordinating with sales, marketing, and operations teams to execute campaigns, gather customer feedback, and track performance in target markets such as the UK and Europe. The Market Performer will also help prepare reports, maintain records of outreach and market responses, and contribute to strategies that improve brand visibility and product reach.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Ability to perform market research, analyze consumer trends, and interpret data to support decision\-making.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly.
* Organizational skills for managing multiple tasks, maintaining records, and meeting deadlines.
* Comfort working in a hybrid environment, collaborating both on\-site in Mumbai and remotely.
* Understanding of or interest in FMCG or food and beverage markets; experience in export or international trade is an advantage.
* Relevant education in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: VP Sales and Distribution
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Business Descriptor**
 HSBC’s Asset \& Wealth Management is primarily responsible for driving mutual fund sales through distributor networks and client relationships, while ensuring compliance and delivering market insights to advisors and investors.
   

  

 A HSBC Mutual Fund Sales Representative (often titled Sales \& Distribution, Relationship Manager, or Product Specialist in HSBC’s Asset \& Wealth Management) is primarily responsible for driving mutual fund sales through distributor networks
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Distributor \& IFA (Independent Financial Adviser(s)/) channel development: Build and manage relationships with banks, IFAs, and national distributors; expand the IFA network and deepen penetration in the assigned region.
* Sales targets \& assets under management (AUM) growth: Own quarterly/annual sales budgets, focus on AUM growth, and meet/exceed mutual fund sales targets.
* Client/advisor engagement: Present fund strategies, market views, and portfolio solutions to IFAs, relationship managers, and institutional clients; support them in client conversations and portfolio reviews.
* Training \& enablement: Conduct internal/external training sessions, product workshops, and webinars for internal teams and advisors; create sales plans around “focus funds” and campaigns.
* Market intelligence: Gather feedback from the field, share competitor and flow trends, and work with product teams to refine positioning and campaigns.
* Compliance \& documentation: Ensure all sales activities adhere to SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) /AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India) guidelines, KYC (Know Your Customer )/AML(Anti\-Money Laundering ) norms, and internal risk/compliance policies; maintain accurate records and reporting.


**Requirements**
 Experience: 5\+ years; prior experience in mutual fund distribution, wealth sales, or private banking is preferred.
   

  

 Certifications: NISM VA certification is mandatory
   

  

 Education: Graduate/postgraduate in finance, business, or related fields.
   

  

 Skills: Strong relationship management, negotiation, presentation skills; comfort with sales pipelines, Excel/CRM reporting, and basic portfolio analytics.
   

  

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.


**Note**
 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Sell to the CFO's office — engage CFOs, financial controllers, heads of FP\&A, and CIOs on high\-stakes problems: long close cycles, complex group consolidation, regulatory compliance, and planning transformation

* Co\-sell with the Big 4 partner ecosystem — build deal\-level alignment with EY, Deloitte, PwC, and Accenture practices, leveraging our strategic Centre of Excellence relationships to source and accelerate opportunities
* Position the unified platform advantage against point solutions and legacy incumbents (Oracle EPM/PBCS, Anaplan, OneStream, SAP BPC), anchoring value in regulatory readiness, finance ownership, and total cost of change

**BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER – ENTERPRISE** 




  





**ABOUT NEWJAISA TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED** 




 NewJaisa Technologies Limited is India's leading R2v3 and CPCB\-certified refurbished IT hardware company, listed on the NSE and headquartered in Bengaluru. We enable enterprises across India to procure certified, performance\-tested refurbished laptops, desktops, and servers \- delivering up to 50–70% cost savings versus new hardware, without any compromise on quality, reliability, or compliance.
 



 With a rapidly growing enterprise client base spanning BPO, BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, and Education verticals, we are now expanding our North India footprint and are looking for a sharp, networked sales professional to own the Maharastra and North India territory.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 This is a hunter\-first, relationship\-driven enterprise sales role. As BDM \- Enterprise for North India, you will own the full sales cycle \- from market mapping and cold/warm outreach to pitching, negotiation, and closure.
 



 You will leverage your existing network within target industries to drive qualified pipeline, meet decision\-makers on\-ground, and build NewJaisa's brand presence in the region through client visits and offline events.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in the field, is commercially sharp, and can independently drive revenue without hand\-holding.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Own end\-to\-end enterprise sales for the Maharastra \& North India territory \- from lead identification through to deal closure.
* Proactively map the market to identify high\-potential enterprise accounts across BPO, BFSI, Healthcare, and Retail verticals.
* Leverage existing professional network to generate warm leads and referrals from Day 1\.
* Run outbound prospecting via LinkedIn, industry databases, cold calling, and direct visits to target accounts.
* Identify and engage procurement managers, IT heads, CFOs, and CXOs who influence or own hardware purchase decisions.
* Conduct in\-person meetings, presentations, and product demos to key decision\-makers at enterprise accounts.
* Manage the complete sales lifecycle \- discovery, solution mapping, proposal, negotiation, and closure.
* Develop and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with enterprise accounts to drive repeat business and upsell opportunities.
* Plan and execute offline client events, roundtables, and business networking meets in Maharastra NCR and across North India.
* Represent NewJaisa at industry forums, IT procurement events, and vertical\-specific gatherings.
* Work with the marketing team to drive regional ABM (Account\-Based Marketing) campaigns and BTL activations.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of leads, opportunities, and client interactions in the CRM.
* Provide weekly pipeline updates and monthly sales forecasts to reporting management.
* Track competitor activity, pricing trends, and market intelligence and relay inputs to the central team.
* Coordinate with the inside sales, pre\-sales, and operations teams to ensure smooth order processing and post\-sale fulfilment.
* Collaborate with the marketing team on collateral, case studies, and account\-specific materials.
* Share ground\-level market feedback to help refine product positioning and go\-to\-market strategy.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




**Must\-Have** 




**Experience:** 
 2\-5 years of B2B / enterprise sales.
 



**Communication:** 
 Fluent in English, Marathi and Hindi (spoken \& written) \- non\-negotiable.
 



**Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Business, Engineering, or related fields preferred.
 



**Location:** 
 Based in Maharastra or willing to relocate immediately.
 



**Travel:** 
 Willing to travel extensively across North India (50%\+ of working time).
 



**Mindset:** 
 Self\-starter \- able to independently generate, qualify, and close leads.
 



**Attitude:** 
 Agile, adaptable, and comfortable in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
 



  





**Good to Have** 



* Prior experience selling IT hardware, managed services, SaaS, or technology solutions to enterprise clients.
* An existing contact network within BPO, BFSI, Healthcare, or Retail organisations in North India \- especially with IT, procurement, or operations decision\-makers.
* Understanding of the IT asset lifecycle, enterprise procurement processes, and bulk hardware buying cycles.
* Experience planning or participating in corporate events, trade shows, or client meets.
* Proficiency with any CRM tool (Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar).
* Exposure to sustainability\-led or ESG\-aligned sales pitches (green IT, circular economy).



  





**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU** 



* Work with a publicly listed, fast\-growing company in India's sustainable technology sector.
* Full ownership of a high\-potential territory \- Maharastra and North India \- with real scope to grow.
* Competitive fixed CTC \+ attractive performance\-linked incentives (structured for field sales).
* Opportunity to fast\-track into a Senior BDM or Regional Sales Lead role based on performance.
* Join a sharp, entrepreneurial team with a strong culture of ownership and execution.



  





**APPLICATION NOTE** 




 If you have 2–5 years of enterprise sales experience, a contact book in any of our target industries, and the hunger to build something meaningful in North India \- we want to hear from you.
 



  





 NewJaisa Technologies Limited is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in\-depth regulatory know\-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end\-markets that include Human Health \& Nutrition, Home \& Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints \& Coatings and Wood Protection.
   

  

 With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024\. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R\&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.
   

  

 This job is responsible for sustainable and profitable growth of a mix of BLs business across India by leading commercial strategy, developing key customer relationships and identifying market development opportunities. The role is accountable for achieving sales and profitability targets, managing receivables and serving as the primary commercial interface between customers and internal stakeholders. Through strong market intelligence, customer engagement and cross\-functional collaboration, the position supports strategic decision making, strengthens competitive positioning and delivers long\-term business value.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions:**
* Owns commercial performance across the assigned market, delivering sales, profitability and growth objectives. Drives margin improvement through disciplined pricing, value selling, cost management and effective management of receivables and working capital.
* Develops and executes strategic account plans for key customers, builds long\-term relationships and ensures high standards of customer responsiveness, technical support and service excellence.
* Identifies, develops and converts new business opportunities within existing and adjacent markets. Supports and guides distribution partners to drive profitable growth and maximize market penetration. Maintains opportunity pipelines and CRM discipline.
* Acts as the market expert by monitoring competitors, market trends, regulatory developments and technology changes. Provides market insights and demand forecasts to support business planning, S\&OP and strategic decision\-making.
* Collaborates with Marketing, Product Management, R\&D and Operations to influence product development, pricing and supply priorities. Represents the region in global and regional initiatives, product launches and strategic discussions.
* Manages reporting, compliance requirements, internal meetings, training, travel, process improvements and other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Education should be Graduate / Bachelor any discipline
* 8\+ years sales experience in chemical sector, preferable Paints \& Coatings.
* Strong sales/Business development skills
* Sound understanding of specialty chemicals and market dynamics, and the ability to develop strategic customer relationships
* Strong negotiation, communication, analytical and influencing skills are essential, along with the ability to interpret market trends, manage complex sales opportunities and collaborate effectively across functions
* Able and willing to work from company premises (Mumbai) and /or home office; frequent travel


 Arxada has world class offering in two distinct areas:
   

  

**Microbial Control Solutions (MCS)** 
 focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home \& Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints \& Coatings and Material Protection.
   

  

**Nutrition, Care \& Environmental (NCE)** 
 provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high\-performance applications.
   

  

 Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Google Sheets** 

 .

 This internship will give you hands\-on exposure to
 
**sales, brand partnerships, event marketing, community building, influencer outreach, and live event execution**

 Associates are the engine driving GLG's Insight Network – the world's largest and most varied source of first\-hand expertise. The Associate role involves fast\-paced communication, working directly as thought partners with leading professionals across industries for client deliverables.
   

  

 Associates should have a natural curiosity, strong critical thinking skills, and a competitive spirit to win for clients. Armed with those qualities, you’ll go through our robust onboarding and training programs so that you can grow and hone the skills needed to succeed in your role. Over time, basis consistent performance, you will be owning the project lifecycle, speaking frequently with leading clients and experts – all while receiving continued coaching and mentoring from your team to help you develop top\-tier project management and communication skills.

* Recruiting new experts to join GLG’s insight network through targeted lead generation and timely outreach by phone, email, and other methods.
* Scheduling and confirming critical calls and meetings between GLG’s clients and Network Members, including scheduling all calls with your new recruits.
* Collaborating closely with client\-facing team members to expand projects and rescope of recruiting populations to drive successful client outcomes.
* Building your understanding of client strategies, various industry sectors, and value chains to identify and vet the best experts for client projects.
* Learning and upholding our compliance policies and procedures to protect the integrity of client engagements.
* Proactively engaging with GLG’s Network Members to understand their expertise and gauge their fitment for client projects.

* Excel in a phone based and highly challenging environment that demands attention to detail and prioritization of various workflows and execution on multiple projects at the same time.

* Develop strong, transferable business skills, including communication, time management, negotiating, problem solving, project management, research and the ability to achieve monthly/quarterly targets.
* Collaborate with colleagues on and across both regional and global teams to contribute to revenue and broader commercial success.

**Ideal Candidates Have**
* Bachelor's degree or higher (required)
* 2\-4 years of work experience in internet/market research, outreach, partnership, client\-facing, sales, or account management roles
* Excellent communication skills and fluency in written English
* Confident and strong communication (oral and written), interpersonal \& problem\-solving skills and motivation to work on the phone daily with Network Members and potential recruits.

* Desire to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, team environment where we strive to provide an excellent experience for experts and clients.

* High motivation to exceed personal weekly, monthly, and quarterly commercial targets.
* Willingness to work flexible and extended hours (including evenings and some holidays) based on client needs and expectations
* Demonstrate the ability and initiative to handle increasing responsibility over time

You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high\-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Maritime**
 We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the maritime/offshore industry, with exposure to ship and MOU operations, classification requirements, and customer\-facing roles.
* Driven, goal\-oriented, and results\-focused professional with a proactive approach to achieving business objectives.
* Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.
* Capable of performing efficiently under pressure while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
* Forward\-thinking, innovative, and solution\-oriented, with strong analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent customer engagement and relationship management abilities, with a proven capability to interact effectively at both operational and executive levels.
* Possesses strong knowledge of the maritime industry, offshore operations, and classification requirements.
* Experienced in ship and Mobile Offshore Unit (MOU) operations, enabling effective communication and engagement with a diverse customer base.
* Skilled in working closely with Area Managers, Approval Centre Managers, Production Managers, Business Development Managers, and Key Account Managers (KAMs) to achieve organizational goals.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* International exposure and experience working with multicultural teams and stakeholders are considered a strong advantage.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, demonstrating leadership, ownership, and accountability.
* Willing and able to travel as required by the role.

 Fairmont Hotels \& Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. **THE THIRD ROOM**
* Coordinate day\-to\-day bookings across the nine named rooms, working with the front\-of\-house and concierge teams to ensure member allocations, minimum\-attendance rules, and billing are correctly applied at the point of booking
* Act as a point of escalation for the floor concierge team on member\-specific questions

**EVENTS \& CULTURAL PROGRAMMING**
* Support delivery of Roswyn's cultural calendar, including on\-the\-ground event management
* Coordinate logistics for partner\-hosted events at Roswyn (galleries, founder communities, media partners, corporate hosts), working directly with external partners on run\-of\-show, guest lists, and venue requirements
* Assist with the Artist in Residence programme — scheduling, hospitality coordination, and day\-to\-day support for the resident artist
* Maintain the Cultural Partnerships \& Events Tracker, keeping partner status, next actions, and event details current


**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION**
* Liaise with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to keep membership collateral, pipeline reporting, and revenue tracking aligned with the Director's direction
* Work with the hotel's IT and front\-office teams on system and process issues affecting member experience
* Support the Director in preparing materials for ownership, GM, and Ennismore\-level updates


 Additional Information
   

  

* 1\-3 years of experience in hospitality operations, membership/loyalty programmes, luxury retail clienteling, or events management
* Genuinely organised — comfortable owning a CRM, a pipeline, and a run\-of\-show simultaneously without letting any of them slip
* Strong written and verbal communication; equally at ease drafting a member welcome letter and briefing a partner on event logistics
* A natural comfort with people — members, partners, and colleagues across departments — and the judgement to know when to handle something directly versus flag it upward
* An interest in art, design, hospitality, or cultural programming is a strong plus, given the role's proximity to Roswyn's cultural calendar and partnerships
* Proficiency with standard office and CRM tools; comfort picking up new systems quickly

title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
The Senior Sales Manager (SSM) drives revenue growth by managing and expanding business with mid\-to\-high potential hearing aid dealers, independent audiology practices, and regional retail clinics. This role focuses on increasing share\-of\-wallet within an assigned territory, ensuring high product adoption, and delivering localized sales strategies.
   

  

 The SSM operates with a focused regional revenue target tailored to premium account management, which is structurally distinct from the macro\-level enterprise targets managed by our Business Development Managers (BDMs).
   

  

* Core Role Demarcation (SSM vs. BDM)


**Role**
 To maintain structural clarity across our sales vertical, this position is differentiated from the Business Development Manager (BDM) role across three primary pillars:
   

  

* Portfolio Scope: The SSM manages and nurtures existing mid\-to\-high tier retail dealers. The BDM focuses strictly on untapped corporate chains, hospital networks, and government tenders.
* Revenue Scale: The SSM target is scaled to regional dealer capacity, sitting structurally lower than national or macro\-level BDM revenue targets.
* Sales Cycle: The SSM handles high\-frequency, relationship\-driven monthly sales and restocking cycles. The BDM handles long\-cycle institutional contract acquisitions.
* Key Responsibilities


**Account Management \& Growth**

title: Sr Appl/Sys Sales Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 You will work with customers, consultants, contractors, OEMs, system integrators, and internal teams to shape architecture, influence specifications, and develop differentiated solutions that improve uptime, efficiency, resilience, safety, and lifecycle value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Consultative Selling and Business Influence**
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, consultants, contractors, and internal sales teams across mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Drive consultative selling by translating business needs, operational risks, and technical requirements into integrated Honeywell Building Automation solutions.
* Influence specifications and solution architecture for Security and Fire systems, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, identity\-driven workflows, integrations and applications, and related mission\-critical infrastructure systems.
* Support account teams in identifying, qualifying, and advancing strategic opportunities in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers by developing compelling technical value propositions.
* Collaborate with sales, product, engineering, estimation, and operations teams to develop technically sound, commercially viable, and customer\-centric proposals.
* Lead customer workshops, technical presentations, and consultant engagements as a Honeywell subject matter expert.
* Develop and deliver technical demonstrations, proof of concepts, pilot deployments, solution validations, and customer enablement sessions aligned with security use cases and operational needs.


**Technical Solutioning for Mission\-Critical Environments**
* Develop integrated Security and Fire solution concepts for mission\-critical infrastructure, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, command center integration, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Apply domain knowledge of Security and Fire to create scalable, resilient, and maintainable architectures covering physical access control, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management systems, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, intercom, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Design security architectures that address zoning, credentialing strategy, camera coverage, recording and retention requirements, alarm prioritization, operator workflows, redundancy, cybersecurity readiness, and integration with building management and fire life safety systems.
* Define integration approaches across third\-party systems using relevant protocols, APIs, SDKs, middleware, databases, and IP networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, PoE, ONVIF, Wiegand, OSDP, and RTSP.
* Support customers and consultants in defining operational security outcomes such as controlled access, incident response, auditability, situational awareness, regulatory alignment, business continuity, and lifecycle serviceability.
* Review customer specifications, drawings, sequence of operations, and tender documents to identify solution gaps, risks, optimization opportunities, and Honeywell differentiators.
* Define solution scope, system architecture, bill of materials guidance, integration approach, and technical assumptions for complex proposals in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Advise customers on operational outcomes such as uptime, redundancy, energy optimization, alarm management, fault detection, cybersecurity readiness, and lifecycle serviceability.


**Collaboration and Technical Influence**
* Influence stakeholders through technical credibility, structured discovery, persuasive solution positioning, and clear communication.
* Work with sales, engineering, product, service, operations, and commercial teams to translate requirements into executable solutions.


 Support bid strategy, technical compliance, value engineering, and customer clarification responses during pre\-sales and proposal stages.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Building Automation, or a related technical field.
* 12\+ years of experience in application engineering, systems sales engineering, solution consulting, pre\-sales, or technical solutioning for building automation, mission\-critical environments like Data Centers, industrial controls, or critical infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of Security and Fire systems, including access control systems, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management platforms, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, command center operations, emergency communication, alarm management, system interoperability, and security integration architectures.
* Hands\-on understanding of security system design, deployment, commissioning, diagnostics, troubleshooting, product validation, and integration with enterprise integrations and applications.
* Experience reviewing technical specifications, designing solution architectures, supporting proposals, and influencing consultant or customer specifications.
* Proven ability to engage with end users, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and internal stakeholders in complex technical sales cycles.
* Willingness to travel for customer engagements, consultant meetings, site visits, workshops, and industry events.


**WE VALUE**
* Strong executive presence and communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Customer\-first mindset with strong commercial awareness, consultative selling discipline, and ability to connect technical value to business outcomes.
* Ability to work independently in a matrixed organization while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with emerging security trends such as video analytics, identity management, IoT\-enabled security, cloud\-based video platforms, analytics\-driven security operations, and integrated security ecosystems.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Account Executive
description:
Account Executive — SMB Market
 



**Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune \| In\-Office \| B2B SaaS \| Construction Tech** 




  





 About RDash
 



 Construction is a $13 trillion global industry — and one of the least digitised. Projects routinely overrun budgets and timelines because execution data lives in spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and the heads of site engineers. The cost of this opacity runs into millions on every project.
 



 RDash is an AI\-powered Construction Management System that gives construction and infrastructure companies real\-time control, visibility, and predictability over project execution.
 



**Backed by Y Combinator, Stellaris Venture Partners \& Zacua Ventures** 
 RICS SEA PropTech of the Year — 2024 \& 2025 \| ET Realty PropTech of the Year 2024 \& 2026 Reference Customers: Amazon (India \& UAE), JSW Homes, Danube, LivSpace, Semac Construction, Continuum Energy
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are hiring SMB \& Mid\-Market Account Executives across India to accelerate RDash's growth in the sub\-enterprise segment.
 



 This is a quota\-carrying, high\-velocity closing role built for professionals who thrive in shorter sales cycles, can manage a large active pipeline, and know how to drive urgency with mid\-sized buyers. You will own the full sales cycle — from outbound prospecting and discovery through demo, negotiation, and close — typically within a 2–6 week cycle.
 



 You will be engaging Operations Heads, Project Directors, Business Owners, and PMO leads at construction contractors, real estate developers, interior fit\-out firms, and infrastructure companies — and positioning RDash as the platform that replaces their spreadsheets and WhatsApp chaos with real\-time project control.
 



 You will be supported by an active inbound engine, SDR team, and marketing\-driven lead generation — but you are expected to build pipeline independently through outbound prospecting and referral networks as well.
 



  





 What You Will Own
 


* High\-velocity SMB sales cycles — from first demo to signed contract, typically in 2–6 weeks
* Pipeline development through outbound prospecting, referrals, and marketing\-sourced inbound leads
* Product demonstrations and consultative discovery with operations and business decision\-makers
* Commercial negotiation and deal closure at ACVs of ₹5–50 Lakh
* Consistent pipeline hygiene and CRM discipline — you own your forecast
* Market feedback from the field to inform product and GTM decisions



  





 Who Should Apply
 



**Must Have** 



* 2–5 years of B2B SaaS sales experience with a track record of quota overachievement
* Proven ability to run high\-velocity sales cycles — managing 20–40 active deals simultaneously
* Experience closing software deals of ₹5–50 Lakh ACV with Indian SMB and mid\-market buyers
* Comfort engaging Business Owners, Operations Heads, and Project Directors in consultative conversations
* Self\-starter with strong outbound instincts — you don't wait for leads to come to you
* Full\-cycle ownership — you prospect, demo, negotiate, and close independently



  





**Great to Have** 



* Prior exposure to construction, real estate, interior fit\-out, or infrastructure industries
* Experience at a vertical SaaS or construction tech company
* Familiarity with MEDDIC, Challenger, or similar sales frameworks



  





**Ideal Prior Backgrounds** 



* Construction Tech / PropTech / Infra SaaS (Powerplay, Procore, Autodesk, Wrench, BuildSupply)
* Vertical SaaS targeting field\-operations or asset\-heavy industries
* ERP or workflow software selling to SMBs and mid\-market companies
* High\-growth B2B SaaS with strong outbound and volume\-based sales motion



  





 What This Role Is Not
 


* This is not an SDR or lead generation role — you are expected to close deals, not just book meetings
* This is not a relationship management or farming role — you are hunting and closing new logos
* This is not remote — all positions are in\-office, Gurgaon
* This is not for someone whose experience is primarily in channel, affiliate, or inbound\-only sales



  





 Location
 



**Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune — In\-office** 




  





 Why RDash
 


* **High\-velocity, high\-reward** 
 — short cycles mean faster commissions and a faster feedback loop on your skills
* **Real domain, real buyers** 
 — you are selling into an industry that has a genuine problem, not creating artificial urgency
* **Category leadership** 
 — RDash is the leading AI\-powered construction management platform in India and the Middle East; you are not selling an unknown product
* **Direct founding team access** 
 — GTM decisions happen fast; your field intelligence shapes product and strategy
* **Uncapped incentives** 
 — designed to reward closers, not participants



  





**Compensation:\- 14 LPA\- 18 LPA**

 Kindly apply those who are having Sales closure experience.

title: Business Growth Specialist - Talent Management
description:
**Position Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for a dynamic, commercially driven Business Growth Specialist to join our Artist Management team. The role will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, building strong relationships with brands, agencies, corporates and event organisers, and creating revenue opportunities for the artists represented by the company.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the entertainment, artist management, events, brand activation and corporate engagement ecosystem, along with excellent networking, pitching and negotiation skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Business Development \& Revenue Growth** 



* Identify and develop new business opportunities for artist bookings, performances, brand associations, endorsements and collaborations.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients, brands, agencies and corporate accounts.
* Generate leads through networking, market research, industry events, referrals and existing relationships.
* Drive business from lead generation through pitching, negotiation, closure and handover.
* Achieve agreed business development and revenue targets.



  





**2\. Artist \& Brand Partnerships** 



* Understand the company's artist portfolio and identify suitable commercial opportunities for each artist.
* Develop customised proposals for brand collaborations, corporate events, endorsements, appearances, performances and digital campaigns.
* Identify opportunities where artists can be integrated into brand campaigns and marketing initiatives.
* Work closely with the Artist Management team to ensure opportunities are commercially viable and aligned with the artist's positioning.



  





**3\. Client Acquisition \& Relationship Management** 



* Develop long\-term relationships with brand managers, marketing heads, event agencies, advertising agencies, corporate clients, media houses and entertainment stakeholders.
* Maintain regular engagement with existing clients to generate repeat business, upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Understand client requirements and recommend appropriate artists, formats and commercial solutions.
* Ensure a high level of client servicing throughout the business development cycle.



  





**4\. Pitching \& Negotiation** 



* Prepare and present business proposals, artist profiles, commercial decks and partnership ideas.
* Lead commercial discussions and negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines and contractual terms in coordination with the relevant internal teams.
* Ensure commercial proposals are aligned with company revenue objectives and artist expectations.
* Track negotiations and follow up consistently to convert opportunities into confirmed business.



  





**5\. Market Intelligence** 



* Keep abreast of entertainment trends, emerging artists, brand marketing strategies, competitor activities and industry developments.
* Identify emerging categories, brands and markets that can generate new revenue opportunities.
* Maintain a database of prospective clients, agencies, brands and industry contacts.
* Provide regular market insights and business development reports to management.



  





**6\. Internal Coordination** 



* Coordinate with Artist Management, Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution of confirmed opportunities.
* Ensure all commercial commitments are clearly communicated and documented.
* Support the team in developing new business verticals and artist monetisation opportunities.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Graduate degree in Business Management, Marketing, Mass Communication, Events, Media, Entertainment or a related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, Artist Management, Events, Entertainment, Brand Partnerships, Media or related industries.
* Experience in selling artist performances, entertainment solutions, brand collaborations, event solutions or celebrity associations will be an added advantage.
* Strong existing network among brands, advertising/event agencies, corporates and marketing professionals will be preferred.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




  





**The ideal candidate is someone who:** 



* Enjoys meeting people, networking and creating business opportunities.
* Can independently identify prospects and convert them into revenue.
* Has a strong understanding of how brands use artists, celebrities and entertainment for marketing and engagement.
* Is comfortable working with targets and commercial negotiations.
* Can balance a sales mindset with creative thinking.
* Has the confidence and maturity to interact with senior brand and agency stakeholders.
* Is passionate about the entertainment and artist management industry.

title: Sr Adv Appl/Sys Sales Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, consultants, contractors, and internal sales teams across mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Drive consultative selling by translating business needs, operational risks, and technical requirements into integrated Honeywell Building Automation solutions.
* Influence specifications and solution architecture for Security and Fire systems, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, identity\-driven workflows, integrations and applications, and related mission\-critical infrastructure systems.
* Support account teams in identifying, qualifying, and advancing strategic opportunities in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers by developing compelling technical value propositions.
* Collaborate with sales, product, engineering, estimation, and operations teams to develop technically sound, commercially viable, and customer\-centric proposals.
* Lead customer workshops, technical presentations, and consultant engagements as a Honeywell subject matter expert.
* Develop and deliver technical demonstrations, proof of concepts, pilot deployments, solution validations, and customer enablement sessions aligned with security use cases and operational needs.


**Responsibilities**
**Technical Solutioning for Mission\-Critical Environments**
* Develop integrated Security and Fire solution concepts for mission\-critical infrastructure, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, command center integration, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Apply domain knowledge of Security and Fire to create scalable, resilient, and maintainable architectures covering physical access control, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management systems, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, intercom, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Design security architectures that address zoning, credentialing strategy, camera coverage, recording and retention requirements, alarm prioritization, operator workflows, redundancy, cybersecurity readiness, and integration with building management and fire life safety systems.
* Define integration approaches across third\-party systems using relevant protocols, APIs, SDKs, middleware, databases, and IP networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, PoE, ONVIF, Wiegand, OSDP, and RTSP.
* Support customers and consultants in defining operational security outcomes such as controlled access, incident response, auditability, situational awareness, regulatory alignment, business continuity, and lifecycle serviceability.
* Review customer specifications, drawings, sequence of operations, and tender documents to identify solution gaps, risks, optimization opportunities, and Honeywell differentiators.
* Define solution scope, system architecture, bill of materials guidance, integration approach, and technical assumptions for complex proposals in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Advise customers on operational outcomes such as uptime, redundancy, energy optimization, alarm management, fault detection, cybersecurity readiness, and lifecycle serviceability.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Building Automation, or a related technical field.
* 12\+ years of experience in application engineering, systems sales engineering, solution consulting, pre\-sales, or technical solutioning for building automation, mission\-critical environments like Data Centers, industrial controls, or critical infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of Security and Fire systems, including access control systems, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management platforms, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, command center operations, emergency communication, alarm management, system interoperability, and security integration architectures.
* Hands\-on understanding of security system design, deployment, commissioning, diagnostics, troubleshooting, product validation, and integration with enterprise integrations and applications.
* Experience reviewing technical specifications, designing solution architectures, supporting proposals, and influencing consultant or customer specifications.
* Proven ability to engage with end users, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and internal stakeholders in complex technical sales cycles.
* Willingness to travel for customer engagements, consultant meetings, site visits, workshops, and industry events.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Associate, Client Solutions
description:
This role is based at our Mumbai office at BKC. Candidates from Mumbai may apply. The role follows a hybrid model of working (3 days work from office and 2 days work from home)
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Overview of the Role: Client Solutions**
 GLG is the world’s leading B2B platform connecting professionals with expertise. We connect thousands of clients to the largest global network of subject\-matter experts across every sector. We bring the power of insight to every great professional decision.
   

  

 GLG is seeking Associates who are excited to learn and excel at best\-in\-class client service in a strong performance\-driven, merit\-based, and team\-oriented environment.
   

  

 Associates are the engine driving GLG's Insight Network – the world's largest and most varied source of first\-hand expertise. The Associate role involves fast\-paced communication, working directly as thought partners with leading professionals across industries for client deliverables.
   

  

 Associates should have a natural curiosity, strong critical thinking skills, and a competitive spirit to win for clients. Armed with those qualities, you’ll go through our robust onboarding and training programs so that you can grow and hone the skills needed to succeed in your role. Over time, basis consistent performance, you will be owning the project lifecycle, speaking frequently with leading clients and experts – all while receiving continued coaching and mentoring from your team to help you develop top\-tier project management and communication skills.
   

  

**Key Associate Responsibilities Include (but Are Not Limited To)**
* Recruiting new experts to join GLG’s insight network through targeted lead generation and timely outreach by phone, email, and other methods.
* Scheduling and confirming critical calls and meetings between GLG’s clients and Network Members, including scheduling all calls with your new recruits.
* Collaborating closely with client\-facing team members to expand projects and rescope of recruiting populations to drive successful client outcomes.
* Building your understanding of client strategies, various industry sectors, and value chains to identify and vet the best experts for client projects.
* Learning and upholding our compliance policies and procedures to protect the integrity of client engagements.
* Proactively engaging with GLG’s Network Members to understand their expertise and gauge their fitment for client projects.


**As An Associate, You Will Learn To**
* Excel in a phone based and highly challenging environment that demands attention to detail and prioritization of various workflows and execution on multiple projects at the same time.
* Recruit and vet new relevant experts to the GLG Network, building your lead generation, outreach, screening and pitching skills.
* Develop strong, transferable business skills, including communication, time management, negotiating, problem solving, project management, research and the ability to achieve monthly/quarterly targets.
* Collaborate with colleagues on and across both regional and global teams to contribute to revenue and broader commercial success.
* Mentor future GLG Associates as you become tenured and proficient in your role.


**Ideal Candidates Have**
* Bachelor's degree or higher (required)
* 6 months to 2 years of work experience in recruitment, internet/market research, outreach, partnership, client\-facing, sales, or account management roles
* Excellent communication skills and fluency in written English
* Confident and strong communication (oral and written), interpersonal \& problem\-solving skills and motivation to work on the phone daily with Network Members and potential recruits.
* Eagerness to learn about new topics, industries, and companies.
* Desire to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, team environment where we strive to provide an excellent experience for experts and clients.
* Hustle and tenacity to work responsibly and manage multiple, simultaneous tasks and prioritize effectively, given that client priorities shift quickly at GLG.
* High motivation to exceed personal weekly, monthly, and quarterly commercial targets.
* Willingness to work flexible and extended hours (including evenings and some holidays) based on client needs and expectations
* Demonstrate the ability and initiative to handle increasing responsibility over time


**About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group**
 GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision\-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.
   

  

 At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high\-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry’s most trusted research environment, you’ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.
   

  

 We are a global team of pragmatic problem\-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented.

 Stranger Soccer is expanding across key cities worldwide and is seeking a License Owner to launch and grow the Stranger Soccer operation in Mumbai.**
**This is not a salaried management role—it's an opportunity for an entrepreneurial individual to build and operate something of their own while making football more accessible in their local community. We're looking for someone ambitious, community\-driven, and passionate about the game.**
**Does This Sound Like You?**
 Visit
 **www.strangersoccer.com** 
 and explore the
 **"Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City"** 
 section to learn more.
   

  

 If this opportunity aligns with your goals, complete the interest form to start the conversation. We also recommend downloading the Stranger Soccer app to experience the platform firsthand.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Launch and grow the Stranger Soccer brand in Mumbai
* Recruit, train, and manage a small local team (2\-3 people), supported by Official Hosts
* Secure suitable football venues and regular playing opportunities
* Drive marketing and customer growth through digital and local initiatives
* Oversee game operations while delivering an outstanding player experience
* Work closely with Stranger Soccer HQ, supported by established operations and technology teams


**What We're Looking For**
* Passion for football and strong connections within the local football community
* Experience in management, operations, sales, or customer\-facing roles
* An entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work independently
* A strong sense of ownership and ambition to grow Stranger Soccer locally
* Motivation to deliver results, with rewards tied to performance and growth


**About Stranger Soccer**
 Football is loved by billions, yet many still struggle to play regularly. Stranger Soccer makes playing football as easy and convenient as going for a jog or visiting the gym.
   

  

 Our app lets players discover nearby games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play.
   

  

 Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates across 10\+ cities and has delivered over 100,000 games worldwide. We're looking for passionate License Owners who want to bring this experience to their communities—whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or football.
   

  

**Our Mission**
 To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.
   

  

**Ready to be part of the journey?**
 We'd love to hear from you.

title: Electrical Sales Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Devta Electricals, established in 1989, is a leading manufacturer of electrical control panels, cable trays with accessories, and a turnkey electrification contractor. The company combines state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure with experienced engineering professionals to deliver reliable, cost\-effective solutions aligned with modern technology. Devta Electricals is ISO 9001:2008 certified and holds CPRI type\-testing for products such as power panels and bus ducts, ensuring high standards of quality, durability, and safety. The organization executes complete industrial and commercial electrification projects, including cable laying, control panel and bus duct installation, earthing station setup, and OEM panel building. As a certified system panel builder for Schneider Electric (Prisma iPM IEC 61439\-1/2\), Devta Electricals maintains a strong market position and focuses on continual improvement and customer satisfaction.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Electrical Sales Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Navi Mumbai. This position involves identifying and developing business opportunities for electrical control panels, cable trays, bus ducts, and turnkey electrification solutions, while maintaining strong relationships with existing and prospective clients. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include preparing technical and commercial proposals, conducting product presentations and site visits, and coordinating with the engineering and projects teams to ensure accurate solution design and timely delivery. The Electrical Sales Engineer will provide pre\-sales and post\-sales technical support, address customer queries, and assist in troubleshooting basic application issues. The role also requires maintaining sales reports, monitoring market trends, and contributing to strategic sales planning to support revenue growth.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills to interpret technical specifications, propose suitable solutions, and assist customers with electrical applications.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication and Customer Service skills to engage with clients, present complex information clearly, and build long\-term professional relationships.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales skills, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing, to achieve assigned targets and expand the customer base.
* Candidates should have a good understanding of electrical systems, control panels, cable trays, bus ducts, and industrial/commercial electrification practices.
* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in industrial or commercial electrical product sales or project\-based selling will be an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site, conduct client visits, and collaborate with engineering and project execution teams.
* Proficiency in basic office and documentation tools, with strong organizational and reporting capabilities.

 A Channel or Franchise Partner is an individual or business entity that acquires the rights to represent, market, and resell Expertrons’ partner companies’ products and services within an assigned territory.
 



  





  





**What does the Onboarding Team do?** 




 The onboarding team is responsible for partner acquisition and activation. This includes handling inbound leads, pitching the business model, managing negotiations, closing partnerships, and ensuring partners are successfully onboarded and activated.

title: Inside Sales Manager - B2B Edtech in Mumbai
description:
Role Overview \- We are looking for a dynamic and persuasive inside sales manager to play a critical front\-line role in our growth engine. This is an individual contributor role focused on generating appointments and delivering product demos directly to prospective clients, primarily K\-12 schools.
   

  

 You should be confident on the phone, comfortable with CRM tools, and fluent in both English and Hindi. Prior EdTech experience is not mandatory, but 1\+ years of telesales experience is essential.
   

  

 Report to: Co\-founder
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Nurturing and Appointment Setting
* Make outbound follow\-up calls to school decision\-makers (principals and owners) to introduce the product.
* Qualify leads and set up high\-quality appointments for the field sales team.

 What We Offer
   

  

* Fixed salary with an attractive incentive structure linked to demos and conversions.
* Exposure to a rapidly growing EdTech company with a high\-performance culture.
* Opportunity to grow into a senior sales or customer success role based on performance.

At the forefront of educational innovation, Fyule aims to use the latest technologies and pedagogical practices to upgrade Indian classrooms.
