title: Territory Manager - Hydrebad
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**
**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** 
**At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**
**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**
**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
**Your Role: Territory Sales Manager \- Poultry**
 As a Territory Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening Elanco’s presence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, farm owners, and distributors. Your role will focus on building strong customer relationships, executing company strategies, and ensuring timely product movement and payment collection.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities:**
* Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote animal health products and generate profitable sales.
* Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
* Follow up on outstanding payments from customers and distributors to ensure timely collections.
* Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
* Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.


**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, or a related field.
* Experience: Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory\-based role.
* Top Skills: Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.


**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (preferred qualifications):**
* Strong understanding of the animal health market, including veterinary channels and livestock farming.
* Experience working with distributors and managing accounts receivable.
* Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
* High levels of ethics, self\-discipline, and accountability.
* Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.


**Additional Information:**
* Location: Based in India – field\-based role covering an assigned sales territory.
* Travel: Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
* Must attend company meetings and training sessions as scheduled and comply with all company policies and reporting systems.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown underrecognized groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Elanco we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or other roles!
   

  

 Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status

These tools help ensure a consistent, structured evaluation, but they do not make hiring decisions. All decisions involve a human reviewer. For more information on how we handle personal data, please see our Elanco Workforce Privacy Notice.

 Location: New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, and more

 As a Corporate Sales Manager at Amitoje India, you will dive into the dynamic world of retail display sales, focusing on large brands and corporations. This role is a blend of strategy, persistence, and people skills, requiring you to master the art of communication, negotiation, and salesmanship under pressure. title: Sales - Engineering Polymers and Compounds
description:
Sales \| Engineering Polymers and Compounds
 



  





**About the Company** 




  





 We’re partnering with a high\-growth, Series A venture\-backed specialty chemicals technology platform that is modernizing global industrial supply chains. By combining R\&D capabilities, global supply partnerships, and tech\-enabled distribution, the company enables B2B manufacturers to reliably source high\-performance chemical inputs and materials. Built on a foundation of rapid growth and strong investor backing, the business is scaling a lean, highly specialized team with an ambitious roadmap toward a $500M business by 2030\.
 



  





 To support the launch of a brand\-new commercial vertical focused on
 **Engineering Polymers and Compounds** 
 , the company is seeking driven, field\-intensive sales professionals (hiring at Sales Manager / Senior Manager / Regional Manager levels based on experience) to build customer territories from the ground up across major manufacturing hubs in India.
 



  





 📍
 **Location:** 
 Delhi / NCR, Mumbai, or Bengaluru (Candidates near manufacturing hubs in Gujarat or Chennai also considered)
 



 🗺️
 **Market:** 
 India Manufacturing Ecosystem (Engineering Polymers, Compounds \& Additives)
 



 🚗
 **Travel:** 
 Field\-intensive (Expected 10–15 customer meetings per week)
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




  





 This is a greenfield sales leadership opportunity for a true commercial builder. Rather than managing legacy accounts, you will take ownership of uncharted territory, opening doors, developing application\-based solutions, building a robust pipeline, and converting early\-stage opportunities into recurring revenue.
 



 Working directly alongside founder\-led leadership, you will play a foundational role in establishing market presence for this new division. If you are commercially hungry, understand the polymer ecosystem, and enjoy spending time in the field closing deals with SME promoters and manufacturing leaders, this position offers direct line\-of\-sight to long\-term commercial leadership.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Territory Development \& Customer Acquisition** 



* Own business development for the Engineering Polymers, Compounds, and Additives portfolio across your assigned region.
* Identify and build relationships with target manufacturers (₹50 Cr to ₹500 Cr revenue), engaging SME promoters, business owners, procurement leads, and technical stakeholders.
* Build a structured account list from the ground up, prioritizing high\-value commercial opportunities.



**Revenue Generation \& Pipeline Conversion** 



* Own and hit ambitious monthly and annual sales targets, aiming to scale toward \~₹1 Cr in monthly revenue within the first 3\-4 months of ramping.
* Manage the complete sales cycle in Zoho CRM from initial cold outreach and discovery to technical evaluation, commercial negotiation, and order closure.
* Drive high\-volume field activity, conducting 10\-15 customer meetings weekly to maintain a healthy project funnel.



**Application \& Consultative Solution Selling** 



* Position the product portfolio as cost\-effective, high\-performance drop\-in replacements for incumbent materials.
* Work closely with technical and product teams to map customer application requirements, coordinate sample trials, and evaluate performance.
* Gather on\-the\-ground market intelligence regarding pricing dynamics, competitor offerings, and emerging material demands.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Required Experience** 



* Years of B2B field sales experience within Engineering Polymers, Engineering Plastics, Compounds, Masterbatches, Polymer Additives, or closely allied specialty materials.
* Demonstrated track record of building new territories, acquiring new key accounts, and achieving aggressive revenue targets.
* Strong familiarity with Indian manufacturing clusters across regional hubs (Delhi/NCR, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Karnataka, or Tamil Nadu).
* Proven success selling to SME promoters, business heads, procurement teams, and plant technical staff.



**Key Skills** 



* Engineering Polymer \& Compound Application Knowledge
* Greenfield Business Development \& Cold Prospecting
* Field Sales Execution \& High\-Cadence Account Visits
* Drop\-In Replacement \& Solution\-Based Selling
* Commercial Negotiation \& Closing
* Pipeline Management \& CRM Hygiene (Zoho CRM experience is a plus)



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





 We are looking for an action\-oriented sales professional who thrives on autonomy and field activity.
 



 The ideal candidate will:
 


* Have deep market fluency in engineering polymers, compounds, or specialty additives.
* Be commercially confident and skilled at navigating pricing negotiations with Indian business owners.
* Take absolute accountability for revenue outcomes rather than just meeting activity metrics.
* Demonstrate high integrity, transparent communication, and a willingness to share market insights with internal teams.
* Be excited by the prospect of building a new business unit from scratch rather than inheriting existing accounts.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





 The successful candidate will:
 


* Rapidly establish a qualified opportunity pipeline and achieve early revenue traction (\~₹1 Cr/month target post\-ramp).
* Convert initial sample trials and technical evaluations into repeatable commercial supply contracts.
* Build long\-term strategic relationships with key promoters and manufacturing leaders in the territory.
* Lay the foundation for regional sales expansion, opening up opportunities for future team leadership.



  





**Why Join?** 




  




* **Ground\-Floor Opportunity:** 
 Help launch and scale a brand\-new commercial vertical within a venture\-backed tech\-enabled platform.
* **Aggressive Career Growth:** 
 Direct path from individual contributor to regional or national commercial leadership as the business unit scales.
* **Direct Access to Founders:** 
 Work alongside experienced serial entrepreneurs and investment leaders.
* **High Ownership \& Autonomy:** 
 Full freedom to manage and build your territory with minimal micromanagement and maximum accountability.

**Company:**

**About Kenshine Group** 




 Kenshine Group has been moving cargo for Indian exporters and importers since 1989\. We are a multimodal logistics provider and an accredited Authorized Economic Operator (AEO), delivering port\-to\-door, door\-to\-port and door\-to\-door solutions across ocean, air and surface. Our services span freight forwarding, LCL consolidation, customs brokerage, third\-party logistics, warehousing, surface transportation and specialised packing, through Kenshine Global Logistics Private Limited, Kenshine Shipping Private Limited and Kenshine Logistics Private Limited.
 



  





**About the openings** 




 We are expanding our Freight Forwarding and LCL Consolidation business in Mumbai and are hiring across four functions. Candidates at all levels — from freshers to experienced professionals — are encouraged to apply; the role and responsibilities will be matched to your experience.
 



  





**Customer Service** 




 Own a set of accounts end to end: booking confirmations, space planning with carriers and co\-loaders, milestone updates to shippers and consignees, and resolution of delays, roll\-overs and exceptions. You are the single point of contact the customer calls.
 



  





**Procurement** 




 Source and negotiate ocean, air and LCL rates with carriers, NVOCCs, consolidators and overseas agents. Maintain the rate grid, close spot buys against live enquiries, and protect margin on every shipment without compromising transit or reliability.
 



  





**Documentation** 




 Prepare and verify shipping bills, bills of lading, delivery orders, manifests, certificates of origin and export/import documentation. Coordinate filings with customs, carriers and CFS/ICDs, and keep records audit\-ready against AEO and regulatory requirements.
 



  





**Sales** 




 Develop new business among exporters, importers and trade partners in the Mumbai market. Map prospects, quote and convert enquiries, build long\-term account relationships, and work with Procurement and Customer Service to deliver what you sell.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 



* Interest in, or experience with, freight forwarding, LCL consolidation, customs clearance or 3PL operations
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to deal directly with customers, carriers and overseas agents
* Working knowledge of MS Office; familiarity with a logistics or ERP system is an advantage
* Accuracy and attention to detail — in this business, a wrong document number is a real cost
* A graduate degree in any discipline; qualifications in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Trade or Commerce are preferred
* Willingness to work on\-site in Mumbai



  





**Why Kenshine** 



* 35\+ years in the trade, with an established network of carriers and overseas agents
* AEO\-accredited operations and strong compliance standards
* Direct exposure to the full shipment lifecycle rather than one narrow task
* A small, senior team where good work is visible

title: Field Engineer - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you’ll be the technical face of Anysphere in the field, helping customers evaluate Cursor, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows.
   

  

 You’ll work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer\-facing role where you’ll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Partner with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, demos, and proof\-of\-concept engagements
* Build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, architects, and developers, serving as their technical advisor
* Translate customer requirements into solution designs, guiding them on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, and context configuration
* Develop and deliver technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, and hands\-on workshops tailored to customer needs
* Act as the customer’s technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering
* Collaborate with post\-sales teams to ensure a smooth handoff and successful customer onboarding
* Maintain deep knowledge of Cursor’s capabilities and competitive landscape to position our value effectively
* Support strategic account planning and help drive expansion opportunities with technical validation


**You may be a fit if**
* You have strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs.
* You have a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, modern engineering org structures, and developer productivity challenges
* You have hands\-on technical ability, and while you don’t need to be a full\-time engineer, but you should be fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and debugging complex environments
* You are customer\-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact
* You have experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre\-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software
* You thrive in a startup environment: resourceful, adaptable, and proactive in creating solutions

title: Founders office
description:
Founder’s Office – Strategy, Business Development \& Operations
 



  





 KS Legal \& Associates \| Mumbai
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 KS Legal is looking for a highly driven, sharp and entrepreneurial individual to work directly with the Founder as part of the Founder’s Office.
 



  





 This is not a conventional desk job. We are looking for someone who can operate as an extension of the Founder someone who can think independently, manage people, build relationships, drive business, represent the firm professionally and take ownership of whatever needs to get done.
 



  





 The role will involve working across strategy, operations, client management, business development, PR, networking, presentations, research and special projects.
 



  





 You should be comfortable moving between a client meeting, a team discussion, a pitch presentation, a networking event and an internal operational issue and be able to handle each with confidence.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



  





 1\. Founder’s Office \& Execution
 



  





 \* Work closely with the Founder on day\-to\-day strategic and operational priorities.
 



 \* Convert the Founder’s ideas and discussions into actionable tasks and ensure timely execution.
 



 \* Follow up with internal teams, clients, external stakeholders and vendors.
 



 \* Manage multiple priorities simultaneously and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
 



 \* Identify problems independently and find solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
 



 \* Prepare briefs, reports, trackers, presentations and updates for the Founder.
 



 \* Assist with special projects and initiatives undertaken by the firm.
 



  





 2\. Team Management
 



  





 \* Coordinate and manage different teams and workstreams.
 



 \* Allocate and follow up on tasks and monitor timelines.
 



 \* Ensure accountability and execution across the team.
 



 \* Identify bottlenecks and escalate important issues to the Founder.
 



 \* Help create systems, processes and workflows to improve the firm’s efficiency.
 



 \* Maintain discipline around deadlines, deliverables and follow\-ups.
 



  





 3\. Business Development \& Client Acquisition
 



  





 \* Identify and develop potential clients and business opportunities.
 



 \* Build and maintain relationships with founders, promoters, CXOs, investors, professionals, companies and other relevant stakeholders.
 



 \* Assist in converting relationships and conversations into mandates.
 



 \* Research prospective clients and understand their business and legal requirements.
 



 \* Participate in client meetings and business discussions.
 



 \* Prepare pitches, proposals, credentials and presentations.
 



 \* Follow up on leads, proposals and prospective mandates.
 



 \* Develop new channels for business generation and strategic partnerships.
 



 \* Represent KS Legal at networking events, conferences and industry forums.
 



  





 4\. Client Relationship Management
 



  





 \* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
 



 \* Understand client requirements and coordinate internally to ensure effective delivery.
 



 \* Track important client conversations, follow\-ups and opportunities.
 



 \* Ensure a high\-quality client experience.
 



 \* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships.
 



  





 5\. PR, Media \& Brand Building
 



  





 \* Work with the Founder and external/internal PR teams on the firm’s positioning and visibility.
 



 \* Identify relevant media opportunities, publications, interviews, panels and speaking opportunities.
 



 \* Assist with journalist outreach and PR pitching.
 



 \* Coordinate thought\-leadership opportunities for the Founder and the firm.
 



 \* Help develop content, presentations, articles, opinions and other external communications.
 



 \* Track relevant industry conversations and identify opportunities for KS Legal to participate.
 



  





 6\. Presentations \& Communication
 



  





 \* Create high\-quality presentations, pitch decks, business proposals and internal presentations.
 



 \* Assist the Founder in preparing for important meetings, pitches and speaking engagements.
 



 \* Develop clear and compelling written and verbal communication for clients and external stakeholders.
 



 \* Present confidently when required.
 



  





 7\. Research \& Strategic Projects
 



  





 \* Conduct business, industry, competitor and market research.
 



 \* Track developments relevant to the firm’s practice areas and clients.
 



 \* Identify new sectors, industries and opportunities for the firm.
 



 \* Assist in developing new practice areas, initiatives and business strategies.
 



 \* Prepare concise research notes and actionable insights for the Founder.
 



  





 8\. Travel \& External Representation
 



  





 \* Travel with the Founder or independently for client meetings, conferences, networking events and business development initiatives, as required.
 



 \* Represent KS Legal professionally in meetings and external events.
 



 \* Coordinate logistics and preparation for meetings, events and travel.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for an owner, not an order\-taker.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be:
 



  





 \* Highly proactive and self\-driven.
 



 \* Extremely organised and excellent at follow\-ups.
 



 \* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and demanding environment.
 



 \* Strong in communication, presentation and relationship\-building.
 



 \* Commercially aware and interested in business development.
 



 \* Confident interacting with senior professionals, founders, CXOs and clients.
 



 \* Comfortable managing teams and holding people accountable.
 



 \* Excellent at preparing presentations and written material.
 



 \* Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
 



 \* Someone who can independently take a problem, figure out what needs to be done and execute it.
 



 \* Presentable, professional and confident in external interactions.
 



 \* Willing to travel and attend meetings/events when required.
 



 \* Someone who genuinely enjoys networking, meeting people and building relationships.
 



  





 The Most Important Quality
 



  





 You should not need to be told what to do at every step.
 



  





 If the Founder says, “We should explore this client / event / opportunity,” you should be able to research it, identify the right people, initiate contact, prepare the pitch, coordinate the meeting, follow up and report back — without needing instructions for every individual step.
 



  





 Who This Role Is For
 



  





 This role would suit someone who wants exposure to business, law, entrepreneurship, strategy, leadership and client management rather than being restricted to one functional role.
 



  





 You will work closely with the Founder and get a first\-hand view of how a professional services business is built, managed and scaled.
 



  





 Experience
 



  





 Any level of experience preferred, although exceptional candidates from consulting, business development, startups, professional services, PR, strategy, law or similar backgrounds may be considered.
 



  





 A legal background is not mandatory.
 



  





 What matters more is intelligence, ownership, communication, commercial instinct, execution ability and the ability to build relationships.
 



  





 Location
 



  





 Mumbai
 



  





 The role will involve regular interaction with the Founder, team members, clients and external stakeholders, along with travel and attendance at meetings/events as required.
 



  





 What We Expect
 



  





 \* High ownership
 



 \* Strong work ethic
 



 \* Excellent follow\-through
 



 \* Confidentiality and discretion
 



 \* Professionalism
 



 \* Attention to detail
 



 \* Speed of execution
 



 \* Ability to prioritise
 



 \* Strong relationship\-building skills
 



 \* Willingness to do whatever is required to get the job done
 



  





 What You Can Expect
 



  





 \* Direct exposure to the Founder and leadership of the firm.
 



 \* Significant responsibility and autonomy.
 



 \* Exposure to high\-value clients and business relationships.
 



 \* Opportunity to participate in business development, strategy, PR and growth initiatives.
 



 \* A fast\-learning environment with substantial ownership.
 



 \* Opportunity to grow into a senior leadership/business role within the organisation.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who wants to build, not simply execute a job description.

title: Assistant Manager – Business Operations & Lender Partnerships
description:
**Manager / Assistant Manager – Business Operations \& Lender Partnerships** 




**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
 



**Function:** 
 Business Operations
 



**Industry:** 
 Fintech / Digital Lending / NBFC / Banking
 



**Reporting:** 
 Senior Management
   





**About Supermoney** 




 Supermoney is an enterprise\-led Supply Chain Finance platform working with large corporate anchors, their MSME dealer/vendor ecosystems, and multiple banks and NBFCs.
 



 We manage the operating layer across anchor programmes, borrower acquisition, lender coordination, credit movement, limit activation and utilisation. The role therefore sits at the intersection of
 **business, credit and execution** 
 .
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a high\-ownership Business Operations professional who can act as the execution bridge between
 **Sales, Credit, Operations, Anchors and our lending partners** 
 .
 



 This is not a conventional back\-office operations or MIS role.
 



 The person will own the movement of business from
 **opportunity → lender allocation → credit evaluation → sanction → limit activation → utilisation** 
 , identify bottlenecks before they become escalations, and help management improve conversion, turnaround times and lender performance.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable getting into individual cases when required while simultaneously maintaining a portfolio\-level view of pipelines, lender capacity, ageing and operational priorities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Lender \& Case Execution** 



* Own day\-to\-day business coordination across Supermoney's active banks and NBFC partners.
* Drive cases from initial lender allocation through credit evaluation, sanction, documentation, limit activation and first utilisation.
* Maintain disciplined follow\-up on lender queries, approvals and pending actions, with clear ownership and escalation.
* Ensure Sales and lender pendencies are identified and acted upon within agreed TATs, with a target of
 **95%\+ actionable items addressed within 48 hours** 
 .
* Track lender\-wise available capacity, NTB appetite, programme limits, policy changes and operational constraints so that cases are routed appropriately.
* Identify sanctioned\-but\-not\-live and live\-but\-not\-utilised cases and drive them to commercial closure.



  





**2\. Pre\-Sales \& Case Quality** 



* Conduct an initial business and documentation review of
 **non\-FLDG cases** 
 before submission to lending partners.
* Assess whether the case is broadly aligned with the relevant lender programme/policy and ensure basic documentation readiness.
* Work with Sales and Credit to close obvious gaps before lender submission, thereby reducing avoidable queries and rework.
* Build institutional knowledge of lender appetite, credit filters and common rejection/deviation themes to improve sourcing quality and conversion.



**This role will not independently underwrite or sanction credit; final credit decisions remain with the relevant lending institution / Credit team.** 




  





**3\. Anchor Programme Operations** 



* Own business operations for assigned anchor programmes, initially including Supermoney's IT/ITES and other key enterprise relationships.
* Coordinate across the Anchor, lender, Sales, Credit and internal Operations teams to ensure smooth onboarding and programme execution.
* Track programme\-level pipeline, sanctions, activations, utilisation and unresolved issues.
* Act as the central internal owner for operational escalations affecting an assigned programme.
* Support activation and scaling of new anchor\-lender programmes once commercial and credit structures have been agreed.



  





**4\. Business Control Tower \& MIS** 



* Maintain a single, accurate view of the business pipeline across stages including:
* Pre\-sales / documentation
* Login
* Credit WIP / lender queries
* Awaiting sanction
* Sanctioned
* Processing fee / documentation pending
* Limit activation pending
* Live but undisbursed
* Utilisation
* Monitor ageing at every stage and highlight exceptions rather than merely reporting totals.
* Prepare concise daily/weekly management dashboards covering lender TATs, programme performance, bottlenecks, conversion and actions required.
* Ensure CRM and business trackers remain aligned and materially accurate.
* Gradually help reduce manual reporting by working with Product/Data teams to systemise recurring MIS.



  





**5\. Lender \& Programme Performance** 



* Track lender\-wise conversion, sanction TAT, activation TAT, utilisation and key reasons for rejection/pendency.
* Identify cases where lender performance, programme structure or internal processes are constraining business.
* Provide management with actionable observations such as:
* cases that can be moved to alternate lenders;
* programmes where available limits are underutilised;
* recurring policy/deviation issues;
* anchor programmes requiring intervention; and
* bottlenecks preventing sanctioned limits from generating AUM.



  





**6\. Policy, Deviation \& Incentive Roll\-outs** 



* Coordinate implementation of lender/programme deviation matrices, sourcing filters and business incentive structures.
* Ensure changes are clearly communicated to the relevant Sales and Operations teams.
* Maintain current versions of programme\-level operating guidelines and key lender requirements.



  





**7\. Cross\-functional \& Strategic Execution** 



* Work closely with Sales, Credit, Operations, Finance, Product and senior management on high\-priority business initiatives.
* Take ownership of short\-cycle projects and management priorities where strong coordination and execution are required.
* Build processes where recurring activities currently depend on individual follow\-up or manual intervention.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The person should be able to independently:
 


* Run the lender/business operating rhythm without senior\-management intervention on routine matters.
* Maintain high visibility on every material case and programme bottleneck.
* Ensure \>95% of actionable Sales/lender pendencies are addressed within agreed TAT.
* Reduce ageing between sanction and limit activation.
* Improve quality of cases reaching lending partners.
* Improve conversion of sanctioned limits into active/utilised AUM.
* Produce concise, accurate management MIS with clear actions—not simply data.
* Become the internal go\-to person for understanding where each key lender programme and business pipeline stands.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 We would prefer candidates with
 **2–5 years of experience** 
 in one or more of the following environments:

title: Category Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind –
 


1. Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
2. Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
3. Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry



**About the Role \& Team** 



* The Category Manager is responsible for driving on\-ground operations. This would primarily involve onboarding new partners and improving the quality of the existing partner base
* This includes end\-to\-end ownership of the initiative, including problem solving, analysis, process improvement, and execution
* Support Business Heads in BAU category management activities related to supply/demand planning, revenue planning



**What you’ll Do:** 



* Drive onboarding of great service professionals in the category – involves thinking through the full supply chain – sourcing, selection, and training of partners.
* Be part of projects that are focused on improving customer and partner experience
* Collaborate with cross\-functional internal partners in marketing, technology, and product to execute multiple category and central\-level projects



**What we need:** 



* Sharp and hungry professionals willing to go above and beyond to create impact
* 6 months –2 years of work experience
* Proficient in advanced Excel/ SQL/ Tableau/Power BI
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, requires solving ambiguous problems, and is highly outcome\-oriented. We will look for candidates who display these characteristics and demonstrate the ability to solve problems on the ground.
* Hustle and get things done attitude



**What can you expect:** 



* A great work environment with massive ownership and growth opportunities.
* Work closely with strong leaders who are amongst the best in the country when it comes to operational excellence and consumer obsession
* A lot of freedom and ownership to propose and change the way we do things. We still believe it is Day 0 and are hungry to improve and change
* Growth opportunities within UC via our robust internal mobility program



  





 At Urban Company, we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, color, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

**Company Description** 




 Idea Simplified is an event platform company focused on creating credible, high\-impact experiences that unite industry and technology leaders, policymakers, start\-ups, and academia. We design C\-level events powered by cutting\-edge content and immersive formats — conferences, exhibitions, roadshows, round\-tables, business matchmaking, investor connects, hackathons, and industry whitepapers. With a strong emphasis on bespoke solutions, we tailor each project to client needs and modern digital\-audience expectations, ensuring client vision and event execution stay closely aligned.
 



**Role Description** 




 The Head of Sales is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for driving revenue across Idea Simplified's owned industry platforms (IPs) and bespoke client events. This is not a single\-product sales role — you will own three distinct revenue streams: 
 **sponsorship \& exhibitor sales** 
 , 
 **delegate/ticket sales** 
 , and 
 **client/brand partnership deals** 
  for custom\-built events.
 



 You will build and run the sales function end\-to\-end: setting targets and pipelines across these streams, leading new business development for both owned IPs and client\-commissioned events, and ensuring sponsors, exhibitors and delegates return year after year — not just once. You will lead, mentor and evaluate a sales team spanning senior BD and telecalling, use data to sharpen targeting and pricing, and work closely with marketing to convert market visibility into actual bookings. You'll also represent Idea Simplified at industry events, stay close to market trends, and feed client/sponsor feedback into how we design future IPs.
 



**What you will own** 



* Sponsorship and exhibitor sales for owned industry platforms
* Delegate acquisition revenue and ticketing targets
* New business development for bespoke, client\-commissioned events
* Year\-on\-year sponsor and exhibitor retention (not just first\-time wins)
* Pricing, proposals and contract negotiation across all three revenue streams
* Team leadership: hiring, coaching and performance management of BD and telecalling staff
* Sales\-marketing alignment to convert campaign visibility into pipeline
* Revenue forecasting and CRM/pipeline discipline



**Qualifications** 



* Proven experience selling into B2B events, media, exhibitions or a comparable high\-touch, relationship\-driven industry — not transactional/product sales
* Demonstrated ability to sell sponsorships and/or delegate seats for a conference, summit or platform (not just corporate accounts)
* Strong C\-level and senior\-stakeholder engagement — comfortable pitching CXOs, policymakers and industry leaders directly
* Team management experience: has built or led a sales team, not just carried an individual number
* Analytical rigor — can read pipeline data, market signals and past\-event performance to set realistic, aggressive targets
* Track record of meeting/exceeding revenue targets in a leadership capacity
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing or related field; MBA a plus
* Comfortable in a lean, founder\-led, fast\-moving environment



**Who Should NOT Apply** 



* Corporate sales background with no experience selling sponsorships, exhibitions or event\-based revenue
* Sales leaders who managed pipeline reporting without personal closing responsibility
* Experience limited to renewing accounts someone else originally won
* Looking for a large, well\-resourced team and slow\-moving approval chains

**Company Description** 
 PyraMed Telemedicine is a unique health\-tech portal and social healthcare venture that brings pediatric and adult specialty care to underserved regions through a customized telemedicine app. As a pioneer of the internationally acclaimed pyramidal Model of healthcare in India, the organization enables primary doctors to remain in control of patient care while collaborating seamlessly with specialists. Founded in 2020 by Dr. Ketan Parikh, a leading pediatric surgeon associated with several major hospitals in Mumbai, PyraMed integrates clinical expertise with technology to improve care delivery. The platform empowers doctors, enhances patient safety, and enriches the healthcare experience by making specialized care more affordable, accessible, accountable, and accurate for communities across the country.
 



 PyraMed is spreading its concept by offering franchise participation to hospitals in tier 2 and tier 3 cities so thatchy can digitally strengthen their hub and spoke network in their extended geographic regions and achieving a dual purpose of:
 


1. offering tele\-mentorship expertise of their medical specialists to their spoke clinics/ local doctors to help the patients under them for easy, timely expert opinion.
2. Enable direct counselling of the patients in the periphery to enable them to seek timely hospital support either for investigations / assessment or treatment.

title: Manager, Enterprise Partnership
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a
 **Manager – Agency Sales** 
 to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role at the intersection of
 **advertising, data, commerce and fintech** 
 . You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.
 



 The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency\-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




**Agency Relationship \& Business Development** 



* Build and own strategic relationships across leading agency networks, independent agencies and digital/performance agencies.
* Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders across
 **agency leadership, investment, planning, strategy, digital, performance and account management teams** 
 .
* Establish Razorpay Ads as a preferred partner for data\-led, commerce\-media and performance advertising solutions.
* Create agency\-level account plans covering priority agencies, key stakeholders, advertiser portfolios, opportunities and revenue potential.
* Drive regular agency engagements, capability sessions, workshops and joint client conversations.



**Advertiser \& Revenue Development** 



* Identify high\-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.
* Work with agency teams to understand advertiser objectives, media plans, campaign challenges and investment priorities.
* Convert agency relationships into
 **active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities** 
 .
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
* Drive penetration across priority categories including
 **BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories** 
 .
* Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.



**Consultative \& Solution Selling** 



* Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
* Position Razorpay’s transaction\-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
* Develop solutions spanning
 **audience intelligence, transaction\-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement** 
 .
* Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
* Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory\-led selling.



**Agency GTM** 



* Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
* Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for agency\-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
* Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
* Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.



**Campaign Success \& Account Growth** 



* Partner closely with Campaign Management, Product and Operations teams to ensure campaigns deliver against advertiser objectives.
* Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
* Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
* Build case studies and proof points that can accelerate adoption across the wider agency ecosystem.



**Market Intelligence \& Product Feedback** 



* Maintain a strong understanding of the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, agency structures, advertiser budgets and emerging media trends.
* Track competitive offerings across ad networks, commerce media, retail media, audience platforms and large digital publishers.
* Bring structured agency and advertiser feedback to Product, Strategy and Campaign teams.
* Help shape Razorpay Ads’ positioning, packaging, pricing and product roadmap based on market demand.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Success in this role will be measured primarily through:
 



**Agency penetration:** 
 Depth and quality of relationships across priority agencies and senior agency stakeholders.
 



**Active advertisers:** 
 Number of advertisers activated through the agency ecosystem.
 



**Quality advertisers:** 
 Ability to acquire strategic advertisers with meaningful and scalable budget potential.
 



**Advertiser retention:** 
 Repeat campaigns and continued investment from activated advertisers.
 



**Pipeline creation:** 
 Strength and quality of advertiser briefs and qualified opportunities generated through agencies.
 



**Revenue:** 
 Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue objectives.
 



**Strategic relationships:** 
 Ability to convert transactional agency relationships into long\-term partnerships.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **5–8 years of experience** 
 in agency sales, digital advertising, media sales, adtech, commerce media, publisher sales or related businesses.
* Strong existing relationships across
 **media agencies, digital agencies and/or performance agencies** 
 in India.
* Demonstrated experience selling digital advertising solutions through agencies and influencing advertiser budgets.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem including
 **Meta, Google, programmatic, publisher media, performance marketing and brand advertising** 
 .
* Ability to engage comfortably with stakeholders ranging from agency planners and account leads to Business Heads, Managing Partners and CXOs.
* Strong consultative selling and solutioning capabilities — able to start with a client problem rather than an inventory proposition.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience owning pipelines, negotiations and revenue targets.
* Good understanding of advertising metrics including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and brand/measurement metrics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and convert results into a compelling growth narrative.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in an early\-stage business where GTM playbooks are still being built.



  





**Strong Plus** 



* Experience working at an
 **ad network, large digital publisher, commerce/retail media network, DSP, adtech platform or agency partnership function** 
 .
* Existing relationships across leading agency networks and independent digital agencies.
* Experience selling to BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce or consumer internet advertisers.
* Experience selling both
 **performance and branding solutions** 
 .
* Exposure to first\-party data, audience intelligence, CDPs, clean rooms, retail/commerce media or transaction\-led advertising.
* Experience building a new agency channel or GTM motion from an early stage.



  





**The Person We’d Like to Hire** 




 We are looking for someone who is
 **well\-networked but not dependent on their network; commercially aggressive but consultative in approach; comfortable selling what exists today while helping shape what needs to be built tomorrow** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate understands how agencies operate, knows how budgets and briefs move through the ecosystem, can open senior\-level conversations, and has the persistence and strategic thinking required to turn those relationships into a sustainable revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

title: Manager Business Development - International Markets
description:
**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a commercially driven, curious and energetic Business Development Manager to own and grow a portfolio of international distributor and importer accounts across multiple geographies. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys building relationships, spotting opportunities and turning good conversations into great business. You will have clear ownership of your portfolio, with accountability for both sales targets and P\&L; while working closely with teams across the business to make things happen.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Own Your Portfolio:** 




 Take end\-to\-end ownership of a portfolio of distributor and importer accounts across multiple international markets. Build strong relationships, understand each partner’s business and create clear plans to grow the portfolio.
 



**Grow Existing Accounts:** 




 Look beyond the next order. Identify opportunities for repeat business, new product introductions, cross\-sell/up\-sell, better product mix and expansion into new channels or markets.
 



**Own the Numbers:** 




 Deliver agreed sales targets and stay close to the P\&L; of your accounts. Be comfortable discussing revenue, gross margin, contribution, pricing, discounts, trade terms, freight, marketing investments, payment terms and receivables.
 



**Hunt for New Business:** 




 Build a strong pipeline of distributors, importers and channel partners. Generate leads, qualify opportunities, make presentations, negotiate, close and turn new relationships into sustainable business.
 



**Understand the Market:** 




 Keep your eyes and ears open. Use customer conversations, market visits, industry networks and international travel to spot new markets, changing customer needs, competitive activity and opportunities for growth.
 



**Be the Customer’s Champion Internally:** 




 Understand customer demand and make sure the right teams know what is needed. Work closely with marketing, finance, supply chain, regulatory and product/R\&D; teams to deliver a smooth customer experience.
 



**Work Closely with Marketing:** 




 Bring customer and market insights to the marketing team and collaborate on launches, campaigns, product communication, samples, market activations and customer\-specific requirements.
 



**Negotiate with Confidence:** 




 Lead commercial conversations around pricing, margins, MOQs, payment terms, credit, exclusivity, marketing support, volume commitments and other account terms, while working within approved company frameworks.
 



**Make Trade Shows Count:** 




 Help plan and execute relevant international exhibitions and trade shows, including meeting schedules, samples, marketing materials and prospect engagement. Most importantly, turn conversations at the booth into qualified opportunities after the show.
 



**Travel \& Build Relationships:** 




 Travel internationally for customer meetings, distributor reviews, market visits, exhibitions and new business development. Be comfortable building genuine relationships across cultures and geographies.
 



**Plan Ahead:** 




 Maintain accurate forecasts and account plans, flag risks early and give the business clear visibility on expected orders, revenue and market developments.
 



**Stay Commercially Disciplined:** 




 Work with finance and customers to maintain healthy payment cycles, follow up on receivables and make sure growth is healthy as well as exciting.
 



**Share What You Learn:** 




 Bring customer feedback, competitor activity, pricing trends, category developments and emerging needs back to the wider team so that the business can move faster and smarter.
 



**Keep Things Moving:** 




 Maintain clear account, pipeline and activity records and provide regular updates on performance, opportunities, challenges and next steps.
 



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




 • 3–4 years of experience in international sales, business development or key account management, preferably working with distributors/importers.
 



 • Experience in nutraceuticals, sports nutrition, consumer health, FMCG, pharma, wellness, food \& beverage or related consumer categories is preferred.
 



 • Hands\-on experience working with customers across multiple countries, with a genuine willingness to travel internationally.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in business, International Business, Marketing, Commerce, Life Sciences or a related field. MBA is an advantage.
 



 • Fluent written and spoken English is a must.
 



  





**The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here** 




 • Commercially sharp, ambitious and hungry to grow.
 



 • Naturally good with people, with the confidence to build relationships and the humility to listen.
 



 • Energetic and proactive: someone who sees a problem and starts looking for a way through it.
 



 • Comfortable with numbers and genuinely interested in how the P\&L; works, not someone who leaves the spreadsheets to someone else.
 



 • Creative and resourceful when customers need solutions.
 



 • Resilient and persistent, especially when a promising deal takes longer than expected. International business occasionally enjoys testing human patience.
 



 • Collaborative and generous with knowledge, with a genuine willingness to support teammates and celebrate shared wins.
 



 • Curious about different markets, cultures, consumers and ways of doing business.
 



 • Passionate about building brands and businesses, while bringing kindness, respect and positive energy to the way they work.
 



  





**How Success Will Be Measured:** 




 Success in this role will be measured through a balanced combination of sales target achievement, portfolio revenue growth, account profitability/P\&L; performance, new business acquisition, qualified pipeline development, account retention, receivables discipline and forecast accuracy

description:
**About Reaviva Holistic Health** 




  





 Reaviva Holistic Health is a premium, science led wellness sanctuary in Santacruz West, Mumbai, offering integrated solutions across aesthetics, fitness, recovery, nutrition and mental well\-being. We are committed to personalised care and an exceptional client experience in a sophisticated environment.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We are looking for an Associate Sales Manager to own client conversion at the clinic. You will work the enquiry pipeline across telephone, WhatsApp and digital channels, qualify every lead, and convert enquiries into booked consultations and consultations into treatment packages.
 



  





 This is a client facing position at the centre of the business. You will carry an individual revenue target, and you will also be the first point of contact for clients arriving at the clinic, managing the appointment book and the client experience alongside your pipeline. The role suits someone equally confident receiving a client in person and closing a package on the telephone.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Place outbound calls to new leads within the agreed response time, and complete the full follow up cadence for enquiries that do not connect at the first attempt
 



 2\. Respond to enquiries across calls, WhatsApp and direct messages, progressing the pipeline through the working day
 



 3\. Manage incoming calls and walk in enquiries with the same qualification discipline applied to digital leads
 



 4\. Qualify enquiries through structured discovery and convert them into booked consultations
 



 5\. Improve the booked to attended ratio through timely reminders, rapport building and pre consultation preparation
 



 6\. Prepare clients ahead of their consultation and hand over to the clinical team with complete context, so that every consultation begins informed
 



 7\. Introduce complementary services where relevant to the client, and book consultations for the clinical team to advise and recommend
 



 8\. Conduct structured reach out campaigns to dormant client segments and contribute to monthly reactivation revenue
 



 9\. Record every client interaction, update enquiry stages promptly, and maintain database accuracy to the required standard
 



  





 Client experience at the clinic
 



  





 10\. Receive clients on arrival with the warmth and polish of a luxury wellness environment, manage the appointment book, and keep waiting times minimal and clearly communicated
 



 11\. Process billing and payments accurately, and record every amount received against the correct client, service and package
 



 12\. Coordinate between clients, therapists and doctors so that each day runs to schedule and every transition between services is seamless
 



 13\. Operate the clinic management system accurately and in real time across appointments, client records, billing and packages
 



 14\. Maintain the reception area, displays and client facing materials to the standard of the brand
 



 15\. Uphold the confidentiality, discretion and presentation standards expected of a premium clinical environment
 



  





 Performance and standards
 



  





 16\. Submit a daily performance update and participate in weekly funnel reviews with the sales team
 



 17\. Deliver against monthly performance targets covering revenue contribution, enquiry connection, qualification, consultation bookings, attendance rate, walk in conversion and database reactivation
 



 18\. Represent Reaviva in a manner that is informed, courteous and consultative at all times
 



  





 Requirements
 



  





 Two to four years in a client facing sales role within luxury services, wellness, aesthetics, hospitality or premium retail
 



  





 A record of carrying an individual revenue target, supported by specific examples of what was achieved and how
 



  





 Hands on working experience with an operational clinic, spa or salon management system such as Zenoti, covering appointment scheduling, client records, billing and package management. Working knowledge of a sales CRM is a further advantage
 



  





 Excellent spoken English, delivered with clarity, warmth and conviction
 



  





 Excellent written communication in English across WhatsApp and email, together with correct telephone etiquette
 



  





 A consultative approach to selling, based on establishing trust rather than applying pressure
 



  





 Willingness to work at the clinic and in front of clients for the full working day
 



  





 The ability to manage concurrent responsibilities, attending to a client in person while progressing follow ups, without compromising either
 



  





 Accuracy and discipline in billing, cash handling and record keeping
 



  





 A composed and presentable manner, particularly at times of high footfall
 



  





 A structured approach to problem solving where process is still being established
 



  





 Resilience and consistency in a target led environment with weekly reporting
 



  





 Preferred Background
 



  





 Client servicing or guest relations experience in a premium hotel, spa or clinic, followed by a move into a selling role, is the strongest background for this position. Candidates from luxury brands, wellness, beauty or aesthetics are equally encouraged to apply, and prior exposure to high net worth clientele in a service led environment will be considered a significant advantage. Candidates whose experience is limited to telephone based inside sales may find this position less suitable.
 



  





 What We Offer
 



  





 A front line position in a growing premium wellness brand, with ownership of the client experience from first contact to closed package
 



  





 A monthly incentive linked to revenue, in addition to fixed compensation
 



  





 A defined progression path to senior and leadership positions for consistent performers
 



  





 A collaborative working environment with direct access to leadership
 



  





 Additional Details
 



  





 Location: Santacruz West, Linking Road, Mumbai
 



  





 Working Hours: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
 



  





 Working Pattern: Full time and on site, six days a week with one weekly off on rotation. The clinic is open all days
 



  





 Start Date: Immediate
 



  





 Compensation: Discussed at interview
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Please apply through LinkedIn with your curriculum vitae and a brief covering note. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an on site discussion.

**Summary**
 Imagine what you could do here. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionised entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry\-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. Our Apple Business and Education team supports our enterprises, governments, and educational institutions in transforming the way employees work and students learn. To realise this goal, we gain a deep understanding of the sectors we engage with—at all levels, from strategic to tactical. We create a vision that inspires our customers to transform their workplaces and campuses using the Apple ecosystem. We collaborate closely with internal and external partners to implement solutions and new use cases.
   

  

 As the Team Leader for our Field Engineers in India, you will lead, develop, and grow a world\-class expert team that solves technical and business problems to ensure success for Apple, our partners, and our customers. As a team of subject matter experts in India, you and your team will provide technical pre\-sales consulting with the goal of transforming the way people teach, learn, and work. Our team of Field Engineers helps to ensure the technical integrity of platforms, solutions, and apps developed for our customers to maximise the value of their investments in Apple products and services. You will also be a critical part of the India leadership team for business and education markets. You will work closely with worldwide and regional leadership and country teams, and you will serve as a thought leader for our strategic partners and alliances. This position will be located in Bangalore, Delhi, or Mumbai.
   

  

**Description**
 We are looking for an exceptional leader who will:
   

  

 Lead and develop a team of senior Field Engineers, focusing on developing strategies and plans to influence enterprises, governments, and educational institutions to invest in Apple technology while maximising the value for those investing in our ecosystem.
   

  

 Represent Apple by engaging with key executive stakeholders at our major customers and partners.
   

  

 Develop and implement strategies to position Apple technology effectively, and cultivate and leverage a robust ecosystem of partners.
   

  

 Establish relationships and partner with executive leadership at our strategic partners and solution providers.
   

  

 Provide technical leadership and consulting to the Apple sales teams, partners, and customers as you influence executives, faculty, and technical staff in a pre\-sales capacity.
   

  

 Architect, validate, demonstrate, and sell complete Apple hardware, software, and services solutions.
   

  

 Represent and advocate for India's technical priorities to internal stakeholders across Product Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Services organisations, establishing yourself as an expert and partner in a global organisation.

 s the creator of NonaShield, the world’s first unified mobile security infrastructure designed to deliver end\-to\-end protection in a single solution. Instead of relying on multiple point tools, NonaShield secures the full mobile lifecycle through one integrated engine. The platform also provides network security, identity protection, and backend defense, helping organizations strengthen their mobile security posture.  We are seeking a
 **Quota\-Crushing Enterprise Sales Partner**

 This role is tailored for an independent dealmaker who rejects bureaucratic 12\-month sales cycles and thrives on executing fast 2\-to\-4\-week mid\-market closures. You will leverage a frictionless 14\-day "Shadow Mode" PoC to prove value on day one and earn high\-percentage deal commissions and milestone equity perks.
 



 Key Responsibilities

 Source, negotiate, and close high\-velocity enterprise deals across our two core channels:
* **Channel A (Digital Lending \& NBFCs):** 
 Solve synthetic loan origination, emulator farms, and first\-payment defaults.

 Target RMG, Neo banking, Crypto, and Consumer, gaming, eCommerce , payment , upi Apps to eliminate multi\-accounting, bot farms, and location spoofing.

 Orchestrate lightweight 14\-day passive SDK audits that surface actual emulator and tampering leaks in client staging/production traffic, converting them directly into commercial agreements.



  




* **Displace Legacy Competitors:** 
 Out position browser\-heuristic fingerprinting and monolithic compliance wrappers by demonstrating sub\-15ms client latency, zero user friction, and unforgeable hardware\-backed attestation.

 Structure flexible rolling monthly and annual agreements to eliminate legal and procurement friction.

 8\+ years of experience selling software/infrastructure in Indian banking technology, payment rails (UPI, PG/PA, Switch), or cybersecurity.

**Global Trade Solutions** 
 ( GTS)
   

  

 Global Trade Solutions comprises over 4,500 people across more than 60 countries, helping suppliers and buyers with their export and import finance needs. Trade is where HSBC began in 1865, when we financed commerce between Europe, North America and Asia.
   

  

**Role Purpose**

* They will develop new revenue streams by identifying and selling innovative GTS solutions to a portfolio of clients thus maximizing commercial profitability and relationship depth. This will include responsibility for pricing, reviewing and negotiating the full range of GTS services together with effecting any cost reduction initiatives required by the Group.
* Drives best practice in lending and risk policies ensuring this remains in line with economic and market practices


**Impact on the Business**
* To manage a client portfolio in order to maintain existing and generate new income for the business. Undertake sector/portfolio planning and client monitoring/contact
* Develop effective strategies for maintaining and growing a client portfolio in order to maintain and generate new income for the Group. This will involve initiatives such as sector planning and client/contact monitoring to ensure efforts and support GTS business objective
* Manage portfolio customers and follow end to end CM process as defined by Business Development Transformation
* To manage costs within plan, keep losses to a minimum and identify any cost reduction initiatives.
* Work closely with colleagues to promote awareness of GTS products, strategies and competitor information amongst the RM and other strategic business communities.
* Maintain awareness of the applicable regulatory and business environment: understand audit, tax and legal implications and changes as they affect he customers and the Bank.


**Customers / Stakeholders**
* Develop an appropriate calling plan to efficiently and effectively achieve goals and objectives. Through consultative selling, design and implement workable, innovative solutions for customers individual needs plus generate and receive quality referrals for/from other parts of the Group.
* Where appropriate undertake professional presentations etc. to customers in support of potential opportunities portraying HSBC in the best possible light against a backdrop of competition from local, regional and/or global banks.

* By matching customers’ requirements in response to proposal requests (RFP’s etc.)
* Provision of appropriate strategic business ideas based on awareness of market and industry initiatives and customer feedback. Sharing of best practices and to the overall direction of GTS regional and global business.


**Leadership \& Teamwork**

* Demonstrating excellence in sales and following end to end sales process as defined internally
* Be self\-motivated and achieve results in the face of setbacks
* Keep management informed of progress/obstacles towards sales targets
* Establish an interactive dialogue process with Risk Management teams in order to build a sustainable asset growth
* By demonstrating and sharing best practices with colleagues.
* Sharing of feedback to appropriate stakeholders and colleagues
* By provision of commentary to team leader, senior client management, product and sales etc.


**Operational Effectiveness \& Control**

* Ensure all CM Sales activity documentation is complete to provide performance tracking and targeting future sales efforts
* Continually assess the CM Sales processes to identify improvements
* Keep Team leader informed of any obstacles, issues etc.
* Compliance with and management of sales suitability risks and requirements
* Ensure all completed sales and prospecting activity documentation is appropriately completed, approved and stored to provide performance tracking, targeted future sales efforts and compliance with sales and transactional suitability guidelines and requirements
* Monitors own completion of mandatory training
* No unknown crisis issues
* Liaise with Client Service Teams, CoE inclusive, to certify a deliver an outstanding services to clients


**Major Challenges**
* Drive sales from existing clients and manage attrition
* Managing multiple time sensitive tasks
* Constantly evaluate \- Customer banking practices and trends in the market, GTS systems and techniques employed and the competitive market place.
* Adapting to a fast pace work environment and continually changing lines of communication, technological advances etc
* Ensuring RM community is sufficiently knowledgeable with GTS products/services/ regulation and having confidence they are able to continually apply this knowledge to their client base


**Role Context**
* GTS is a key strategic business for the HSBC Group under Corporate and Institutional Banking ( CIB) and its history is mixed with almost 150 years of Group history. HSBC is recognized worldwide as “the World's leading and largest trade bank and a Leading player in the receivables finance market” and its global leadership is unquestionable.
* Through capitalizing on the Group’s international network and on the regional expertise, GTS India not only consistently holds an important status internally as a reliable and relevant income generator as well externally receiving formal market recognition.

**Management of Risk**

* The jobholder will also continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology. Additionally they will ensure they effectively manage sales suitability, money laundering, counter terrorist financing, fraud, and reputational risk.
